title: Chinese V American Views On WAR With Taiwan | Armstrong Economics
summary: [![Image 1: China v Taiwan 3](https://www.armstrongeconomics.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/02/China-v-Taiwan-3.jpg?w=300)](https://www.armstrongeconomics.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/02/China-v-Taiwan-3.jpg) The Center for Strategic and Intern
content:
[![Image 1: China v Taiwan 3](https://www.armstrongeconomics.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/02/China-v-Taiwan-3.jpg?w=300)](https://www.armstrongeconomics.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/02/China-v-Taiwan-3.jpg)

The Center for Strategic and International Studies conducted an extraordinary survey of 64 leading experts on China, Taiwan, and cross-Strait relations, including 28 former senior U.S. government officials, 23 former government policy and intelligence analysts, and 13 academics and think-tank experts. What their answers reveal is not that China is preparing to invade Taiwan tomorrow, as the neocons would like everyone to believe, but that Beijing remains willing to wait so long as nobody crosses the line of formal Taiwanese independence. Some [**84% said Beijing is willing to wait for unification**](https://chinapower.csis.org/survey-experts-china-approach-to-taiwan/ "84% said Beijing is willing to wait for unification") but will not accept the status quo permanently, while only 10% believed China seeks unification at the earliest opportunity. Not one of the 64 experts believed Beijing would ever accept an independent Taiwan.

This is precisely why Taiwan has become so dangerous. The West keeps portraying the conflict as if Xi Jinping wakes up every morning staring at a calendar trying to decide when to launch an amphibious invasion. Yet 83% of these experts said China did not plan to use significant kinetic force against Taiwan by 2027, and 80% said China’s enormous 2022 military exercises did not indicate Beijing had accelerated its timetable. Only 6% of respondents outside the former senior government group saw 2027 as a hard deadline, while not one former senior U.S. official did. The obsession with 2027 has nevertheless become extremely useful for the military establishment because every supposed deadline becomes another justification for weapons, deployments, bases, and spending.

The survey found that 44% believed Beijing has a hard deadline of 2049, the centennial of the People’s Republic, while 42% believed China could wait indefinitely provided unification remains possible. This is an important distinction because China thinks in terms of generations while Western politicians think in terms of the next election. Beijing does not need to invade Taiwan if economic, political, and military pressure can gradually change the situation in its favor. Only 20% of those surveyed believed China even possessed a coherent roadmap for peaceful unification, which tells us this is not some perfectly scripted invasion plan sitting in Xi’s desk drawer.

[![Image 2: TaiwanMagnified](https://www.armstrongeconomics.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/TaiwanMagnified.jpg?w=300)](https://www.armstrongeconomics.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/TaiwanMagnified.jpg)

Where the numbers become alarming is not an unprovoked invasion but what happens when politicians begin crossing China’s red lines. More than three-quarters of the experts, 77%, believed China would invade within six months if Taiwan formally declared independence. Among former senior U.S. officials, that number was 79%. Even some of those who did not expect an immediate invasion believed Beijing would respond with a blockade or enormous military exercises. This is why politicians encouraging Taiwan toward formal independence are playing with the lives of 23 million people. They can deliver all the speeches they want about democracy from Washington, London, or Brussels, but they will not be the civilians sitting underneath the missiles if their political experiment goes wrong.

Not one expert believed an explicit American commitment to defend Taiwan would cause China to invade immediately, but 64% believed Beijing would respond strongly enough to provoke a U.S.-China or China-Taiwan crisis, while another 31% expected a more limited negative response. Only two of the 64 experts believed formally committing America to Taiwan’s defense would actually deter China from using force because Beijing already assumes that the United States will intervene anyway.

A direct invasion is not even the most likely path toward conflict. Only 8% of the experts described an amphibious invasion within ten years as likely, while 63% called it possible and 27% unlikely. Force short of invasion received much higher probabilities, with 52% saying deliberate escalation such as a blockade was likely or very likely. An accidental military incident was considered even more dangerous, with 34% saying a collision or accident around the Taiwan Strait was likely and another 22% calling it very likely. When warships and aircraft from opposing nuclear powers continually operate around the same small body of water, war does not require some grand master plan. It requires one mistake followed by politicians who refuse to back down.

A later CSIS survey of American and Taiwanese experts reinforces that point. Roughly 90% of U.S. experts and 62% of Taiwanese experts believed China already possessed the capability to impose a law-enforcement-led quarantine that substantially reduces trade into Taiwan. Around 80% of American experts and 60% of Taiwanese experts believed Beijing could execute a PLA [**blockade**](https://chinapower.csis.org/data/survey-results-chinas-approach-to-taiwan/ "blockade"), while Taiwanese experts were considerably more skeptical that China could successfully carry out an invasion. If Beijing wanted to coerce Taiwan during the following five years, experts considered a quarantine the most likely option. If China decided it wanted immediate unification, however, approximately 80% regarded a highly kinetic joint blockade as likely or very likely.

[![Image 3: Taiwan ECM 2](https://www.armstrongeconomics.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/05/Taiwan-ECM-2.jpg?w=300)](https://www.armstrongeconomics.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/05/Taiwan-ECM-2.jpg)

This is where the economic consequences become enormous because Taiwan does not need to be invaded for the world economy to be thrown into chaos. A quarantine or blockade would immediately threaten shipping, insurance, semiconductor supply chains, electronics, automobiles, communications equipment, and virtually every modern industry dependent upon advanced chips. The later CSIS survey found most American and Taiwanese experts did not believe Taiwan could withstand a Chinese blockade for longer than three months without substantial U.S. intervention. Washington would then face the decision nobody wants to discuss honestly: accept China’s blockade or attempt to break it militarily and risk direct war between two nuclear powers.

Taiwan is also the world’s semiconductor pressure point. The island’s importance to advanced chip manufacturing means a serious blockade would not remain a regional event. Factories thousands of miles away could discover that a conflict they thought had nothing to do with them suddenly prevents them from obtaining critical components. Markets would begin repricing the risk immediately, shipping premiums would explode, companies would scramble for inventory, and governments would discover once again how fragile global supply chains have become. This is why capital will react long before politicians formally declare that a war has begun.

What I find particularly revealing in the later CSIS survey is the difference between American confidence and Taiwanese confidence in Washington. An astonishing 96% of American experts were completely or moderately confident that the United States would intervene militarily if China invaded Taiwan during the following five years. Taiwanese experts were less confident in American intervention and considerably less confident that U.S. allies would join the fight. It is always easier for people thousands of miles away to be certain about somebody else’s war.

This is precisely why Taiwan remains one of the critical geopolitical pressure points as we move toward 2029. The danger is not simply that China arbitrarily decides to invade. The greater danger is escalation, miscalculation, political promises that cannot be withdrawn, and Western policymakers convincing themselves that every additional provocation somehow produces deterrence. China has made its position on formal independence perfectly clear, and even the experts inside the Western foreign-policy establishment overwhelmingly acknowledge that Beijing would react with force if that line were crossed.

If Taiwan declares formal independence, 77% of the experts surveyed believed China would invade within six months. That is not a statistic policymakers should treat as another war-game scenario. It is a warning about what happens when politicians deliberately remove the ambiguity that has helped keep the peace.

## 第十八章 毛澤東陰施借刀計 彭德懷派兵斬袁王

話說朱德、毛澤東會師井岡山後，彼此產生諸多矛盾。由於周恩來的介入，毛澤東重新當選為第四軍前委書記，兩人爭執暫時平息。但中共本是個以鬥爭立黨的組織，它不會停止鬥爭的。

前文講到，因中共中央關於土匪的極端政策，毛澤東提議讓袁文才任第四軍副參謀長，跟隨紅四軍南下，暫時沒有對袁文才採取「極端手段」。

有一天，袁文才來到前委祕書長劉輝霄處。見門敞開著，沒通報就進去了。他四處觀看，突然桌子上一份文件，一行醒目的標題──「與土匪的關係」吸引了他。他屏住呼吸，飛快地讀了下去。這一讀不要緊，袁倒吸一口涼氣，頓覺寒徹肌骨，彷彿掉進了冰窖，一屁股跌坐在地上。聽到響聲的劉輝霄急忙出來，看到袁文才的表情，即刻明白了。

不知此刻袁文才是啥心情：為了毛澤東，為了共產黨，他把什麼都豁出去了，到頭來還是不被信任。其實袁文才沒有真正認清共產黨是什麼東西，不知道共產革命是多麼殘酷：像他這樣的土匪，是中共認定的階級異己分子，不管你曾經為其做過什麼，中共遲早要翻臉，要算賬的。

袁、劉默坐一陣，袁文才怏怏告退。此後，那份文件像噩夢一樣在他腦海中揮之不去。終於有一天，他以「到哪裡革命都一樣」為由，決心再回到自己的部隊去，遂將一張「告假條」放在軍部，拉上劉輝霄、謝桂標等人，趁著黑夜悄悄離開部隊，趕往井岡山。

聞聽袁文才不告而別，毛澤東迅即召開前委會，並嚴肅道：「此例不可開。這是臨陣逃跑、目無軍法的表現，這也表明像袁文才這樣的土匪最終還是靠不住的，必須嚴肅處理。」

朱德緩緩說道：「袁文才所犯錯誤是嚴重的。但考慮到他身後還有隊伍，處理方式要得當，防止出現不可控的狀況。」

毛澤東也陷入沉思。從他內心來講，是支持「六大」決議的：共產黨、紅軍確實需要純潔自己的隊伍，這也是毛澤東從事農運工作時的一貫主張。他從內心也看不起土匪出身的袁、王。尤其是袁文才，身上確實有一些「匪氣」。從純潔黨的隊伍出發，應除掉為宜。

離開井岡山之前，毛澤東專門給彭德懷安排：「袁文才這個人很狡猾，很有心計，你要多注意他的舉動。雖然前委沒有立即執行中央決議，但要見機行事，關鍵時刻要果斷。」實際是給了彭德懷尚方寶劍。毛還囑咐：「井岡山土籍、客籍矛盾極深，但土籍代表更多、更貧苦的農民，關鍵時刻還是更放心一些。」

毛澤東提出的井岡山土籍、客籍之事，是指井岡山土籍人與客籍人的矛盾之爭。土籍是指井岡山原居民，人數眾多，但經濟條件較差，中共黨員也比較多。而客籍人數相對較少，但經濟條件較好，且有不少富商，掌握一定地方權力。故黨內有種說法：「土籍的黨，客籍的槍」。客家、土家矛盾淵源極深，為了化解他們之間的矛盾，毛澤東曾嚴厲批評龍超清、袁文才：「共產黨不分國界省界，不分籍貫地界，群眾不懂，難道你們也不懂？虧你們都是黨的負責幹部！……消除土、客籍矛盾，應當首先從黨內開始，道理已經說得夠明白了。哪個以後還要搞土、客籍爭端，組織上對他不客氣！」

但從中共的觀念看，土籍是更可靠的革命力量，而客籍則是可以聯合的力量，關鍵時候就可以過河拆橋、卸磨殺驢，以免給中共革命造成危害。

經過深思熟慮之後，毛澤東提議：袁文才逃跑之事交給湘贛特委處理。

這是個令人費解的安排。毛澤東十分清楚：湘贛特委由土家族把持，和袁文才之間的矛盾很深。連續三屆特委書記楊開明、鄧乾元、朱昌偕都跟袁勢同水火：楊開明因毛、賀結婚之事遷怒於袁文才；鄧乾元臨走之時，向中央寫信匯報：「袁、王現在對我們處處懷疑，有另找出路脫離我們的徵兆。王在袁的影響下，亦與我們的關係日益惡化」；而朱昌偕亦對袁文才成見極深：「要是不能肅清土匪，則土匪必將與我們為敵，國民黨若因其有益而利導之，以夾攻我們，則我們危矣」。唯特委成員宛希先與袁文才走得比較近，打得火熱。

在宛希先調停下，湘贛特委只給予袁文才黨內警告處分，這可讓朱昌偕、永新縣委書記劉真、寧岡縣委書記王懷懷恨在心，竟對宛希先起了殺心。

宛希先曾處理過一起投敵案。因下屬處理不當，竟把劉真結婚僅三個月的妻子龍家衡處決。劉真把這「殺妻之仇」算在宛希先身上，一直氣憤難平，更是必欲除之而後快。

1930年2月，宛希先接到湘贛特委的緊急通知，讓他速回永新參加重要的軍事行動。誰料去永新的路上，宛遇到了政府軍的包圍。在衝出包圍到達永新後，已耽誤了軍事行動計劃。朱昌偕不問青紅皂白，竟以「貽誤戰機」之名把宛希先處決。這共產黨真是沒人性：對自己革命的同志竟然是說殺就殺。當然，也只有共產黨的組織才會這樣幹。不是說了嗎！中共的內部鬥爭有時就是你死我活的。

宛希先一死，雙方更加對立。

恰逢此時，又發生一件事情，使湘贛特委有了置袁、王於死地的藉口。

一日，袁文才、王佐商議：茶陵、酃縣、寧岡三縣聯防團團總羅克紹有個兵工廠，何不把他抓來，把兵工廠收為己用。說幹就幹，結果就把羅抓到山上，跟他談兵工廠之事。當然，談判自然是先禮後兵，那就好吃好喝的伺候著羅克紹。哪知此事被朱昌偕知道，認定袁文才、王佐與羅克紹私通。立即聯繫劉真、龍超清等人，商定對付袁文才之計。

無巧不成書，此時中共中央特派員彭清泉來到井岡山。背景是中央收到了兩任湘贛特委書記楊開明、鄧乾元事關袁、王的報告。要知道，中央本來就戴著「有色眼鏡」看待袁文才、王佐。對於毛澤東遲遲沒有按照中央政策處理袁、王，中央也很不滿。彭清泉正是帶著解決袁文才、王佐的任務來到井岡山。這與邊界特委朱、龍的想法不謀而合。

可是，一個非常現實的問題卻令他們深感頭痛。袁、王兩部合編的紅四軍三十二團，擁有一千多兵員，七百多枝槍，還有一座兵工廠。加之該部官兵大多獵戶出身，對井岡山地形特別熟悉，戰鬥經驗豐富，其戰鬥力絕不在留守的紅五軍之下。

古語道：「害人之心不可有，防人之心不可無。」而在中共黨內，處處都是害人之輩。若沒有「防人之心」，稍有不慎，就可能落入別人的圈套。

一日，袁文才突然收到毛澤東來信。來信稱：紅四軍前委決定，邊界六縣的赤衛隊合編為紅六軍第三縱隊，任命袁文才為司令，王佐副之，定於2月22日在永新縣城合編，隨後配合紅五軍共同攻打吉安。

看到毛的來信，袁、王自是喜不自勝：老毛還真夠意思，關鍵時刻還想著我們。當即決定，立即趕往永新任職。

與此同時，紅五軍軍長彭德懷在睡夢中被驚醒，說是地方黨委負責人深夜求見。彭急忙迎出內室。還未開口，朱昌偕便趕緊走上前，急急拉住他的手，焦急地說：「彭軍長，出大事了。袁文才、王佐要叛變。」彭德懷驀地一驚，忙扶來人坐定，安慰道：「不要急，慢慢講。」

朱昌偕說：「袁文才、王佐勾結羅克紹叛變了革命。他們在特委聯席會議上，強迫會議改編地方武裝，統歸他們指揮。王佐講話時手拿駁殼槍，囂張得很。看樣子如果不通過他們提出的要求，出席會議的同志有被一網打盡的危險。」話說到此，朱昌偕請求道：「情況已到萬分危急的地步，我們特委務請紅五軍即刻出動，挽救這場危機。」

「情況有這麼嚴重？」彭德懷有些將信將疑：「去年五六月間，王佐率領特務營和五軍共同行動打酃縣、桂東、城口、南雄等地表現還不壞，怎麼變化得這麼快呢？」

朱昌偕忙解釋道：「這完全是袁文才挑撥起來的。他在紅四軍政治部看了六大決議案關於土匪那一段原話，回到井岡山後對王佐說，我們怎樣忠心，也不會被信任。」

鑒於事態如此嚴重緊急，又見朱昌偕等人這般焦急，彭德懷未作深層次的思考。同時，彭也想起毛澤東離開井岡山時的再三囑咐：對袁文才要有足夠的防範，必要時要堅決出手。想到此，彭德懷立即安排張純清率紅五軍第四縱隊隨朱昌偕趕往永新縣城，並聽從朱昌偕指揮。

1930年2月22日下午，袁文才、王佐率紅四軍三十二團七百餘人槍，進駐永新縣城禾川鎮。特委組織了上千民眾，在城東浮橋頭舉行歡迎儀式，紛紛祝賀「袁、王二人榮升新職」。一時間，袁、王二人與特委間出現了罕有的融洽。

當晚，酒足飯飽後，袁文才被安排到了永新縣城尹家巷22號。那是一所乾淨寬敞的宅院。王佐則住進了尹家祠堂，其餘官兵散居在附近早被騰空出來的店鋪與百姓家。

王佐回到住地，感到周圍環境有些不對頭，立刻拉上袁文才就要回去，並不停地說：「快離開這個是非之地，切莫老虎上了狗的當。」但袁文才阻止了王佐，認為王佐多心了。

23日午夜，特委向五縣赤衛隊傳達了軍事部署：「袁、王二人勾結茶陵團總羅克紹已經叛變革命，明日借成立大會之際，務必除掉二位叛徒。各部牢記口令，左臂纏繞白毛巾，一定完成鋤奸任務。」24日凌晨5時左右，朱昌偕帶著十餘名荷槍實彈的赤衛隊員衝進了袁文才住所。他徑直趕往袁文才門口，敲門喊道：「袁司令，老袁，我是朱昌偕，有事找你。」與袁文才同住一室的李筱甫遲疑了一下，還是輕輕拉開了門。袁文才剛從睡夢中睜開眼，朱昌偕抬手就是一槍，子彈正中袁文才眉心。隨即，另外幾支槍同時響起，李筱甫與袁文才倒在了血泊中。

尹家巷22號的槍聲驟然響過後，一直心懷警覺並在住處內打好了地洞的王佐，彷彿天人感應一般從床上一躍而起。嘴上連連叫道：「不好，出事了。」然後，帶上刁輝林等人沿著地洞鑽出了祠堂，跨上幾匹未卸鞍的戰馬，飛馳而去。逃跑的路上，王佐等人遭到紅五軍第四縱隊伏擊，當場斃命。

與此同時，城中的三十二團除部分人逃脫之外，大部被繳械控制起來。特委清點現場，找到了袁文才、李筱甫、王佐等人的十七具屍體。

這樣，袁文才、王佐這兩個結拜兄弟，做到了「不求同年同月同日生，但求同年同月同日死」，也算不枉兄弟一場。

尤其讓人不齒的是：袁文才妻子謝梅香幾天後給袁文才收屍，那屍首已腐爛。要知道，中國人最忌諱的就是暴屍，就算後來的日本人在戰場上遇到中國死亡的士兵，有時都要掩埋的。而那些中共黨徒竟然任憑袁文才暴屍荒郊，真是邪惡他娘給邪惡開門——邪惡到家了！有這麼大的仇恨嗎？

3月初，袁文才的部下謝角銘、謝益謀、陳次謀、曾李生牽頭，聯名客籍黨員幹部劉克猶、朱開卷等十六人，寫信給彭德懷並轉贛西南特委和紅四軍軍委，希望上級能主持公道。但發出的信猶如石沉大海，上級沒有任何回信。不僅如此，特委繼續搜捕袁文才、王佐的同謀者。部分袁、王下屬逃進深山，特委令紅六軍第三縱隊派出部隊上山「搜索圍剿」。

3月下旬，得不到中共反饋的謝角銘等聯絡王佐部下王雲隆，給湘贛兩省國民政府「電告反赤」。兩省政府分別於第三天派出「撫慰大員」來到寧岡龍市，策劃袁王舊部的「反共大業」。

寧岡、遂川兩縣的國民黨政府也派人來井岡山，給農民免費送來了糧食、食鹽等物資，其中還有耕牛，尤其對袁、王舊部排長以上的家庭給予更為優厚的撫慰。當然，對仍然留在紅軍隊伍中的成員，其家庭也受到政府軍的懲治。

4月上旬，寧（岡）遂（川）邊防保衛團在茅坪成立，謝角銘為團總，王雲隆為團副。保衛團以袁、王舊部為主，又招收了兩百多名團丁，加上國民黨吉安駐軍撥來的一批槍彈，使保衛團擴充到七百多人槍。之後，中共軍隊幾次試圖奪回井岡山，但井岡山的一切都變了：老百姓不再給他們提供情報了，不再給他們提供糧食了，甚至出現對紅軍投石塊、打黑槍的情況。失去了老百姓的紅軍，再也沒能收回井岡山。

按照現在中共的說法，袁文才收到的毛澤東來信是偽造的。如此大的事，朱昌偕敢偽造嗎？跟毛澤東朝夕相處的袁文才看不出毛的筆跡嗎？為什麼事後沒有對此進行處理？中央特派員彭清泉來到井岡山的任務，就是對袁文才採取非常手段，難道毛澤東不知道？彭德懷動用軍隊捕殺袁文才，會不跟毛澤東匯報？謝角銘等人的上訪信為什麼沒有回應？

其實，毛澤東自始至終參與了對袁文才、王佐的謀殺。就在開始行動之前，彭清泉親自派人去見毛澤東專門匯報，並得到了老毛寄給袁文才的親筆信。據說，毛澤東曾對袁文才被殺事件痛心疾首，曾後悔地說道：「殺錯了，殺錯了！」典型的「貓哭耗子假慈悲」。既然說殺錯了，那就說明此前一直認為「殺得對」。這跟「還我盧德銘」是一樣的醜惡嘴臉。有的看官說了，毛澤東有那麼惡毒嗎？看看他以後的作為就知道了，這點事對他來說只不過是初試牛刀，小事一樁！

中共內部的相互殘殺，會愈演愈烈。

正是
中共本是一邪黨 過河拆橋自應當
老毛遙指井岡山 自有老彭斬袁王

如是曰：在中共的文獻中，都說是王明的左傾主義害了袁文才。其實，中共六大決定對土匪採取「極端手段」，正是中共對待階級異己分子所應該採取的措施，共產黨面對土匪時就是要採取這樣的革命手段。這和毛澤東在《中國社會各階級的分析》、《湖南農民運動考察報告》中所寫論調完全是一致的。所以袁文才、王佐之死也是必然的。

# 湾区 9月27日 牛腾宇妈妈 作品展

By:[Lili Hu](https://www.zyd1998.com/archives/author/lili-hu)

Date:

2026年9月26日

7251

【周日下午活动】｜牛腾宇妈妈 作品展

🕟 4:30–6:30 PM

现场将展出牛腾宇妈妈的画作，并邀请她和大家交流。我们将有机会听她亲自讲述牛腾宇案的相关情况及狱中生活近况，也听她分享作品背后的故事，以及一路走来面对困境、坚持抗争的经历与心声。

这不仅是一次作品的展示，也是两场关于人生选择、女性成长、困境与坚持、爱与生命力量的真诚交流。

有人经历风雨，依然选择热爱生活；

有人身处困境，依然选择坚持和发声。

期待这个周末与大家在Los Altos Public Library相见。一起看作品、听故事、聊人生，在真实的生命经历中，看见彼此，也获得一些温暖与力量。

[**香港**](https://udn.com/search/tagging/2/%E9%A6%99%E6%B8%AF)電話詐騙多，案發數剛創下單月新高，又新增一紀錄，是港府保安局長接獲聲稱「保安局官員」的電話詐騙。

港府保安局局長鄧炳強在[社交平台上傳短片](https://www.facebook.com/reel/1787925009114917)，說他接獲疑似[**詐騙電話**](https://udn.com/search/tagging/2/%E8%A9%90%E9%A8%99%E9%9B%BB%E8%A9%B1)，對方聲稱是保安局人員，又說「你涉嫌觸犯了內地法律，現在立刻過來政府總部10樓，核實身分協助調查。」鄧炳強即時詢問對方屬於保安局哪一組，又說自己正身處10樓，叫對方過去找他。

鄧炳強說，香港保安局不會致電要求市民協助調查，更不會要求交錢轉帳，接到這些電話一定是詐騙。這類假冒政府部門的電話，往往是想套取個人資料，甚至要求轉帳。提醒市民收到可疑電話時，一定要保持冷靜，再三核實，不要上當。

香港電話詐騙案居高不下，警方10月公布今年前8個月罪案數據，說首8個月共錄得2萬9千多宗詐騙案，電話騙案依然是最嚴重的詐騙類別之一，占整體詐騙宗數約27%，8月份已錄得5,100多宗，創歷史單月新高。

香港電話詐騙案也新揭發有黑社會操控，2天前警方宣布搗破黑社會和勝和操控的詐騙及洗黑錢集團，行動中拘捕44人。

在香港，最常見的電話詐騙是假冒平台客服、保冒親友猜猜我是誰、 假冒大陸公安、香港警察或香港入境處等人員實施訛騙。

title: New prostate cancer drug approved under Hong Kong's '1+' mechanism
zh_title: 前列腺癌新药在香港“1+”机制下获批
summary: 香港 香港在其“1+”药品注册机制下批准了一种治疗转移性激素敏感性前列腺癌的新药，使总数达到23种。该药物已获得中国药品监管部门的批准，并经过当地专家的审评。政府的目标是到 2030 年扩大第一层审批。 [![图片 1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编 2026 年 10 月 15 日， 15:40 HKT · 2 分钟读 香港在“1+”药品注册机制下批准了另一种新药
content:
香港
香港在“1+”药品注册机制下批准了一种治疗转移性激素敏感性前列腺癌的新药，使总数达到23种。该药物已获得中国药品监管部门的批准，并经过当地专家的审评。政府的目标是到2030年扩大一级审批。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

2026 年 10 月 15 日 15:40 香港时间 · 阅读 2 分钟

卫生署周四宣布，香港在“1+”药物注册机制下批准了另一种新药，这次是用于治疗转移性激素敏感性前列腺癌。该药物在根据该机制提交申请之前已获得中国大陆药品监管部门的批准。

药剂业及毒药管理局注册委员会审查申请人的临床数据并咨询当地专家后得出结论，该药物符合规定的安全性、有效性和质量标准。卫生署已将批准结果通知申请人。
随着这项最新批准，自2023年11月1日起，已有23种新药在“1+”机制下注册。其中7种已纳入医院管理局的药物名册，其中6种属于“特殊药物”类别，这意味着合资格的病人只需支付每四个星期20元的标准费用。该局于6月8日成立的创新药物和医疗器械引进办公室正在与卫生部合作，加快新产品的注册速度，将抗癌药物的审查时间从最长150个工作日缩短至100天内。

“1+”机制于2024年11月1日扩大到涵盖包括先进治疗产品在内的所有新药，允许申请人提交一项参考监管批准而不是两项，前提是申请人提供经当地专家认可的合格本地临床数据。该部门已收到超过230家制药公司的920多项查询，并推出了提交前咨询服务和研讨会。

该机制被视为“一级审批”的踏脚石，卫生署于2026年3月31日开始分阶段实施。第一阶段涵盖已在香港注册的药物的扩展，目标是到2030年全面覆盖所有医药产品，让香港能够根据临床数据独立评估和审批新药。
政府表示将继续深化监管改革，并于2026年成立香港药物及医疗器械监管局，旨在根据香港第一个五年计划和2026年施政报告，将香港定位为国际医疗创新中心。

[![图片3：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

【原文 English Original】
Hong Kong
Hong Kong has approved a new drug for metastatic hormone-sensitive prostate cancer under its '1+' drug registration mechanism, bringing the total to 23. The drug was approved by China's drug regulator and reviewed by local experts. The government aims to expand first-layer approval by 2030.

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

15 Oct 2026 at 15:40 HKT · 2 min read

Hong Kong has approved another new drug under its "1+" drug registration mechanism, this time for metastatic hormone-sensitive prostate cancer, the Department of Health announced on Thursday. The drug had already been approved by mainland China's drug regulator before its application was submitted under the mechanism.

The Registration Committee of the Pharmacy and Poisons Board reviewed the applicant's clinical data and consulted local experts before concluding that the drug met the required safety, efficacy and quality standards. The Department of Health has notified the applicant of the approval result.

With this latest approval, 23 new drugs have now been registered under the "1+" mechanism since it took effect on 1 November 2023. Seven of these have been included in the Hospital Authority's drug formulary, with six placed under the "special drugs" category, meaning eligible patients pay only the standard fee of $20 every four weeks. The authority's Office for Introducing Innovative Drugs and Medical Devices, established on 8 June, is working with the Department of Health to speed up registration of new products, with review times for cancer drugs cut from a maximum of 150 working days to within 100 days.

The "1+" mechanism, expanded on 1 November 2024 to cover all new drugs including advanced therapy products, allows applicants to submit one reference regulatory approval instead of two, provided they supply qualifying local clinical data endorsed by local experts. The department has received more than 920 enquiries from over 230 pharmaceutical companies and has launched pre-submission consultation services and workshops.

The mechanism is seen as a stepping stone to "first-layer approval", which the Department of Health began implementing in phases on 31 March 2026. The first phase covers extensions of drugs already registered in Hong Kong, with a target of full coverage of all pharmaceutical products by 2030, enabling Hong Kong to independently assess and approve new drugs based on clinical data.

The government said it will continue deepening regulatory reforms and establish a Hong Kong Drug and Medical Device Regulatory Authority within 2026, aiming to position Hong Kong as an international medical innovation hub under the city's first five-year plan and the 2026 policy address.

# DEFENSE/Taiwan watching for large-scale PLA drills as peak season nears

10/15/2026 03:30 PM

China’s Liaoning aircraft carrier. CNA file photo

Taipei, Oct. 15 (CNA) The Ministry of National Defense (MND) said Thursday that it was closely monitoring the possibility of large-scale Chinese military exercises near Taiwan as the traditional peak season for People's Liberation Army (PLA) drills approaches.

At a news conference Thursday, defense officials were asked whether a large-scale exercise encircling Taiwan could take place as the PLA's November-December peak season approaches.

Pan Chun-kuang (潘俊光), an official from the Office of the Deputy Chief of the General Staff for Intelligence, said the MND was using joint intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance capabilities to monitor the PLA's latest activities.

The ministry had noticed that China had recently been using propaganda about its military activities to step up its cognitive warfare efforts, Pan said.

"We see this as behavior that disrupts regional stability," he said, adding that the ministry would remain on high alert and respond appropriately to such behavior.

Asked about a naval fleet led by China's Liaoning aircraft carrier, which began what Beijing described as "routine drills" in the western Pacific on Wednesday, Pan said the activities had drawn concern from countries in the region and put them on alert.

The PLA Navy has said the drills were "not directed at any country or target."

The MND would monitor the situation closely and take precautions, Pan said.

China staged a large-scale exercise encircling Taiwan in August 2022, shortly after then-United States House Speaker Nancy Pelosi visited Taiwan.

Similar exercises have since become a regular occurrence, with at least one held each year from 2023 to 2025.

The PLA has not staged one this year.

(By Sean Lin)

孫中山先生誕辰紀念日11月將到來，港澳地區已經開始有預熱活動，圖為澳門12日舉辦的座談會。圖／取材自澳門政府官網

紀念[**孫中山**](https://udn.com/search/tagging/2/%E5%AD%AB%E4%B8%AD%E5%B1%B1)誕辰160周年，港澳兩地相繼舉辦舉辦座談會、書畫展等活動，[**香港**](https://udn.com/search/tagging/2/%E9%A6%99%E6%B8%AF)特首[**李家超**](https://udn.com/search/tagging/2/%E6%9D%8E%E5%AE%B6%E8%B6%85)14日於座談會表示，孫中山先生一生以革命為己任，立志救國救民，為中華民族作出了彪炳史冊的貢獻，要學習和繼承孫中山先生熱愛祖國的崇高精神、振興中華的偉大志向，把愛國愛港的價值觀化為具體行動，為以中國式現代化全面推進強國建設、實現中華民族偉大復興貢獻香港力量。

綜合新華社、大公文匯網報導，孫中山誕辰是11月12日，紀念活動在兩地連番登場，「紀念孫中山先生誕辰160周年座談會」12日率先於澳門科學館舉行，全國人大常委會副委員長鄭建邦出席並呼籲海內外中華兒女堅定反「獨」促統，澳門特區政府社會文化司司長柯嵐則表示將從傳承中山精神、發揮平台優勢及引導青年三方面推展工作。

此外，由香港金紫荊書畫院主辦的「天下為公．薪火相傳紀念孫中山誕辰160周年書畫邀請展」13日在港開幕，展出兩岸暨港澳近200位藝術家共200多幅作品，參展作品涵蓋書法、篆刻、國畫、油畫等多個門類，既保留了傳統書畫的深厚底蘊，也融入了當代藝術的創新表達。

孫中山先生後人、中國和平統一促進會香港總會常務副會長孫偉勇表示，孫中山先生一生追求理想，根源就是愛國。紀念孫中山旨在接過「振興中華」接力棒，讓年輕人走近其故事與精神。

報導指出，李家超於14日座談會指出，香港是孫中山先生孕育革命思想和求學的重要地方，與其革命生涯有深厚歷史淵源，孫中山先生曾在港就學，更曾憶述「我之此等思想發源地即為香港」，他其後在中環成立香港興中會總會及同盟會期間，均以香港為起義策源地和籌款樞紐。這段歷史淵源，為今天香港推動愛國主義教育提供了珍貴教材。

特區政府「愛國主義教育工作小組」成立兩年多來積極推進相關工作，上月公布的「香港第一個五年規劃」已明確提出深化愛國主義教育、國民教育及國家安全教育等目標，2026年「施政報告」亦提出具體施政重點。

除推廣校園大使計畫與設立延安教育基地外，當局亦將設立新博物館介紹國家輝煌成就，並持續支持同鄉社團推廣家鄉文化及於中華文化節推出展現優秀傳統文化的項目。

The 17th Cognitive Infocommunications Conference (CogInfoCom 2026) was held from 12 to 15 October at Hong Kong Science Park, marking its first appearance in China and the Greater Bay Area.

Co-hosted by the Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK), its Shenzhen Research Institute (SZRI), the InnoHK Centre for Perceptual and Interactive Intelligence (CPII), and Corvinus University of Budapest (CUB), the event brought together international experts to discuss advances in artificial intelligence, cognitive science, and information technology.

Launched in 2010, CogInfoCom has previously been held in Europe and Asia. This year marks its debut in China, symbolising the region's growing prominence in AI and cognitive research, according to the organisers.

Distinguished guests included CUHK's pro-vice-chancellor Anthony Chan Tak-cheung, SZRI director Yam Yeung, CPII director Helen Meng Mei-ling, and Péter Baranyi of CUB, along with other scholars and industry partners.

Chan highlighted CUHK's commitment to interdisciplinary and international collaboration, describing the conference as a bridge for global academic and innovation exchange. Yam stressed the importance of hosting the event in the region, emphasising its role in fostering cooperation in AI and cognitive infocommunications.

The hybrid event covered topics including the integration of cognitive science with information technology and the development of AI systems that augment human abilities. Highlights included keynote speeches, expert presentations, and exhibitions showcasing the latest research in AI, machine learning, and human-AI interaction.

The conference also reinforced Sino-Hungarian collaboration, following recent strategic agreements between the host institutions and the launch of joint research projects.

【大紀元2026年10月15日訊】美國網路雜誌Tablet（Tablet Magazine）週日（10月11日）發表了一篇題為「中國十億美元器官移植產業背後的駭人真相」的專題報告，探討了已在中國存在多年並被中共極力掩蓋的器官移植產業。

## 北京閱兵場上的意外對話

該報告從2025年在北京舉行的紀念戰勝日本80周年閱兵期間，中共黨魁習近平與俄羅斯總統普京（Vladimir Putin）之間的一段對話開始。

當時，習近平與普京並肩而行，兩人談論了器官移植與長壽的問題，對話被現場未關閉的媒體直播麥克風錄下。

習近平在翻譯的協助下說道：「以前，人們很少能活到70歲，但如今，70歲仍然是個孩子。」當時，習近平與普京都已是72歲。

普京則回答說，隨著生物技術進步，「人體器官可以不斷移植」，「這會讓我們變得越來越年輕，甚至可能實現永生」。

隨後，直播畫面切換至天安門廣場。兩位領導人稍後出現在觀禮台上。此時，習近平已不在鏡頭之中，但他又就此話題補充說：「有人預測，本世紀有可能活到150歲。」

報告指出，當時各大媒體多把這段習普對話解讀為兩位獨裁領導人對權力的渴望，但長期關注中共的人士則認為，它與兩件事有關：一是大規模強摘良心犯器官，二是為中共高層服務的保健計劃「981工程」。

## 器官移植量激增與迫害法輪功同步

據報告介紹，在中國民眾受傳統觀念影響，自願捐獻器官的意願非常低的背景下，中國的器官移植產業卻在2000年代初期迅速擴張。

值得注意的是，該器官移植產業爆發式增長的時間段，與中共開始全面打壓法輪功的時間段重合。

法輪功是一種佛家修煉功法，因為有益身心健康且效果顯著，在1990年代迅速傳播。在1999年迫害開始前夕，其修煉人數估計有7000萬至1億人。

1999年，時任中共黨魁江澤民因懼怕法輪功的影響力可能超過共產黨，下令實施鎮壓，並透過國家宣傳機器將法輪功污衊為「邪教」。

2006年，《大紀元時報》（The Epoch Times）率先披露，中共開始有系統地摘取被關押的法輪功修煉者的器官。多名證人挺身而出。

一名逃亡海外、化名安妮的護士作證說，其前夫是瀋陽蘇家屯一家醫院的神經外科醫生，他曾被迫從仍有生命跡象的法輪功修煉者身上摘取眼角膜。

## 醫生、法庭的說法

報告說，當年中國的醫院曾公開刊登英文器官移植廣告，並宣傳其器官等待時間短的優點。在有獨立調查人員打電話就此諮詢時，醫生承認會提供「新鮮」器官進行移植，並承諾只要付得起高價，就能迅速安排手術。

以色列心臟外科醫生雅各布·拉維（Jacob Lavee）透露，2005年，他的一名病人告訴他，自己已不想再等了，並已獲得安排，在兩週後前往中國接受心臟移植。當這名病人真的移植了一顆新心臟回來時，拉維博士大為震驚。

拉維後來在倫敦的中國問題獨立法庭（China Tribunal）作證說，在正常醫療體系中，沒有人能夠提前兩週安排心臟移植手術，因為必須有捐獻者死亡才行。

該法庭由曾起訴前南斯拉夫總統米洛舍維奇（Slobodan Milošević）的英國大律師傑弗里·尼斯爵士（Sir Geoffrey Nice）主持。

該法庭在收集證據一年後得出結論，強摘器官在中國「相當大規模」地發生著，而無需任何法律手續即可抓捕和關押的法輪功修煉者，成為了器官移植的主要來源。強摘器官規模之大，已超越了所有可能的理由及所有的合理解釋。

## 為何短時間內能配到器官

報告分析說，在正常移植體系中，器官來自意外事故中的逝者，而且還需要匹配血型、組織和尺寸等，病人往往要等數月甚至數年，才能獲得器官移植的機會。

但中國國內的權貴和付費的外國病人，卻常常能在幾天或幾週內完成器官移植手術，有時甚至能夠提前定好日期。

報告認為，只有存在已配型的龐大活體「器官供體庫」才可能做到這一點。

報告指出，在中共器官移植產業「蓬勃發展」的時間段裡，數以十萬計的法輪功修煉者遭到逮捕。許多人拒絕透露自己的姓名，以保護家人。

一項不成文的規定將法輪功修煉者在羈押期間的死亡一律視為自殺。

外界看到的只是失蹤和酷刑，但在體制內，被關押者卻接受血型檢測、組織配型，並被納入資料庫。

當高級官員或付費客戶需要器官時，便能找到配型合適的人，並專門為這次移植殺死該名囚犯。由於殺人可以按需進行，手術也就能預先安排。

2000年至2005年間，隨著這個活體器官來源庫形成，中國的移植能力呈爆炸式增長。新醫院、新團隊和新手術室以驚人的速度出現，無法以自願捐獻或死刑犯器官來源作出合理解釋。

這個器官庫成為中共政權迫害法輪功修煉者的核心部分。

報告引述的被關押法輪功修煉者的回憶，佐證了這一點。

很多法輪功學員在被關押期間，都曾被抽血、做體檢。這些都是器官移植手術配型的關鍵步驟。

此前，海外獨立中文媒體《大紀元時報》已經披露了多位此類倖存者講述的親身經歷。

[延伸閱讀：前日本黑幫幹部親見遭中共活摘器官的法輪功學員](https://www.epochtimes.com/b5/22/6/25/n13767360.htm)

## 981工程與軍方醫院

報告還指出，中共於2005年推出了所謂的「981工程」。這是一個專為黨內高層及權貴階層設立的頂級醫療保健計劃（又稱「首長健康工程」）。該計劃以追求人類長壽（目標直指150歲）及「器官功能再生」為核心。

前解放軍總後勤部衛生部部長白書忠（於2004年退休）被指與該項目的籌備及早期推動密切相關。

追查迫害法輪功國際組織（WOIPFG）的調查人員此前曾匿名致電白書忠，他當時在電話中承認，摘取法輪功修煉者器官是上級下達的命令。

報告說，該保健計劃的合作醫院網絡包括北京的中國人民解放軍總醫院，以及上海長征醫院。

據「追查迫害法輪功國際組織」此前發布的、對中國大陸各大醫院器官移植數據的梳理與研究報告，長征醫院曾做過等待時間短至四小時的緊急肝移植。

報告認為，這在醫學上只有在隨時有活體捐獻者時才可能做到。

報告中還提到了2023年去世的中共文化部前副部長高占祥。其訃告稱，他生前曾「更換了體內許多器官」。

據撰寫訃告的官員說，高占祥生前曾開玩笑表示，「許多零部件已經不是自己的了」。

報告指出，這是中共高層黨員能優先取得器官按需進行移植的跡象。

[延伸閱讀：揭中共「981工程」追求延壽背後的黑幕](https://www.epochtimes.com/b5/25/11/14/n14635756.htm)

## 官方否認 數據受質疑

報告指出，長期以來，中共始終否認相關指控。在早期，中共官方解釋說，這些器官來自死刑犯。自2015年起則改稱，只使用了捐獻器官。

但在2019年11月發表於《BMC醫學倫理》（BMC Medical Ethics）的一項研究發現，中共當局公布的器官移植手術數量，帶有明顯人為操縱的痕跡，「年復一年完美貼合特定計算公式」。

2016年，加拿大前官員大衛·喬高（David Kilgour）、人權律師大衛·麥塔斯（David Matas）和調查記者伊森·葛特曼（Ethan Gutmann）聯合報告估計，中國每年實際移植手術數量高達6萬至10萬例，遠高於官方公布的數字，並認為實際數字更接近較高的估值。

為得出這個數字——最高可達官方數據的10倍——三人考慮了中國器官移植醫院的數量（超過700家）、國家級移植中心進行大量移植手術的能力（其中一家每年超過8,000例）、醫院公布的床位數，以及這些醫院對移植手術的高度重視。

葛特曼在2016年向美國國會表示，他認為這一估計數字仍然相當保守。

喬高和麥塔斯在2006年的一份報告中記錄了一名病人的案例：他在上海一家醫院先後被移植了八顆腎臟，直到最後一顆才配型成功。

報告說，2020年，該報告作者曾報導過一名女子飛往中國接受心臟移植手術的案例。醫生在10天內為她找到了四顆配型成功的心臟。

反對強摘器官醫生組織（Doctors Against Forced Organ Harvesting）歐洲區副主任安德烈亞斯·韋伯（Andreas Weber）博士，在2025年「終止強摘器官扶輪衛星社」（EFOH Rotary）的一個活動中分享了一名德國病人的故事：

「這名女子是AB型血，這是一種罕見血型，使尋找配型器官更加困難。她也是一名酗酒者，因此不符合在德國列入等待名單的資格。所以，她在數年內三次飛往中國。她接受了三次肝臟移植，每次支付約40萬歐元。」

## 呼籲美國立法

報告強調，大規模強摘器官體系不會一夜之間形成。正如楊傑凱（Jan Jekielek）近期著作《按需殺害》（Killed to Order）所詳述的，這一體系的基本要素包括多年的蓄意政策、協調一致的行動，以及對特定群體進行有系統的非人化，類似於納粹德國針對猶太人的仇恨運動。

報告還指出，以色列已在2008年立法，將器官販運和器官移植旅遊定為犯罪。隨後，臺灣、意大利、挪威、比利時、韓國、英國和加拿大也已跟進。

目前，美國只有德克薩斯州、亞利桑那州等六個州禁止醫療保險承保來自中國的器官移植手術。

報告呼籲美國參議院通過《2025年制止強摘器官法案》（H.R. 1503）和《法輪功及強摘器官受害者保護法案》（S. 4009），對涉事人員實施制裁、限制簽證，並要求定期公布相關報告。

報告最後強調，習近平與普京之間關於器官移植的討論，雖然是被偶然曝光，但絕非偶然。各國不應再對此保持沉默，以免變相默許中共繼續運作其慘無人道的器官移植體系。

Tablet Magazine（通常簡稱為Tablet）是美國一家著名的猶太文化與新聞網絡雜誌。它於2009年6月由非營利組織Nextbook Inc.創辦，總部設於紐約，由阿拉娜·紐豪斯（Alana Newhouse）擔任總編輯。

責任編輯：李沐恩#

title: 張婉瑩保釋申請再被駁回 檢方揭其雙面生活
summary: 【大紀元2026年10月15日訊】（大紀元洛杉磯記者站報導）涉嫌充當中共代理人的加州華女張婉瑩此前經法官裁定不得保釋。10月14日（週三），她申請撤銷羈押令，再被聯邦地區法官駁回。法官認為，張婉瑩存在潛逃風險，可能逃離美國、躲避司法制裁，且在訴訟程序中存在不誠實行為。 [![Image 1](https://i.epochtimes.com/assets/uploads/2026/10/id14870179-2-1-600x450.jpg)](https://i.epocht
content:
【大紀元2026年10月15日訊】（大紀元洛杉磯記者站報導）涉嫌充當中共代理人的加州華女張婉瑩此前經法官裁定不得保釋。10月14日（週三），她申請撤銷羈押令，再被聯邦地區法官駁回。法官認為，張婉瑩存在潛逃風險，可能逃離美國、躲避司法制裁，且在訴訟程序中存在不誠實行為。

[![Image 1](https://i.epochtimes.com/assets/uploads/2026/10/id14870179-2-1-600x450.jpg)](https://i.epochtimes.com/assets/uploads/2026/10/id14870179-2-1.jpg)

2026年10月14日，美國聯邦地區法官裁定張婉瑩繼續羈押。圖為庭審的聯邦法院。（韓冰／大紀元）

34歲的加州橙縣房地產經紀人張婉瑩（Wanying 「Heather」 Zhang）10月4日於洛杉磯國際機場（LAX）被逮捕。她被指控非法充當中共代理人，並涉嫌受命監視台灣總統賴清德之子。被捕當下，她正持有一張單程機票，準備飛往上海。

[![Image 2](https://i.epochtimes.com/assets/uploads/2026/10/id14870185-3-1-600x551.png)](https://i.epochtimes.com/assets/uploads/2026/10/id14870185-3-1.png)

司法部起訴書顯示，西雅圖機場租車行拍攝到張婉瑩與涉嫌同伴在租用一輛黑色2025年款Nissan Rogue SUV。（美國司法部／公有領域）

7日開庭時，聯邦治安法官（Magistrate Judge）史蒂夫·金（Steve Kim）考慮其潛逃風險，已裁定不予保釋。檢方將張婉瑩稱為「祕密特工」，並指控其代表中共從事「間諜活動」。

張婉瑩一方隨後向上級法官提交羈押複審聽證會申請。但聯邦地區法官塞雷娜‧穆里略（Serena R. Murillo）駁回其申請，裁定不予保釋。

## 檢方提交密封文件

週三開庭前，檢方已向法庭提交一份密封文件，反對撤銷張婉瑩原本的羈押命令。

聯邦助理檢察官科林·斯科特（Colin Scott）在庭上指出，這不是一般案件，不僅是因為張婉瑩所涉嫌的行為，也因為其背後涉及一個國家的資源與力量；指派她在美國從事監視工作的是中共國家安全部的官員。

他接著說，間諜活動往往是建立在欺騙之上。檢方指控張婉瑩是中共情報機構的積極線人。她聽命於中共情報人員指令，與同伴「Individual 1」一同前往在西雅圖監視一名台灣高級政府官員的家人，並匯報監視結果。

這名同伴並非張婉瑩的丈夫。斯科特在庭上指出，此人據稱是她的「親密伴侶」。

檢方此前披露，張婉瑩曾透過一家「未註冊的加密貨幣交易所」，向她在中國的銀行帳戶轉帳19萬美元；她在中國擁有「數十萬美元」（hundreds of thousands）可供其支配。

「她還在中國投資了一家夜店。」斯科特表示，由於檢方無法直接調取中國銀行的完整資料，因此不確定她在中國到底還有多少其它資產。

不僅如此，他說，至少有相關指控指出，她的親密伴侶擁有相當可觀的資產，「具體是1億美元還是1億人民幣尚不確認，但金額十分龐大，這意味著她（在中國）完全不缺乏經濟資源」。

## 張婉瑩私人律師反駁指控

週三，張婉瑩的私人辯護律師克雷格·哈博（Craig Harbaugh）當庭反駁了檢方的種種指控。

他表示，張是美國公民，自2014年起就在美國生活，擁有相當可觀的房地產資產，還是兩個孩子的母親，且檢方指控的間諜活動可追溯至2025年9月。根據刑事起訴書，其當事人最後一次與中共官員接觸是在2025年10月。

哈博說，過去約一年的時間，張婉瑩也多次飛往中國，但每次都會返回美國；檢方沒有提供證據證明她對社區具有危險性。

哈博告訴法官，張婉瑩願意以名下一處市值超過100萬美元的房產作擔保，如果還不夠，也願意提供家人其它房產作為擔保；她還提出四名擔保人，分別為丈夫、公公、小姑子及主管。

「我們還可以接受佩戴電子監控腳環、居家監禁、接受電子監控。」哈博說，FBI已經扣留了她的護照，她行動受限，也不存在潛逃問題。

## 檢方：張婉瑩過著雙面生活

檢方主張被告律師的辯詞不足以撤銷羈押令。斯科特告訴法官，電子腳環及居家監禁遠遠不足以消除逃亡風險。即使在以往普通案件中，也發生過被告剪斷電子監控腳環逃跑、自此杳無音訊的情況。

「而本案的特殊之處在於，張婉瑩據稱得到她所服務的那個國家的積極支持。」斯科特說，中共政府可以替她取得新的護照，也可以安排專機、協助她離開美國。中美之間沒有引渡條約，如果她逃往中國，美國可能難以將她帶回受審。

斯科特指控，張婉瑩一直過著「雙面生活」，其家人都不知道她正在做這些事；最親近她的人，也不知道她是中共情報機構的積極情報人員，如今這些證據浮上水面。

網民深挖張婉瑩的背景時還發現，她與中共前外長秦剛、女間諜方芳一樣，都畢業於有「間諜搖籃」之稱的北京「國際關係學院」。

根據起訴書，張婉瑩與「中共政府官員1」均為國際關係學院公共管理學院2014屆的畢業生。畢業後，兩人持續透過電子訊息聯繫，偶爾見面。他們在微信中談論孩子、投資，比較美中差異，談話還涉及在華盛頓州西雅圖監視台灣政府高層官員近親及其家人。

檢方此前指控，張婉瑩的父母和兄弟姐妹都居住在中國；調查人員認為她的一位兄弟曾為中共政府工作（part of the Chinese government）；起訴書中的「Individual 1」已於不久前持單程機票返回中國。

檢方還指控，張婉瑩在被捕後填寫資產申報資料時，聲稱自己名下只有一處房產，但她實際擁有多處房產。這反映了她可能在對自己有利時向法庭說謊。

法官聽取雙方的陳述後，表示將做出裁決，駁回張婉瑩的請求、繼續羈押，直到下次開庭。

庭審結束後，張婉瑩由法警押送離開。她的丈夫埃德里克‧丁（Edric Ding）和另外兩名親友當天也在法庭現場。案件仍在起訴階段，未來一旦被定罪，張婉瑩將面臨最高10年監禁。◇

責任編輯：嘉蓮

title: Donate to SAVE US FROM THE MEGA EMBASSY! SUPPORT OUR LEGAL CHALLENGE, organized by Mark Nygate
summary: We are 100 families taking on the CCP - and we need your help. 我們是「皇家鑄幣廠居民協會」，由約一百戶職工家庭組成。我們懇請你伸出援手。 In 2018, our homes-key-worker flats in Tower Hamlets were sold in a secretive deal to the People's Republic of China. We had no say. No war
content:
We are 100 families taking on the CCP - and we need your help.

我們是「皇家鑄幣廠居民協會」，由約一百戶職工家庭組成。我們懇請你伸出援手。

In 2018, our homes-key-worker flats in Tower Hamlets were sold in a secretive deal to the People's Republic of China. We had no say. No warning. And now, we face living under the shadow of a hostile superpower.

2018年，我們居住的Tower Hamlets地段，在未經通知、無任何諮詢下，被秘密售予中國政府。我們無從置喙，如今更面對一個敵對政權的威脅。

The UK Government is expected to approve plans to build the largest embassy in Europe - right here, at Royal Mint Court, next to the Tower of London… and directly on top of our homes.

英國政府即將批准於倫敦塔旁的皇家鑄幣廠（Royal Mint Court）興建歐洲最大規模的中國大使館，預定地點正正位於我們所居之上。

This is not just a planning dispute.

我們擔憂的不僅是一項城市規劃決策，而是一場關乎國家安全、人身安全與基本權利的危機。

China has never shown any regard for our safety - and now the Government and the Metropolitan Police have abandoned us too.

自2018年起，中國政府從未就此提供明確回應，我們甚至不知道會否被驅逐、是否仍能繼續安居於此。而如今，政府與執法機關也對我們置之不理。

We are the Royal Mint Court Residents Association. People backed our previous Crowdfunder campaign that helped pay for a barrister to present our evidence including an independent security assessment showing the serious risks to us from a terror attack on the mega-embassy.

我們是「皇家鑄幣廠居民協會」。我們之前的眾籌活動獲得許多人的支持，資助我們聘請資深大律師提交證據，包括一份獨立的安全評估報告，指出超級大使館可能帶來的恐襲風險。

We are now launching an urgent legal challenge - a Judicial Review - to change the law and stop this injustice.

我們現在正展開一項緊急法律挑戰 — 即司法覆核 — 希望改變現行法律，阻止這場不公。

We need your help to protect our community from the mighty Chinese Communist Party.

我們需要你的幫助，去保護我們的社區，免受強大的中國共產黨威脅。

Whatever you can spare us, will help David stand-up to Goliath.

無論你能捐出多少，都能幫助大衛對抗歌利亞。

We are seeking to pursue a Judicial Review because we have believed all along that the planning process has been flawed. Here are some of the reasons we think are likely to be relevant:

我們決定提起司法覆核，是因為我們始終認為整個規劃程序存在問題。以下是我們認為可能相關的一些原因：

“Closed mind”: Ministers may have signalled early approval to China, before formal procedures were followed, breaking the law and abusing planning powers. In a similar vein, objections disappeared after UK ministers returned from Beijing. Residents have felt like pawns in a geopolitical game since the start.

預設立場：部長們可能在正式程序開始前就向中方表示支持，違反法律並濫用規劃權力。在部長們從北京回來之後，原有的反對聲音突然消失。居民們從一開始就覺得自己成了地緣政治博弈中的棋子。

Security concerns: Building a fortified embassy with homes on site and critical infrastructure nearby, ignoring espionage concerns and the real human risk to dissidents, is indefensible.

安全隱患：在住宅區內及重要基礎設施附近建設高度防禦的大使館，無視間諜活動與對異見人士的人身威脅，完全不能接受。

Procedural unfairness: We were shut out of the process. No consultation. No transparency. No respect for the people who live here.

程序不公：我們被完全排除在決策過程之外。無諮詢、無透明、無對居民的尊重。

Legitimate expectation: We were promised due process and protection. We got silence.

合理期望落空：我們被承諾將獲程序保障與保護，實際卻是得不到任何保障。

What’s wrong with the embassy plan?

We still live here. 100 families. Nurses, teachers, pensioners. Our 100 homes are on land now owned by the Chinese government. That means the Chinese ambassador is our landlord - with rights to enter our homes.

我們仍然住在這裡 ，足足一百戶家庭，包括護士、教師、退休人士。我們的一百個住所現已位於中國政府擁有的土地上。這代表中國大使成為我們的業主，有權進入我們的住所。

China refuses to answer us. Since 2018, we’ve begged for assurances: will we be evicted? Will we be safe? Can we stay? Beijing’s answer: not until we get planning permission. This refusal, and the proposal to install a temporary style wooden boundary fence as a dividing line, raises fears that the Chinese Government intends to take back the entire 100 apartments at St Mary Graces Court once they secure diplomatic status for the site, leaving us homeless.

中國拒絕回應我們的訴求。自2018年起，我們不斷尋求保證：我們會被驅逐嗎？我們是否安全？我們能否繼續居住？北京的答覆是：等規劃許可下來再說。這種拒絕，以及擬議中以臨時木欄分隔的做法，讓我們擔心中國政府一旦取得外交地位，將會收回整個St Mary Graces Court的100個單位，使我們流離失所。

This embassy is a fortress. It’s not a normal diplomatic building. It will have secret communications centres, fortified walls, and surveillance technology that can monitor our entire estate, even our bedrooms. It will also stand on top of critical UK cables that MI5 warn are a security risk to the UK.

這座大使館是一個堡壘，並非普通的外交建築。它將設有秘密通訊設施、加固圍牆、監控技術，可監視整個屋苑，甚至包括我們的睡房。而它的地基下方，更有英國重要電纜 ，MI5曾警告這是對國家安全的威脅。

The UK Government knows the risk - and ignored it. Our independent security report warns that this site puts families and national security at risk. Even the UK’s Head of Counter-Terrorism originally objected - citing threats to residents and dissidents. But since ministers returned from Beijing, objections have mysteriously vanished.

英國政府明知有風險，卻選擇無視。我們的獨立安全報告指出，該地點將危害居民與國家安全。甚至連英國反恐部門首長最初也曾反對 ， 指出對居民與異見人士的威脅。但自從部長從北京回來後，這些反對聲音神秘地消失。

Ministers made no mention of the 100 families living here. We are alarmed that the letters from Home Secretary Yvette Cooper and Foreign Secretary David Lammy have ignored the fact that UK families live in 100 apartments on the land that is actually part of Royal Mint court - and is owned by the Chinese government. Our Resident’s Chairman has personally appealed to ministers, submitted the full Crilly Consultants security report, and our plight has appeared in The Times, FT, BBC, CNN, and more. What is happening to democratic accountability in this country?

部長們從未提及這裡有一百戶居民。我們對內政大臣Yvette Cooper及外交大臣David Lammy的信件感到震驚，因為他們完全忽略了皇家鑄幣廠的土地上住有英國公民、100個家庭。我們的居民協會主席曾親自致函部長、提交完整的Crilly安全報告，而我們的處境亦已被《泰晤士報》、《金融時報》、BBC、CNN等多間媒體報導。英國民主問責制度何在？

The first duty of the UK government is to protect its citizens. We understand the UK’s diplomatic obligations - but not at the expense of its own people. The refusal to acknowledge the basic risks of housing a high-security foreign embassy on top of a residential block is deeply troubling. It appears the government is prioritising relations with Beijing over the safety of its own citizens.

英國政府的首要職責是保護其國民。我們明白外交義務，但不能以犧牲本國人民為代價。將一個高安全級別的外國大使館設於住宅區上方，而拒絕承認基本風險，是極度令人不安的。

It’s not just about us. Dissidents, including Hong Kongers, Uyghurs, Tibetans, Taiwanese and Chinese exile communities are terrified. They’ve told us they no longer feel safe protesting outside the site, and on British soil. Their presence, and ours, will be met with constant surveillance and intimidation by a regime known to harass and threaten activists - even abroad.

這件事不僅關係到我們。流亡港人、維吾爾人、西藏人、台灣人及中國異見社群皆感到恐懼。他們表示不再敢在該地點或英國土地上公開抗議。他們與我們一樣，將面對來自這個以恐嚇異見者聞名的政權的持續監控與威嚇。

The people have spoken, and they support us.

人民已經發聲，並支持我們。

On 8 February 2025, thousands of British citizens - including Hong Kongers, Uyghurs, Tibetans, Taiwanese and Chinese pro-democracy activists, and human rights campaigners - gathered outside Royal Mint Court in protest against this embassy.

2025年2月8日，數以千計的英國公民 ，包括港人、維吾爾人、西藏人、台灣人、中國民主人士與人權倡議者， 齊集皇家鑄幣廠，抗議中國大使館計劃。

They were joined by cross-party MPs, journalists, and allies. Together, they said NO to the Chinese embassy, and YES to democratic values, safety, and justice.

他們與跨黨派議員、記者及盟友並肩站立，一同說出明確立場：反對中國大使館，支持民主、安全與公義。

Further mass protests followed on 15 March, 3 May, and 14 June - showing growing national resistance to the plan.

3月15日、5月3日及6月14日亦舉行後續大型集會，反對聲浪日益壯大。

They continue to protest, and have made it clear: they won’t stop until this mega-embassy deal is over.

抗議仍在持續，並清楚表示：他們不會停止，直至該項目取消為止。

But the Government is not listening.

但政府並未聆聽我們的訴求。

So now, we go to court.

所以現在，我們只有訴諸法庭。

But we need your help - fast.

但我們需要您的協助 - 迅速的協助。

The legal fees for a Judicial Review are beyond the reach of ordinary families. But with your help, we can stand up to both Beijing and Whitehall.

司法覆核的法律費用遠超普通家庭的負擔。但在您的幫助下，我們能夠與北京和英國政府對抗。

This case is about more than one building. It’s about:

這宗案件關乎的遠不止一座建築。它關乎：

Protecting British citizens from state overreach

保護英國公民免受國家權力的侵害

Defending UK democracy from foreign influence

捍衛英國的民主，抵抗外國影響

Challenging backroom deals that put power over people

挑戰那些將權力凌駕於人民之上的秘密交易

If we succeed, we won’t just protect our homes. We’ll set a precedent that no foreign government can build on British soil without respecting British citizens and British values.

如若成功，我們不僅能保護我們的家園，我們更是創下先例：任何外國政府不得在罔顧英國公民和英國價值的前提下在英國土地上建造任何建築。

Will you stand with us?

您願意與我們並肩作戰嗎？

Please chip in whatever you can. £10. £100. £1,000. Every penny goes to legal costs to take this to court. We are a group of teachers, nurses, shop workers and pensioners. We don’t have the Chinese Communist Party’s millions - but with your help, we do have people power.

請您捐出任何您能負擔的金額 — 不論是 £10，£100 還是 £1,000。每一分錢都將用於支付法律費用，讓我們將此案帶上法庭。我們只是一群教師、護士、店員和退休人士。雖然我們沒有中國共產黨的龐大資金 — 但在您的幫助下，我們擁有的是人民的力量。

Share this far and wide.

請廣傳此訊息。

Donate if you can.

如有行力，請捐款。

Stand up for democracy.

為民主發聲。

Because if they can do this to us, they can do it to anyone.

唇亡齒寒。

PLEASE NOTE

請注意：

This is a secure UK-based platform, fully registered and subject to UK law.

這是一個安全的英國平台，註冊並受英國法律管轄。

It is widely used to support political and legal campaigns, including by MPs, NGOs, and grassroots movements - some of which are openly critical of the Chinese government.

該平台廣泛用於支持政治和法律活動，包括國會議員、非政府組織和基層運動 — 包括曾公開批評中國政府的政治活動。

The platform offers full transparency, with public donation records and payment processing via Stripe or PayPal.

該平台提供完全透明的捐款記錄，並通過 Stripe 或 PayPal 處理支付。

There is no history of censorship or compliance with pressure from the Chinese state.

台以往並無自我審查紀錄，也未曾屈從於中國的壓力。

It adheres strictly to GDPR regulations, ensuring donor and campaigner data is protected.

平台嚴格遵守 GDPR 規範，確保捐款者和活動者的數據安全。

About your donations

關於您的捐款

2.95% + 0.25 of each donation goes to the platform; 100% of the remaining funds will be used to cover legal costs.

每筆捐款將扣除 2.95% 加 £0.25 之平台手續費，其餘款項將全數用以支付法律相關費用。

If the legal case is dismissed, your donation will be directed to charity unless you request a refund. If you would like your donation returned, please email us. We will calculate and refund your contribution (with platform fee deducted).

如法律訴訟最終被駁回，捐款將撥捐予慈善機構，除非閣下主動申請退款。如欲索回捐款，請電郵至，我們將在扣除平台手續費後，計算並退還閣下之捐款。

About campaign updates

關於活動更新

We will post updates every two weeks, which you can follow directly on this page.

我們每兩週更新一次進展，您可以直接於此頁面查看。

# US Hong Kong Safe Harbor Postcard Campaign

***When donation, make as anonymous if you wish to hide the donator's name and make the TIPS to 0.00***While US-China tensions continue to escalate and the November presidential elections loom near, as Hongkongers living in the United States (or any informed person in the world), we must not forget or turn a blind eye to the CCP’s continuous oppression on Hongkongers and other minority groups in China, such as Uyghurs, Tibetans, and Mongolians. With the promulgation of the new National Security Law on June 30, 2020, the government has since been arresting and charging dissidents with these vaguely-worded laws that may entail life imprisonment. In the past month alone, 12 Hong Kongers fleeing protest-related charges have been detained in China and denied meetings with lawyers since August 23, 2020; Legislative Council elections had been postponed a year in the name of “public health concerns” amidst a mass arrest of candidates; media mogul Jimmy Lai, who runs the only pro-democratic print newspaper in Hong Kong, has been arrested with the National Security Law; and the Education Bureau has begun actively censoring content they deemed politically incorrect in Liberal Studies textbooks, including concepts like “civil disobedience” and “separation of powers”, and images of Lennon Walls. Up until today, the administration has arrested more than 10,000 Hong Kongers, charged over 2,200, deployed water cannons, fired more than 16,000 tear gas canisters and over 10,000 rubber bullets against its own people. Freedom of speech, freedom of assembly and political rights as we knew it have been thoroughly eroded.11月的美國總統大選逐漸逼近，中美關係日漸緊張，作為居住在美國的香港人或是在這個世界上任何有良知的人，面對中共對香港、維吾爾族、藏族和蒙古族的持續壓逼，我們不能容忍，更不能視而不見。自2020年6月30日頒布《國家安全法》以來，政府持續逮捕異見人​​士，並以措辭含糊的法律起訴抗爭者，香港的司法制度已經徹底淪為政府的打壓工具。及後更有12名香港抗爭者為了逃離這種不公義的審判欲流亡台灣，卻被中共非法拘捕。他們無法與律師會面，音訊全無。而香港人僅有的發聲方法——立法會選舉，卻因為「公共衛生風險」而被推遲一年；同時間，大批候選人被逮捕或是被拒絕參選。作為香港唯一異見紙媒《蘋果日報》的老闆黎智英被警方高調逮捕，《蘋果日報》總部更被大肆搜查。教育局亦積極審查通識科教科書中所謂的「政治不正確」內容，例如「公民抗命」和「三權分立」的概念，以及連儂牆相片。到今天為止，已經有超過10,000多名香港人被捕、2,200多人被起訴，警方向市民發射了超過16,000枚催淚彈和10,000多發橡皮子彈，令香港人長期生活在恐懼中。香港人的言論自由、集會自由和政治權利已被徹底侵蝕。In light of the deteriorating situation, we plan to kickstart a new round of postcard campaign urging Congress to pass two bills related to Hong Kong as soon as possible - Hong Kong Safe Harbor Act (H.R.7415/S.4110), and Hong Kong People’s Freedom and Choice Act (H.R.7428/S.4229):鑑於情況日益惡化，我們希望透過郵寄明信片給國會議員的方式，呼籲他們盡快通過兩項與香港有關的法案 —— 香港安全港法案 (H.R.7415 / S.4110) 和香港人民自由與選擇法(H.R.7428 / S.4229):The Hong Kong Safe Harbor Act will designate certain Hong Kong residents who are victims of persecution or who have a well-founded fear of future persecution because of their peaceful political activities as Priority 2 refugees (excluded from refugee cap), allowing them and their spouses, children, parents to apply to the U.S. Refugee Admissions Program for protection. (Click here for more details)《香港安全港法案》將指定某些遭受迫害，或因其參與和平的政治活動而感到恐懼的香港居民列為「優先級別2」的難民，且不受每年限額限制，亦允許他們及其配偶、子女、父母向「美國難民接納計劃」申請庇護。(詳情請瀏覽)The Hong Kong People's Freedom and Choice Act will provide Temporary Protected Status (TPS) for Hong Kongers, maintain Hong Kong’s status as autonomous for the purposes of immigration, provide special and expedited status for certain high-skilled Hong Kongers as well as expedite Permanent Resident status for Hong Kongers residing in the US. (Click here for more details)《香港人民自由與選擇法》會為香港人提供臨時保護身份（TPS），維持香港在移民方面的自治地位，亦為部分香港專業人仕提供特殊和快速的身份，並加快辦理香港人的美國永久居民(綠卡)身份的程序。(詳情請瀏覽)In our last postcard campaign pushing for the Hong Kong Human Rights and Democracy Act, we delivered over 3000 postcards to Congress. We aren’t part of any formal organization and do not have operation funds. We desperately call for your contribution again to help us deliver these postcards to Congress, to remind them of Hong Kong’s urgent situation and urge them to take immediate action. Your contribution would support our printing and delivery costs. Thank you so much!在上一次推動《香港人權與民主法》的明信片運動中，我們向國會送出了超過3000張的明信片。我們不是任何正式組織的成員，也沒有運營資金，所以我們竭誠呼籲您為我們提供資金，並幫助我們將這些明信片送交您們所屬的國會議員，提醒他們香港的緊急狀況，並呼籲他們立即採取行動。所有受到的捐款將支持我們的打印和交付成本。萬分感謝！

【大紀元2026年10月15日訊】（大紀元記者夏楚君澳洲悉尼編譯報導）一項調查發現，兩個涉嫌與中共間諜有關的領英（LinkedIn）帳戶，在全球累積了數千名人脈，並以有償諮詢服務為誘餌，主動聯繫了數十名在澳洲政府、警務及貿易領域任職的人士。

澳廣（ABC）的調查發現，這些涉嫌間諜偽裝成智庫員工，向目標提供具競爭力的報酬，以換取「有價值的建議」。

2016年至2025年間，超過100名與澳洲有關的人士被列為接觸目標，包括前昆州州長、現任反對黨領袖史蒂文·邁爾斯（Steven Miles）、一名澳洲聯邦警察（AFP）指揮官，以及多名聯邦政府高級官員。他們的個人資訊出現在自稱代表智庫的兩個LinkedIn帳戶的聯絡人記錄中。被指控的外國特工聯繫了其中的58位聯絡人，部分收件人也提供了個人聯絡資訊。

澳廣披露，這些澳洲人是被同一中共間諜網絡鎖定，該網絡曾招募澳洲商人亞歷山大·切爾戈（Alexander Csergo）。切爾戈已因「魯莽外國干預罪」入獄，成為首名依此罪名被定罪者。

澳洲聯邦警方在調查切爾戈期間獲得的LinkedIn記錄顯示，這些帳戶曾聯繫過其他澳洲人，其中包括在政府機構和州貿易投資機構工作的人員。聯邦警方稱，這項行動由中共國家安全部（MSS）策劃。聯邦警方表示，中共國家安全部使用虛假的LinkedIn帳戶，聯繫並培養潛在的外國線人，然後向他們索取資訊。

但中共駐堪培拉大使館否認相關指控，稱澳洲聯邦警方的說法「毫無根據」。

今年6月，由美國、英國、澳洲、加拿大和新西蘭組成的五眼聯盟發出罕見聯合警告，指中共情報機構利用線上求職平台進行招募，藉此取得對五眼聯盟國家具有戰略及戰術優勢的情報。

## 以高薪顧問工作為誘餌 接觸政府及貿易部門人士

2021年11月，當時居住在上海的切爾戈收到一個名為Vera Su的LinkedIn帳戶發出的兼職工作邀請。對方自稱來自Nesa Consulting，表示該機構希望聘請專家，就中國與澳洲之間的貿易提供建議。澳廣對Vera Su的通訊記錄進行分析後發現，同樣的LinkedIn帳號也在尋找其他擁有相關專業知識和人脈的人。

被直接接觸的人士包括曾任職於澳洲貿易投資委員會（Austrade）、澳洲外交貿易部（DFAT）、新州投資局（Investment NSW）、維州投資局（Invest Victoria）及澳洲旅遊局（Tourism Australia）的人員。

部分訊息更直接探詢對方能否接觸政府內部人士。其中一則訊息寫道：「我想知道您是否有特殊的資訊來源……例如：來自政府重要人物的資訊。」

一位澳洲貿易投資委員會的員工表示，他不能接受金錢，因為他為澳洲政府工作，但他表示願意介紹自己職業網絡中的人脈。

前昆州州長邁爾斯在2021年4月擔任副州長期間，也與Vera Su的LinkedIn帳戶有聯繫。據澳廣了解，邁爾斯沒有回覆Vera Su發出的任何訊息。

## 商業顧問：警惕網上接觸及美人計

澳廣檢視的數據顯示，部分與澳洲有關的目標分享了聯絡方式，或討論改以LinkedIn以外的方式繼續交流，包括通過微信、電話或會面。

商業顧問尼克·科伊爾（Nick Coyle）在處理其前伴侶成蕾在中國被捕一事時，也遭涉嫌中共間諜的接觸。

「那段時間我收到很多奇怪的接近」，他說。有些是「美人計」，有人試圖線上或線下成為「朋友」。

「我採取的做法是——如果我之前不認識他們，就會回避」，他說。

澳洲人生教練（life coach）阿德里安·卡希爾（Adrian Cahill）也在2021年與Vera Su交換了聯絡方式。他懷疑自己前軍人的背景使他成為更具吸引力的目標。

「我經常收到這類訊息」，他說。「有人寫信給我說『我們有工作、有錢、有預算』。」

他說，過去接受的訓練有助他辨識這類手法，但缺乏安全及情報經驗的人會逐漸被誘入陷阱，提供「越來越多的信息」。

## 專家：情報搜集手法出現根本轉變

中國情報問題專家尼古拉斯·埃夫蒂米亞迪斯（Nicholas Eftimiades）形容這類國家支持的「撒網」行動是情報搜集手法的「根本轉變」。他表示，中國日益增長的AI能力可能發揮了作用，使中共情報人員能夠更有效率、更安全地進行大規模招募。

「他們可以一次接觸數十萬人，招募人員為他們工作的成本更低」，他說。

曾為美國政府處理涉及中共情報行動案件的美國前聯邦檢察官維卡斯·迪德瓦尼亞（Vikas Didwania）表示，LinkedIn是情報收集的「金礦」。

「我們在LinkedIn上看到有人公開自己能接觸到什麼機密資訊、擁有什麼等級的安全許可。」

迪德瓦尼亞表示，從LinkedIn招募對象取得的資訊可能並非機密，甚至不實用，但可能只是培養消息來源過程的一部分。

「在關係發展過程中，你可以開始再推進一步。」

## 與中國往來的澳洲人面臨的微妙平衡

近年來，澳洲安全情報局（ASIO）局長邁克·伯傑斯（Mike Burgess）警告稱，外國干預澳洲的威脅已達到「極端級別」，並且很可能會加劇。

在切爾戈的審判中，法庭獲悉他沒有洩漏任何機密資訊，他的報告均來自公開信息。克雷格·史密斯（Judge Craig Smith）法官判處切爾戈三年六個月監禁。他表示，阻止人們參與可能危害澳洲國家安全的活動「至關重要」。

對於與中國合作的澳洲人來說，這項判決也重新界定了與外國實體進行合法合作與國家支持的干預之間的危險界線。

中國約有2,000家智庫，這些機構與中共及政府的關係各不相同，而且往往不透明。此外，中共2017年實施的《國家情報法》要求組織及公民支持國家情報工作。一些專家認為，這項法律在實際運作中的影響，也可能波及在中國經營的外國企業。

迪德瓦尼亞表示，應對中共間諜活動的努力需要權衡利弊，避免產生寒蟬效應。

他表示，「如何區分真正意義上的合作和實際上是國家安全部招募人員的合作，確實是一個挑戰。」

# Help 88-year old Veteran Keep His Home After Marriage Fraud

UPDATE 9/8: Our retainer is gone and we are in need of funds to replenish the trust account with the attorney. We are in the middle of the discovery process, and while the wife continues to hide assets, we are forced to subpoena her bank and investment accounts which costs more money. The lawyer will ask the court that she pay our attorney fees, it likely won’t be granted until the trial in February. By then we may be out a lawyer because we can’t pay him. UPDATE 6/25: We have retained an attorney! We are continuing to seek donations for when the retainer runs out. Due to family donations, we need to raise less money than originally anticipated, so we’ve lowered our fundraiser from $15,000 to $10,000. My 88-year-old father is a victim of elder abuse and marriage fraud that may leave him homeless and destitute. I am setting up this GoFundMe to pay for his legal representation, likely the only way he will be able to keep his home of 23 years. Please hear our story: About six years ago, my father was pursued through an online dating site by a woman named Candy. In a matter of days and through very limited communication, she convinced my father she was in love with him, asked for his address, hopped on a Greyhound, and moved into his small home. Within two weeks they were married at the courthouse. Candy is a citizen of the People’s Republic of China, had been in and out of the country on a B2 tourist visa, and is 22 years younger than my father. Immediately after the marriage, Candy began the US citizenship process with my father's sponsorship. Upon her demand, my father took out a series of small loans to hire her an immigration attorney even though she started working. She began to receive social security spousal support, and was also receiving money from her Chinese pension. In spite of her income, my father continued to pay all their bills himself, including the mortgage and utilities. When Candy took a trip to Hawaii (with her friends and her own income), my father disclosed to me that he did not feel safe with her. I learned she had become increasingly hostile towards him, calling him fat, denying him food, referring to him as “the sickly old man” behind his back, and at times being aggressive enough that he would choose to sleep and/or sit in his car until she left the house. Her favorite insult was "garbage husband." It became increasingly clear that Candy was exploiting my father. At one point she approached him with a Quit Claim deed to transmute his sole property into community property. In the throes of an abusive relationship, my father felt like he had no choice but to sign the deed. Now my father's home of 23 years - and its equity - belongs to her as well. About a year ago, Candy started stealing money from my father, and he found himself overwhelmed with not being able to pay the bills that supported them both. By this time, my father had long been beaten down from the abuse, but in a last ditch effort he built up the nerve to ask Candy to return the stolen money and sign a quit claim to give back his house - she said only if he gave her $80,000! My brother and I were relieved when my father made the decision to file for divorce, and we become increasingly involved on his behalf. We prepared court paperwork for him as he cannot identify the correct documents. My father can't type and his handwriting is slow, so filling out forms is also challenging. He is a poor communicator. He often nods off at court. Recognizing that my father cannot represent himself in court, a judge ordered a settlement conference, which went nowhere fast because Candy still demands $80,000. My father does not have any money laying around, and is leveraged to the hilt with debt from the marriage (all in his name), so he couldn't borrow money to pay her even if he wanted. As a National Guard veteran, senior, and low-income individual, my father is eligible for free legal advice three times over, but what he needs is representation. Because of his advanced age and the complexity of his case, he does not have the mental capacity to represent himself. He has long been unable to organize and process decent amounts of detailed information without assistance. He is overwhelmed at the thought of losing his house, which flusters him even more. If he loses his house, not only does he face homelessness, but more importantly he loses the property's equity that was intended to cover his long-term nursing care, care that he is starting to need, and the emotional toll of being forced to sell and move out of his house would surely be the end for him. We appreciate every donation, big and small. The money raised will go directly to his legal representation. Please feel free to contact me with questions or more details.

**Heather Liu**

# Help A #MeToo Survivor and Daughter Win Their Case

(中文版見後）What I’ve experienced isn’t what any woman should ever go through. First there was the violence of non-consensual sex forced on me, followed by lies and denial. Then, rare moments of hope, followed by setbacks tinged with revenge from a father whose fear of revealing truth drives him to deny his child’s existence. This child is my daughter. For 20 years I’ve hidden the nightmare involving her origin by my silence, partly due to the sense of shame and partly because the father of my child is a influential public figure. Till the rapist has pushed us to a corner by threatening our existence with vicious conspiracy theories.（我經歷了任何一位女性都不該經歷的事情。先是遭遇性侵，接著還要面對謊言、抵賴和詆毀。過去20年來，間或閃現的希望，卻因我女兒的生父拒絕承認這孩子的存在，而淹沒在長久的幻滅中。過去20年來，我一直對女兒的身世三緘其口，讓一段揮之不去的夢魘深藏內心，一方面出於羞辱感，另一方面無法面對孩子的生父作為一個公眾人物給我心靈帶來的扭曲。）With your help, the truth of our experience will be told. When it is, I hope justice will prevail. This is why I’m emerging from the shadows.（因您伸出援手，我將得以說出這段真實的經歷。當真相大白的那一天到來，我希望正義能夠隨之彰顯。）(Charlotte and me in 2003)In 2000, I was a journalist working for a local Chinese newspaper in Los Angeles. I was assigned to interview a famous Chinese dissident, a political refugee in America, who people called the “Godfather of the Democratic Movement in China.” I wrote the story, but in doing so, my life was changed forever by his sexual assault of me.（2000年，身為洛杉磯當地一家中文媒體記者的我，被派去採訪一位著名的中國異議人士，也是我本人非常敬仰的政治流亡者、一位被視為「中國民主運動之父」的風雲人物。我完成了採訪任務，然而我的個人生活卻因今生與他這唯一的遭逢而徹底脫軌。）Let’s just say, nine months after I did that story, I gave birth to my daughter, who bore no resemblance to my then-husband. My husband knew why since I’d told him about the sexual assault after it happened. My marriage ended, and my life as a single mom began. To protect my daughter and me from possible backlash about how she was conceived and her father’s identity, I kept my ordeal quiet. The two of us moved to Hong Kong.（在我做了那次採訪的9個月之後，我的女兒降生了。她跟我當時的丈夫長得一點也不像，而我丈夫也並不感到驚訝，因為我早跟他坦白了我遭遇性侵的事。我的婚姻其實從那時起已名存實亡，我作為一個單親母親的生涯也即將開始。為了遠離各種因孩子身世而產生的猜忌，讓我和孩子可以過安靜而屬於自己的生活，同時也為了可以就近得到父母家人的幫忙照顧，我帶著孩子離開了美國，赴香港尋找發展機會。） Through the years I never thought about contacting my daughter's biological father, whom I met only once. I didn’t consider doing this even after I lost my job as an editor in 2012. But then a former colleague, Beifeng, left Hong Kong for the United States. He’d criticized me for "depriving the child the right to be recognized by her father," and later persuaded me to let him bring a lock of my daughter’s hair, wrapped it in tissue paper, that he took with him to the United States. （多年來，我從未想過要聯絡孩子的生父，那個我只見過一面的人，哪怕是2012年我失業的時候也沒萌生這個打算。我根本已經忘記了這個人，要不是當時正要動身赴美的前同事北風（我告訴了他我的孩子生父是誰，但沒有讓他知道詳情，他也沒有探問）批評我「剝奪孩子認父的權利」。他太太當即揪了孩子幾根頭髮，用手紙包了起來。） (drawing by Charlotte)Months later, my heart sank when Beifeng reported back to me that this man had denied everything, even the possibility of knowing me, let alone the possibility of having fathered a child. He’d committed this horrible crime against me, but he refused to acknowledge this truth. For to accept that he’d fathered a daughter, he’d have to admit how she came to existence. It appeared that he was refusing to allow his carefully crafted story about his “heroic” life to be marred by acknowledging his daughter’s existence.（幾個月之後，北風帶來消息並深表意外地說，孩子的生父得知自己可能有個孩子時的反應，竟是敷衍和閃躲，好像根本不可能有這回事一樣。他當然寧肯忘記自己做過的事，但真相怎麼能因你不想面對就可以不承認、孩子怎麼可以就這樣當她不存在呢？就像他後來在郵件裡提到的，他所關切的，是這事將來在他的回憶錄裡該怎麼寫，而不是他身為人父應該盡什麼責。他在意的只是他自己英雄般的人生，無論如何不能留下任何污點。）After this news reached me, I was diagnosed with clinical depression and started to see a doctor regularly. Professionally, however, I had to appear calm and collected so I could earn a living that would support the two of us. I worked as a freelance writer and translator, while also raising my daughter on my own.（我聞訊心裡沉了一下，不久開始意識恍惚，甚至試過下班下車記不起回家的方向。我遠在北京的母親聽說之後，在電話的另一頭啜泣得聲音哽咽。2013年2月，我被確診患上抑鬱症。失業更兼病倒，令我們母女的生計雪上加霜，這期間我成為自由撰稿人，還要硬撐著努力譯書維持生計。好在偶爾有父母幫手、妹妹接濟一下，才度過了一段危機。） (drawing by Charlotte)Five years later, in 2018, in the midst of #MeToo movement, when sexual abuse and harassment were receiving public attention globally, rumors spread online about this famous Chinese man having fathered an illegitimate child. At that point, I contacted him by phone from Hong Kong and boldly asked for child support.（一晃又過了5年，時間到了2018年，在#MeToo（「我也是受害者」）運動的聲浪中，性侵和性騷擾現象的普遍存在引起了全球性輿論關注。在此期間，網上首次出現了對我女兒的生父「不認親」的議論。已變得反應遲緩的我這才開始應對，邁出了主動聯繫孩子生父這一步。）He agreed to a DNA test that was performed privately in Washington D.C.., The DNA results proved that he was Charlotte's father. The person who shared the results with him said that he had responded positively to having a daughter. Accordingly, when I contacted him again, he promised to assist us by at least paying for her education. But later on, since I would not change my tone on the unhappy encounter with him in the past, he decided to deny being Charlotte’s father and began to challenge the DNA results, shirked his responsibility as her biological father, and ignored that I was a victim of his violent sexual assault.（他於是主動提出做個DNA鑑定，並指定了一位背景相當可靠的前白宮幕僚做中間人，在華盛頓特區進行了DNA樣本的收集與鑑定。結果出來後，中間人率先通知我，說結果證明魏先生是孩子的生父無疑，並告訴我，魏先生對鑑定結果表示認可並顯得「很開心」。據此，在我與孩子的生父再次聯繫時，他表示自己起碼會負擔孩子的大學學費。但真到了時候他又變卦了，甚至仗著沒有把DNA鑑定結果如約給我們，便想將已經做過DNA鑑定這事也想賴掉。） (drawing by Charlotte)The rest of the story is detailed in Huaizhao Liu v. Jingsheng Wei, case #1:19-cv-03344, which was heard in the Washington, D.C. federal court. Charlotte’s father managed to find the funds necessary to hire a high-powered defense attorney to help him to deny both our dignity and his basic obligations of paternity.（後來的事情見華盛頓特區聯邦法院卷宗（Case Number 1:19-cv-03344）。我女兒的生父大手筆聘請了專攻白領犯罪辯護的名牌大狀為自己的辯護律師，竭力搬弄法律條文進行技術性規避，想就此永遠掩蓋真相，踐踏我們母女的權益與尊嚴。）We believe that Charlotte’s biological father should be forced to keep his promise of supporting her education, and we are asking that he release the DNA test results to us. His 19-year old daughter deserves to know the truth.（我們堅信，法庭應該為這位竭力否認已經做過親子鑑定的生父驗明正身，然後強制他履行他的諾言，承擔他女兒的學費。我們堅信，他19歲的女兒有權利知曉真相。）The weight of evidence is on our side, but we risk losing the lawsuit that we are filing against him if we cannot raise the money we need to hire an attorney who is as capable as his lawyer. What is at risk is Charlotte's right to a quality education, along with the legally binding acknowledgement of his paternity.（儘管我們掌握活生生的證據，但如果籌不到聘請律師的費用，單憑我們自訴，將無法應對複雜的陪審團庭審程序。立案至今一年多來，被告採取躲和拖的戰術，先是躲傳票，然後提出「司法管轄權」爭議逼我們撤案，一計不成又援引「多國籍」條款，將案子從特區高等法院轉移到聯邦法院。） (Charlotte drawing)With your assistance – with your contributions – we intend to hire an attorney who is experienced in sexual assault and paternity cases. We hope to win this #MeToo case and pursue respectful, equal and democratic human relationship in Chinese community. （您的捐助將幫助我們聘請到專攻性侵案和親子案官司的律師，幫我們贏得這場事關尊嚴、平等、人權以及人性的人身傷害官司，並藉此推動美國的華人社區乃至全球華人的觀念進步與行為的現代化。）Here are some online stories and commentary about this, in Chinese: （以下是部分有關此案的中文文章：）https://www.storm.mg/article/2891777?mode=whole廖亦武：《魏京生DNA認親案》(by Liao Yiwu, award winner of Human Rights Watch Hellman-Hammett Grant 2003, the German Geschwister-Scholl-Preis 2011 and the Peace Prize of the German Book Trade 2012.)（作者/廖亦武，詩人、流亡作家與底層歷史記錄者。2012年德國書業和平獎得主，並曾獲美國《當代基督教》雜誌頒發的「最佳圖書奬」、德國書業協會頒發的「紹爾兄妹獎」、德國廣播協會頒發的「最佳廣播劇奬」及德國阿夏芬堡頒發的「公民勇氣奬」。2013年，法國政府頒發給廖亦武「法蘭西文學藝術軍官獎章」。2018年，廖亦武獲美國紐約瓦茨拉夫 哈維爾圖書基金會頒發「無懼危難作家獎」。）http://minzhuzhongguo.org/MainArtShow.aspx?AID=105641齊家貞：《我認識的劉懷昭和魏京生》(by Qi JIazhen, writer in exile, author of autobiographical series: Tears o

title: Top ‘Cockroach’ leaders sent to jail after protest
summary: **NEW DELHI** — Two leaders of India's youth-led Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) were remanded in custody for five days on Wednesday, as police ratcheted up efforts to clamp down on anti-election commission protests. CJP activists and oppositio
content:
**NEW DELHI** — Two leaders of India's youth-led Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) were remanded in custody for five days on Wednesday, as police ratcheted up efforts to clamp down on anti-election commission protests.

CJP activists and opposition parties have defied a security crackdown to demand the resignation of India's chief election commissioner, accusing the poll body of manipulating voter rolls to benefit Prime Minister Narendra Modi's ruling party.

The commission, which oversees voting in the world's most populous nation, has denied any wrongdoing.

*   [Ukraine accuses US of helping Russia as missiles hit Kyiv](https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/10/15/world/ukraine-accuses-us-of-helping-russia-as-missiles-hit-kyiv/2446078)

Delhi Police said CJP leaders Ashutosh Ranka, 30, and Saurav Das, 27, were taken into custody for their "alleged repeated attempts to disturb public peace and violate the law."

At the end of the five-day remand period, they could have their detention extended, be granted bail or be released.

AFP PHOTO](https://manilatimes.net/manilatimes/uploads/images/2026/10/14/1259329.jpg)](https://manilatimes.net/manilatimes/uploads/images/2026/10/14/1259329.jpg)
RESILIENT RALLYISTS Student activists shout slogans during a protest demanding the resignation of India’s chief election commissioner in the capital New Delhi on Oct. 14, 2026. AFP PHOTO

On Tuesday, the pair jumped security barricades to wave the national flag at Jantar Mantar, a decades-old protest site that police have barred people from using.

*   ![Image 2: Laguna mayors rally behind Aragones](https://miopia.newsroom.bi/statics/i/ps/manilatimes.net/manilatimes/uploads/images/2026/10/14/1257533.jpg?width=113&crop=113:85)
[Laguna mayors rally behind Aragones](https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/10/14/regions/laguna-mayors-rally-behind-aragones/2444954)

"Their alleged attempts to instigate others through social media to engage in similar unlawful activities were also taken into consideration," police said.

Parliamentary opposition leader Rahul Gandhi of the Indian National Congress party backed the men, who were detained after entering the site.

Jantar Mantar, in the heart of the capital New Delhi, has been sealed off for days with yellow metal barricades and guarded by security personnel.

Delhi Police said on Monday it had removed the site from its list of designated protest venues.

*   ![Image 3: Pangilinan seeks reversal of ruling on Duterte’s dropped charges](https://miopia.newsroom.bi/statics/i/ps/manilatimes.net/manilatimes/uploads/images/2026/10/14/1258438.jpg?width=113&crop=113:85)
[Pangilinan seeks reversal of ruling on Duterte’s dropped charges](https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/10/14/news/pangilinan-seeks-reversal-of-ruling-on-dutertes-dropped-charges/2445025)

"Waving the Tricolor at Jantar Mantar in a peaceful protest is not a crime," Gandhi said in a post on social media. "Jailing youth for it is an act of cowardice."

The Congress and CJP have both protested over the voter roll revision. Gandhi said on Wednesday that "all protests are one."

"Different banners, one cause," he added.

'Stand up'

*   ![Image 4: Marcos’ impeachment plot backfires](https://miopia.newsroom.bi/statics/i/ps/manilatimes.net/manilatimes/uploads/images/2026/10/13/1258203.jpg?width=113&crop=113:85)
[Marcos’ impeachment plot backfires](https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/10/14/opinion/columns/marcos-impeachment-plot-backfires/2444878)

CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke praised the men, saying they "knew they could be thrown behind bars" but went ahead to wave the national flag.

"They've shown the entire country that the only way to stand up to a bully like Modi is to never bow down, no matter the consequences," he said in a social media post.

Das has worked as a journalist, while Ranka, an engineer, studied at the prestigious Indian Institute of Technology and the London School of Economics.

Rights advocates and critics say Modi's government has eroded democratic freedoms during more than a decade in power, citing pressure on journalists, civil society groups and political opponents — allegations the government rejects.

Human Rights Watch said on Wednesday the Indian government must uphold the right of citizens to protest peacefully.

"The Modi government should stop throwing young protesters in jail and instead engage with them to address concerns over the right to vote and fairness of elections," it said in a statement.

Journalists in New Delhi marched on Tuesday to protest the detention of reporters during demonstrations. The Press Club of India said attacks on journalists doing their jobs were "unacceptable."

The electoral list revision, which began last year, has led to more than 133 million names being removed from electoral rolls, according to media reports. Critics say the exercise has disproportionately affected minorities, particularly Muslims.

Election authorities say the move was intended to eliminate duplicate, deceased and fraudulent entries.

Members of Modi's Hindu nationalist Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) have long alleged that large numbers of undocumented Muslim migrants from neighboring Bangladesh have fraudulently entered India's electoral rolls.

Home Minister Amit Shah, Modi's powerful right-hand man, dismissed the protests as localized and accused Gandhi of pursuing an "action plan to protect infiltrators."

"The people of India are not going to fall for your deception," he said, predicting a "resounding majority" for government in the next general election, due in 2029.

title: Inadmissible evidence may be admitted if not challenged
summary: **_Dear PAO,_** **_I filed a data privacy case before the National Privacy Commission (NPC), and the said office ruled in my favor. However, the appellate court overturned the NPC’s decision, stating that the text messages I attached to my
content:
**_Dear PAO,_**

**_I filed a data privacy case before the National Privacy Commission (NPC), and the said office ruled in my favor. However, the appellate court overturned the NPC’s decision, stating that the text messages I attached to my complaint were unauthenticated and thus inadmissible. This is surprising because the respondent did not even contest the admissibility of the text messages. Can I still elevate the case to the higher court?_**

**_Syl_**

*   [The ‘captain of the ship’ doctrine](https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/10/14/legal-advice/the-captain-of-the-ship-doctrine/2444935)

Dear Syl,

Yes, you may still elevate the case in the higher court, subject to the prescription period provided for by the Rules of Court.

 delivered to your inbox

Sign up for The Manila Times newsletters

By signing up with an email address, I acknowledge that I have read and agree to the [Terms of Service](https://manilatimes.net/terms-of-service "Terms of Service") and [Privacy Policy](https://manilatimes.net/privacy-policy "Privacy Policy").

As ruled in the case of Trimillos v. Fcash Global Lending Inc., GR 271360, Aug. 13, 2025, penned by Associate Justice Henri Jean Paul Inting, inadmissible evidence may be admitted if not challenged at the proper time, and such issue may not be raised for the first time on appeal, saying:

“However, in the same case, the Court also recognized that inadmissible evidence may be admitted if not challenged at the proper time and such issue may not be raised for the first time on appeal, viz.:

“In any case, it bears pointing out that petitioner failed to raise his objection to the admissibility of the photos during the proceedings in the RTC. Basic is the rule that in order to exclude evidence, the objection to admissibility of evidence must be made at the proper time, and the grounds therefore be specified. Objection to evidence must be made at the time it is formally offered. In case of documentary evidence, offer is made after all the witnesses of the party making the offer have testified, specifying the purpose for which the evidence is being offered. It is only at this time, and not at any other, that objection to the documentary evidence may be made. When a party failed to interpose a timely objection to evidence at the time they were offered in evidence, such objection shall be considered as waived. This is true even if by its nature the evidence is inadmissible and would have surely been rejected if it had been challenged at the proper time.

*   ![Image 1: Laguna mayors rally behind Aragones](https://miopia.newsroom.bi/statics/i/ps/manilatimes.net/manilatimes/uploads/images/2026/10/14/1257533.jpg?width=113&crop=113:85)
[Laguna mayors rally behind Aragones](https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/10/14/regions/laguna-mayors-rally-behind-aragones/2444954)

“As a complimentary principle, it is well-settled that no question will be entertained on appeal unless it has been raised in the proceedings below. Points of law, theories, issues and arguments not brought to the attention of the lower court, administrative agency or quasi-judicial body, need not be considered by a reviewing court, as they cannot be raised for the first time at that late stage. Basic considerations of fairness and due process impel this rule. Any issue raised for the first time on appeal is barred by estoppel.”

In your case, the respondents did not even contest, in any stage of the proceeding, the admissibility of your evidence. Thus, you can argue before the higher court that by failing to timely raise any objection to the admissibility of the text messages you have attached, the respondent is deemed to have already waived the same. Hence, the text messages are admissible in evidence by virtue of estoppel.

We hope that we were able to answer your queries. This advice was solely based on the facts you have narrated and our appreciation of the same. Our opinion may vary when other facts are changed or elaborated.

Thank you for your continued trust and support.

title: ‘Our soldiers are not troublemakers’
summary: DEFENSE Secretary Gilberto Teodoro Jr. blasted Vice President Sara Duterte for saying the Philippines is “becoming the troublemaker of Southeast Asia,” and made clear that the source of all troubles in the region is China. “Can you say that
content:
DEFENSE Secretary Gilberto Teodoro Jr. blasted Vice President Sara Duterte for saying the Philippines is “becoming the troublemaker of Southeast Asia,” and made clear that the source of all troubles in the region is China.

“Can you say that our soldiers who sacrifice there [in the West Philippine Sea] are troublemakers, when we are only fighting for our rights over the sea that is the future of our country’s sustainability?” Teodoro said in Filipino.

Duterte had made the comment after President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. called alleged remittances from a Chinese state-owned firm into a company linked to the vice president’s husband a potential national security issue.

*   [44% expect Sara Duterte’s conviction in impeachment trial — survey](https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/10/14/news/44-expect-sara-dutertes-conviction-in-impeachment-trial-survey/2445251)

“Is doing business with China really prohibited because it’s a national security risk?” Duterte had said in Filipino. ”We are becoming the troublemaker of Southeast Asia.” Teodoro made it clear that engaging with the Chinese in business is not prohibited. What’s in question rather is how a public official is allowed to enter into such transactions.

“Filipinos are not prohibited from doing business with China, but the question is, is a public official, first and foremost, allowed to have any business transactions on a certain level? Some are not, some are. That is a question which has to be determined by the proper investigative authorities,” Teodoro said.

By signing up with an email address, I acknowledge that I have read and agree to the [Terms of Service](https://manilatimes.net/terms-of-service "Terms of Service") and [Privacy Policy](https://manilatimes.net/privacy-policy "Privacy Policy").

Teodoro cited as an example China-owned or linked businesses in the Philippines that were proven to be illegal or flawed such as the alleged substandard steel, illegal mining and the offshore gaming operations which he said “did not benefit the overall integrity of the Philippines.” “If you are a public official, you have a voice in the stability of our national territory and integrity; if you have transactions with China, these should be studied to determine if they are, above all, legitimate and proper,” the Defense chief said.

Teodoro emphasized that it is China who is the troublemaker and not the Philippines, citing as proof the intention of the Association of Southeast Asia Nations (Asean) member countries to finalize a long-awaited South China Sea Code of Conduct with China.

“China is clearly the troublemaker here, crystal clear, and I will not accept any other narrative on that. It’s obvious; nobody can say that the Philippines is the one causing trouble,” Teodoro said.

*   ![Image 1: Pangilinan seeks reversal of ruling on Duterte’s dropped charges](https://miopia.newsroom.bi/statics/i/ps/manilatimes.net/manilatimes/uploads/images/2026/10/14/1258438.jpg?width=113&crop=113:85)
[Pangilinan seeks reversal of ruling on Duterte’s dropped charges](https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/10/14/news/pangilinan-seeks-reversal-of-ruling-on-dutertes-dropped-charges/2445025)

**Chinese talking point**

Vice President Duterte’s use of the word “troublemaker” mirrors Chinese talking points against the Philippines.

China has repeatedly used the label “troublemaker” against the Philippines over the years to describe Manila’s actions in the West Philippine Sea.

In July 2026, Chinese Foreign Ministry spokesman Lin Jian labeled the Philippines a “troublemaker” in the South China Sea after Manila embedded journalists on resupply missions and patrols, accusing the Philippines of provoking maritime confrontations to “stir up tensions.” In July 2015, following the Philippines’ legal challenge against China’s expansive maritime claims at the Permanent Court of Arbitration in The Hague, the Chinese Ministry of Foreign Affairs issued an official statement explicitly referring to the Philippines as the “real troublemaker in the region.”* China accused Manila of deliberately escalating tensions and violating bilateral agreements.

*   ![Image 2: Laguna mayors rally behind Aragones](https://miopia.newsroom.bi/statics/i/ps/manilatimes.net/manilatimes/uploads/images/2026/10/14/1257533.jpg?width=113&crop=113:85)
[Laguna mayors rally behind Aragones](https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/10/14/regions/laguna-mayors-rally-behind-aragones/2444954)

During early disputes following the Scarborough Shoal standoff in July 2013, Maj. Gen. Luo Yuan of the Chinese People’s Liberation Army publicly stated: “The role of the Philippines in the South China Sea is actually, in my view, a troublemaker.” Beijing routinely uses this narrative whenever the Philippines asserts its sovereign rights or brings international visibility to maritime disputes, portraying Manila’s defense measures and joint security partnerships as disruptive to regional peace.

title: Haze worsens air quality in Singapore, East Timor
summary: **SINGAPORE** — Air pollution in one part of Singapore hit the city-state’s “very high” band on Wednesday while East Timor shut schools, as haze from forest fires in Indonesia is causing a regional crisis. The blazes have burned through hun
content:
**SINGAPORE** — Air pollution in one part of Singapore hit the city-state’s “very high” band on Wednesday while East Timor shut schools, as haze from forest fires in Indonesia is causing a regional crisis.

The blazes have burned through hundreds of thousands of hectares of forest and plantations on the Borneo and Sumatra islands, sickened residents in Indonesia and sent thick haze across Southeast Asia.

Air pollution in western Singapore on Wednesday hit “very high” — the country’s top level — the National Environment Agency said.

*   [Japan’s PM: Household duties make me busier](https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/10/15/world/asia-oceania/japans-pm-household-duties-make-me-busier/2445488)

It recorded levels of tiny particulates capable of penetrating the bloodstream and lungs, known as PM2.5, at 288 micrograms per cubic meter, vastly exceeding the World Health Organization’s recommended average annual exposure of five micrograms.

Indonesia regularly battles wildfires during the dry season, but has seen stronger-than-usual blazes this year as a powerful El Niño cycle brings drought.
