By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

16 Oct 2026 at 15:08 HKT · 3 min read

Hong Kong will host the General Assembly of the International Criminal Police Organization (Interpol) for the first time next month, the Secretary for Security Chris Tang Ping-keung has confirmed. In an exclusive interview with Sing Tao Daily, the sister publication of The Standard, Tang reflected on his two-year secondment to Interpol headquarters in Lyon, France, and explained the significance of the upcoming assembly.

Tang served at Interpol's Secretariat in Lyon from 2006 to 2008 as a Specialized Officer before being promoted to Head of the Organized Crime and Violent Crime Unit. He recalled that the work differed significantly from local policing in Hong Kong, requiring direct coordination with international authorities to tackle unfamiliar offenses. During his posting, Tang travelled across Africa, Europe, the Americas and Asia, coordinating anti-piracy operations off the coast of Somalia while based in Tanzania, and countering transnational syndicates linked to organised crime networks such as the Italian Mafia and the Japanese Yakuza. These operations targeted human trafficking, illegal immigration and cross-border gambling networks.

Tang noted that Interpol personnel do not conduct direct arrests. Instead, they operate from command centres to process intelligence, coordinate inter-agency responses and monitor operations in real time. He described the secondment as an invaluable experience that broadened his international perspective and enhanced his understanding of global law enforcement dynamics. Working alongside officials from various cultural and legal backgrounds offered critical exposure to foreign investigative methodologies and organisational management styles, he said, adding that navigating international relations, cross-border security protocols and diverse working cultures served as essential preparation for his subsequent leadership roles as Commissioner of Police and Secretary for Security.

The 94th Interpol General Assembly will take place at the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre from November 30 to December 3, drawing over 1,000 police chiefs, senior government officials and agency leaders from 196 member countries. Tang expressed gratitude to the Central Government for entrusting Hong Kong with hosting the event, following previous assemblies held in Beijing in 1995 and 2017. He stated that the gathering offers an opportunity to demonstrate Hong Kong's public safety, rule of law and professional governance directly to international delegates, counteracting biased media portrayals and showcasing the city's operational capabilities under the "One Country, Two Systems" framework.

To oversee preparations, the HKSAR Government established a three-tier steering structure: a Steering Committee chaired by the Chief Secretary for Administration, an Inter-departmental Working Group led by the Secretary for Security, and a Police Operational Working Group managed by the Commissioner of Police. Extensive preparations have been underway for over a year, including venue security, VIP protection, transport management and crisis management drills. The government is also mobilising youth volunteers and bilingual support staff via various bureaus.

Tang added that the event will incorporate cultural activities, technical showcases featuring robotics and artificial intelligence used by the police force, and high-level exchanges aimed at strengthening global policing partnerships.

# 沈伯洋指都更新政出口窄無解 蔣萬安：將增105名人力

2026/10/16 16:17（10/16 16:56 更新）

[](javascript:)[](javascript:)[](javascript:)[](javascript:)[](javascript:)[![Image 16](https://imgcdn.cna.com.tw/www/website/img/support.svg)](https://cna.com.tw/donate/)

台北市長蔣萬安（圖）16日上午接受廣播節目專訪時宣布將放寬都更門檻，下午隨即在市府召開記者會，說明都更新政策。中央社記者葉蓁芸攝 115年10月16日

（中央社記者[葉蓁芸](https://cna.com.tw/author/0275/)台北16日電）台北市長蔣萬安今天宣布放寬都更門檻，民進黨台北市長參選人沈伯洋說，若放寬入口但出口仍窄，就沒有解決問題。蔣萬安表示，因應新政，將增加都更處人力約105人，以加速審議。

蔣萬安下午在市府召開記者會說明都更政策，會後接受媒體聯訪時被問及沈伯洋說法時表示，水源二、三期及斯文里二期馬上要更新，還有南機場、信維整宅、虎林街60巷等案，不只加快整合意願，也提高審議速度。因應新政，市府會增加1倍人力、提前到位。

媒體提問，若都更門檻降低，是否會導致案量囤積。蔣萬安回應，將增加都更處人力，以利加速審查，他舉出信維整宅、南機場單元三等案例，加速前段整合、審議程序，才能完成招商簽約並拆除更新。

記者追問人力缺乏問題，蔣萬安說，目前已有具體方案，預計增加105名正式員額。至於政策上路時間，蔣萬安說，正進行相關程序，接下來將實施上路。

蔣萬安在記者會中說明，現行都更專案「7599」將調整為「5099」，第一階段自主整合意願門檻從75%降至50%，只要過半人數或戶數有意願，市府就會進場協助試算；第二階段若有90％住戶有意願，即進入第三階段模擬選配，若90％住戶同意，就會公告招商。

蔣萬安表示，第一階段最困難，面對產權複雜、戶數不足情形，須花費許多時間協調整合，降低門檻有助於加速都更，預估將有1214.26公頃地區受惠。

蔣萬安說，第二項新政則是有條件將基準容積從225％增至300％，提高開發誘因，適用於基地面積3000平方公尺以上、位於捷運站或水岸周邊，並在部分容積導入托育、長照服務、圖書館、社會住宅等設施，創造公共利益。

蔣萬安提到，市府已啟動2例大街廓都更案旗艦計畫，第1例為中山行政園區，即過去拆除的第一殯儀館，基地面積1.5公頃，串聯圓山創新聚落、松南AI園區，未來導入區公所、社福照護等，打造中山行政中心。

蔣萬安說，第2例則是南港行政中心，將遷移至南港高工位址，將0.7公頃基地全面都更並提高容積，導入金融、商辦等，結合交通，建構TOD廊帶樞紐。（編輯：林恕暉）1151016

content:
华盛顿 —

美国防务科技公司Shield AI说，该公司已与台湾汉翔航空工业公司(Aerospace Industrial Development Corporation, AIDC)合作，向台湾海洋委员会海巡署交付首架V-BAT垂直起降侦搜无人机，未来还将陆续交付12架同型无人机，以加强台湾对周边海域的态势感知能力。

Shield AI在星期二(10月13日)发布的新闻稿中说，该公司去年7月在海巡署“舰载无人系统项目”招标中得标。海巡署将利用V-BAT的舰载能力执行侦察、海岸巡逻和执法任务，以保持持续性的海域态势感知(Maritime Domain Awareness, MDA)。

**台湾高层视察**

台湾总统府国家安全会议秘书长吴钊燮和海洋委员会主任委员管碧玲，上星期三(10月7日)在海巡署署长张忠龙陪同下，到台北港海巡基地视察海巡科技装备，其中包括Shield AI交付的首架V-BAT。Shield AI亚洲政府关系负责人陈奕儒(Max Chen)和工程师在现场介绍并演示了这架无人机的性能与操作。

Shield AI说，工程师在台北港的演示中“几分钟内便完成装设”，展现了这款无人机易于操作的特点，以及在海洋安全领域的先进技术性能。

海巡署在当天发布的新闻稿中表示，先进无人载具陆续加入，“象征海事执法与防卫体系迈入智慧化新世代”。海巡署未来将常态化投入周边海域执勤，与巡防舰艇形成协同的情监侦网络，“构筑全天候、无死角的海上防线”。

**中国对台湾周边海域施压**

近来中国加大对台湾周边海域的施压，海警、科考和公务船只经常进入台湾邻近水域。台湾海巡署说，星期二又有四艘中国海警船进入金门水域，海巡署全程监控，并派出巡防艇前往驱离。

北京当局称，中国对台湾拥有主权，对其周边水域拥有管辖权。台湾政府拒绝中国的领土主张，并指北京试图营造假象，破坏台海现状。

**V-BAT性能与本土化支持**

Shield AI总裁兼共同创办人曾国光(Brandon Tseng)说，V-BAT将为台湾海巡署提供在台湾海峡及海上边界所需的海域态势感知能力和海上情报图像。他说，V-BAT已为美国海岸防卫队(U.S. Coast Guard)提供同样的能力，仅去年一年就协助拦截了超过10万磅毒品。

曾国光说：“将这一能力扩展到台湾，将有助于维护海峡安全，防范非法活动和敌对行为者。这赋予台湾保护自己水域所需的主权。”

Shield AI的新闻稿说，垂直起降飞行器无须跑道，既提高了部署的灵活性，也降低了成本和人力需求。Shield AI将在台湾建立本土专业能力，培训海巡署的操作和维护人员，并与汉翔公司共同为V-BAT建立稳健的本地支援体系。

按美国国防部依最大起飞重量、飞行高度和速度划分的五级无人飞行系统(Unmanned Aircraft Systems, UAS)标准，V-BAT属于第三级。它配备重油发动机，续航力超过12小时，是为对抗性电子作战环境设计、测试并部署的机型。

Shield AI说，与大型系统相比，V-BAT能以低得多的成本和后勤负担提供情报、监视与侦察(ISR)及目标指示能力。其单引擎、封闭式旋翼设计，可在船舰甲板、城市屋顶和恶劣环境中安全、无须辅助地起飞和回收，在海上和远征行动中尤为有效。

**汉翔合作与本土供应链**

Shield AI说，该公司去年与汉翔公司达成协议，以提升台湾的自主防卫能力，强化航空航天产业基础，并促进技术创新合作。双方通过系统维护、人员培训、自主系统整合等方式展开战略合作，确保Shield AI的产品能在台湾部署、获得支持并扩大应用。

汉翔公司总经理庄秀美(Jennifer Chuang)说，海巡署采用V-BAT，显示Shield AI的世界级技术与汉翔本土专业能力结合所能产生的成效。

庄秀美说：“Shield AI过去一年持续加强在台湾的布局，并一直致力于与本土伙伴合作，在台湾整合、维持和支持先进的自主系统。这让我们确信，他们不只是提供一项能力，也致力于建立本土专业能力和基础设施，提升我们未来多年的海洋安全。”

**分析：美台合作是实现“非红”供应链的捷径**

台湾政府智库“科技、民主与社会研究中心”(Research Institute for Democracy, Society and Emerging Technology, DSET)国家安全组与经济安保组政策分析师方怡然接受美国之音采访时说，包括Shield AI和另一家美国公司Anduril在内，目前有多家美国无人机公司与台湾合作。台湾政府希望本土无人机产业在2027年前实现百分之百“非红”(不含中国元件)的供应链目标，她认为最快的途径就是美台合作。

方怡然说：“现在越来越多美国公司来台湾寻找本土供应链伙伴。Anduril说他们现在大概有30几家供应商；Shield AI则说，台湾供应商和本土伙伴的占比已从大约1%提高到12%，希望未来提高到16%。”

方怡然上个月发表了研究报告《台湾无人机之盾》(Taiwan’s Drone Dome)，探讨台湾无人机的军事需求、政策、本土产业发展、国际合作和未来挑战，强调深化国际合作的重要性。

她说，希望看到更多台湾企业进入美国战争部的“蓝色无人机清单”(Blue UAS Cleared Drone List)，“因为蓝色清单等于认证保证”。目前台湾只有雷虎公司一家在清单上，而只有进入这份安全清单，才能参与战争部的招标。

方怡然认为，台湾企业纳入美国战争部蓝色清单，加上美台产业界的技术合作，将加快台湾的国防自主。不过她表示，更重要的是台湾立法院最近通过的新台币2,400亿元(约75亿美元)无人机预算能够准时到位，才能为台湾的无人系统产业注入一剂强心针。

The Hong Kong Special Administrative Region government will hold an official ceremony on 12 November 2026 at Sun Yat-sen Memorial Park to mark the 160th anniversary of the birth of Dr Sun Yat-sen, the government announced on 16 October.

Dr Sun is described in the government announcement as a great national hero, a great patriot and a great pioneer of China's democratic revolution. The ceremony is intended to honour his contributions to national independence, social progress and the well-being of the people.

Hongkong Post will issue a set of commemorative stamps on the same day to mark the anniversary. Government departments and civic organisations will also hold a series of events from October, including exhibitions, lectures, guided tours, film screenings, student and youth exchange trips to mainland China, local heritage walks and parent-child quiz competitions.

The activities are designed to help the public learn about Dr Sun's life and achievements from multiple perspectives, the announcement said.

Details of the events have been uploaded to a dedicated webpage set up on the Sun Yat-sen Museum official website, which went live on 16 October. The public is invited to visit the webpage for further information.

# Housing Authority to pursue Taizoom over lift installation breaches at two estates

Hong Kong Housing Authority says it will pursue liabilities against Taizoom Elevator Company after the Electrical and Mechanical Services Department found serious deficiencies in lift replacement works at two estates in 2025 and 2026, including missing door frame components.

[![Image 4: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

 By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

 16 Oct 2026 at 03:24 HKT · updated 16 Oct, 04:25 · 1 min read

Share:

[](https://wa.me/?text=Housing%20Authority%20to%20pursue%20Taizoom%20over%20lift%20installation%20breaches%20at%20two%20estates%20https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Housing-Authority-to-pursue-Taizoom-over-lift-installation-b-e5e857 "WhatsApp")[](https://t.me/share/url?url=https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Housing-Authority-to-pursue-Taizoom-over-lift-installation-b-e5e857&text=Housing%20Authority%20to%20pursue%20Taizoom%20over%20lift%20installation%20breaches%20at%20two%20estates "Telegram")[](https://www.facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php?u=https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Housing-Authority-to-pursue-Taizoom-over-lift-installation-b-e5e857 "Facebook")[](https://twitter.com/intent/tweet?url=https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Housing-Authority-to-pursue-Taizoom-over-lift-installation-b-e5e857&text=Housing%20Authority%20to%20pursue%20Taizoom%20over%20lift%20installation%20breaches%20at%20two%20estates "X")[](mailto:?subject=Housing%20Authority%20to%20pursue%20Taizoom%20over%20lift%20installation%20breaches%20at%20two%20estates&body=Housing%20Authority%20to%20pursue%20Taizoom%20over%20lift%20installation%20breaches%20at%20two%20estates%0Ahttps%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Housing-Authority-to-pursue-Taizoom-over-lift-installation-b-e5e857 "Email")

The [Hong Kong Housing Authority](https://clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Hong-Kong-housing-authority-expands-EV-charging-facilities-a-21e115) said on Thursday it has been informed by the [Electrical and Mechanical Services Department](https://clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Hong-Kong-EMSD-reports-latest-Legionella-test-results-for-co-1a878d) (EMSD) that there were serious deficiencies during lift replacement works at two Tenants Purchase Scheme (TPS) estates — Pok Hong Estate in Sha Tin and Tsui Ping (North) Estate in Kwun Tong — in 2025 and 2026 respectively.

Although a fire resisting rating certificate was submitted for the fire resisting doorsets, including door frame components, only the fire resisting doors were installed. Taizoom Elevator Company (HK) Limited did not install the corresponding door frame components. The Housing Authority said the absence of the door frames is a non-compliance, but the lifts can still operate safely.

As the owner of unsold units in the two estates, the Housing Authority said it is highly concerned and is maintaining close contact with the EMSD to follow up and pursue Taizoom's liabilities.

Among all TPS estates, only the two estates had lift replacement works undertaken by Taizoom. For Fu Heng Estate, which is preparing for lift replacement, the contract has not been awarded. The Housing Authority has advised the Incorporated Owners to suspend the contract award and will provide support, including assisting them in studying follow-up arrangements.

# 警方称旺角毒品窝点打击行动中另有两人被捕
香港警方于 10 月 14 日至 15 日在针对旺角贩毒窝点的 Fairlaw 行动中逮捕了两名男子。一名48岁嫌疑人因经营窝点及洗钱金额超过100万港元而被捕，另一名31岁嫌疑人则因允许将处所用作窝点而被捕。两名主谋已被逮捕

警方表示，自六月起，旺角警方在一项代号为“公平法”的行动中，针对该区毒品窝点的策划者和经营者，再逮捕了两名男子。
经调查后，警方于 10 月 14 日星期三在旺角拘捕一名 48 岁黄姓本地男子，罪名是涉嫌经营毒品窝点及洗黑钱。他涉嫌处理超过100万港元的犯罪所得。

10 月 15 日星期四，警察逮捕了一名 31 岁的男子

# Two more arrested in Mong Kok drug den crackdown, police say

Hong Kong police arrested two men on 14 and 15 October in Operation Fairlaw, targeting Mong Kok drug dens. A 48-year-old suspect is held for operating a den and laundering over HK$1 million, while a 31-year-old is held for permitting premises to be used as a den. Two masterminds have been arrested s

[![Image 4: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

 By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

 16 Oct 2026 at 00:59 HKT · 1 min read

Share:

[](https://wa.me/?text=Two%20more%20arrested%20in%20Mong%20Kok%20drug%20den%20crackdown%2C%20police%20say%20https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Two-more-arrested-in-Mong-Kok-drug-den-crackdown-police-say-d75713 "WhatsApp")[](https://t.me/share/url?url=https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Two-more-arrested-in-Mong-Kok-drug-den-crackdown-police-say-d75713&text=Two%20more%20arrested%20in%20Mong%20Kok%20drug%20den%20crackdown%2C%20police%20say "Telegram")[](https://www.facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php?u=https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Two-more-arrested-in-Mong-Kok-drug-den-crackdown-police-say-d75713 "Facebook")[](https://twitter.com/intent/tweet?url=https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Two-more-arrested-in-Mong-Kok-drug-den-crackdown-police-say-d75713&text=Two%20more%20arrested%20in%20Mong%20Kok%20drug%20den%20crackdown%2C%20police%20say "X")[](mailto:?subject=Two%20more%20arrested%20in%20Mong%20Kok%20drug%20den%20crackdown%2C%20police%20say&body=Two%20more%20arrested%20in%20Mong%20Kok%20drug%20den%20crackdown%2C%20police%20say%0Ahttps%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Two-more-arrested-in-Mong-Kok-drug-den-crackdown-police-say-d75713 "Email")

Mong Kok police have arrested two more men in an operation codenamed “Fairlaw” targeting the masterminds and operators of drug dens in the district since June, the force said.

Following investigation, police arrested a 48-year-old local man surnamed Wong in Mong Kok on Wednesday, 14 October, on suspicion of operating a drug den and money laundering. He is suspected of handling over HK$1 million in crime proceeds.

On Thursday, 15 October, officers arrested a 31-year-old local man surnamed Lam at a correctional institution on suspicion of permitting premises to be used as a drug den. He is suspected of renting a building unit for use as a drug den. Police, together with bailiffs, helped the landlord successfully recover the unit involved.

To date, the operation has led to the arrest of two masterminds, including a local man surnamed Yip arrested in June and charged with dealing with property known or believed to represent proceeds of an indictable offence. He is remanded pending transfer to the District Court. The 48-year-old Wong is being detained.

Police warned that operating a drug den or knowingly allowing premises to be used as one carries a maximum penalty of HK$5 million and 15 years' imprisonment.

# 3 die after being found unconscious in Matsu vessel cabin

10/15/2026 08:16 PM

[](jsvscript:)[](jsvscript:)[](javascript:void(0))[Listen](javascript:)

[Link](javascript:)[Whatsapp](javascript:)[Reddit](javascript:)[Line](javascript:)[Email](javascript:)

Photo courtesy of local authorities

Taipei, Oct. 15 (CNA) Three people died Thursday after being found unconscious inside a cabin of a work vessel at Meng'ao Harbor on Dongju Island in the Matsu archipelago, and rescuers later detected high levels of carbon monoxide at the scene.

The three showed no signs of life when rescuers pulled them from the cabin and were later pronounced dead at the local Chukuang Health Center, authorities said.

All three were Taiwanese nationals working for a subcontractor hired to repair the vessel. The vessel was being used by a contractor the Lienchiang County government had commissioned to renovate Meng'ao Harbor.

The Lienchiang County Fire Department received a report at 10:40 a.m. that three workers were trapped and unconscious inside the cabin.

Rescuers reported high levels of carbon monoxide at the scene but said they did not have the equipment to test for other gases.

Media reports said that the deaths may have been linked to exposure to biogas, but authorities said the cause remains under investigation.

Lienchiang County Deputy Magistrate Chen Kuan-jen (陳冠人) said the county government had cordoned off the construction site and ordered the contractor to suspend work, and that it would fully cooperate with prosecutors and the Ministry of Labor in their investigation.

Anyone found responsible for violations or negligence during construction would be held accountable under the law, he said.

The vessel, Dongping No. 17, was used to transport materials for construction work at the harbor, Chen said.

(By Pan Hsin-tung and Shih Hsiu-chuan)

# Hong Kong police smash loan shark syndicate, arrest 22

Hong Kong police have arrested 22 people suspected of running a loan shark syndicate charging annual interest rates exceeding 300 per cent, far above the legal cap of 48 per cent. Officers raided two licensed finance firms in Yau Ma Tei and seized over HK$2 million in cash, documents and valuables.

Hong Kong police have arrested 22 people in a crackdown on a loan shark syndicate that charged annual interest rates exceeding 300 per cent, far above the legal maximum of 48 per cent. The arrests, made on Monday, involved 16 men and six women aged between 27 and 71, on suspicion of offences including lending at excessive interest rates, criminal damage, criminal intimidation and money laundering.

Police said they believed the operation had successfully dismantled a high-interest lending syndicate that controlled two licensed money-lending firms in Yau Ma Tei. Officers raided the premises on Monday. Investigations revealed that bank accounts linked to the firms had recorded more than HK$90 million in transactions over the past year.

The syndicate targeted members of the public through online advertisements and telemarketing, offering quick loan approvals, no credit checks and simple procedures, police said. However, during the loan process, the syndicate used various excuses, such as charging handling or administrative fees, to deduct from the loan amount. Police found that the firms deducted 25 per cent of the loan as a handling fee, pushing the effective annual interest rate well above the legal limit.

Police also said the syndicate used illegal debt-collection methods, including splashing red paint at borrowers' homes and workplaces, posting collection notices with borrowers' personal information, and harassing borrowers and their relatives through phone calls and messaging apps.

During the operation, police seized more than 1,000 loan documents, about HK$2 million in cash, multiple computers and mobile phones, and a number of luxury watches and valuables.

## 中共必然走向灭亡的国际形势特点

还有很多中共内部人士或既得利益者看到这里仍无法接受中共即将走向灭亡的事实，他们认为即使中共内部发生公开化的争斗，那又怎么样？反正是中共内部的争斗，再怎么斗最终也都是中共的人，就是分裂成几块，那也都是中共的政权，说中共会由此灭亡，恐怕是一厢情愿吧？

其实这个观点也有道理，在习上台之前要说这个逻辑也是成立的。

但习上台后，做为一个合格的天选灭共之人，他当然不能给中共留下任何可能存活的机会。

[![Image 2](https://img6.secretchina.com/bigpic/2024/11-4/p3557701a911506510.jpg)](https://naturexcels.com/language/zh/)

这就不得不说一下习的对外施政了。

一个政权要灭亡，在很多时候确实需要有外部力量的存在。如满清王朝，内部已经腐败昏庸到了极点，却仍是溃而不崩。直到八国联军打入北京，才引发了一系列导致灭亡的直接、间接事件，直到彻底灭亡。

中共自认吸取了历史教训，在国际上大力推广它的所谓“和平共处五项原则”，核心就是：互不侵犯、互不干涉内政。什么意思？就是说，它在国内无论怎么残害百姓、镇压民众那都是它的“内政”，别人不能来干预，更不能来“侵犯”。

这就像一个家暴男，到处宣称：我在家里再怎么虐待老婆孩子，就是把他们弄死，那也是我的家事，你们不能干涉、更不能把我赶走。

在五六十年代，国际共产势力还强盛一时之际，把这些主张弄成了国际通行和认可的国际法原则。

但中共仍不放心，因为世界上还有一个军事强国——美国，这个国家以基督教立国，信仰深入人心，连货币上都印着“我们信仰上帝”。

中共自知它是个黑帮邪恶组织，表面上虽然是“政党”，但一旦坏事曝光，就是有那个什么“和平共处五项原则”，美国也有可能会出手干涉，闹不好就会打起来。

但它们认为与美国直接打肯定打不过，只能靠骗。于是它打着被它毁掉的中国五千年文明的幌子假意与美国做朋友，只要美国不来攻击自己，那基本就可以高枕无忧。

其实真要说起来，中共从1936年以[毛泽东](https://www.secretchina.com/news/gb/tag/%E6%AF%9B%E6%B3%BD%E4%B8%9C)会见美国记者斯诺为起点就已经开启了一场长期的针对美国的骗局，欺诈的首要目标（第一张假面具）是让美国认为中共政权是一个同样追求自由民主的政权，其次（第二张假面具）是让美国认为中共只是一个普通的、正常的人类政党，即使有冲突那也是国与国之间正常的竞争关系。

事实上，中共这个靠骗术起家的组织确实把美国蒙骗了快百年，两个假面具一个骗到手了中国的统治权，另一个骗到手了经济腾飞。

但好在，习氏“搅屎棍”终于上台，他彻底抛弃了中共之前的假面具，开始直接和美国硬杠。

暗中搞的名堂暂且不说，只说明显、关键的：一是大量、定向向美国输出毒品芬太尼。并且几乎不加遮掩，似乎就是要以此来要挟或威胁美国在其他政策上对中共让步。习已经让中共政权成为了明面上的、有大量证据证实的顶级贩毒集团。

二是向全世界传播试验室人为制造的[病毒](https://www.secretchina.com/news/gb/tag/%E7%97%85%E6%AF%92)，并且也并不刻意隐藏踪迹，毕竟还有不少美国的组织参与病毒的研制，要说搞科研还好说，但你不能散播啊，那性质可是根本不同的。

以习的认知水平，可能以为那东西反正看不见摸不着，我死不认帐，你能奈我何？但是，目前美国政府已经确认定病毒是从中共试验室泄露出来的，这个认定非常重要，从中共在病毒最开始传播的所作所为可知，它完全没有警告他国并采取措施限制病毒扩散、至今也根本不配合国际的调查——无论病毒从试验室主动还是被动“泄露”出来，恶意“散播”这个罪名算是坐实了！至此，习让中共明确成为了世界上和人类历史上唯一一个真正实施了大规模生化病毒散播的反人类恐怖组织；

试想俄共在苏联时期是不会造毒品、还是不会造病毒、还是俄共领导人不够狠毒？他们都没敢干这种事，为什么？——因为这种事一干出来，就再也没有退路，再也不可能缩回去靠镇压国内民众、闭关锁国维持政权了。

当习领着中共把这些“天大的祸事”干出来以后，估计就是朝鲜的[金正恩](https://www.secretchina.com/news/gb/tag/%E9%87%91%E6%AD%A3%E6%81%A9)也会心惊的暗中猛拍大腿。

后来朝鲜看到俄国打乌克兰需要帮助时，果断投入俄国，开始摆脱中共这个祸秧——你自己想找死，随便，但可千万别拉上我。

任何一个组织，当它开始大规模开展贩毒活动时，那它当然就只是一个犯毒集团——无论它叫太阳贩毒集团、海湾贩毒集团、墨西哥卡特尔还是中国共产党，当然也可能叫阿拉瓜火车，叫什么名不重要，只要它们违反了国际公认的法律，任何一个国家都可以以刑事罪名起诉、追捕、消灭它们。

但或许人们现在就可以思考一下，究竟什么东西会遭到“天灭”？

2026年6月有紫色天雷多次劈了泉州安溪一个周围有不少高楼的仿古建筑“龙须殿”，殿内多个“神像”都是只有脸部被烧黑，而周围建筑一次都没被雷电击中。中共官方出来洗地说，因为周围高大的建筑都有“避雷针”，而这个建筑刚建好还没来的及装，所以雷电劈不到周围的建筑，才劈到了它这里。说实在的，这一洗地更坐实了这事的神奇之处。

查资料可知，所谓“避雷针”根本不是避雷，相反，这个装置是在建筑最高处架设一个细长的金属体主动把雷电吸引到自己身上，然后通过电线将雷电直接导入大地（以此保护建筑本身）——它的作用是主动的吸引雷电，而不是避雷，所谓“避雷”那是相对建筑物本身说的。也就是说，如果周围高大的建筑都装了这个东西，雷电应该会被它们在高空就吸引过去，身处这些高大建筑群中的低矮建筑根本没机会再被雷电击中。但，事实恰恰相反。违反物理原理意味着这些紫色雷电绝非普通下雨时打的雷——官方的洗地反证明此事非常玄妙。

根据中国传统文化，只有当“狐黄白柳”等邪灵、邪祟附在什么东西上害人，人没能力消灭，上天才会出手。关键是一旦招致“天灭”，那就要把这个邪物形神俱灭了，可不像人死了，灵魂还能再轮回转世，它这一灭就彻底魂飞魄散了。

再回头看，如果中共能招来“天灭”，它岂不是和“狐黄白柳”一样是个招致天谴的邪祟吗？从它来源诡异、让人发毒誓为它牺牲一切的邪教仪式来看，也能对应的上必是个邪物。

问题是，它形神俱灭倒没什么，可有的人发毒誓要为它牺牲一切了，在上天看来，发誓的人跟这个邪祟就是一体的，要一起跟着它被形神俱灭！所以请发过誓的人想想，这是你要的吗？连习党魁关键时刻都是保命不保党，你却真的要为它永远的魂飞魄散吗？！

如果这不是你的真实意愿，确实应该赶快退出它。

中国有五千年的记史过程，基于这些历史智慧和现实客观事态、中共内部逻辑、还有一些内部消息，综合起来对当前政局做了些分析推理，去伪存真，分析推理过程也是重逻辑、重客观事实，理出的大致轮廓和大方向应该是准确的。

本文写给那些存有善念，珍惜自己和自己未来的人，至少也是有足够理性和理智的人。8月26日西藏发生泥石流惨剧，当上游的人发现了危险，给身处下游的居民打电话警告时，当地的天空一片晴朗，似乎根本没有任何危险会出现，但面对这种保命的警告，有人选择相信，最终在灾难中毫发无伤的活了下来；而那些面对警告认为自己什么风浪没见过，真有灾难我怎么会不知道？从而无视警告的人……

## 《推背图》四十六至五十九象的预言

在本文最后再次回顾一下《推背图》四十六至五十九象的预言，对即将要发生的未来做一次简单的描绘，希望所有的人都明白——在《推背图》的预言中抛弃中共邪恶统治后的中国即将迎来一个多么美好的明天。

在最后这些预言中，四十七和五十一象含义虽然明了，但指向性不太强，似乎也不是太重要的事件，由于理解有限，只能先暂时搁置。除此之外，从四十九象开始先是总述和概括性的指出了中国将从统一政权走向分裂的大结局，五十象则是大体给出了分裂开始的时间节点，然后接下来五十二、五十三、五十四象如果三象所预示的事件有先后顺序并且顺序正确的话，那么，分裂和独立首先会从“吴楚之地”（长江中下游、江南一带）开始，接下来是“关中”（西北）地区、再下来是黄河中下游、中原地区，到此时，对中共来说局势已经是“磊磊落落、残棋一局”了，所有明眼人都能清楚的看明白中共灭亡的结局了。

在这个过程中，在中共统治彻底灭亡（第五十七象）之前，各个地区的分裂和独立似乎是一个隐性的过程、并不伴随着激烈的战争。或者说中共因中央统治式微，军队背离，因而对地方失去了控制，无力进行军事征讨，只能任由各地相继实行不公开的独立。而中共似乎仍维持着表面的统治形式，有点类似东汉未年“十常侍之乱”后的东汉政权，实际只剩下个名头。只不过此次独立出来的地方政权并不像东汉未年那样互相争战，相反，这些政权是彼此友好支持、一致针对中共的。

可以看到在《推背图》四十五象中，配图是五个小童一起在驱赶一头牛，能看到表情的都是在挥着木棍叱喊，一幅驱逐之意。中共在中国建政之年是牛年，配图应该是用牛来代表中共统治，但此时，健壮高大的牛已经瘦小的比几个小孩子还矮一头，这表明此时中共已经非常虚弱。有人说这五个小孩表示中共的五代领导人，但从《推背图》的画风来看，小孩子一般都代表着正义或善良的力量，这里认为这五个小孩表示在此时至少已经有五个新生的地方政权，他们也可能是公开驱赶，也可能是暗中驱逐，反正他们一起将中共势力逐出了他们管控的地区。

而此时的中共权力缩水，只剩下一张表皮，只能在表面装作强硬，但色厉内荏。预言中的“不分牛鼠与牛羊”可能是说“中共高层不分属鼠还是属羊的”（可以看到从鼠到羊正是目前1955～1960年间出生的这批中共高层领导的属相），以此来指代此时的中共统治集团。而习一尊到这时健康问题日益严重，死守着空洞的“皇位”苟且度日。面对这盘残局，他是“虽笑亦哭”。

就在所有人都看明白中共即将走向覆灭之时，中共政权不甘心面对彻底失败的结局和清算的到来，和纳粹在二战未期一样也在幻想掌握几样超级武器，用它们投入巨资研究了很久的“毒武器”妄图拉着中国和全世界来个鱼死网破！！让所有人给它们陪葬垫背，这就是接下来的《推背图》第五十五象。

配图中，一个枯弱的树干，就剩下梢头有几个沉甸甸的“果实”，要把整棵树都压倒了！这是中共丧心病狂的准备用这些“武器”拉着整个国家一起同归于尽！那个毫无生气的枯树就是整个国家被中共压榨到了极限的象征。

但危急关头，图中有一个官员（实际上应该是很多官员：臣众）举起两只手小心翼翼的托起了将被压倒的枯树，阻止了中共企图同归于尽的邪恶阴谋——“转危为安见节义，未必河山是我送”。

共产主义这个西来幽灵在国际四处流窜，它们如癌细胞一样摧毁着一切能附体的美好东西，它们当然对一个国家的文明、土地毫无感情、随时准备与整个世界同归于尽！据传闻中共确实在搞一些破坏力惊人的武器，但几千年前的《推背图》早就看穿了这一切：“觊觎神器终无用，翼翼小心有臣众”！显然，最后中共想寻死，但并不是所有人都想陪它们一起死。

在接下来的第五十六象中，中共在最后的绝望中，最终是在海上发动了一场对外部战争，妄想能一举翻盘。这场仗具体和谁打的预言没有文字说明，但从配图看大概率是台湾吧，因为图中似乎是两个一模一样的人在打仗，可还有谁能比台湾人和中国人更像呢，原本就是同宗同族的兄弟嘛，当然像了。

而这场仗主要用的是各式海、空武器，士兵本身并未直接参战或者一直到结束也没轮的着参战。但这场仗打的很激烈，给当地造成了不小的破坏和损失，在国际上也形成了非常大的影响、波及了不少国家。中共在这场最后的豪赌中，彻底撕掉了所有伪装、凶相毕露、大打出手，可能到了覆灭前也实在没什么必要再装了吧。

在下来的五十七象中，就在中共邪恶势力似乎要取得战争的优势之时，突然迎来了反转，并且对中共来说似乎是另一场“搬石砸脚”的戏码——被对方“以毒制毒”（这个主导此事的很厉害的人应该还是来自大陆江浙地区）。这次反败为胜非常具有戏剧性，有阴阳相克之理。随着战争的结束，“重洋从此戢兵师”——海洋两边真正实现了永久的和平。但对于中共这种邪恶政权来说，要能真正和平，只能是中共政权彻底走向了覆灭，这也给前面五十四象中的“残棋一局”做出了最终结束的说明。至此，中共邪恶组织和统治——可耻的、永远的退出了人类历史的舞台。

在接下来的五十八象中，中国大陆各方在最终妥善处理和平息了中共在灭亡前所造成的大混乱后，国际社会对中国大陆的现状表示了充分的认可和接受。“称兄弟、六七国”应该指的是在中共发动战争前的五个（四十五象中驱赶中共的五个小童），战争结束后，中共最后占据的地区应该也成为了一国，加上台湾，正好是六七国。此后中国各个政权对政治制度进行了探索，似乎是结合了东、西方政治制度优点，在保持各个政权各自独立的基础上又进行了某种形式的统一，但中国西北地区有一支政治势力此时应该并未认同和加入。

在这个第五十八象的预言中，《推背图》的作者为了表明此象与前面四十九象所指为同一件事用了“称王称帝”、“称兄弟”来重复四十九象中的“帝王称弟兄”；并且用“独有煞星隐西北，未能遍唱太平歌”来最终解释了四十九象的配图：八把刀中有一把刀刀口反向的含义，作者用这些线索来表明：从四十九象开始直至五十八象其实说的是同一个时期，但处于不同地区、不同时点的事件，而不是时间线性发展、完全不同时期的事，前面四十九象重点说的是“分”，后面五十八象重点说的是分的“结果”。若从四十九象中国分裂成多个政权并保持到了预言结束，那后面各象原本也确实应该是分述这个“分”的主要发展过程和关键时点的情况。

这样到了五十九象：那时的中国已经变成了“无城无府，无你无我，天下一家，治臻大化”的美好社会！试问一个国家和社会在什么情况下才能达到如此美好的状态呢？能感化社会至此的会是什么呢？“一人为大世界福，手执签筒拔去竹”，试问是谁有这样的能力做成这样的事情呢？在这里非常确切的相信，就在不久的将来，所有人都会清楚的知道答案是什么。

而这样的社会也一定会成为世界文化和经济的中心，“红黄黑白不分明，东南西北尽和睦”，中国整个成为了国际化的大都市，各肤色人种来来往往好不热闹，此时整个中国也已经达到各个地区东南西北尽和睦的状态，这真是太美好了。

至此《推背图》对中国历史的预言就结束了，作者在最后第六十象中说“一阴一阳，无始无终”，说明最后的美好社会状态将会延续很长很长时间，只是后面相当长的时期都没有什么波澜了，也就不再写了。但另一句“终者自终，始者自始”却非常可怕！中国古代是信神文化、知道生死是轮回的，但作者却说有的生命自此而终——再也没有未来轮回了；而有的生命却自此可以生生世世在那个美好的世界里继续。试想，对那时那样美好的未来，谁不愿在那里生活啊？可究竟谁是“终者”、谁是“始者”呢？希望人们深思。

作者还说道：“茫茫天数此中求，世道兴衰不自由”，以作者能清楚看透千年的能力却仍感叹“世道兴衰不自由”，这说明以他这样的本事都无法对这些事改动半点，那么我们这些凡尘俗世中的人更要珍惜高人的指点和忠告了。

对于最后这段历史时期，《推背图》用了这么多象来详细描述，以《推背图》前面各象对历史预言的精准，我们相信这最后的美好未来一定会到来。但在这之前显然还一有段黎明前的黑暗需要走过去，希望天下所有善良的人都能做出正确的选择，走过这段黑暗，迎接无限灿烂美好的明天。

本文对《推背图》的细节解读肯定也有没理解准确的地方，但《推背图》给出的大方向还是清楚的，结局也是非常清楚，这些方面是没有疑问的，因此写出来与读者分享。

其实既然我们知道了有一个如此美妙的未来，那为什么不积极的迎接这个美好的社会呢？何必守着中共这个腐朽邪恶的政权给它陪葬，多不值得啊。

衷心希望我们都能在那个美好的社会中再次相聚，让我们一起期盼那个激动人心的时刻能早日到来吧！（全文结束）

#中华电力向香港近千所幼稚园派发互动点读笔
中华电力将于10月起向全港近1,000所幼儿园派发升级版点读笔套件，旨在通过互动故事书教导低碳生活。该免费计划于 2016 年启动，已覆盖约 900 所学校的 65,000 名儿童。

# CLP Power sends interactive reading pens to nearly 1,000 Hong Kong kindergartens

CLP Power is distributing upgraded reading pen kits to nearly 1,000 kindergartens across Hong Kong from October, aiming to teach low-carbon living through interactive storybooks. The free programme, launched in 2016, has reached 65,000 children at about 900 schools.

[![Image 4: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

 By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

CLP Power is distributing upgraded reading pen learning kits to nearly 1,000 kindergartens across Hong Kong for the new school year, with deliveries beginning in October, the company announced on Thursday.

The new POWER YOU Kindergarten Education Kit features the Power Kid Reading Pen and two interactive storybooks themed around “Low-Carbon Living” and “The Importance of Electricity.” The kit uses voice guidance, sound effects and interactive elements to introduce energy-saving and low-carbon living concepts through familiar everyday scenarios, encouraging children to develop environmental awareness from a young age.

Quince Chong Wai-yan, chief corporate development officer at CLP Power, said energy education should be rooted in daily life and match children’s learning styles. “By encouraging children to listen, observe, read and play, we hope to spark their curiosity about energy and inspire them to embrace low-carbon living habits in their daily lives,” she said.

The reading pen series combines reading, technology and energy education, Chong added.

The POWER YOU Kindergarten Education Kit was launched in 2016 and is provided free of charge to schools across Hong Kong. As part of the initiative, CLP engineers regularly visit kindergartens to explain electricity and energy-saving concepts to students. The programme has reached 65,000 children at around 900 schools to date.

# 中银香港将发行境内非同业存单，成为首家离岸人民币清算银行
香港唯一的人民币清算行中国银行（香港）计划今年发行最多222亿元人民币境内银行同业存单，成为首家获此额度的离岸清算行。此举旨在提升香港作为领先离岸人民币枢纽的地位。

根据利率自律机制的一份声明，该行已成为“首家获得境内同业存单发行额度的离岸人民币清算银行”。

# BOCHK to issue onshore NCDs, first offshore yuan clearing bank

Bank of China (Hong Kong), the sole yuan clearing bank in the city, plans to issue up to 22.2 billion yuan in onshore interbank certificates of deposit this year, becoming the first offshore clearing bank granted such a quota. The move aims to boost Hong Kong's status as a leading offshore yuan hub.

[![Image 4: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

 By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

 15 Oct 2026 at 19:32 HKT · 1 min read

Bank of China (Hong Kong) (2388), the sole yuan-clearing bank in the city, plans to issue interbank negotiable certificates of deposit (NCDs) in mainland China's onshore market, a move aimed at further strengthening Hong Kong's position as the leading offshore yuan centre.

The lender has become "the first offshore yuan-clearing bank granted an issuance quota for onshore NCDs," according to a statement from the Interest Rate Self-Regulatory Mechanism, which is overseen by the People's Bank of China.

The bank said it plans to issue up to 22.2 billion yuan (HK$26.04 billion) worth of NCDs in 2026, according to a separate statement this week. NCDs are popular short-term debt instruments issued between banks for their financing needs.

"All issuance will be denominated in yuan and the bank will determine the size and tenor of each NCD at its discretion based on market conditions and the bank's circumstances," it said.

The move comes after authorities from Beijing and Hong Kong in July unveiled a range of measures to bolster currency, bond and gold trading in the city, stepping up efforts to establish Hong Kong as a leading offshore yuan centre amid heightened geopolitical tensions.

The yield on one-year NCDs stood at about 1.44 per cent, while the offshore yuan HIBOR, a gauge that measures the interbank borrowing cost in Hong Kong, was at about 1.78 per cent this week.

title: Hong Kong unveils land sale plan for 3,845 private flats in Sha Tin and beyond
zh_title: 香港公布沙田及其他地区3,845个私人单位的卖地计划
summary: 香港政府当局宣布了一项新的土地出售计划，提供约3,845个私人住宅单位，其中包括沙田的960个单位的地块和市区重建局的1,050个住宅单位的项目。前三季度供应15,680套，超额完成全年目标12,600套。 [![图片 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编 2026 年 10 月 15 日 16:37 HKT · 2 分钟阅读政府公布了最新的季度土地出售计划，
content:
政府
香港当局宣布了一项新的土地出售计划，提供约 3,845 个私人住宅单位，其中包括沙田地块的 960 个单位和市区重建局项目的 1,050 个住宅单位。前三季度供应15,680套，超额完成全年目标12,600套。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

香港时间 2026 年 10 月 15 日 16:37 · 阅读时间 2 分钟

香港政府公布最新季度卖地计划，以招标方式推出沙田石门住宅用地，预计可提供约960个私人房屋单位。根据周四的公告，市区重建局还将在土瓜湾道推出重建项目，提供约1,050个单位。

私人土地发展及重建方面，有七个项目预计于第三季完成地契修改或换地，提供约1,835个单位。该计划下的所有项目总共将供应约 3,845 个单位。
发展局局长林汉海表示，加上本财政年度首两季，首三季将提供约15,680个私人房屋单位，超额完成全年供应目标12,600个单位。她强调，该目标不是一个硬性指标，因为年度住房供应数据可能会因宏观经济状况和政府协调之外的私人项目而波动，并补充说当局从广泛的角度评估总体供应趋势。

林恩表示，一些政府协调的项目，包括北部大都市的项目、铁路房地产开发和城市更新计划，都遵循与政策需求和地区发展相关的具体时间表。她表示，“政府不会仅仅因为达到了数字目标就放慢脚步。”她指出，今年市场情绪依然乐观，开发商对前景持乐观态度，成熟社区对地块的需求稳定。

当被问及第四季度是否继续出售土地时，林恩表示，政府将在发布公告之前审查市场和经济状况。关于粉岭北地区的招标，她表示，当局正在寻求城市规划委员会的重新分区批准，将住宅产量从2,000个单位增加到4,000个单位，并建议更改该地区的工业用地，目标是在年底前启动招标。
除住宅用地外，政府亦会在沙田小沥源提供一幅地块兴建大专学生宿舍，提供约600个床位。

[![图片3：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

【原文 English Original】
Government
Hong Kong authorities announced a new land sale programme offering about 3,845 private residential units, including a Sha Tin plot for 960 flats and an Urban Renewal Authority project for 1,050 homes. The first three quarters will supply 15,680 units, exceeding the annual target of 12,600.

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

15 Oct 2026 at 16:37 HKT · 2 min read

The Hong Kong government has unveiled its latest quarterly land sale programme, offering a residential site in Shek Mun, Sha Tin, by tender, expected to supply about 960 private housing units. The Urban Renewal Authority will also launch a redevelopment project on To Kwa Wan Road, providing roughly 1,050 units, according to an announcement on Thursday.

For private land development and redevelopment, seven projects are set to complete land lease modifications or land exchanges in the third quarter, contributing about 1,835 units. In total, all projects under the programme will supply approximately 3,845 units.

Secretary for Development Bernadette Linn Hon-hoi said that combined with the first two quarters of the current financial year, the first three quarters will provide about 15,680 private housing units, surpassing the annual supply target of 12,600 units. She stressed that the target is not a rigid indicator, as annual housing supply figures may fluctuate due to macroeconomic conditions and private projects outside government coordination, adding that authorities assess overall supply trends from a broad perspective.

Linn said some government-coordinated projects, including those in the Northern Metropolis, railway property developments and urban renewal schemes, follow specific timelines tied to policy needs and district development. "The government will not slow down purely because the numerical target has been met," she said, noting that market sentiment remains positive this year and developers are optimistic about prospects, with steady demand for sites in mature communities.

Asked whether land sales would continue in the fourth quarter, Linn said the government would review market and economic conditions before making an announcement. On the Fanling North area tender, she said authorities are seeking rezoning approval from the Town Planning Board to increase residential output from 2,000 to 4,000 units, and are also proposing changes for industrial land in the area, with a target to launch the tender by the end of the year.

Apart from residential sites, the government will also offer a plot in Siu Lek Yuen, Sha Tin, for the construction of a tertiary student hostel providing about 600 bed spaces.

# Hong Kong security chief exposes phone scam in viral video

Security Secretary Chris Tang shared a video of himself confronting a phone fraudster impersonating a government official, urging the public to stay vigilant. He stressed that the Security Bureau never demands assistance, money or account transfers over the phone.

[![Image 4: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

Secretary for Security Chris Tang Ping-keung has warned the public against phone scams after releasing a video of himself handling a fraudulent call from someone claiming to be a Security Bureau official.

In the video posted on Thursday, the scammer told Tang he was suspected of breaching mainland law and instructed him to report immediately to the 10th floor of the Central Government Offices to verify his identity and assist in an investigation.

Tang responded by asking which unit of the Security Bureau the caller belonged to, noting that he was already on the 10th floor and inviting the caller to come and find him instead.

中國國民黨新北市長參選人李四川（前右4）15日出席坪林區競選總部成立大會，近400名鄉親、里長到場力挺，場面熱烈。（李四川競辦提供）中央社記者曹亞沿傳真 115年10月15日

（中央社記者[曹亞沿](https://cna.com.tw/author/0192/)、黃旭昇新北15日電）中國國民黨新北市長參選人李四川今天說，將落實「青春山海線2.0」政策，以周遊券整合大眾運輸、景點、住宿、美食及消費優惠，串聯各地特色景點，創造坪林區商機。

李四川上午出席坪林競選總部成立大會表示，這樣可讓遊客一券暢遊新北，促進在地就業，讓更多年輕人留家鄉工作，而坪林孕育的茶葉是新北重要特色農產，如果當選，將整合交通、觀光及行銷資源積極推廣，讓新北好茶走向國際。

[![Image 23](https://imgcdn.cna.com.tw/www/website/img/ad300x223.jpg)](https://lin.ee/tPtHlLQ)

至於台北市長選戰近日為科技廊帶政見交鋒，李四川接受媒體聯訪表示，民進黨台北市長參選人沈伯洋不熟市政，如果民進黨新北市長參選人蘇巧慧也有相同認知，可能會讓國外大廠不敢投資雙北。

他說，交通與土地是人工智慧（AI）產業投資主要條件，有聚落才能聚集人才、建立平台，也才能讓國外大廠願投資。（編輯：李明宗）1151015

# PetroChina to launch first LNG bunker fuelling in Singapore

PetroChina International will bunker a vessel with liquefied natural gas in Singapore for the first time on Thursday, its chairman said, expanding alternative-fuel options at the world's top refuelling port. The company also completes a methanol bunker vessel acquisition on Friday amid rapid growth

[![Image 4: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

 By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

 15 Oct 2026 at 14:25 HKT · 1 min read

Share:

[](https://wa.me/?text=PetroChina%20to%20launch%20first%20LNG%20bunker%20fuelling%20in%20Singapore%20https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/business/PetroChina-to-launch-first-LNG-bunker-fuelling-in-Singapore-0a457a "WhatsApp")[](https://t.me/share/url?url=https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/business/PetroChina-to-launch-first-LNG-bunker-fuelling-in-Singapore-0a457a&text=PetroChina%20to%20launch%20first%20LNG%20bunker%20fuelling%20in%20Singapore "Telegram")[](https://www.facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php?u=https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/business/PetroChina-to-launch-first-LNG-bunker-fuelling-in-Singapore-0a457a "Facebook")[](https://twitter.com/intent/tweet?url=https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/business/PetroChina-to-launch-first-LNG-bunker-fuelling-in-Singapore-0a457a&text=PetroChina%20to%20launch%20first%20LNG%20bunker%20fuelling%20in%20Singapore "X")[](mailto:?subject=PetroChina%20to%20launch%20first%20LNG%20bunker%20fuelling%20in%20Singapore&body=PetroChina%20to%20launch%20first%20LNG%20bunker%20fuelling%20in%20Singapore%0Ahttps%3A//clb.org.hk/en/business/PetroChina-to-launch-first-LNG-bunker-fuelling-in-Singapore-0a457a "Email")

PetroChina International will use liquefied natural gas (LNG) to bunker a vessel in Singapore for the first time on Thursday, Chairman Wu Junli said, widening the alternative-fuel options it can offer shipowners at the world's top refuelling port.

The trading arm of Chinese state major PetroChina (0857) was one of eight firms that received LNG bunkering licences from the Singapore government, and it also has a licence to supply methanol to ships. Wu made the remarks at the Singapore International Bunkering conference.

PetroChina will also complete the acquisition of a methanol bunker vessel on Friday, Wu said. Citing data from Clarksons, he said by the end of 2025, orders globally for alternative-fuel vessels had neared 2,000 ships, including more than 1,200 LNG-fuelled vessels.

"Methanol-fuelled vessels are expanding rapidly, while ammonia-fuelled vessels are beginning to gain momentum," he said. However, infrastructure for emerging marine fuels significantly lags fleet development, he noted, with the number of existing and planned methanol bunkering ports remaining below 50 versus 220 LNG bunker ports worldwide.

PetroChina accounted for about 10 per cent of Singapore bunker sales last year, which exceeded 56 million metric tons. The company sold 7.95 million tons of bunker fuel globally last year and can supply 18 ports with 16 bunker vessels on time charter, he added.

Last year, PetroChina completed its first commercial LNG bunkering operation in Europe and secured methanol bunkering qualification in Rotterdam in the Netherlands. China has the capacity to produce 380,000 tons per year of green methanol, Wu said.

韩联社釜山10月15日电 中国留学生涉嫌在韩擅拍军事设施案二审15日宣判，两名被告人均被判有罪，法院维持原审判决。

釜山高等法院刑事审判第一庭当天就上述案件进行宣判，判处被告人A某有期徒刑1年半，判处被告人B某有期徒刑1年、缓刑2年。

A某和B某涉嫌于2023年3月至2024年6月使用中国制造的无人机和手机，未经许可共9次拍摄釜山海军作战司令部，以及为参加作战访韩的美国海军航母“西奥多·罗斯福”号。2024年6月25日，时任总统尹锡悦访问“西奥多·罗斯福”号时，两人使用无人机企图拍摄活动现场。

两名被告人均被指控违反《军事基地及军事设施保护法》，A某还被指控涉嫌一般利敌罪。原审法院认定检方对A某的两大指控均成立，但由于军舰和航母本身不属于军事设施，认定A某拍摄军舰和航母的行为无罪。二审法院指出，综合原审法院判处有罪的依据以及大法院有关一般利敌罪的判例，原审法院判处被告人有罪符合法理。（完）

# Hong Kong Space Museum launches new 3D dome film 'Explore the Stars 3D'

The Hong Kong Space Museum has launched a new 3D dome film, 'Explore the Stars 3D', tracing astronomy's past and future. The 28-minute show runs until 14 July 2027, with tickets priced at HK$30 and HK$40.

[![Image 4: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

 By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

 15 Oct 2026 at 12:52 HKT · 1 min read

Share:

[](https://wa.me/?text=Hong%20Kong%20Space%20Museum%20launches%20new%203D%20dome%20film%20%27Explore%20the%20Stars%203D%27%20https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Hong-Kong-Space-Museum-launches-new-3D-dome-film-Explore-the-196572 "WhatsApp")[](https://t.me/share/url?url=https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Hong-Kong-Space-Museum-launches-new-3D-dome-film-Explore-the-196572&text=Hong%20Kong%20Space%20Museum%20launches%20new%203D%20dome%20film%20%27Explore%20the%20Stars%203D%27 "Telegram")[](https://www.facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php?u=https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Hong-Kong-Space-Museum-launches-new-3D-dome-film-Explore-the-196572 "Facebook")[](https://twitter.com/intent/tweet?url=https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Hong-Kong-Space-Museum-launches-new-3D-dome-film-Explore-the-196572&text=Hong%20Kong%20Space%20Museum%20launches%20new%203D%20dome%20film%20%27Explore%20the%20Stars%203D%27 "X")[](mailto:?subject=Hong%20Kong%20Space%20Museum%20launches%20new%203D%20dome%20film%20%27Explore%20the%20Stars%203D%27&body=Hong%20Kong%20Space%20Museum%20launches%20new%203D%20dome%20film%20%27Explore%20the%20Stars%203D%27%0Ahttps%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Hong-Kong-Space-Museum-launches-new-3D-dome-film-Explore-the-196572 "Email")

The Hong Kong Space Museum has launched a new stereoscopic dome film, Explore the Stars 3D, which takes audiences on a journey through the past and future of astronomy with vivid, detailed imagery, the government announced on Thursday.

The film showcases how pioneering scientists reshaped humanity's understanding of the universe, gradually unravelling the mysteries of celestial motion. It covers the tracking of the relative positions of the Sun and the Moon along the ecliptic to predict solar and lunar eclipses, the shift from a geocentric to a heliocentric model, and the development of physical laws that help calculate spacecraft orbits.

These discoveries laid the foundation for modern space exploration and paved the way for humanity's ambition to land on Mars, according to the museum.

The programme runs for 28 minutes and will be screened until 14 July 2027. Weekday screenings are scheduled for 2pm and 6.30pm, while weekend and public holiday screenings take place at 12.30pm and 5pm.

Tickets are priced at HK$30 for front seats and HK$40 for rear seats. They are available at the Hong Kong Space Museum box office and through Urbtix (www.urbtix.hk). Details of the show can be found on the museum's website.

The Hong Kong Space Museum is located at 10 Salisbury Road, Tsim Sha Tsui, Kowloon. It is closed on Tuesdays except public holidays.

# Hong Kong releases kindergarten profiles for 2026/27 school year

The Education Bureau has published the online version of the 2026/27 Kindergarten Profile, listing basic information for about 930 kindergartens in Hong Kong to help parents choose schools.

[![Image 4: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

 By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

 15 Oct 2026 at 12:03 HKT · 1 min read

The Education Bureau on 15 October released the online version of the 2026/27 school year “Profile of Kindergartens and Kindergarten-cum-Child Care Centres” (www.chsc.hk/kindergarten), providing basic information on all kindergartens and kindergarten-cum-child care centres in Hong Kong. The bureau said the profile aims to enhance school transparency and help parents obtain more relevant information when choosing schools for their children.

The profile lists basic information on about 930 kindergartens across Hong Kong, including the list of schools participating in the 2026/27 kindergarten education scheme, approved school fees, the number of principals and teachers and their qualifications, student numbers, teacher-to-student ratios, curriculum information, reference prices for major educational supplies, application fees, registration fees and admission application details.

The profile also includes sections on “support for non-Chinese speaking students” and “support for students with special educational needs” for parents’ reference, the bureau said.

For kindergartens participating in the scheme, the profile shows the approved school fees after deducting government subsidies. Parents can also refer to the school’s fee certificate to check approved charges, including details of tuition and meal fees, the bureau said. All participating kindergartens are required to publicly disclose the proportion of expenditure in major spending areas in the profile.

All kindergartens in the scheme must undergo quality reviews to ensure standards. The profile indicates whether kindergartens that have completed quality reviews have met specified standards and provides links to the most recent quality review reports, according to the bureau.

The Secretary for Innovation, Technology and Industry, Professor Sun Dong, said the city's New Industrialisation Funding Scheme has subsidised nearly 150 smart production lines, as the government pushes to accelerate Hong Kong's advanced manufacturing development.

Speaking at an event on Thursday, Sun said innovation commercialisation requires understanding industry needs, managing intellectual property and expanding business outreach. He noted that the government's InnoHK initiative has brought together about 3,000 international researchers from around the world, who collaborate with local institutions to set up research centres and laboratories in Hong Kong.

The government will add a new category for young researchers under the Innovation and Technology Support Programme to strengthen support for early-career scientists, Sun added.

He also said the authorities are helping companies establish advanced manufacturing facilities in Hong Kong. The Microelectronics Research and Development Institute (MRDI) is preparing to set up the city's first national manufacturing innovation centre, with two pilot lines expected to begin operation this year, focusing on third-generation semiconductor research and trial production.

Sun expressed confidence that Hong Kong's advanced public service infrastructure, abundant testing platforms and international connections, combined with the Greater Bay Area's strong manufacturing capabilities and supply chains, would create significant opportunities for businesses.

# 台灣採購阿拉斯加天然氣 美學者：強化能源韌性縮減貿易順差

2026/10/15 09:26

[](javascript:)[](javascript:)[](javascript:)[](javascript:)[](javascript:)[![Image 17](https://imgcdn.cna.com.tw/www/website/img/support.svg)](https://cna.com.tw/donate/)

請同意我們的隱私權規範，才能啟用聽新聞的功能。

（中央社記者[侯姿瑩](https://cna.com.tw/author/0193/)華盛頓14日專電）美國總統川普稱台灣已同意在未來20年內採購阿拉斯加液化天然氣管線計畫30%天然氣。美學者今天向中央社記者分析，這有助強化台灣能源韌性、縮減對美貿易順差；台灣在美國出口市場的地位越重要，華府就越有意確保台灣安全。

川普（Donald Trump）昨天在阿拉斯加一場造勢集會上表示，台灣同意在未來20年內採購阿拉斯加液化天然氣管線計畫30%天然氣，還將額外投資44億美元用於該項計畫。他今天又在自家社群媒體「真實社群」（Truth Social）發文重申此事。

台灣經濟部指出，中油去年3月簽署「阿拉斯加液化天然氣買賣暨投資意向書」後，已與美方開發商協商取得重大進展，依目前規劃，開採後每年採購600萬噸液化天然氣，以及參與專案開發，預估投資金額最高44億美元。

針對這項天然氣採購及投資計畫，華府智庫「史汀生中心」（The Stimson Center）資深研究員孔明尚（Michael Cunningham）以電子郵件回覆記者詢問表示，這對台灣、美國及台美關係而言，都是有利的發展。若協議落實，將有助強化台灣能源韌性，同時也有助縮減台灣對美貿易順差，「這是華府非常在意的事項」。

根據台灣財政部統計，2025年台灣對美貿易順差約為1501億美元。

孔明尚指出，最重要的是，這類採購協議能提升台灣作為美國客戶的重要性。「台灣在美國出口市場的地位越重要，美國就越有意確保台灣維持安全」。

他認為，有鑑於阿拉斯加天然氣計畫預計2031年才會開始出口，川普所提及的20年採購時程意味著，至少就這項天然氣計畫而言，「台灣直到2050年代都將維持關鍵地位」。

另一方面，華府智庫哈德遜研究所資深研究員華特斯（Riley Walters）受訪表示，這項宣布意義重大，特別是在韓國對阿拉斯加液化天然氣計畫是否能獲利表達疑慮後。

華特斯分析，台灣承諾採購約1/3的產量，將有助確保這條天然氣管線的獲利能力。就美台關係而言，這項宣布也有助台灣朝向達成擴大對美投資承諾的目標邁進。

[![Image 18](https://imgcdn.cna.com.tw/www/website/img/ad300x223.jpg)](https://lin.ee/tPtHlLQ)

川普表示，韓國將投資500億美元推動阿拉斯加液化天然氣計畫。不過，外媒報導，韓國方面則說，唯有在這項計畫具備商業可行性的情況下才會推進。

經濟部表示，透過長期能源採購及專案投資，有助於增加天然氣供應來源，進一步強化台灣能源韌性。阿拉斯加液化天然氣計畫可透過太平洋航線直達台灣，有助分散天然氣運輸路線及地緣政治風險；若計畫順利推進，最快2032年可挹注國內天然氣供應。（編輯：田瑞華）1151015

summary: Wrongly Accused Abroad Help Me Afford Legal Defense and Survival. Hi to everyone, my name is Julian! I'm an Italian and American national, I used to work as a substitute teacher in an Italian high school. On 26th of August I went to China t
content:
Wrongly Accused Abroad Help Me Afford Legal Defense and Survival.

Hi to everyone, my name is Julian! I'm an Italian and American national, I used to work as a substitute teacher in an Italian high school.

On 26th of August I went to China to start traveling. Some weeks later, on September 28th, I arrived in Thailand. Since then, I had been traveling mostly in northern Thailand.

It was an incredible experience — honestly, probably the best of my life.

But then… something completely unexpected happened to me.

On Wednesday, November 26th, very early in the morning around 5:30 a.m., I booked a Grab taxi from where I was staying, in Nothanburi (a province northwest of Bangkok), to go to Suvarnabhumi Airport. I had a flight with Etihad Airways at 8:55 a.m. to Italy, where I live.

I arrived at the airport two hours before departure, as recommended by the airline. The check-in process went smoothly, and everything seemed normal until I reached immigration.

There were two sections: one with officers and one automatic lane. The automatic lane was moving faster, so I chose that. When it was my turn, I tapped my passport on the scanner, but a red message appeared. I tried again—same result.

A security guard came to help me and tried scanning my passport himself, but it still didn’t work. He then told me to go to the manual lane.

The immigration officer took my passport, typed something on her computer, smiled, and said, “Sorry, just wait here for a moment.” She left and returned a few minutes later with another officer who looked serious. They escorted me to the immigration desk and told me to wait.

At that moment I started to feel anxious. I thought maybe I had overstayed my visa. My visa was expiring that same day, November 26th, so I was worried I might be in trouble.

After about 15 minutes, I approached the desk to ask what was happening, but they just told me to sit down and wait. Ten minutes later, another officer came with a paper showing a photocopy of my passport and asked me to confirm that it was mine. I said yes.

Most of the staff did not speak English, which made everything more frightening.

Then, using a translation app on his phone, the officer showed me a message saying that I was being charged with possession of indecent content and distribution of that material on websites accessible to the public.

I was completely shocked and confused. I thought there must be a mistake.

There was no opportunity to explain anything. Two immigration officers escorted me to another office inside the airport.

Inside, I was told to sign many documents, all in Thai. No one explained them to me in English. They took photos of me with officers behind me. Later, they took more photos from the front, left, and right. That’s when I realized: they were taking a mugshot.

Everything felt surreal. I was exhausted because I hadn’t slept much the night before. It felt like a nightmare.

“Did you tell your family that you have been arrested?”

That was the moment it truly hit me. I had never imagined being arrested in my life, especially not in a foreign country. I was terrified and confused.

I called my embassy, but it was still closed. Later, they contacted me and explained the situation. The embassy told me that creating and distributing certain types of videos can be a crime in Thailand, as in many countries, and that if I believed I was innocent, the Thai legal process would take its course.

They asked me for two emergency contacts and sent me a list of lawyers, advising me to find legal representation.

Eventually, we arrived at a police station in Samut Prakan province, in a town called Khlong Dan.

At that point, I was officially placed under arrest and faced the risk of jail if I was unable to pay bail.

My Italian passport was confiscated by the police and is currently being held by them. This happened on November 26th.

I am writing this today, February 24, 2026. I am creating a YouTube channel to explain in more detail what is happening to me. I am currently safe and living in a hostel in Bangkok. The last three months have been the most stressful of my life.

In December, I struggled to obtain a visa extension, which I was finally able to secure on January 8, 2026. This visa must be renewed every 45 days.

I am asking for your help to raise funds for legal fees, living expenses, and possible bail that may be requested by the judge if the case goes to court. I cannot legally work in Thailand because that requires a work visa. My family is helping me at the moment, but they cannot sustain these expenses for much longer. I do not know when I will be able to return to my country, as I must wait for the Thai legal process to run its course.

**I want to state clearly that I have never uploaded any indecent content on the internet. The accuser, a woman, has claimed to provide “evidence” of this. At the police station, I was shown the alleged evidence, which consisted of screenshots from an OnlyFans profile belonging to a couple: a Thai woman and a Caucasian man. The man’s face was blurred, and I was accused of being that person.**

The case will soon be handed over to the prosecutor, and according to police officers at Khlong Dan Police Station, it will most likely proceed to court (that's what they said). This is extremely distressing, especially because my lawyer has told me that cases with weak evidence are usually dropped by the police or the prosecutor.

Thank you for taking the time to read my story. Any help or support during this very difficult time would mean a great deal to me.

Julian

# Taiwanese, Korean firms eye Japan grid storage market with China locked out

Chinese battery suppliers' lack of cybersecurity certification creates opening

Taiwan's Cold Electric looks to expand production capacity ninefold for making power storage system. (Cold Electric)

MAO KAWANO

October 15, 2026 04:45 JST

Listen

English (Original)

[](https://twitter.com/share?text=Taiwanese%2C+Korean+firms+eye+Japan+grid+storage+market+with+China+locked+out&url=https%3A%2F%2Fasia.nikkei.com%2Fbusiness%2Fenergy%2Ftaiwanese-korean-firms-eye-japan-grid-storage-market-with-china-locked-out&via=NikkeiAsia)[](https://www.facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php?u=https%3A%2F%2Fasia.nikkei.com%2Fbusiness%2Fenergy%2Ftaiwanese-korean-firms-eye-japan-grid-storage-market-with-china-locked-out)[](https://api.whatsapp.com/send?text=Taiwanese%2C+Korean+firms+eye+Japan+grid+storage+market+with+China+locked+out+https%3A%2F%2Fasia.nikkei.com%2Fbusiness%2Fenergy%2Ftaiwanese-korean-firms-eye-japan-grid-storage-market-with-china-locked-out)[](https://t.me/share/url?text=Taiwanese%2C+Korean+firms+eye+Japan+grid+storage+market+with+China+locked+out&url=https%3A%2F%2Fasia.nikkei.com%2Fbusiness%2Fenergy%2Ftaiwanese-korean-firms-eye-japan-grid-storage-market-with-china-locked-out)[](mailto:?subject=Taiwanese%2C%20Korean%20firms%20eye%20Japan%20grid%20storage%20market%20with%20China%20locked%20out&body=https%3A%2F%2Fasia.nikkei.com%2Fbusiness%2Fenergy%2Ftaiwanese-korean-firms-eye-japan-grid-storage-market-with-china-locked-out)

TOKYO -- Taiwanese and South Korean battery suppliers look to make inroads in Japan's grid-scale energy storage market as Chinese rivals' lack of local certification provides an opening.

Cold Electric, a Taiwanese battery storage system manufacturer, plans to expand production capacity at its factories in Taiwan ninefold to 3 gigawatt-hours by 2028. The company is looking to expand sales in Japan, among other markets.

Cold Electric has not been able to compete with Chinese companies on price, so the fact that Chinese manufacturers have not obtained certification in Japan is one reason the company is focusing on the market, said CEO Phil Chen.

Advertisement

Starting next April, the Japanese government will require equipment connected to the power grid to obtain JC-STAR cybersecurity certification. For power storage facilities, this mandate will apply to equipment with communication functions, such as battery control systems and power conditioners.

JC-STAR reviews are conducted by the Innovation Platform Agency (IPA), an organization under Japan's Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry. For power storage system products, roughly 50 companies have obtained JC-STAR certifications, according to an IPA list. They include companies from Japan, the U.S., Germany, South Korea and Taiwan.

However, Chinese companies that have significant penetration in the Japanese market, such as Huawei Technologies, Sungrow and BYD, are not on the list.

The government has not said why Chinese companies appear locked out of certification, but national security concerns are believed to be an underlying factor. If Chinese suppliers are unable to receive certification, they will likely be forced to scale back in Japan.

Cold Electric obtained JC-STAR certification in August. There are plans to launch Japan's first energy storage facility using Cold Electric products by the end of the year. The company is partnering with Yuasa M&B, an Osaka-based battery distributor, to expand sales.

Samsung SDI obtained JC-STAR certification last year. The South Korean company plans to increase sales in Japan to 2 GWh by 2030. This marks a tenfold increase from the 2026 forecast. Samsung SDI looks to capture demand from customers switching from Chinese manufacturers.

Formosa Plastics Group, a Taiwanese conglomerate, plans to sell 3 GWh of battery storage annually in Japan by 2029. The group has applied for JC-STAR certification from the IPA and expects to be approved by the end of the year.

Formosa Plastics has petrochemical and materials operations within the group, enabling it to manufacture 70% of battery components, such as electrolytes and separators, in-house. The company is able to respond flexibly to customers' cost requirements.

Storage system users in the U.S. and Southeast Asia are shifting to avoid over relying on Chinese-made equipment, and Formosa Plastics plans to capitalize on that demand, said Clayton Lien, head of the group's Japanese subsidiary.

The company will expand facilities in Taiwan to quintuple production capacity to 10 GWh by 2029.

South Korean and Taiwanese suppliers believe their larger scales give them a price advantage over Japanese companies. While they cannot match prices of Chinese players, they can more easily offer lower prices than Japanese rivals, such as PowerX and GS Yuasa.

Samsung SDI batteries are "20-30% more expensive than Chinese manufacturers, but 20-30% less costly than Japanese manufacturers," said a company executive. The lower costs would be paired with cybersecurity certification, the executive added.

Home to the world's fifth-largest demand for electricity, Japan is rushing to install renewable energy capacity. The country is expected to have 100 GWh worth of operational capacity at power storage facilities by 2040, according to the Tokyo-based consultancy RTS, which would be nine times more than this year.

The scale would be equivalent to bringing online one or two nuclear power plants a year. Power demand is expected to expand further due to the buildup of artificial intelligence data centers.

JC-STAR certification does not apply to battery cells or other components that do not have communication functions. According to a construction company and a specialized trading house that do business with Chinese suppliers such as Huawei, Chinese manufacturers are exploring ways to sell battery storage systems in Japan without telecommunication components. The parts for communications would be outsourced to Japanese companies.

# 1,336 people officially recognized as Siraya since July: CIP

10/14/2026 04:04 PM

[](jsvscript:)[](jsvscript:)[](javascript:void(0))[Listen](javascript:)

[Link](javascript:)[Whatsapp](javascript:)[Reddit](javascript:)[Line](javascript:)[Email](javascript:)

Siraya community members dancing at a ceremony, which marked the tribe's official recognition at the Executive Yuan in Taipei in July. CNA photo July 30, 2026

Taipei, Oct. 14 (CNA) A total of 1,336 people had completed registration as Indigenous Siraya people by the end of September, following the government's official recognition of the Siraya as Taiwan's 17th Indigenous group in July, the Council of Indigenous Peoples (CIP) said Wednesday.

Since the Plains Indigenous Peoples Status Act took effect in October 2025, the CIP has received applications for recognition from nine groups: the Siraya, Taivoan, Makatao, Taokas, Kaxabu, Pazeh, Papora, Babuza and Ketagalan.

The law, which was passed by the Legislature on Oct. 17, 2025, aims to give Plains Indigenous groups' the right to receive official recognition and maintain their collective identity.

According to the CIP's report to the Legislature on Wednesday, applications to be listed on the Siraya membership register and to register Indigenous status opened on Aug. 13.

By the end of September, 12,178 people had applied to be listed on the membership register, of whom 1,336 had completed registration and obtained officially recognized Plains Indigenous status as Siraya people, the CIP said.

Applications from the Pazeh, Kaxabu and Taokas are expected to proceed to review by a panel of experts and scholars, while a draft set of eligibility requirements for membership in the Taivoan group is expected to be released, the council said.

Premier Cho Jung-tai (back, center) and other officials poses for a group photo at the Executive Yuan in Taipei in July. CNA photo July 30, 2026

To qualify for Plains Indigenous status, applicants must provide supporting documentation. One important source is population census records from the Japanese colonial period, which identified their communities and defined the areas where they lived.

The Plains Indigenous people's movement for official recognition began in the 1990s. Before then, they were considered to have largely assimilated into the majority population under the Kuomintang government after it took power in 1945.

Before the Siraya's recognition, Taiwan officially recognized 16 Indigenous groups, generally classified as Mountain Indigenous.

(By Chang Hsiung-feng and Lee Hsin-Yin)

# Hong Kong customs seizes 120,000 illicit cigarettes in retail crackdown

Customs officers arrested 10 people and seized about 120,000 suspected duty-not-paid cigarettes worth about HK$540,000 in a territory-wide operation targeting newsstands and grocery stores. Since the amended smoking ordinance took effect in September 2025, authorities have busted 38 retail outlets a

[![Image 4: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

 By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

Hong Kong customs have arrested 10 people and seized about 120,000 suspected duty-not-paid cigarettes in a territory-wide operation targeting retail outlets including newsstands and grocery stores, the department said on Wednesday.

The contraband, estimated to have a market value of about HK$540,000 and a duty value of about HK$400,000, was confiscated in an operation that began last Wednesday, according to a customs statement.

Officers posed as customers in test purchases and found some outlets selling cigarettes at prices below the statutory duty level. Those arrested, three men and seven women aged 26 to 73, included shop owners and staff.

Customs said that since the Smoking (Amendment) Ordinance 2025 was gazetted in mid-September last year, it has conducted frequent inspections of cigarette retail points and launched multiple enforcement operations, including decoy purchases.

In total, 38 cigarette retail outlets have been shut down, about 450,000 duty-not-paid cigarettes seized and 39 people arrested under the enforcement drive, the department said. Eleven cases have completed judicial proceedings, with sentences ranging from four weeks to six months in jail, while the remaining cases are pending court action.

# Guangdong yacht scheme opens for applications ahead of Friday debut

Hong Kong's Marine Department opened applications on Wednesday for the 'Guangdong Yacht Southbound' scheme, which launches Friday. Owners or captains can apply up to 30 days before arrival, with online declarations required 30 hours before docking and 4 hours before leaving mainland waters.

[![Image 4: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

 By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

 14 Oct 2026 at 22:44 HKT · 1 min read

Share:

[](https://wa.me/?text=Guangdong%20yacht%20scheme%20opens%20for%20applications%20ahead%20of%20Friday%20debut%20https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Guangdong-yacht-scheme-opens-for-applications-ahead-of-Frida-1d9813 "WhatsApp")[](https://t.me/share/url?url=https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Guangdong-yacht-scheme-opens-for-applications-ahead-of-Frida-1d9813&text=Guangdong%20yacht%20scheme%20opens%20for%20applications%20ahead%20of%20Friday%20debut "Telegram")[](https://www.facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php?u=https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Guangdong-yacht-scheme-opens-for-applications-ahead-of-Frida-1d9813 "Facebook")[](https://twitter.com/intent/tweet?url=https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Guangdong-yacht-scheme-opens-for-applications-ahead-of-Frida-1d9813&text=Guangdong%20yacht%20scheme%20opens%20for%20applications%20ahead%20of%20Friday%20debut "X")[](mailto:?subject=Guangdong%20yacht%20scheme%20opens%20for%20applications%20ahead%20of%20Friday%20debut&body=Guangdong%20yacht%20scheme%20opens%20for%20applications%20ahead%20of%20Friday%20debut%0Ahttps%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Guangdong-yacht-scheme-opens-for-applications-ahead-of-Frida-1d9813 "Email")

Hong Kong's Marine Department said on Wednesday that applications for the 'Guangdong Yacht Southbound' scheme are now open, ahead of the first voyage on Friday. Under the scheme, owners or captains of Guangdong-registered yachts wishing to sail south to Hong Kong can complete cross-border procedures as early as 30 days before arrival.

Applicants must submit online declarations to Hong Kong authorities at least 30 hours before arriving in the city, and to mainland authorities at least four hours before departing mainland waters, the department said.

The scheme is part of broader efforts by the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region government to facilitate yacht travel between Guangdong and Hong Kong. Over the past few months, authorities have trained and assessed mainland captains on their knowledge of Hong Kong waters, according to earlier government statements.

The Marine Department has also set up a real-time yacht movement monitoring system to assist with berthing arrangements for Guangdong yachts. In addition, an electronic business system has been introduced to provide one-stop convenience services for crew members and passengers travelling on these vessels.

The first voyage under the scheme is scheduled for Friday, marking the start of regular operations.

# DH urges hygiene as hand, foot and mouth disease cases rise

Hong Kong's Department of Health has urged the public to maintain hygiene as hand, foot and mouth disease outbreaks increase in schools and child care centres. The Centre for Health Protection will update schools and requires immediate reporting of outbreaks, noting alcohol-based handrub is not a su

The Department of Health (DH) on Wednesday urged the public to maintain hygiene as local cases of hand, foot and mouth disease (HFMD) have increased recently.

The Centre for Health Protection (CHP) of the DH will issue letters to schools today, updating them on the latest HFMD situation. Schools and institutions are required to report any outbreak to the CHP immediately.

According to the CHP's latest surveillance data, eight outbreaks in institutions and schools, affecting 27 people, were recorded per week in mid-September. The number of HFMD outbreaks increased gradually to 12, 11 and 20 outbreaks per week in the past three weeks.

From Sunday to Tuesday, nine outbreaks affecting 24 people were reported. Ninety per cent of the outbreaks occurred in child care centres, kindergartens and primary schools.

HFMD is a common disease in children caused by enteroviruses, such as Coxsackie virus and EV71. It occurs throughout the year in Hong Kong, with the usual peak from May to July and from October to December.

The DH said HFMD usually causes mild symptoms, including fever, poor appetite, fatigue and sore throat, followed by painful mouth sores that may ulcerate. Most people recover without treatment in seven to 10 days.

The department also reminded that alcohol-based handrub should not substitute hand hygiene with liquid soap and water, as alcohol does not effectively kill some viruses that cause HFMD.

The Chinese University of Hong Kong (Shenzhen) announced the death of Li Renke, a chair professor and vice dean of its medical school, who died on Saturday (10 October) while attending an academic conference in Xi'an. He was 65.

Li, born in Harbin, Heilongjiang, was an internationally renowned scientist in cardiac regenerative medicine, tissue engineering and stem cell therapy. He joined CUHK-Shenzhen full-time last year to lead research and translational work, the university said in an obituary posted on its official website.

The obituary described Li as a distinguished pioneer in cardiovascular regenerative medicine and biomedical engineering, and the first scientist globally to receive U.S. Food and Drug Administration approval for stem cell transplantation to treat heart failure. It noted his decades of dedication to scientific research, exploring the frontiers of life sciences, and advancing medical technology through outstanding academic achievements and innovative spirit.

According to the obituary, Li devoted his life to science, serving his country and mentoring younger scholars. He left an environment where he had worked for nearly 40 years to drive disruptive research in regenerative medicine and interdisciplinary fields. He served as a member of the State Council's Overseas Chinese Affairs Office expert advisory committee and as a project reviewer for the National Natural Science Foundation and the Ministry of Science and Technology. He also received national recognition for his work.

A farewell ceremony for Li will be held on Tuesday (14 October) morning in Xi'an, followed by a memorial service at CUHK-Shenzhen on Saturday (17 October).

# 香港与六个国家签署避免双重征税协定
政府表示，香港将与巴巴多斯、约旦、吉尔吉斯共和国、马尔代夫、挪威和卢旺达实施全面避免双重征税协定。这些协议旨在促进双边贸易和投资，使该市的总网络达到 60 个司法管辖区。

# Hong Kong moves to enact double tax treaties with six nations

Hong Kong will implement comprehensive double taxation avoidance agreements with Barbados, Jordan, the Kyrgyz Republic, Maldives, Norway and Rwanda, the government said. The pacts aim to promote bilateral trade and investment, bringing the city's total network to 60 jurisdictions.

[![Image 4: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

 By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

Hong Kong will move to implement comprehensive double taxation avoidance agreements with six countries, including Norway, as the city seeks to promote bilateral trade and investment, the government said in a statement on Wednesday.

The Chief Executive in Council made six orders on October 6 covering pacts signed with Barbados, Jordan, the Kyrgyz Republic, Maldives, Norway, and Rwanda, the government said. The orders will be gazetted on Friday and tabled at the Legislative Council on October 21 for negative vetting. The treaties will take effect once Hong Kong and the respective jurisdictions conclude their formal ratification processes.

The agreements ensure that residents of Hong Kong and the relevant tax jurisdictions will not be subject to double taxation on the same income, and enable investors to assess more effectively the potential tax burden arising from their cross-border economic activities, a spokesperson for the Financial Services and the Treasury Bureau said.

Hong Kong inked the deals with the Maldives, Jordan, Rwanda, and Norway across 2025, followed by agreements with the Kyrgyz Republic and Barbados in March 2026.

The move brings Hong Kong's total network of comprehensive double taxation agreements to 60 jurisdictions, with 15 secured under the current government.

# Hong Kong's iAM Smart app launches AI assistant for government queries

Hong Kong's Digital Office has launched an AI assistant in the iAM Smart mobile app to help residents find government service information and complete online applications more easily. The feature will be rolled out gradually from 14 October to late October, with a personalised enhanced version expec

[![Image 4: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

 By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

 14 Oct 2026 at 17:00 HKT · 1 min read

Share:

[](https://wa.me/?text=Hong%20Kong%27s%20iAM%20Smart%20app%20launches%20AI%20assistant%20for%20government%20queries%20https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/artificial-intelligence/Hong-Kong-s-iAM-Smart-app-launches-AI-assistant-for-governme-de9463 "WhatsApp")[](https://t.me/share/url?url=https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/artificial-intelligence/Hong-Kong-s-iAM-Smart-app-launches-AI-assistant-for-governme-de9463&text=Hong%20Kong%27s%20iAM%20Smart%20app%20launches%20AI%20assistant%20for%20government%20queries "Telegram")[](https://www.facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php?u=https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/artificial-intelligence/Hong-Kong-s-iAM-Smart-app-launches-AI-assistant-for-governme-de9463 "Facebook")[](https://twitter.com/intent/tweet?url=https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/artificial-intelligence/Hong-Kong-s-iAM-Smart-app-launches-AI-assistant-for-governme-de9463&text=Hong%20Kong%27s%20iAM%20Smart%20app%20launches%20AI%20assistant%20for%20government%20queries "X")[](mailto:?subject=Hong%20Kong%27s%20iAM%20Smart%20app%20launches%20AI%20assistant%20for%20government%20queries&body=Hong%20Kong%27s%20iAM%20Smart%20app%20launches%20AI%20assistant%20for%20government%20queries%0Ahttps%3A//clb.org.hk/en/artificial-intelligence/Hong-Kong-s-iAM-Smart-app-launches-AI-assistant-for-governme-de9463 "Email")

Hong Kong's Digital Office has launched an "AI Assistant" feature in the iAM Smart mobile app to help residents access government services more easily. The tool uses artificial intelligence to search official sources for answers to users' questions and presents the information in a clear, organised format.

When residents ask about how to apply for an online government service, the AI Assistant will list the eligibility requirements, step-by-step procedures and provide direct links to the relevant online forms. It also supports the existing "Form Filler" function to help users complete applications seamlessly.

The latest version of the iAM Smart app (version 5.0) with the AI Assistant will be pushed to users gradually from 14 October through late October via official app stores. Users need to install the updated app and tap on the avatar of the app's mascot "A-Chi" on the home screen to activate the assistant.

The Digital Office said it will continue to improve the AI Assistant and plans to launch an enhanced version offering personalised services by the end of 2026, aiming to further improve the user experience.

# Hong Kong stocks close slightly lower; Meituan jumps 6.6 per cent

Hong Kong shares edged down on Wednesday, with the Hang Seng Index dipping 0.13 per cent, despite gains in tech stocks. Meituan led blue chips with a 6.6 per cent rise, while biopharmaceutical firms dragged the market.

[![Image 4: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

 By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

Hong Kong stocks closed slightly lower on Wednesday, even as major technology shares rebounded. The benchmark Hang Seng Index slipped 31 points, or 0.13 per cent, to 24,314 points, with turnover reaching HK$193.4 billion.

The Hang Seng Tech Index rose 0.91 per cent to 4,174 points. Meituan (3690) posted the biggest gain among blue chips, jumping 6.6 per cent, followed by Xiaomi (1810), which advanced 5.4 per cent. Alibaba (9988) climbed 3 per cent, while Tencent (0700) fell 0.4 per cent.

Oil majors outperformed the broader market amid rising energy prices. CNOOC (0883) and PetroChina (0386) gained 1.8 per cent and 1.3 per cent, respectively.

In contrast, biopharmaceutical stocks weighed on the index. Innovent Biologics (1801) dropped 4 per cent, the worst performer among Hang Seng Index constituents. Sino Biopharmaceutical (1177), Hansoh Pharmaceutical (3692), and Wuxi Biologics (2269) declined 3.5 per cent, 3 per cent, and 2.95 per cent, respectively.

Semiconductor firms also fell, with Hua Hong Grace Semiconductor (1347) and Semiconductor Manufacturing International Corporation (0981) dropping over 2 per cent each for a third consecutive session.

content:
商务
内部文件显示，欧盟正在寻求与越南在关键矿产方面建立更密切的关系，以减少对中国的依赖。在越南领导人苏林下周访问布鲁塞尔之前，欧盟计划为越南采矿和加工业提供财政支持。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

香港时间 2026 年 10 月 14 日 14:54 · 阅读时间 4 分钟

路透社看到的欧盟内部文件显示，由于担心现有供应可能面临风险，欧盟正在寻求从越南获取更多关键矿产，以减少对中国的依赖。

越南拥有大量重要矿物储量，包括钨、稀土、锑、铋和铝土矿，可以从这些矿物中提取副产品镓。向欧盟的出口主要限于钨和锑，两者均用于国防领域，包括弹药和爆炸物。

欧盟驻河内代表团准备的一份文件称：“考虑到欧洲需要尽快重新武装和消除风险，欧盟不能忽视越南作为关键原材料的潜在供应国，特别是考虑到越南丰富的稀土和钨储量。”
该报告和日期为 2026 年 6 月的附件文件建议为越南采矿和加工业提供财政支持，以“维持和扩大目前的供应，特别是钨、铋、锑和钛”，并警告称，来自伙伴国家的竞争可能会扰乱欧盟的供应。该报告及所附文件此前未曾报道过。

文件称，需要与越南加强接触，以“为中国这个全球最大的关键矿产生产国添加一个替代品”，特别是在北京去年的出口限制“扰乱了欧洲供应链”之后。其中一份文件敦促欧盟机构为越南领导人苏林访问布鲁塞尔期间取得具体成果做好准备。四名欧洲和越南官员表示，此次访问将于下周举行，并定于 10 月 22 日与欧盟领导人举行会议。此次访问尚未正式宣布。

此次访问紧随本周的欧洲理事会召开，预计欧盟领导人将在会上讨论减少对中国商品和原材料依赖的计划，同时确保关键资源的替代供应。

当被问及该文件和苏林的访问时，欧盟执行机构发言人表示：“欧盟委员会目前正在评估与越南在关键原材料领域开展具体合作的潜力。”
越南目前不在欧盟16个原矿战略伙伴之列。两位官员表示，预计关键矿物将在下周的谈判中占据重要地位。上周，布鲁塞尔将越南从避税天堂黑名单中删除。河内还敦促欧盟国家批准2019年签署的投资保护协议，但该协议仍受到法国等少数国家的阻止。它还敦促欧盟取消对越南渔业的警告。

越南外交部没有回应置评请求。欧盟代表团拒绝发表评论。

来自伙伴国家日益激烈的竞争被视为对欧盟供应的潜在威胁。其中一份文件引用了去年一项失败的计划，涉及澳大利亚、美国和加拿大的实体收购
