The European Union is pursuing closer ties with Vietnam on critical minerals to reduce reliance on China, according to internal documents. The bloc plans financial support for Vietnam's mining and processing industry, ahead of a visit by Vietnamese leader To Lam to Brussels next week.

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

14 Oct 2026 at 14:54 HKT · 4 min read

The European Union is seeking to secure more critical minerals from Vietnam to reduce its reliance on China amid concerns that existing supplies may be at risk, according to internal EU documents seen by Reuters.

Vietnam has substantial deposits of critical minerals, including tungsten, rare earths, antimony, bismuth and bauxite, from which gallium can be extracted as a byproduct. Exports to the EU have been largely limited to tungsten and antimony, both used in the defence sector, including in ammunition and explosives.

"Considering Europe's need to rearm and de-risk as fast as possible, the EU cannot afford ignoring Vietnam as a potential supplier of critical raw materials considering its abundant reserves in rare earth and tungsten in particular," said a document prepared by the EU delegation in Hanoi.

The report and an annexed document, dated June 2026, recommend financial support for Vietnam's mining and processing industry to "maintain and expand current access notably to tungsten, bismuth, antimony and titanium," warning that competition from partner countries might disrupt EU supplies. The report and annexed document have not been reported on before.

The documents say stronger engagement with Vietnam is needed to "add an alternative to China," the world's top producer of critical minerals, especially after Beijing's export restrictions last year "disrupted European supply chains." One of the documents urged EU institutions to prepare for concrete outcomes during Vietnamese leader To Lam's visit to Brussels, which four European and Vietnamese officials said would take place next week with meetings with EU leaders slated for October 22. The visit has not been officially announced.

The visit would come on the heels of this week's European Council, where EU leaders are expected to discuss plans to reduce their reliance on Chinese goods and raw materials while securing alternative supplies for critical resources.

"The European Commission is currently assessing the potential for concrete cooperation with Vietnam in the critical raw materials sector," a spokesperson for the EU executive arm said when asked about the document and To Lam's visit.

Vietnam is not currently among the EU's 16 strategic partners on raw minerals. Critical minerals are expected to feature prominently in next week's talks, two officials said. Last week, Brussels removed Vietnam from its tax-haven blacklist. Hanoi has also urged EU states to ratify an investment protection agreement signed in 2019, which remains blocked by a handful of countries including France. It has also pressed the EU to lift a warning on Vietnamese fisheries.

Vietnam's foreign ministry did not respond to a request for comment. The EU delegation declined to comment.

Growing competition from partner countries is being viewed as a potential threat to EU supplies. One of the documents cites a failed plan last year involving entities from Australia, the US and Canada to acquire a majority stake in Vietnam's largest tungsten operation, owned by Masan High-Tech Materials.

The complex, which includes a mine and a refinery, is a key supplier of tungsten to Europe, particularly Germany, although exports fell significantly last year due to administrative bottlenecks and amid soaring tungsten prices. The plan, which two people with knowledge of the matter said was orchestrated by Australian mining firm EQ Resources, was "not without risks to existing supplies to the EU," the document said. The two sources declined to be identified publicly as the talks were private.

EQ Resources did not respond to a request for comment. Masan High-Tech declined to comment. Last month, Masan High-Tech sold a 4.99 per cent stake to Elmet Group, a tungsten supplier to the US defence stockpile. Masan High-Tech is also in talks with a non-European foreign investor for the sale of another 5 per cent stake, two people familiar with the discussions said. They also declined to be named because the talks were private.

A separate project by Australia's Lynas Rare Earths and South Korea's LS Eco Energy to produce rare earth metals in Vietnam using imported feedstock is viewed as another initiative "which risks leaving the EU behind," the document says.

It urges EU support for Vietnam's processing industry, which it describes as less politically sensitive than mining operations. Loans, grants, technical assistance and export-credit insurance are among the instruments proposed to support critical-mineral projects in Vietnam, including efforts to map resources more accurately.

The document also warns about risks of investing in Vietnam's critical minerals, including a lack of transparency about China's involvement, regulatory and political hurdles, and Vietnam's "economic nationalism" involving technology transfer requirements.

# Hong Kong to Offer Over 72,000 Subsidised Homes in Five Years, Minister Says

Hong Kong's housing minister announced that over 72,000 subsidised sale units will be completed in the next five years, boosting homeownership opportunities. The upcoming 'Home Ownership Scheme 2025' sale will offer nearly 7,000 new flats and about 400 re-sold units, with prices ranging from HK$1.5

[![Image 4: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

 By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

 14 Oct 2026 at 16:06 HKT · 1 min read

Share:

[](https://wa.me/?text=Hong%20Kong%20to%20Offer%20Over%2072%2C000%20Subsidised%20Homes%20in%20Five%20Years%2C%20Minister%20Says%20https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/government/Hong-Kong-to-Offer-Over-72-000-Subsidised-Homes-in-Five-Year-511f79 "WhatsApp")[](https://t.me/share/url?url=https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/government/Hong-Kong-to-Offer-Over-72-000-Subsidised-Homes-in-Five-Year-511f79&text=Hong%20Kong%20to%20Offer%20Over%2072%2C000%20Subsidised%20Homes%20in%20Five%20Years%2C%20Minister%20Says "Telegram")[](https://www.facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php?u=https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/government/Hong-Kong-to-Offer-Over-72-000-Subsidised-Homes-in-Five-Year-511f79 "Facebook")[](https://twitter.com/intent/tweet?url=https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/government/Hong-Kong-to-Offer-Over-72-000-Subsidised-Homes-in-Five-Year-511f79&text=Hong%20Kong%20to%20Offer%20Over%2072%2C000%20Subsidised%20Homes%20in%20Five%20Years%2C%20Minister%20Says "X")[](mailto:?subject=Hong%20Kong%20to%20Offer%20Over%2072%2C000%20Subsidised%20Homes%20in%20Five%20Years%2C%20Minister%20Says&body=Hong%20Kong%20to%20Offer%20Over%2072%2C000%20Subsidised%20Homes%20in%20Five%20Years%2C%20Minister%20Says%0Ahttps%3A//clb.org.hk/en/government/Hong-Kong-to-Offer-Over-72-000-Subsidised-Homes-in-Five-Year-511f79 "Email")

Hong Kong's Secretary for Housing, Winnie Ho, said on Wednesday that more than 72,000 subsidised sale flats will be completed in the next five years, giving more families a chance to own a home. In a social media post, she said the government has been working to speed up, increase, improve and enhance housing supply.

Ho also announced that the 'Home Ownership Scheme 2025' (HOS 2025) will begin flat selection next Wednesday. The sale includes five new HOS developments in Kai Tak, Kam Tin, Tseung Kwan O, Ping Shan and Tung Chung, offering nearly 7,000 units. The flats' saleable areas range from about 281 sq ft to about 560 sq ft. In addition, about 400 re-sold HOS flats will be offered.

Prices for the new HOS flats range from about HK$1.5 million to HK$4.8 million, Ho said. She gave an example: for a flat priced at HK$2.8 million with a saleable area of about 390 sq ft, a buyer taking a 90 per cent mortgage over 30 years at the current interest rate of about 3.5 per cent would pay about HK$11,300 per month.

The Housing Authority will invite eligible applicants in batches by post or email, according to the priority order of application categories, to select flats at the authority's customer service centre in Lok Fu during designated times.

Ho said the current term government has significantly increased the supply of subsidised sale flats in recent years, with more than 72,000 units expected to be completed in the next five years.

Taipei, Oct. 14 (CNA) The U.S. dollar fell against the Taiwan dollar Wednesday, shedding NT$0.012 to close at NT$32.073.

Turnover totaled US$2.224 billion during the trading session.

The greenback opened at NT$32.100, and peaked at NT$32.228 during trading.

# Hong Kong proposes easing stamp duty rules for corporate restructuring

Hong Kong's government introduced a bill to relax stamp duty exemptions for asset transfers between related companies, lowering the ownership threshold from 90% to 75% and expanding eligibility to limited liability partnerships and guarantee companies without share capital. Hong Kong’s Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury moved the second reading of the Stamp Duty (Amendment) (No. 3) Bill 2026 in the Legislative Assembly on 14 October, proposing to relax criteria for stamp duty exemptions on asset transfers between associated corporate bodies.

The bill implements a recommendation from the 2026-27 Budget to lower the ownership threshold for two entities to be considered associated from 90% to 75% of issued share capital. Under the current Stamp Duty Ordinance, association is determined primarily by one entity holding at least 90% of the other’s issued share capital.

Two key changes are proposed. First, when determining association, the government will consider direct and indirect beneficial interests and voting rights in addition to issued share capital. This would extend eligibility to qualifying limited liability partnerships and guarantee companies without share capital. Second, the required ownership percentage will be reduced from 90% to 75%.

“The proposed measures will reduce the cost of transferring property or securities within corporate groups, facilitating flexible restructuring or business expansion,” the secretary said. If passed, the relaxed criteria would apply to instruments executed on or after 25 February 2026, the date of the Budget announcement.

The government argues the changes will improve Hong Kong’s business environment and maintain the competitiveness of its tax system.

# Citi and Foundation Equip Hong Kong Youth With AI Skills Through Job Hunter Challenge

Citi and the Changing Young Lives Foundation held the finale of the Job Hunter Challenge 2026, a year-long programme training over 400 underprivileged students in AI literacy. Ten winners received internships, supported by a US$500,000 Citi Foundation grant.

[![Image 4: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

 By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

 14 Oct 2026 at 12:20 HKT · 1 min read

Citi and the Changing Young Lives Foundation hosted the grand finale and award ceremony of the Job Hunter Challenge 2026, a youth employability programme designed to equip underprivileged young people with AI literacy and skills for the future of work.

The year-long programme, which ran from November 2025 to October 2026, attracted more than 400 secondary and tertiary students. After individual and group assessments, 30 participants reached the final round, and 10 winners were selected to receive internship opportunities offered by corporate partners.

Speaking at the ceremony, Charles Lam, Hong Kong Head of Markets at Citi, said that while AI enhances productivity, critical thinking and communication skills remain essential for personal growth and career development.

Throughout the programme, Citi volunteers served as workshop mentors, mock interviewers and judges, drawing on their professional experience to provide career guidance and practical insights. They helped students build confidence, develop skills, and learn how to use AI to navigate an evolving workplace.

The programme is supported by the Citi Foundation’s Global Innovation Challenge, launched in 2023 to provide philanthropic support to community organisations addressing social and economic challenges through innovative solutions. In 2025, the Changing Young Lives Foundation was selected as a grant recipient and received US$500,000 to implement the two-year Job Hunter Challenge in Hong Kong, aiming to enhance young people’s employability and career readiness.

#香港成立三十周年活动督导委员会
香港已成立由政务司司长担任主席的指导委员会，筹划回归祖国30周年，并设有专责小组和项目办公室支持筹备工作。官员们表示，活动将包含国民教育元素，并凸显城市在“一带一路”下的优势。

Hong Kong has established a steering committee to oversee preparations for the 30th anniversary of its return to China next year, the Secretary for Home and Youth Affairs, Alice Mak, told the Legislative Council on Wednesday.

Speaking in response to a lawmaker's question, Mak said that under the Chief Executive's instruction, the government has set up a steering committee chaired by the Chief Secretary for Administration to provide overall guidance for planning the celebration activities. A dedicated task force, led by the Deputy Chief Secretary for Administration, has also been formed to coordinate the implementation of specific tasks, supported by a project planning office.

The government is now making full efforts to plan and advance the anniversary celebrations and will make announcements in due course, she added.

Mak said various policy bureaux and departments are organising a wide range of activities covering different areas and incorporating elements of national education. The aim is to deepen citizens' understanding of the country's and Hong Kong's history and development, strengthen their sense of national identity and belonging, and cultivate patriotic sentiments.

The celebrations will also showcase Hong Kong's unique advantages of being backed by the motherland and connected to the world under "one country, two systems", highlighting the city's distinctive role and status on the international stage, she said. The events will help tell the stories of China and Hong Kong to the world and promote the opportunities presented by the country's 15th Five-Year Plan.

Finance ministers and senior officials from the 21 APEC member economies will gather in Hong Kong next Tuesday and Wednesday for the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation finance ministers' meeting, China's Ministry of Finance has announced.

Minister Lan Fo'an will lead the Chinese delegation and chair the meeting. Vice-Minister Liao Min will deliver remarks on behalf of China. Representatives from relevant international organisations and partner economies will also take part.

According to the Ministry of Finance, the programme includes a closed-door session on Tuesday morning, focusing on informal discussions under the theme 'Driving Asia-Pacific Economic Growth in a Changing World'. A working lunch with business leaders from the Asia-Pacific region will follow, with the aim of hearing private-sector recommendations on mobilising private capital and supporting digital infrastructure financing. The formal agenda will begin with an opening ceremony on Tuesday afternoon.

On Wednesday morning, after the meeting concludes, a press conference will be held. The schedule also includes a series of visits. As the host of this year's gathering, Hong Kong, an international financial centre and tourist destination, will showcase its recent development achievements and urban appeal.

# Hong Kong flu jab drive reaches 700,000 doses, minister hopes for higher uptake

Hong Kong's flu vaccination drive has administered about 700,000 doses in less than a month since 17 September. Health Secretary Lo Chung-mau urged higher uptake, targeting last year's 2.03 million doses, as new measures including expanded procurement and e-consent forms take effect.

[![Image 4: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

 By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

Hong Kong's Secretary for Health, Lo Chung-mau, said on 14 October that the territory's seasonal influenza vaccination programme, which began on 17 September, has administered about 700,000 doses in less than a month. Speaking at a Legislative Council flu jab event, he expressed hope that the overall uptake would surpass last year's total of about 2.03 million doses.

Lo noted that the government has introduced four new measures this year to improve coverage. These include procuring a wider variety of vaccines, expanding a pilot scheme for private doctors from 100,000 to 300,000 doses, launching electronic consent forms, and stepping up community outreach. He added that about 99 per cent of schools—more than 2,200—have taken part in the outreach programme to vaccinate students, with only 13 schools not participating, mainly due to space or staffing constraints.

The minister urged people with elderly family members, those working in care homes, and hospital staff to get vaccinated promptly to protect themselves and vulnerable groups. Legislative Council President Starry Lee, who also received a jab at the event, said more than 40 lawmakers had been vaccinated on the day, with others having done so earlier or planning to do so later.

Lee warned that influenza is not a common cold and can lead to serious complications, particularly for children, the elderly, and people with chronic conditions. She called on the public to get vaccinated early, saying 'one day earlier vaccination brings one day earlier peace of mind'. She also highlighted strengthened cooperation between the government, district councils, and community care teams to make vaccination more convenient for residents.

这家科技巨头表示，扣除费用和佣金后，预计所得款项总额将分别约为17.9亿美元和258.9亿元人民币，并将用于一般企业用途。

此次发行包括将于 2036 年到期的 13 亿美元票据，票面利率为 6。

# Tencent prices US$1.8b and 26b yuan notes under MTN programme

Tencent has priced US$1.8 billion in US dollar notes and 26 billion yuan in yuan-denominated notes under its global medium-term note programme. Proceeds will go towards general corporate purposes, with the notes due between 2036 and 2056 and listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange.

[![Image 4: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

 By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

 14 Oct 2026 at 10:06 HKT · 1 min read

Tencent (0700) said on Wednesday it had priced US$1.8 billion (HK$14.04 billion) of US dollar notes and 26 billion yuan (HK$30.49 billion) of yuan-denominated notes under its global medium-term note (MTN) programme.

The technology giant said the proceeds, after fees and commissions, were expected to total about US$1.79 billion and 25.89 billion yuan, respectively, and would be used for general corporate purposes.

The offering comprises US$1.3 billion of notes due in 2036 carrying a 6.1 per cent coupon and US$500 million of notes due in 2046 carrying a 6.75 per cent coupon.

Tencent also priced 20 billion yuan of notes due in 2036 with a 2.40 per cent coupon and 6 billion yuan of notes due in 2056 with a 3 per cent coupon.

The notes are expected to be issued on October 21, and Tencent intends to list them on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange.

The debt sale follows Tencent's announcement earlier this week that it planned to issue notes under its MTN programme.

content:
2007年2月8日拍摄的台北国立故宫博物院全景。以珍藏丰富中国古代瑰宝而闻名的台湾国立故宫博物院，在历经三年的翻新工程后重新开放。（图片来源：SAM YEH/AFP via Getty Images）

有一次，一位北大教授对说：当年蒋公撤退[台湾](https://www.secretchina.com/news/gb/tag/%E5%8F%B0%E6%B9%BE)，带走了国库里的几百万两黄金,才有今日台湾的兴旺和发达。此话让笔者十分错愕，人们看到的是黄金百万的价值，看不到蒋公带走更珍贵而且无价的是什么？

49年的大撤退，世人往往只见国府之溃败、江山之易手。可当马列西来幽灵在大陆掀起滔天赤浪、疯狂屠戮五千年[中华文明](https://www.secretchina.com/news/gb/tag/%E4%B8%AD%E5%8D%8E%E6%96%87%E6%98%8E)之际，人们并没有认识到，这是一场关乎华夏文明生死存亡的大迁徙。台湾这座孤悬海外的岛屿，默默承担起人类历史上最悲壮的使命。

如今，77年过去，一边是中共暴政在道德沦丧与制度腐败中步入历史暮年，另一边则是台湾将传统仁厚与现代宪政完美融合，绽放出文明的繁盛之花。历史在此刻交汇，更将中共强加给海峡的“分裂”罪名，化为一记射向其自身心脏的致命回力镖。台湾不是偏安的残局，而是神州文明在灭顶洪水前启航的“挪亚方舟”。

[![Image 2](https://img6.secretchina.com/bigpic/2024/11-4/p3557701a911506510.jpg)](https://naturexcels.com/language/zh/)

## **台湾 华夏文明的“挪亚方舟”**

1948年12月至1949年2月，故宫文物分三批由中鼎轮、海沪轮、昆仑号军舰押运至基隆，共计2,972箱，包含翠玉白菜、快雪时晴帖、毛公鼎等国宝，未损一纸一玉，躲过了文革破四旧的文化劫难，中华民国在神州遭遇红魔肆虐之前，将中华文脉乘船渡海。

那一年，带走的不仅仅是国库中的几百万两黄金，更是一整座五千年文明的灵魂。故宫博物院近三千箱、逾六十万件历代法书名画、商周彝器、宋元孤本，在烽火连天中奇迹般地未损分毫，跨越海峡；陈寅恪、胡适、傅斯年、钱穆等硕学鸿儒，或应召赴台，或寄寓港九，华夏思想与学术的真正道统，在万方多难中拔根流亡。这绝非军事溃败的被动逃亡，而是文明巨灵在冥冥之中的自救移徙。

这不禁令人遥想《创世记》中所载的太古大洪水。在滔天巨浪吞噬大地之前，神晓谕挪亚预备方舟，将一切受造之物的种子引领登舱。彼时万里晴空，旁人皆以挪亚为疯癫，百般嘲弄讥刺；唯有挪亚在孤寂中伐木造舰，默默等待着黑云蔽日的一刻。

1949年的台湾，何尝不是在历史的大晴天、沉醉于中共“解放”狂欢之际，承受着举世的冷眼与误解，在危崖之上孤身打造着一艘承载中华文明血脉的方舟？

77年后回望，大陆经历了反右、大饥荒、文革“破四旧”、89屠城，99年迫害正信的修炼者，再到今日全民被禁锢于数字高墙与思想集中营，文明生态几近荒芜；而台湾这座36000平方公里的海岛，非但未被惊涛骇浪所吞没，反而将中华民族最精微的温良恭俭让、最珍贵的民族传统文化与乡土伦理，与现代民主宪政、言论自由熔铸为一炉。77年的守望，不是偶然的偏安，是神对中华文明的护佑。

## **看透西来幽灵 蒋中正对赤患的世纪洞察**

若说蒋先生身负使命，可能很多人会不以为然。我们先来溯源蒋中正对共产主义长达半个世纪的深刻认知。在民国初年的知识界与政界，受列宁煽惑者不可胜数；即便是国父孙中山先生，早年亦出于联络国际奥援的现实考量，采取了“联俄容共”的策略。

然而，唯有亲身踏足赤色魔窟腹地的蒋中正，以其儒学浸润之深与政治嗅觉之敏锐，最早勘破了这个西来幽灵的嗜血底色。

历史的分水岭在1923年。蒋中正奉孙中山之命率“孙逸仙博士代表团”赴莫斯科考察3个月。那场近百天的考察，彻底击碎了他原本对苏维埃革命的一丝浪漫幻想。他在日记与给廖仲恺的密函中直言不讳：苏俄口称反帝国主义，实则包藏祸心，乃是更加隐蔽凶残的“赤色帝国主义”；苏俄之政治极权专横，蔑视人性尊严，根本不尊重大陆传统伦理。他无比警醒地预言：俄共殊无诚意，中共党人甘受其操纵牵线，将来必为[中国](https://www.secretchina.com/)民族之巨祸。

此言不幸言中，1949年之后，中国人民身处中共的水深火热之中。

1927年当中共在苏联顾问鲍罗廷操纵下试图借壳上市、全面赤化国民革命时，蒋中正毅然发动清党，中断赤祸蔓延。在后续的江西剿共与抗战岁月中，蒋中正更屡次在日记与文告中将中共定性为“衣冠禽兽”与“人面兽心”。他痛斥中共的斗争哲学以阶级仇恨撕裂人伦亲情，唆使父子相残、夫妻告密、朋友相噬，彻底践踏孔孟以来“忠孝仁爱信义和平”的五千年立国之本。

抗战时期，中共“一分抗日、二分应付、七分发展”，趁国军在正面战场以数百万忠烈血肉之躯抵御日寇之际，在敌后扩军占地，甚至与日军暗通款曲以耗损国军。蒋中正深明此理：日本之侵略乃肌肤之患，割地赔款犹有收复之日；而共产之侵蚀乃心腹之疾，一旦赤化，则宗庙丘墟、文脉断绝，神州将沦为万劫不复的人间地狱。一九四九年退守台湾后，他力倡“反共抗俄”，其核心主旨从未仅是政权之争，而是保卫中华道统免于被苏俄走狗彻底拔除的生死决战。

信中写道：“俄党之言，只有主义，而无信义。其所谓国际主义与世界革命者，实即赤色帝国主义之代名词……俄党殊无诚意，其欲利用我国民党以达到其不可告人之目的。”

## **十年文革浩劫 与中华文化复兴运动的生死对垒**

当红卫兵在大陆掘开孔子墓、斩断历代宗祠古迹之时，台湾在日月潭边、阳明山下，为五千年道统点燃了不灭的薪火。

若要检验谁才是中华文明的真正传人，1966年爆发的历史大对决便是无可驳斥的照妖镜。那一年，[毛泽东](https://www.secretchina.com/news/gb/tag/%E6%AF%9B%E6%B3%BD%E4%B8%9C)在神州大地发动狂暴的“文化大革命”，自命“和尚打伞，无法无天”。“破四旧”的魔火席卷长江南北：曲阜孔林孔庙被红卫兵用炸药破坏，孔子遗骨遭焚毁侮辱；海瑞墓被挖，岳飞庙被砸，霍去病墓被毁；无数传承千百年的族谱被当街焚烧，佛寺道观改为屠宰场与猪圈，字画古籍在烈焰中化为飞灰。

这场浩劫不只是文物的毁灭，更是对中华民族精神骨髓的凌迟。“爹亲娘亲不如毛主席亲”，夫妻划清界限，子女殴打父母，学生折磨师长。数千年在血脉中流淌的孝道、仁爱、廉耻与诚信，被彻底掏空，取而代之的是禽兽般的阶级斗争与狼奶喂养的告密文化。这是一场由政权主导、针对本民族文明根脉的自残式种族与文化灭绝。

恰在此际，1966年11月12日，孙中山先生百年诞辰之日，海峡对岸的台湾做出了震撼历史的回应。蒋中正正式宣布发起“中华文化复兴运动”，并亲任推行委员会会长。台湾以国家之力，将传统文化的保护与发扬上升为最高国策。从编纂《中华文化概述》到小学全面普及《论语》、《孟子》经典朗读；从在基隆、台北重修孔庙、恢复太牢释奠礼，到将正体汉字视为中华文明之正统血脉悉心守护。

那是人类文明史上罕见的黑白分明图景：海峡西岸，群魔乱舞，撕书砸碑，将华夏圣贤踩在脚下；海峡东岸，弦歌不辍，尊师重道，将传统仁爱奉为圭臬。正是这场历时十余年的文化复兴运动，奠定了台湾社会“礼失而求诸野”的底层道德基石。

今天世人走在台北或台南的街头，所感受到的人情之美、乡土之淳、温和礼让，乃至信守承诺的商道，皆是当年这艘“文明方舟”在惊涛浪静中为华人世界留存的珍贵遗产。

蒋中正在宣言中指出：“共匪之摧毁中国传统文化，乃其自掘坟墓之先兆……今日吾人在此复兴中华文化，实为拯救神州同胞与整个人类文明之神圣天职。”

## **历史照妖镜 谁才是肢解与分裂中国的真正罪魁？**

“中共自诞生之日起，便是苏俄卵翼下的分裂集团。从瑞金的列宁头像卢布，到一九四九年硬生生将大陆从中华民国版图撕裂，中共犯下的是彻头彻尾的‘陆独’重罪！”

数十年来，中共宣传机器最歇斯底里的嚎叫，莫过于给台湾扣上“分裂国家”、“背叛祖国”的帽子。然而翻开泛黄的历史档案，人们将目睹近代史上最荒诞、最赤裸的黑色幽默——在分裂祖国、裂土分疆这桩重罪上，中共不仅是劣迹斑斑的惯犯，更是首屈一指的祖师爷。

早在中共建党前夕的1920年9月，青年毛泽东便在长沙《大公报》上连篇累牍发表《湖南建设问题的根本问题——湖南共和国》、《打破没有基础的大中国，建设许多的小中国——22省3特区两藩地合共27个国》等文章。

毛泽东赤裸裸地主张：“最好办法，是索性湖南自搞……各省自搞，连清白白建立22省、3个特区、两个藩地，合共27个小中国。”彼时的毛泽东，何曾有半点国家统一的念头？他正是“湘独”与“肢解中国”的首倡者！

更令人发指的，是1931年。当年9月18日，日本关东军炮轰沈阳，九一八事变爆发，中华民族面临亡国灭种之危局。而中共在做什么？仅仅不到两个月后的1931年11月7日，恰逢苏联十月革命14周年纪念日，中共在莫斯科直接指令与卢布资助下，于江西瑞金公然建立“中华苏维埃共和国”割据政权！毛泽东出任所谓“中央执行委员会主席”，召开“开国大典”，制定“宪法大纲”，发行印有列宁头像的苏维埃纸币，以苏联镰刀铁锤为国旗，以《国际歌》为国歌！

更为卖国的是，这部瑞金伪宪法第14条白纸黑字规定：“中华苏维埃政权承认中国境内少数民族有民族自决权，一直承认到有从中国分裂出去独立成邦的权利。”在国难当头之际，中共甘当外国敌对势力苏联的马前卒，在中国心脏腹地建立“国中之国”，武装割据、策应苏俄。

及至1949年，中共在苏联斯大林提供的大批关东军武器援助下，以暴力推翻依据1946年《中华民国宪法》合法民选的中华民国政府，在大陆擅立“中华人民共和国”。这绝非什么合法政权的更迭，而是一场由共产国际策划、引狼入室的“颜色革命”；是中共硬生生将大陆国土从中华民国的合法法统中分裂了出去！这是一场彻头彻尾的“大陆独立”（简称“陆独”）。如果不是中共犯下这桩“陆独”罪行，何来今日海峡两岸长达77年的对峙与分离？

## **历史的终极审判 [习近平](https://www.secretchina.com/news/gb/tag/%E4%B9%A0%E8%BF%91%E5%B9%B3)讲话的回力镖效应**

2021年10月9日，中共党魁习近平在北京人民大会堂举行的“纪念辛亥革命110周年大会”上，声色俱厉地宣称：“凡是数典忘祖、背叛祖国、分裂国家的人，从来没有好下场，必将遭到人民的唾弃和历史的审判！”

闻听此言，凡对中国近代史稍有常识者，无不拍案叫绝。拍案者非为其赞赏，实乃惊叹于历史命运之弄人与天道好还之精妙！因为这三项滔天罪名——“数典忘祖”、“背叛祖国”、“分裂国家”，每一项的罪魁祸首，无一例外都是中国共产党！

试问：谁数典忘祖？认德国人马克思、俄国人列宁为精神亲爹，将五千年炎黄道统践踏入泥，砸碎孔庙、焚毁典籍、废黜正体汉字，让十几亿中国人被迫认贼作父，这难道不是人类有史以来最登峰造极的“数典忘祖”？

试问：谁背叛祖国？在抗日战争国难当头之际，躲在延安种植鸦片（特货）、密谋勾结汪伪日军损耗国军主力；在建政之后，为换取苏联、朝鲜、缅甸支持，大笔一挥割让江东六十四屯、唐努乌梁海、长白山天池一半以及白龙尾岛，甚至欢呼外蒙古从中国版图彻底脱离！这难道不是彻头彻尾的“背叛祖国”？

试问：谁分裂国家？1920年鼓吹27国独立，1931年在瑞金建立苏维埃割据伪政权，1949年以暴力撕裂中华民国版图、自立“陆独”门户，这难道不是77年来造成台海分裂的千古罪魁？

习近平发言中指责海外与台湾势力，但其“数典忘祖、背叛祖国、分裂国家”三项指控，恰好条条对应中共建党及执政后的实际历史行为。

## **方舟靠岸之日 台湾的文明荣光**

“台湾守住的，不是一岛一地的霸权，而是10多亿中华儿女本该享有的尊严日常。这座方舟的荣光，终将在赤祸消散的那一天，普照神州故土。”

如果不是1949年中共勾结境外势力撕裂国土、搞出惨绝人寰的“大陆独立”，今天的神州大地本应是何种模样？

大陆14亿同胞，原本应当在1946年宪法的保障下，享有真正属于人民的直接普选权；享受不论贫富皆能安心就医的全民健保制度；享有言论自由、信仰自由与迁徙自由；享有独立公正的司法审判，不必在强拆上访中含冤泣血，不必在毒奶粉、地沟油与烂尾楼中提心吊胆，更不必在极权体制的铁拳下沦为随时被收割的“代价与韭菜”。这一切文明社会的基本体面，并非西方文明的专利，早已在台湾海峡的这一侧，生动、踏实地实现了几十年。

台湾的伟大，不在于其幅员之辽阔，而在于其使命之崇高。在长达77年的逆境中，面对对岸动辄飞弹洗礼、文攻武划的生存威胁，台湾顶住了整个共产极权阵营的黑云压顶。它没有滑向军国主义的疯狂，反而以无比的韧性完成了从威权体制向现代民主社会的和平转型。

如今，世界看到了：儒家伦理中的“民贵君轻”、“天下为公”，在二十一世纪完全可以与现代法治、公民社会、尖端半导体科技交相辉映。

1946年国民大会通过宪法；1987年解严；1996年首次总统直选；2000年、2008年、2016年三次和平政党轮替，奠定华人世界第一个成熟民主政体。

大洪水终有退去的一天，方舟终将在重见天日的亚拉腊山顶靠岸。今天，中共的“历史周期率”已然不可逆转：经济衰竭、民怨沸腾、外交孤立、塔西佗陷阱深不见底，这座建立在暴力、谎言与文化自残之上的红色沙堡，正在全方位崩解。而台湾这艘苦心经营七十七载的中华文明方舟，早已将最纯正的文化密码、最成熟的民主种子、最温暖的族群善意完好无损地保存了下来。

这便是历史赋予台湾的至高荣耀。当红祸的滔天浊浪化作历史的陈迹，当神州故土从噩梦中苏醒，感激这座在风雨如晦的岁月里，以36,000平方公里之躯，为整个中华民族守住灵魂、保留文明火种的伟大方舟！

# Customs seizes HK$18m of suspected smuggled drugs at bridge port

Hong Kong Customs seized about 320,000 suspected pharmaceutical products worth HK$18 million at the Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao Bridge port on Tuesday. A 39-year-old mainland driver was arrested and charged with attempting to export unmanifested cargo.

[![Image 4: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

 By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

 14 Oct 2026 at 04:21 HKT · 1 min read

Share:

[](https://wa.me/?text=Customs%20seizes%20HK%2418m%20of%20suspected%20smuggled%20drugs%20at%20bridge%20port%20https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Customs-seizes-HK-18m-of-suspected-smuggled-drugs-at-bridge-4b180d "WhatsApp")[](https://t.me/share/url?url=https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Customs-seizes-HK-18m-of-suspected-smuggled-drugs-at-bridge-4b180d&text=Customs%20seizes%20HK%2418m%20of%20suspected%20smuggled%20drugs%20at%20bridge%20port "Telegram")[](https://www.facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php?u=https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Customs-seizes-HK-18m-of-suspected-smuggled-drugs-at-bridge-4b180d "Facebook")[](https://twitter.com/intent/tweet?url=https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Customs-seizes-HK-18m-of-suspected-smuggled-drugs-at-bridge-4b180d&text=Customs%20seizes%20HK%2418m%20of%20suspected%20smuggled%20drugs%20at%20bridge%20port "X")[](mailto:?subject=Customs%20seizes%20HK%2418m%20of%20suspected%20smuggled%20drugs%20at%20bridge%20port&body=Customs%20seizes%20HK%2418m%20of%20suspected%20smuggled%20drugs%20at%20bridge%20port%0Ahttps%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Customs-seizes-HK-18m-of-suspected-smuggled-drugs-at-bridge-4b180d "Email")

Hong Kong Customs has seized about 320,000 suspected pharmaceutical products with an estimated market value of about HK$18 million at the Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao Bridge Hong Kong Port, in a suspected smuggling case involving an outgoing lorry.

Based on risk assessment, officers intercepted a lorry declared to contain supplements, skincare products and clothes. Upon inspection, they found the suspected pharmaceutical products hidden inside the cargo compartment.

A 39-year-old mainland male driver was arrested and charged with one count of attempting to export unmanifested cargo. He will appear at West Kowloon Magistrates' Courts on Wednesday.

Customs reminded the public that exporting unmanifested cargo carries a maximum penalty of HK$2 million and seven years' imprisonment, while exporting pharmaceutical products without a valid export licence carries a maximum fine of HK$500,000 and two years' imprisonment.

# 俄羅斯空襲基輔發電廠 澤倫斯基稱未獲西方盟友預警

2026/10/14 06:32（10/14 06:44 更新）

[](javascript:)[](javascript:)[](javascript:)[](javascript:)[](javascript:)[![Image 19](https://imgcdn.cna.com.tw/www/website/img/support.svg)](https://cna.com.tw/donate/)

請同意我們的隱私權規範，才能啟用聽新聞的功能。

（中央社基輔13日綜合外電報導）烏克蘭總統澤倫斯基（Volodymyr Zelenskyy）表示，俄羅斯昨天傍晚發射的1枚彈道飛彈擊中基輔1座發電廠，但烏克蘭事前未接獲西方盟友的任何預警。

法新社報導，澤倫斯基在社群媒體臉書（Facebook）發文說：「俄羅斯對基輔發動彈道飛彈攻擊。我們的夥伴再次未提供預警。」他指出：「（俄方）主要目標鎖定能源基礎設施，具體來說是第四火力發電廠（CHP-4），很遺憾它被擊中。」

法新社駐基輔記者回報說聽到數次爆炸聲。烏克蘭高度依賴西方（特別是美國）情報以偵測來襲的俄羅斯攻擊，和協助確認自己的打擊目標。

澤倫斯基指出，烏克蘭防空系統直到飛彈逼近基輔市才將其攔截。他強調：「這一點也不公平：當他們正在摧毀我方基礎設施，烏克蘭甚至未收到關於發射彈道飛彈的初期預警。」

美國總統川普（Donald Trump）11日在自家社群平台「真實社群」（Truth Social）出乎意料宣布達成一項「能源停火」，稱俄羅斯與烏克蘭已同意終止對發電廠和煉油廠的致命長程打擊。

川普屢次抨擊澤倫斯基空襲俄羅斯煉油廠一事，他更在10日暗示「是時候讓烏克蘭換個新總統了」。（編譯：[洪啓原](https://cna.com.tw/author/0019/)）1151014

# 投資人消化通膨報告 歐洲股市收跌

2026/10/14 00:37

[](javascript:)[](javascript:)[](javascript:)[](javascript:)[](javascript:)[![Image 19](https://imgcdn.cna.com.tw/www/website/img/support.svg)](https://cna.com.tw/donate/)

請同意我們的隱私權規範，才能啟用聽新聞的功能。

（中央社倫敦13日綜合外電報導）歐洲主要股市今天收低，主因投資人正在評估德國最新公布的通膨報告。報告顯示，德國9月消費者物價指數年增率升至3.3%。明天，市場焦點將轉向西班牙與美國的通膨數據。

倫敦FTSE 100指數下跌5.95點或0.06%，收報10650.33點。

法蘭克福DAX指數下挫17.78點或0.07%，收在25259.90點。

巴黎CAC 40指數下跌5.25點或0.07%，收7827.63點。（編譯：[張曉雯](https://cna.com.tw/author/0090/)）1151014

title: 中共五中全会18项维稳密令曝光 北京狂抓访民(图)  -  社会百态 -
summary: 2026年5月14日，北京警察在执勤。示意图（图片来源：Pedro Pardo AFP via Getty Images） 【看中国2026年10月13日讯】（看中国记者李木子综合报导）**[中共](https://www.secretchina.com/news/gb/tag/%E4%B8%AD%E5%85%B1)**第20届**五中全会**将于10月26日至29日在北京召开，**北京**草木皆兵。据爆料的中共机密文件，中共为这次会议部署了多达18项**维稳安保**措施，内
content:
2026年5月14日，北京警察在执勤。示意图（图片来源：Pedro Pardo AFP via Getty Images）

【看中国2026年10月13日讯】（看中国记者李木子综合报导）**[中共](https://www.secretchina.com/news/gb/tag/%E4%B8%AD%E5%85%B1)**第20届**五中全会**将于10月26日至29日在北京召开，**北京**草木皆兵。据爆料的中共机密文件，中共为这次会议部署了多达18项**维稳安保**措施，内容包括对驻华使领馆、外国媒体以及对**中国访民**的严控等。传北京已经开始大肆抓捕访民。

10月12日，X平台《爆点周刊》发布消息，随着中共[五中全会](https://www.secretchina.com/news/gb/tag/%E4%BA%94%E4%B8%AD%E5%85%A8%E4%BC%9A)临近，北京及周边地区的安保措施持续升级。据一份中央层级的机密文件，首次披露中共为此次五中全会部署的18项维稳安保措施，揭开这一庞大政治安全体系的运作内幕。

中共中央维护政治安全和社会稳定工作领导小组办公室向各省、自治区、直辖市和新疆生产建设兵团维护政治安全和社会稳定工作议事协调机构（工作机制）、中央政法委、中央维护政治安全和社会稳定工作领导小组各成员单位、各专项工作小组及相关成员单位下发了《关于做好二十届五中全会期间维护安全稳定工作的通知》。

[![Image 2](https://img6.secretchina.com/pic/2025/7-29/p3676411a560438137.jpg)](https://www.naturenergy.us/)

《通知》要求各有关部门“要保证24小时专人在岗”，涉及重大突发情况必须及时请示报告，不得迟报、漏报、谎报、瞒报。并启动日报告机制，“各地区各部门须于每日18点前报送当天情况，做到有事报情况，无事报平安”。

通知提出的17项具体工作要求还有：密切关注境外分裂势力渗透、颠覆、破坏动向；严控各重点国家驻华使领馆、媒体、非政府组织人员赴各重点地区、点位活动；严防国内不安定分子通过快闪滋扰、电子投屏放送反动标语、涂挂传统“反动标语条幅”和无人机黑飞等风险。

内容还涉及到：紧盯劳动群体、妇女群体、青年学生等群体涉政动向；加强境外宗教渗透和境内非法宗教活动风险防控处置；深入排查、防范换届期间各类不稳定的因素和风险隐患；切实做好反恐防恐工作。

还有，做好首都禁飞区实施工作，做好临近首都空域安全管控；严控进京上访人员……坚决把各种不安全、不稳定因素堵截在首都之外；严防发生群体性事件；严防个人极端案事件；加强网络涉稳舆情引导管控，等等。

> 独家曝光：中共五中全会18项维稳密令｜爆点周刊｜纽约10月12日讯｜记者：保罗｜[中国](https://www.secretchina.com/news/gb/tag/%E4%B8%AD%E5%9B%BD)共产党第二十届中央委员会第五次全体会议将于10月26日至29日在北京召开。随着会议临近，北京及周边地区的安保措施持续升级。在中国高度封闭的政治体制下，重大政治活动背后的安保部署、维稳机制及其具体运作方式，始终笼罩在政治黑箱之中，外界难以窥见其真实面貌。中共究竟如何动员庞大的国家机器，为一场党内政治会议实施全方位的社会管控？近日，《爆点周刊》透明度计划获得一份中央层级的机密文件，首次披露中共为此次五中全会部署的18项维稳安保措施，揭开这一庞大政治安全体系的运作内幕。 近日，中共中央维护政治安全和社会稳定工作领导小组办公室向各省自治区直辖市和新疆生产建设兵团维护政治安全和社会稳定工作议事协调机构（工作机制）、中央政法委、中央维护政治安全和安全稳定工作领导小组各成员单位、各专项工作小组及相关成员单位下发了《关于做好二十届五中全会期间维护安全稳定工作的通知》。 通知要求各地区各部门要坚决贯彻党中央决策部署要求，进一步提高政治站位，树牢底线思维、极限思维。以防范化解政治安全和社会稳定重大风险隐患集中攻坚为抓手。扎实做好线索落查、教育稳控、防范应对各项工作，全力维护党的二十届五中全会期间社会大局安全稳定工作。通知指出，要严格落实工作责任。各地区各有关部门要严格落实党委、党组国家安全责任制，维护社会稳定责任制。要压实属地维稳化解责任，行业主管监管责任，政法机关责任，共同把维稳安保各项工作抓实、抓细、抓出成效。各有关部门要保证24小时专人在岗，严格执行值班请假报告制度，涉及重大突发情况必须及时请示报告，不得迟报、漏报、谎报、瞒报。党委维护政治安全和社会稳定工作领导小组启动日报告机制，各地区各部门须于每日18点前报送当天情况，做到有事报情况，无事报平安。各成员单位和各项专项工作小组成员要加强本行业领域设稳风险排查化解。为此，通知具体提出了以17项具体工作要求： 一、 狠抓国家安全、政治安全工作，密切关注境外分裂势力渗透、颠覆、破坏动向，持续深化反制和斩断勾连专项行动。要强化重要情报信息搜集，坚决防止境内外反动势力勾连聚合、煽动滋事。 二、 中央和各地区有关责任单位要密切配合，严控各重点国家驻华使领馆、媒体、非政府组织人员赴我国各重点地区、点位活动的审核把关和跟踪监视及预防控制力度。加强有关敏感外国人情报收集和行为预判，妥善处置外国敏感人员动向线索，严防刺探搜情，严防脱管失控。 三、 严防国内不安定分子通过快闪滋扰、电子投屏放送反动标语、涂挂传统“反动标语条幅”和无人机黑飞等风险。加强对城市高风险点位公共电子屏显示等安全管控，严防形成现实危害。 四、 紧盯劳动群体、妇女群体、青年学生等群体涉政动向。做好教育疏导管控工作，严防发生非官方组织规模性人员聚集。 五、 加强境外宗教渗透和境内非法宗教活动风险防控处置。严防发生天主教地下教会和基督教家庭教会非法集会传教，公开聚集滋事等事件。 六、 切实维护好省级党委换届秩序，深入排查、防范换届期间各类不稳定的因素和风险隐患，确保工作不断、力度不减、秩序不乱。 七、 切实做好反恐防恐工作。加强涉恐情报信息搜集研判，严格落实反恐防恐“六住”措施（主要包括：1、盯住人：排查、监控涉恐嫌疑人员及重点关注对象。2、把住口：加强交通要道、出入口和重要通道的安全检查。3、管住房：加强重点建筑、房屋及相关场所的安全管理。4、看住物：严格管控危险物品及可能用于恐怖袭击的工具。5、守住点：加强学校、医院、交通枢纽等重点目标的安全防护。6、控住面：对重点区域实施综合治安防控和风险排查。）切实守住不发生暴恐案件底线。 八、 配合做好首都禁飞区实施工作，做好临近首都空域安全管控，加强低慢小航空器管理，坚决守住首都禁飞区不发生无人机黑飞和低慢小航空器黑飞事件底线。 九、 严控进京上访人员，全面落实《进一步规范群众来访登记工作办法》，深入排查梳理进京涉防高风险群体和人员。认真做好政策落实，帮扶解困，教育疏导，源头稳控等工作。严防滞留北京滋事，加强首都“护城河”（主要包括环绕北京的河北省和天津市，其中河北省廊坊、保定、张家口、承德等环京地区）区域协同防控。通过跨区域警务协作、情报共享、重点人员管控、对公路、铁路、民航等各类进京渠道进行联合查控，坚决把各种不安全、不稳定因素堵截在首都之外。 十、 严防发生群体性事件。把防范利益诉求群体规模聚集作为重中之重，深入排查投资受损、退伍军人涉访、三车两员（ “三车”是指：1、货车司机2、网约车司机3、出租车司机；“两员”是指：1、快递员2、外卖员）等利益群体和房地产、涉众金融等重点领域串联聚集突出动向。紧盯煽动罢工、组建工会、扬言游行示威等涉稳风险苗头，针对性做好线索落查、教育稳控等工作，严防风险落地成势。坚持和发展新时代“枫桥经验”。 十一、 严防个人极端案事件。进一步发挥好综治中心作用，深入开展矛盾纠纷排查化解专项行动。密切关注婚恋家庭、邻里纠纷、欠薪欠资等节假日易发的矛盾纠纷。加强严重精神障碍患者、刑满释放人员、罪错未成年人、“三失一偏”人员（是指生活失意、心理失衡、行为失常、性格偏执的人员）等特殊群体服务管理，严防发生个人极端案事件和恶性刑事案件。 十二、 强化社会面整体防控。认真开展深化扫黑除恶专项斗争，形成强力震慑。加强公安武警联勤联动，全面排查党政机关，商场景区，车站机场，公园广场等场所治安隐患和盲点，强化城乡结合部、农村集市等薄弱地区安全管理。做好大型活动安保维稳工作。 十三、 加强社会面动态管控。持续深入开展“辑枪治爆”隐患排查，强化寄递物流和枪支、爆炸物、危化品等管控。 十四、 集中采取行动治理滥用非列管制、成瘾性物质专项行动，严防危险物品进京流入社会，确保首都社会面净化安全。 十五、 严防发生重特大公共安全事件。加强重点行业、领域、重点部位安全巡查和隐患排查，切实防范城市内涝、山体滑坡、泥石流等灾害风险事故。深入开展交通、消防隐患排查整治。严厉打击涉灾违法犯罪，防止相关风险向安全稳定领域传导。 十六、 加强看守所、监狱、纪检监察执法办案中心等场所安全管理工作，确保执法单位内部安全。 十七、 加强网络涉稳舆情引导管控，充分发挥4-15（4小时和15分钟）机制作用。聚焦境内外主流社交平台和重点网络群组，严格落实7✖️24小时网上监测管控措施。坚决封堵、删除政治谣言和有害信息，严防风险从境外倒灌境内，网上网下传导。 十八、 密切关注各类民生、维权等热点话题。有针对性做好宣传引导，防止网络舆论误解、误读异化炒作。强化依法处置，对为赚取流量造谣生事恶意炒作的，对煽动集会游行、发布散布有害信息的要快速落地查人依法严肃处理。 https://t.co/xcNNfkh3X0
>
> — 爆点周刊（BaodianTimes） (@baodiantimes) [October 12, 2026](https://x.com/baodiantimes/status/2109565162793341113?ref_src=twsrc%5Etfw)

对此，网民在评论区热议：“细思极恐：上下联动，密不透风；铁板一块，事与愿违。”“共匪极权统治已经到了摇摇欲坠的地步了。”“物极必反，人不治天治！”

## 中共五中开会前夕 访民又遭殃

旅居日本的中国维权人士杨彩英上传多则视频消息，10月12日，中共国家信访局内，多位维权访民被截访人员和警察强行抬走。

据视频显示，4、5个执法人员扯着一名女子的四肢，连抬带托，将痛哭的女子抬走。另一画面显示，两名警察，在人群中找一位老妇，不由分说架起就走。

中共五中全会前夕不止是[北京](https://www.secretchina.com/news/gb/tag/%E5%8C%97%E4%BA%AC)严控访民，据10月8日的视频显示，江苏淮安中级法院门口，一名维权访民被十多名警察摁倒在地，家属被逼迫无奈，情急之下接连跳河抗议。

# Hong Kong stocks rise on tech gains; Lenovo rebounds 8 per cent

Hong Kong shares closed higher on Friday, driven by tech stocks, with the Hang Seng Index up 0.52 per cent. Lenovo rebounded 8 per cent after a sharp fall, while Kuaishou rose on its new AI video model. Mainland indices also gained.

[![Image 4: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

 By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

 16 Oct 2026 at 16:35 HKT · 1 min read

Share:

[](https://wa.me/?text=Hong%20Kong%20stocks%20rise%20on%20tech%20gains%3B%20Lenovo%20rebounds%208%20per%20cent%20https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/business/Hong-Kong-stocks-rise-on-tech-gains-Lenovo-rebounds-8-per-ce-7c5a07 "WhatsApp")[](https://t.me/share/url?url=https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/business/Hong-Kong-stocks-rise-on-tech-gains-Lenovo-rebounds-8-per-ce-7c5a07&text=Hong%20Kong%20stocks%20rise%20on%20tech%20gains%3B%20Lenovo%20rebounds%208%20per%20cent "Telegram")[](https://www.facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php?u=https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/business/Hong-Kong-stocks-rise-on-tech-gains-Lenovo-rebounds-8-per-ce-7c5a07 "Facebook")[](https://twitter.com/intent/tweet?url=https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/business/Hong-Kong-stocks-rise-on-tech-gains-Lenovo-rebounds-8-per-ce-7c5a07&text=Hong%20Kong%20stocks%20rise%20on%20tech%20gains%3B%20Lenovo%20rebounds%208%20per%20cent "X")[](mailto:?subject=Hong%20Kong%20stocks%20rise%20on%20tech%20gains%3B%20Lenovo%20rebounds%208%20per%20cent&body=Hong%20Kong%20stocks%20rise%20on%20tech%20gains%3B%20Lenovo%20rebounds%208%20per%20cent%0Ahttps%3A//clb.org.hk/en/business/Hong-Kong-stocks-rise-on-tech-gains-Lenovo-rebounds-8-per-ce-7c5a07 "Email")

Hong Kong shares ended higher on Friday, lifted by technology stocks, with the benchmark Hang Seng Index rising 124 points, or 0.52 per cent, to 24,186 points. Full-day market turnover reached HK$178.2 billion, according to exchange data.

The Hang Seng Tech Index advanced 1.16 per cent to 4,108 points. Lenovo rebounded 8 per cent at the close after slumping 14 per cent a day earlier, making it the best performer among blue-chip stocks.

Property developers also gained, with Longfor (0960) climbing 6.2 per cent and China Resources Land (1109) rising 3.3 per cent. Among tech heavyweights, Alibaba (9988) added 2.3 per cent, while Tencent (0700) closed flat.

Kuaishou (1024) once jumped over 6 per cent before closing 2.5 per cent higher, as the company released its latest video generation model, Kling 4.0.

On the mainland, the Shanghai Stock Exchange Composite Index rose 0.95 per cent to 3,742 points, and the Shenzhen Stock Exchange Component Index increased 1.19 per cent to 11,957 points.

title: Madlanga Commission witness nabbed at OR Tambo airport
summary: A suspect was arrested at OR Tambo International Airport as he was about to leave the country, and his travel plans now include heading to a court to face charges for failing to appear at the Madlanga Commission of Inquiry. The police have
content:
A suspect was arrested at OR Tambo International Airport as he was about to leave the country, and his travel plans now include heading to a court to face charges for failing to appear at the Madlanga Commission of Inquiry.

The police have not yet named the suspect, and this detail will be added to this developing story once he has been in court.

He was expected to appear in the Pretoria Magistrate’s Court on Friday, 16 October 2026.

### ‘International flight’

According to a South African Police Service (SAPS) statement, the suspect, 49, was taken into custody late on Thursday, “moments before he was due to board an international flight”.

The SAPS statement read: “The suspect was arrested for failing to appear before the Madlanga Commission of Inquiry.”

He was detained by the Commissions Recommendations Task Team, which is following up on and probing matters arising from the Madlanga Commission, which is investigating accusations that a cartel has infiltrated the state.

While the police have not named the suspect, there have been several issues with witnesses not appearing before the commission.

### Carrim’s Cape Town visit

About two months ago, in August, it emerged that the Madlanga Commission would lodge criminal complaints against North West ANC member and businessman Suliman Carrim after he repeatedly failed to appear before it.

Carrim’s legal team had put forward medical reasons why he could not testify. But Carrim refused an independent medical assessment, which sparked questions around his condition.

Before that, it emerged that Carrim had been at a shop and an eatery in Cape Town – even though a doctor had deemed him medically unfit to testify before the commission.

Carrim had also wanted an application to postpone his testimony at the commission heard in camera – in other words, to be heard in private.

Businessman Suliman Carrim testifies at the Madlanga Commission of Inquiry on 10 March 2026. (Photo: Gallo Images / Frennie Shivambu)

Earlier this year, when Carrim initially failed to obtain a ruling that his testimony be heard in camera, he was questioned about his ties to various individuals.

He admitted to having dealings with organised crime accused Vusimuzi “Cat” Matlala, who faces accusations that he colluded with corrupt police officers and is a member of a drug cartel known as the Big Five. (This is the cartel that is alleged to have infiltrated the state.)

### Khan and the criminal charges

Another Madlanga Commission witness who has failed to appear before it is former Crime Intelligence officer Feroz Khan.

He was initially meant to have testified before the commission at the start of July, but just days before he was wounded in a shooting in Houghton, Johannesburg.

Khan’s lawyer had also said that his medical condition had prevented him from appearing on a few occasions.

Former Crime Intelligence officer Feroz Khan appears in the Kempton Park Magistrate’s Court on 11 May 2026. (Photo: Gallo Images / OJ Koloti)

Last month, after Khan again did not appear despite a subpoena, the commission announced it would lodge criminal complaints against him.

He was again expected to testify privately earlier this month, but on the eve of that, [his uncle, Preggy Padayachee, was murdered](https://www.dailymaverick.co.za/article/2026-10-06-feroz-khans-commission-testimony-postponed-after-uncle-murdered/) in a shooting in Gauteng.

Padayachee’s murder meant Khan’s testimony did not go ahead as planned. **DM**

_This is a developing story. Daily Maverick has a team at the court and will update this story as details become available._

title: Hong Kong gazettes bill to expand tax deductions for IP spending
zh_title: 香港宪报法案扩大知识产权支出税收减免
summary: 香港政府已在宪报刊登一项法案，扩大知识产权费用的税收减免，涵盖从关联公司购买、海外许可和预付特许权使用费。政府表示，此举将降低知识产权交易成本，支持该市成为区域知识产权贸易中心的目标。 [![图片 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编 2026 年 10 月 16 日香港时间 11:30 · 2 分钟阅读《香港报》政府刊宪税收（修正案）（电子产品税收减免）
content:
政府
香港已在宪报刊登一项法案，扩大知识产权费用的税收减免，涵盖从关联公司购买、海外许可和预付特许权使用费。政府表示，此举将降低知识产权交易成本，支持该市成为区域知识产权贸易中心的目标。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

香港时间 2026 年 10 月 16 日 11:30 · 阅读时间 2 分钟

香港政府周五刊宪《2026年税务（修订）（知识产权开支税务扣除）条例草案》，落实2025-26及2026-27年度财政预算案公布的措施，进一步完善香港知识产权税制，降低知识产权交易成本。

商务及经济发展局发言人表示，该法案旨在“优化本地知识产权的扣税安排”和“降低知识产权交易成本”，从而促进更多知识产权交易活动，支持香港知识密集型产业的发展。
该法案建议放宽知识产权的税务扣除规则，允许企业就三类资本支出申请扣除：从集团附属公司等联营公司购买合资格的知识产权，以鼓励跨国公司在香港集中管理知识产权；购买合格的知识产权供香港以外的被许可人使用，前提是特许权使用费收入被视为产生于香港并须缴纳利得税；以及根据使用合格知识产权的许可安排支付的预付特许权使用费。

该修正案将适用于 2026 年 4 月 1 日或之后签订的购买合格知识产权或使用权的合同。

为保护香港的税基并防止滥用扣除安排，该法案包括一系列保障措施。其中包括从关联人购买知识产权的主要目的测试、从在香港经营业务的关联人购买知识产权时的可扣除金额的计算方法，以及当从香港境外关联人购买的合资格知识产权或从关联人获得的许可的资本支出超过指定阈值时，要求提供独立的第三方评估报告以支持扣除申请。
发言人补充，政府一直积极推动香港知识产权贸易及融资的发展。继“专利盒”优惠税率实施后，该法案将进一步完善香港的知识产权税收生态系统，吸引更多本地和海外企业利用香港作为跨境技术转移和知识产权融资的平台，符合香港在“十五五”规划中成为国际创新科技中心和区域知识产权交易中心的目标。

该法案将于10月28日提交立法会一读和二读。

[![图片3：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

主编

负责 CLB.org.hk 报道和编辑标准的主编。

【原文 English Original】
Government
Hong Kong has gazetted a bill to broaden tax deductions for intellectual property expenses, covering purchases from affiliated firms, overseas licensing and prepaid royalties. The government says the move will cut IP trading costs and support the city's goal of becoming a regional IP trade hub.

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

16 Oct 2026 at 11:30 HKT · 2 min read

The Hong Kong government gazetted the Tax (Amendment) (Tax Deduction for Expenditure on Intellectual Property) Bill 2026 on Friday, implementing measures announced in the 2025-26 and 2026-27 budgets to further improve the city's tax regime for intellectual property (IP) and reduce the cost of IP transactions.

A spokesman for the Commerce and Economic Development Bureau said the bill aims to "optimise the tax deduction arrangements for local intellectual property" and "reduce the cost of intellectual property transactions", thereby promoting more IP trading activities and supporting the development of knowledge-intensive industries in Hong Kong.

The bill proposes to relax tax deduction rules for IP, allowing enterprises to claim deductions for capital expenditure incurred on three categories: purchasing qualifying IP from associated companies, such as group affiliates, to encourage multinational corporations to centralise IP management in Hong Kong; buying qualifying IP for use by licensees outside Hong Kong, provided the royalty income is deemed to arise in Hong Kong and is subject to profits tax; and prepaid royalties paid under licensing arrangements for the use of qualifying IP.

The amendments will apply to contracts entered into on or after April 1, 2026, for the purchase of qualifying IP or the right to use it.

To protect Hong Kong's tax base and prevent abuse of the deduction arrangements, the bill includes a series of safeguard measures. These include a principal purpose test for purchases of IP from associated persons, a calculation method for the deductible amount when buying IP from associated persons carrying on business in Hong Kong, and a requirement for independent third-party valuation reports to support deduction claims when capital expenditure on qualifying IP bought from associated persons outside Hong Kong, or on licences obtained from associated persons, exceeds specified thresholds.

The spokesman added that the government has been actively promoting the development of IP trading and financing in Hong Kong. Following the implementation of the "patent box" preferential tax rate, the bill will further improve Hong Kong's IP tax ecosystem, attracting more local and overseas enterprises to use Hong Kong as a platform for cross-border technology transfer and IP financing, in line with the city's goal under the 15th Five-Year Plan to become an international innovation and technology centre and a regional IP trading hub.

The bill will be introduced into the Legislative Council for first and second reading on October 28.

[![Image 3: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

title: Cosatu calls for government ban of Shein and Temu to protect local jobs
summary: The Congress of South African Trade Unions (Cosatu) backed a motion put forward by the Southern African Clothing and Textile Workers’ Union (Sactwu) for the government to ban international e-commerce platforms Shein and Temu, citing a 2025
content:
The Congress of South African Trade Unions (Cosatu) backed a motion put forward by the Southern African Clothing and Textile Workers’ Union (Sactwu) for the government to ban international e-commerce platforms Shein and Temu, citing a 2025 study which estimated that the platforms could jeopardise up to 34,000 local jobs by 2030.

Sactwu made a presentation on day three of Cosatu’s 15th National Conference, held on Wednesday, 15 October, at Emperor’s Palace in Johannesburg, where members displayed placards showing illustrations of handbags, carpets and other textiles on the front with the numbers of local jobs under threat in each industry on the back.

The placards showed estimated job losses based on current employment numbers in existing factories, ranging from seven to 304 across textile, clothing, leather, and cosmetics industries, amounting to a total of 34,000.

“Comrades, Shein and Temu now sell more products than other global retailers in South Africa,” said Sactwu president Susan Khumalo.

“It is causing job losses, it is also pushing down wages, pushing our benefits and our working conditions, as the clothing and textile workers union and the other workers [competing] with the cheap imports. If nothing is done, comrades, to change this, our city and our families will lose 34,000 jobs by 2030 as clothing and textile [industries], including the retailers,” she said.

### ‘They’re selling cheaper and faster’

South African Clothing and Textile Workers’ Union members display placards on 14 October, 2026, showing the potential number of jobs lost by 2030 in the clothing, textile, and manufacturing industries due to the proliferation of international e-commerce platforms. The Cosatu 15th National Congress is being held at Emperor’s Palace, Johannesburg. (Photo: Naledi Mashishi)

Shein, a Chinese-founded and Singaporean-headquartered e-commerce platform, first entered the South African market in 2020 and became the [most downloaded shopping app](https://personal.nedbank.co.za/learn/blog/shein-temu-taxes-south-africa.html) by 2023. Chinese-owned Temu entered the market in 2024. Both companies were able to take advantage of low overheads due to a lack of brick-and-mortar stores, aggressive marketing, high shipment volumes and tax loopholes to undercut local retailers.

In the second quarter of 2024, the Bureau for Economic Research found that confidence among semi-durable goods retailers of products such as textiles, clothing, footwear and leather goods fell to 38% from 68% in the first quarter, [adding](https://www.ber.ac.za/Documents/ViewMode/1212272a-f33b-4dee-b74f-6e7a2660f6d3) that retailers such as Shein “may also strain domestic clothing retailers”.

By the end of 2024, the companies [captured R7.3-billion](https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/shein-temu-outpace-global-retail-giants-south-africas-fashion-market-2025-08-05/) in sales, amounting to 37.1% of South Africa’s retail, clothing, textile, footwear and leather e-commerce market.

Previously, clothing retailer Shein made a somewhat slower, but still impressive, splash using a concept of retail and marketplace sales from China.

“These companies have taken off in South Africa. They are selling cheaper and faster than anyone else. But it is putting enormous pressure on workers and our local manufacturers, including retailers and workers in the public sector as well. It’s only four years of Shein and other online shopping, but it took a huge chunk of our clothing, textile, footwear and leather, including the retail market,” said Khumalo in her presentation.

Cosatu resolved to back the call and urged all other members to delete their Shein and Temu apps and commit to only sourcing goods from local retailers, in solidarity.

### Shein’s growth slowed to 11%

Members of the South African Clothing and Textile Workers Union hold up placards showing the number of jobs that could be lost by 2030 in the clothing, textile and manufacturing industries. (Photo: Naledi Mashishi)

However, Shein and Temu are already undergoing significant sales downturns. This is because in 2025, the South African Revenue Service (SARS) cracked down by removing tax exemptions on imported goods priced below R500. Shein, which previously grew between 30% to 50% annually, slowed to just 11% in 2025, while Temu recorded average monthly declines of 42% in the same period.

Independent economic strategist and board adviser Refilwe Moloto told Daily Maverick that the 34,000 figure might be outdated, given that it was calculated before the SARS tax amendments were in place. She warned an outright ban on the apps could be an uncompetitive approach that could have negative trade-offs.

> “Protectionist measures of that nature are likely to encourage, below the table, irregular and non-regulated trading. And what you really do want is for the taxpayer to be able to collect accordingly for value-added products and you’d also want to not have nefarious dealings across the border.”

She said South Africa was not unique in its predicament. Shein and Temu have had a larger impact on the US, French, and Latin American markets. In the US, Shein ranks as the third-largest online retailer.

In addition, the local textile industry has struggled to remain competitive due to local conditions such as high energy prices, the collapse of rail transportation and administrative costs.

“Those are structural issues that will impact the retailers themselves and the margins that they’re able to claim. It is not Shein’s fault that they operate in a country that makes their inputs cheaper, and that’s something that the government may need to address,” she said. **DM**

title: Hong Kong to mandate price transparency for private healthcare providers
zh_title: 香港强制要求私营医疗服务提供者价格透明
summary: 香港政府计划要求所有持牌私营医疗服务提供者公布双语价目表，针对私营医院的措施最早将于 2027 年 8 月生效。违规者将面临医院最高 10 万港元的罚款，诊所最高 25,000 港元的罚款。 [![图片 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编 2026 年 10 月 15 日 21:33 HKT · 2 分钟阅读香港计划通过附属立法强制私营医疗保健提供者的价格透明度，
content:
政府
香港计划要求所有持牌私营医疗服务提供者公布双语价目表，私营医院的措施最早将于 2027 年 8 月生效。违规者将面临医院最高 10 万港元的罚款，诊所最高 25,000 港元的罚款。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

2026 年 10 月 15 日 21:33 香港时间 · 阅读 2 分钟

政府于 2026 年 10 月 15 日宣布，香港计划通过附属立法强制私营医疗保健提供者实行价格透明度，首批针对私营医院的措施预计最早将于 2027 年 8 月生效。

卫生局向立法会提交文件，概述规定所有持牌私营医疗机构必须按规定格式提供双语价目表。清单必须按类别列出收费，包括病房、手术室或手术室、药物及消耗品，并以固定金额或范围表示价格，例如“每次300港元”或“300港元至500港元”。

该报称，如果费用取决于患者个人情况，机构必须在价目表中注明将在提供服务之前提供费用，并向患者提供印刷或电子形式的信息。
私人医疗保健提供者必须在工作时间内在所有接待和付款柜台、入院柜台和护士站展示打印或电子形式的价目表。私立医院也必须在其网站上公布名单。对价目表的任何修改必须在生效前至少 7 天宣布，并向卫生部报告。

该规定还要求所有持牌私立医院提供接受指定治疗和手术的患者的费用估算。对于以固定金额估价的情况，如果最终费用超出估价20%或以上，医院必须提供书面解释。

根据该局的文件，违反规定的私立医院可能会被处以最高 10 万港元的罚款，而日间医疗中心和诊所则可能会被处以最高 25,000 港元的罚款。

政府计划于2026年底前向立法会提交规例，并制定实务守则，并于2027年下半年开始分阶段实施。

[![图片3：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

主编

【原文 English Original】
Government
Hong Kong plans to require all licensed private healthcare providers to publish bilingual price lists, with measures for private hospitals taking effect as early as August 2027. Violators face fines of up to HK$100,000 for hospitals and HK$25,000 for clinics.

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

15 Oct 2026 at 21:33 HKT · 2 min read

Hong Kong plans to mandate price transparency for private healthcare providers through subsidiary legislation, with the first measures targeting private hospitals expected to take effect as early as August 2027, the government announced on 15 October 2026.

The Health Bureau submitted a paper to the Legislative Council outlining regulations requiring all licensed private healthcare institutions to provide bilingual price lists in a prescribed format. The lists must itemise charges by categories including wards, operating theatres or procedure rooms, drugs and consumables, with prices expressed as fixed amounts or ranges such as "HK$300 per time" or "HK$300 to HK$500".

If fees depend on individual patient circumstances, institutions must indicate in the price list that the charges will be provided before the service is delivered, and supply the information in print or electronic form to patients, the paper said.

Private healthcare providers must display price lists in print or electronic form at all reception and payment counters, admission desks and nurse stations during business hours. Private hospitals must also publish the lists on their websites. Any amendments to price lists must be announced at least seven days before taking effect and reported to the Department of Health.

The regulations will also require all licensed private hospitals to provide fee estimates for patients receiving designated treatments and procedures. For cases where the estimate is given as a fixed amount, hospitals must provide a written explanation if the final charge exceeds the estimate by 20 per cent or more.

Violations of the requirements could result in fines of up to HK$100,000 for private hospitals and HK$25,000 for day medical centres and clinics, according to the bureau's paper.

The government plans to submit the regulations to LegCo by the end of 2026 and draw up a code of practice, with measures to be implemented in phases starting in the second half of 2027.

# Taipei mayoral candidates Chiang, Shen to debate Oct. 31

10/15/2026 08:56 PM

Taipei Mayor Chiang Wan-an (right) and Democratic Progressive Party lawmaker Puma Shen. CNA file photo

Taipei, Oct. 15 (CNA) Taipei Mayor Chiang Wan-an (蔣萬安) of the Kuomintang (KMT) and his challenger, Democratic Progressive Party (DPP) lawmaker Puma Shen (沈伯洋), agreed Thursday to hold their first televised debate on Oct. 31.

The debate will be held from 12 p.m. to 2 p.m. that day at the TVBS studio, TVBS and SET News, the event's co-hosts, said in a joint statement following a meeting attended by representatives of both campaigns.

The debate format will include opening statements, cross-examination between the candidates, questions from the media and closing statements, the hosts said.

Wu Szu-yao (吳思瑤), a DPP lawmaker and campaign manager for Shen, said the two sides had differing views on the date and time, although Shen's campaign remains flexible.

Wu said her side had also proposed holding more debates, but Chiang's campaign did not respond favorably to the proposal.

KMT Legislator Lo Chih-chiang (羅智強), representing Chiang, said Chiang's campaign is open to holding more debates and has accepted invitations from other media outlets.

The debate date coincides with this year's Taipei Pride march, which is scheduled to begin at 2:05 p.m. at Taipei City Hall Square and pass through the commercial area in Taipei's eastern district, following a rally starting at noon.

Wu said Shen will take part in the march, while Lo said Chiang will also join the event, as both have done in previous years.

(By Yeh Chen-yun and Shih Hsiu-chuan)

title: Taiwan president urges Micron, unions to negotiate 'sincerely' ahead of possible strike
zh_title: 台湾总统敦促美光科技与工会在可能的罢工之前“真诚地”进行谈判
summary: 台湾商界总裁赖清德呼吁美光科技及其台湾员工就可能导致罢工的奖金纠纷进行真诚谈判。他在美光新工厂发表讲话时敦促建立和谐的劳资关系，而美光表示 2027 年产能已售罄。 [![图片 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编 2026 年 10 月 15 日 13:44 HKT · 2 分钟阅读台湾总统赖清德周四呼吁美国内存芯片制造商美光科技
content:
商务
台湾总统赖清德呼吁美光科技及其台湾工人就可能导致罢工的奖金纠纷进行真诚谈判。他在美光新工厂发表讲话时敦促建立和谐的劳资关系，而美光表示 2027 年产能已售罄。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

香港时间 2026 年 10 月 15 日 13:44 · 阅读时间 2 分钟

台湾总统赖清德周四呼吁美国存储芯片制造商美光科技及其工人在该公司台湾工会可能举行罢工之前“真诚地”进行谈判。

上周，代表美光科技工人的台湾工会表示，已获得其成员的授权，可以就该公司奖金计划的争议进行罢工，导致该芯片制造商最大制造中心的劳资冲突升级。美光科技在台湾拥有约 15,000 名员工，并表示其在台湾的投资超过 1.6 万亿新台币（494 亿美元）。
黎智英在台中一家新的美光先进组装和测试工厂的开业典礼上发表讲话时表示，他希望政府和私营部门能够共同努力，促进劳资之间加强沟通。我们也希望劳资双方秉持鱼需要水、水需要鱼的精神，继续真诚协商，凝聚最广泛共识。” “只有营造和谐劳动关系，才能双方共赢，让员工安心工作，让企业走得稳、走得更远。”

赖表示，他赞赏美光科技对台湾的承诺，并希望美光科技继续扩大在台湾的投资，并补充说美光科技已获得政府对高带宽内存（HBM）研发的支持。台湾是美光 DRAM 和 HBM 芯片的重要生产中心，这些芯片用于人工智能服务器。

美光科技总裁兼首席运营官曼尼什·巴蒂亚 (Manish Bhatia) 在赖智发表讲话前不久发表的评论中没有提及可能采取的罢工行动。他表示：“我们已经售出了该工厂将在 2027 年建造的所有产能，我们预计到 2028 年，高带宽内存的增长速度将比 DRAM 行业的其他产品增长得更快。”
美光台中工会告诉路透社，期待该公司与他们进行“更实质性的对话和谈判”。美光及其位于桃园的其他工会都没有立即回应对赖的言论发表评论的请求。

上周，代表美光桃园和台中工厂员工的两个工会表示，希望公司能够为员工提出具体的利润分享提案。与桃园工会的调解于9月未能达成协议，而台中工会仍在谈判中。工会鼓励会员在 10 月 19 日休息一天，参加在台北举行的集会，他们表示这不会是罢工。

[![图片3：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

【原文 English Original】
Business
Taiwanese President Lai Ching-te called on Micron Technology and its Taiwan workers to negotiate sincerely over a bonus dispute that could lead to a strike. Speaking at a new Micron facility, he urged harmonious labour relations, while Micron said 2027 capacity is already sold out.

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

15 Oct 2026 at 13:44 HKT · 2 min read

Taiwanese President Lai Ching-te called on Thursday for US memory chipmaker Micron Technology and its workers to negotiate "sincerely" ahead of a possible strike by the company's union in Taiwan.

Last week, a Taiwanese union representing workers at Micron said it had secured authorisation from its members to strike over a dispute concerning the company's bonus scheme, escalating a labour conflict at the chipmaker's largest manufacturing hub. Micron employs about 15,000 people in Taiwan and has said it invested more than T$1.6 trillion ($49.4 billion) on the island.

Speaking in Taichung at the opening of a new Micron advanced assembly and testing facility, Lai said he hoped the government and private sector could work together to promote stronger communication between labour and management. "We also hope both labour and management will uphold the spirit that fish need water and water needs fish, continuing to negotiate sincerely and in good faith to build the broadest possible consensus," he added. "Only by creating harmonious labour relations can both sides win, allowing employees to work with peace of mind and businesses to move steadily and go further."

Lai said he appreciated Micron's commitment to Taiwan and hoped it would continue expanding investment on the island, adding that Micron had secured government support for high-bandwidth memory (HBM) research and development. Taiwan is a crucial production hub for Micron's DRAM and HBM chips, which are used in AI servers.

Manish Bhatia, Micron's president and chief operating officer, made no mention of a possible strike action in his comments delivered shortly before Lai's. "We have already sold out all the capacity for 2027 that this factory will build and we expect high-bandwidth memory to grow faster than the rest of the DRAM industry all the way through 2028," he said.

Micron's Taichung union told Reuters that it looked forward to the company engaging in "more substantive dialogue and negotiations" with them. Neither Micron nor its other union, in Taoyuan, immediately responded to requests for comment on Lai's remarks.

Last week, the two unions representing workers at Micron's Taoyuan and Taichung operations said they hoped the company would put forward a concrete profit-sharing proposal for employees. Mediation with the Taoyuan union ended without agreement in September, while the Taichung union remains in negotiations. The unions are encouraging members to take a day off on October 19 to join a rally in Taipei, which they said would not be a strike.

3小时前

萨琳·哈贝希安

](https://ichef.bbci.co.uk/news/480/cpsprodpb/7c7f/live/f7333c90-c838-11f1-b2e8-93da8301514e.jpg.webp)盖蒂图片社

白宫正在为其新任新闻秘书凯蒂·扎卡里亚辩护，因为她面临着对其法律资历的审查。

唐纳德·特朗普总统上周宣布任命扎卡里亚为律师时，她将自己描述为律师。

但周二，当一名记者问她在哪个州通过了成为美国律师所需的律师考试时，她站在总统身边说：“当我搬到中国时。”

她似乎没有在她居住过的任何州的律师协会注册。白宫通讯主管史蒂文·张 (Steven Cheung) 表示，扎卡里亚“具有独特的资格和聪明才智，可以帮助向美国人民通报情况”。

在回答有关她的资质的问题时，扎卡里亚在本周的一份声明中表示：“我从事国际交易法工作，拥有所有适当的资质。”

周三，监督组织“问责运动”向加州律师协会提出投诉。

他们正在寻求调查扎卡里亚是否“一再向公众声称自己有权在没有执照的情况下执业，加州法律将这种行为视为犯罪”。

加州佩珀代因大学证实，这位 42 岁的政治战略家 2011 年毕业于该大学法学院。
法律学位并不是在美国执业的许可证。

这位新任白宫新闻秘书周三告诉《纽约时报》，当她第一次开始出现在有线电视新闻中时，她曾问佩珀代因应该如何表明自己的身份。

她说，大学校长建议她可以称自己为律师，但不能称自己为律师。

据《华尔街日报》报道，扎卡里亚从法学院毕业后在加州参加了律师资格考试，但没有通过。加州的律师考试被广泛认为是美国最难通过的律师考试之一。

一位直接了解此事的人士告诉媒体，扎卡里亚参加考试的时间大约是在她计划婚礼并准备与未婚夫搬到中国的同时。

由于丈夫在一家美国私募股权公司工作，她搬到了北京。扎卡里亚表示，她在那里研究“国际交易法”。

她的 LinkedIn 个人资料显示，她于 2011-13 年间在北京中伦律师事务所担任律师。

在中国，只有中国公民才有资格获得律师执业资格。外籍雇员可以在律师事务所担任其他职务。

去年2月，扎卡里亚在保守派广播节目《克莱·特拉维斯和巴克·塞克斯顿秀》中表示，她在中国期间曾担任国际金融公司（IFC）和世界银行的外部顾问。

BBC 已联系世界银行和国际金融公司征求意见。
据了解，世界银行集团有时会聘请外部律师事务所，由这些律师事务所决定将哪些律师分配到任何工作的哪些部分。

根据扎卡里亚的 LinkedIn 个人资料，她还担任 Fix California 的总法律顾问，这是一个由特朗普盟友里克·格雷内尔 (Ric Grenell) 创办的保守派非营利组织。

](https://ichef.bbci.co.uk/news/480/cpsprodpb/7c7f/live/f7333c90-c838-11f1-b2e8-93da8301514e.jpg.webp)Getty Images

The White House is defending its new press secretary, Katie Zacharia, as she faces scrutiny over her legal credentials.

President Donald Trump described Zacharia as an attorney when announcing her appointment last week and she has referred to herself as a lawyer.

But when she was asked on Tuesday by a reporter in which state she had passed the bar exam required to be an attorney in the US, she said standing alongside the president: "When I moved to China."

She does not appear to be registered to the bar in any state where she has lived. White House communications director Steven Cheung said Zacharia is "uniquely qualified and whip smart to help inform the American people".

Responding to questions about her credentials, Zacharia said in a statement this week: "I practised international transaction law, with all the appropriate credentials."

On Wednesday, a watchdog group, Campaign for Accountability, filed a complaint with the California State Bar Association.

They are seeking an investigation into whether Zacharia "repeatedly held herself out to the public as entitled to practise law without a licence to do so, conduct California law treats as a crime".

The 42-year-old political strategist graduated from law school at Pepperdine University in California in 2011, the university confirmed.

A law degree is not a licence to practise law in the US.

The new White House press secretary told the New York Times on Wednesday that when she first began appearing on cable news, she had asked Pepperdine how she should identify herself.

She said she was advised by the university president that she could call herself a lawyer, but not an attorney.

Zacharia took the bar exam in California after graduating from law school but did not pass, according to the Wall Street Journal. California's bar exam is widely regarded as one of the hardest in the US to pass.

A person with direct knowledge of the matter told the outlet that Zacharia took the exam around the same time that she was planning a wedding and preparing to move to China with her husband-to-be.

She moved to Beijing because of her husband's job at an American private equity firm. Zacharia has said she worked on "international transaction law" there.

Her LinkedIn profile states that she worked as an associate at Zhong Lun Law Firm in Beijing from 2011-13.

In China, only Chinese citizens are eligible to obtain a licence to practise law. Foreign employees may work at law firms in other roles.

In February last year, Zacharia said on conservative radio programme The Clay Travis and Buck Sexton Show that she had worked as outside counsel for the International Finance Corporation (IFC) and the World Bank during her time in China.

The BBC has contacted the World Bank and IFC for comment.

It is understood the World Bank Group sometimes retains outside law firms, and that those firms decide which of their lawyers are assigned to which parts of any work.

Zacharia has also served as general counsel for Fix California, a conservative non-profit started by Trump ally Ric Grenell, according to her LinkedIn profile.

title: Ilocos Region health officials make push for improved stroke care coordination
summary: HEALTH officials and medical professionals in the Ilocos Region are seeking better coordination among hospitals and health care facilities to address delays in stroke treatment, particularly for patients in remote communities, as stroke rem
content:
HEALTH officials and medical professionals in the Ilocos Region are seeking better coordination among hospitals and health care facilities to address delays in stroke treatment, particularly for patients in remote communities, as stroke remains the region’s leading cause of death.

The issue was discussed during a multi-stakeholder roundtable organized by UHC Watch and supported by Boehringer Ingelheim, where participants examined ways to improve stroke prevention, emergency treatment, referrals and rehabilitation across Region 1.

In La Union, stroke has remained among the causes of death over the past three years, according to Dr. Ivy Ico of the Provincial Department of Health Office in La Union.

*   [Laguna mayors rally behind Aragones](https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/10/14/regions/laguna-mayors-rally-behind-aragones/2444954)

“Stroke is not only a major health problem. It also places a significant financial burden on patients, families and communities,” Ico said.

[![Image 1: FACEBOOK/UHC WATCH](https://manilatimes.net/manilatimes/uploads/images/2026/10/14/1260041.jpg)](https://manilatimes.net/manilatimes/uploads/images/2026/10/14/1260041.jpg)
FACEBOOK/UHC WATCH

By signing up with an email address, I acknowledge that I have read and agree to the [Terms of Service](https://manilatimes.net/terms-of-service "Terms of Service") and [Privacy Policy](https://manilatimes.net/privacy-policy "Privacy Policy").

She cited the need to improve referral pathways, specialist availability, public awareness and coordination among health care providers.

For patients in remote municipalities, traveling to facilities equipped to provide specialized stroke care can take two to four hours, potentially exceeding the 4.5-hour treatment window for certain interventions.

*   ![Image 2: Arroyo hails Nobel Peace Prize winner](https://miopia.newsroom.bi/statics/i/ps/manilatimes.net/manilatimes/uploads/images/2026/10/14/1259931.jpeg?width=113&crop=113:85)
[Arroyo hails Nobel Peace Prize winner](https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/10/15/news/national/arroyo-hails-nobel-peace-prize-winner/2445857)

Dr. Mary Grace Fabia-Mistica, stroke program head of the Ilocos Training and Regional Medical Center Brain and Spine Center and the La Union Medical Center, said delays in recognizing symptoms and coordinating referrals contribute to patients arriving at hospitals beyond the critical treatment window.

“Some families still mistake stroke symptoms as a temporary episode of high blood pressure or initially seek treatment at home. Every delay can affect a patient’s chances of survival and recovery,” Mistica said.

Health care professionals also cited uneven access to neurologists, rehabilitation providers and long-term follow-up services, particularly in geographically isolated communities.

To address referral delays, stakeholders are advancing StrokeLiNCS LU, or Stroke Linking Institutions for Network Care, toward a Stronger La Union. The initiative aims to connect health care facilities through a hub-and-spoke system.

*   ![Image 3: ‘Our soldiers are not troublemakers’](https://miopia.newsroom.bi/statics/i/ps/manilatimes.net/manilatimes/uploads/images/2026/10/14/1260179.jpg?width=113&crop=113:85)
[‘Our soldiers are not troublemakers’](https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/10/15/news/our-soldiers-are-not-troublemakers/2445870)

Under the proposed model, designated hospitals, including the Ilocos Training and Regional Medical Center and the La Union Medical Center, would provide specialized stroke services, while smaller facilities would focus on recognizing symptoms, stabilizing patients and arranging referrals.

The proposed system would also use standardized protocols, hospital pre-notification, workforce training, telemedicine support and a shared stroke registry to improve coordination from emergency treatment through rehabilitation.

“The model does more than move patients,” Mistica said. “It helps bring expertise closer to where patients are.” The initiative is aligned with the Department of Health’s National Policy Framework on the Prevention, Control and Management of Acute Stroke, which seeks to establish coordinated stroke care under the Universal Health Care Act.

Ico said the framework covers prevention, acute treatment, rehabilitation and long-term recovery, supported by stronger health care networks, data systems, training and financing.

*   ![Image 4: Pangilinan seeks reversal of ruling on Duterte’s dropped charges](https://miopia.newsroom.bi/statics/i/ps/manilatimes.net/manilatimes/uploads/images/2026/10/14/1258438.jpg?width=113&crop=113:85)
[Pangilinan seeks reversal of ruling on Duterte’s dropped charges](https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/10/14/news/pangilinan-seeks-reversal-of-ruling-on-dutertes-dropped-charges/2445025)

At the provincial level, the La Union government and local stakeholders are working to incorporate dedicated stroke referral pathways into the next version of the province’s health care provider network referral manual.

Plans for a Level II general hospital and a neurological rehabilitation center have also been included in the proposed La Union Medical Hub.

Alvin Manalansan, co-convenor of UHC Watch, said improving stroke care requires cooperation among government agencies, hospitals, health care professionals, civil society groups and private organizations.

Participants called for continued coordination across the full range of stroke care, from public awareness and emergency response to treatment, rehabilitation and long-term follow-up.

title: 中港澳人员赴美交流暂停，参与者或面临中国当局干预胁迫
summary: 香港 — 上个月在美国总统唐纳德·特朗普(Donald Trump)为中国国家主席习近平举行的欢迎仪式上，习近平宣布，将在未来5年邀请10万名美国青少年到中国交流学习。然而，由美国政府招募并资助中港澳人员访问美国的交流计划，却传出参与者遭到中国当局的干预骚扰，导致美方在今年七月暂停该项目。 美国招募并资助中方人员赴美短期交流已有数十年历史。多年来，美国每年会邀请数十名来自中国大陆和港澳人士前往美国，了解外交政策、反恐及人工智能等范畴。据了解，中国国务院前总理李克强、香港前特首
content:
香港 —

上个月在美国总统唐纳德·特朗普(Donald Trump)为中国国家主席习近平举行的欢迎仪式上，习近平宣布，将在未来5年邀请10万名美国青少年到中国交流学习。然而，由美国政府招募并资助中港澳人员访问美国的交流计划，却传出参与者遭到中国当局的干预骚扰，导致美方在今年七月暂停该项目。

美国招募并资助中方人员赴美短期交流已有数十年历史。多年来，美国每年会邀请数十名来自中国大陆和港澳人士前往美国，了解外交政策、反恐及人工智能等范畴。据了解，中国国务院前总理李克强、香港前特首林郑月娥，及现任保安局局长邓炳强都曾经参与有关计划。

**香港前议员：美方根据参加者意愿安排交流**

现居美国的香港前立法会议员单仲偕于1998年首次参与由美国国务院资助的同类计划。他在接受美国之音专访时表示，美方把政治上有发展潜质的人士视为邀请对象，并根据他们的兴趣和意愿，安排整个行程。

单仲偕说：“据了解，美方希望让一些政坛新星多了解国际社会。1998年的时候，我属于政党中人，属于非政府人员。还记得当时是有关单位直接联系我的。那次我在美国至少逗留了三周，到过华盛顿、芝加哥、纽约等五、六个城市。必须强调的是，整个行程看些什么，要去哪些城市，都是参加者主导的。有关单位会根据参加者感兴趣的范畴、主题，作出行程建议。整个过程充满互动。”

虽然时隔接近三十年，单仲偕对当时为期一个月的访美交流仍然记忆犹新。

单仲偕说：“当年美国在通讯、媒体等领域一枝独秀、百花齐放。尤其留下深刻印象的是我参观了科技通讯巨头摩托罗拉，了解到美国作为科技先导者如何进行领导、监管，可谓大开眼界。这对于我往后在香港涉入相关范畴，有很大帮助。”

不过，日本《共同社》10月9日[报道](https://english.kyodonews.net/articles/-/87716)，相关的专业交流计划，包括“国际访问者领导力计划”(International Visitor Leadership Program)及“专业人才交流项目”(Professional Fellows Program)在7月底已暂停。据《共同社》掌握的一份备忘录提及，美国外交机构认为，中国当局对华府资助训练和交流的参与者施加“过度干预”，部分人在胁迫下退出，也有人遭到“骚扰、威胁，甚至被逮捕”。

美国之音就有关计划暂停向国务院发出问询请求，但至发稿前，并未收到回应。

**陈道银：中方或对参加者软硬兼施**

对于中国当局是否向有意到美国交流的人员施压，旅居智利的中国独立政治学者陈道银对美国之音表示，若真有其事，估计中方采取的手段是软硬兼施。

陈道银说：“单位只要说，‘可能不太妥当吧’，一句话就够了。参加者就知难而退了。这就是软的。如果你真的是顶得硬上的话，那就会停职，甚至现实中所有物质上的利益都没了。”

陈道银表示，中共十八大以来一再强调意识形态安全，科研院所的意识形态由一把手总负责。没有哪个一把手，就是书记，敢冒意识形态的风险。

“中国对于美国的学术交流是有加强管理的。而从美方的角度考虑，参加活动的中方人员，可能也达不到美方所需要的效果。比方说，他可能考虑到一些禁忌，一些敏感话题，就可能不再说真话了。美方也要考虑到这些人回去之后，可能受到政治压力。从这些因素考虑下来，美方暂停这个项目是不得已而为之。”陈道银说。

一名参与“专业人才交流项目”的香港人员向《共同社》透露，他在今年4月至5月到美国东岸一所大学的研究中心停留六周，其后发现自己是该计划最后一批中国参加者。

**单仲偕：国安法后，赴美交流或成“勾结外国势力”**

香港前立法会议员单仲偕估计，中国希望着眼于科技上的交流，但不愿意中方人员受到美国意识形态的影响。

单仲偕说：“中国官员当然想看(先进)科技，但这方面美方也许会有保留。但谈到意识形态、民主制度、司法独立这些，中方自然不会相信美国的一套。撇除政治和科技交流，文化领域这些中方也不热衷。在习近平治下，近年中方开始限制官员外访、外游、资产转移等。”

单仲偕说，香港主权归还中国后的最初10多年，与美国的这类交流仍然畅顺，除了民主派，亲北京政党人士也曾获邀到访美国。但自从《港版国安法》生效，过去四、五年，参与美国当局的交流活动已成为禁忌。

单仲偕说：“个别立法会议员到美国和国会议员交流，被指勾结外国势力。《国安法》生效后，在‘隐性红线’下，参与交流的人数大幅下降。而由于香港的反对派已消失，这类交流已谈不上为当地培育政坛新星。”

美国总统特朗普今年五月访问北京，并与习近平达成共识，同意建立“建设性的战略稳定关系”。上月回访美国期间，习近平在白宫的欢迎仪式上公开表示，中方未来五年将邀请10万名美国青少年到中国交流学习。

**美中互信低，人员交流难**

政治学者陈道银认为，外界不宜把中国积极邀请美国年轻人到中国观摩视为两国关系改善的指标。他说，在激烈竞争下美中将如何共存才是重点。

陈道银说：“美国是在7月份中止两个交流项目。习近平是在9月(宣布邀请美国年轻人到中国交流)。这两者当中有个时间差。美国终止了交流项目，但是中国开放对美国年轻人接触中国的渠道。美中之间的战略战争实际上还是很激烈的。从此事就可以看出，美中之间的竞争已从物理层面、科技层面，进展到知识交流层面了，也反映出两国之间的竞争在加剧。”

新加坡国立大学政治系副教授庄嘉颖对美国之音表示，美中两国仍有不少议题有待解决，包括彼此的科技限制，中国对美投资的限制等。在这种氛围下，两国元首的合作意愿能否落实，仍有待观察。

庄嘉颖说：“虽然习近平有提出，希望有更多美国年轻人去中国交流，可是在实际操作方面可能与习的话有些出入。虽然美中双方领导人之间希望表示一定的默契，不过在结构上，美中双方彼此的互信很低，互相质疑很高。(两国)领导人建立的形象是一回事，而两边实际的运作是另外一回事。”

# Hong Kong customs seizes over 7,000 suspected counterfeit goods worth HK$7.6 million

Hong Kong customs has smashed 16 cases of cross-border transshipment of counterfeit watches and other goods, seizing over 7,000 items worth more than HK$7.6 million. A 65-year-old man was arrested and is out on bail pending investigation.

[![Image 4: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

 By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

Hong Kong customs has seized more than 7,000 suspected counterfeit goods, including watches, apparel and mobile phones, with an estimated market value of over HK$7.6 million, following a two-week operation targeting the cross-border transshipment of fake watch-type items.

The operation, which ran over the past fortnight, resulted in the detection of 16 related cases, customs said on Wednesday. A 65-year-old man was arrested during the crackdown and is currently out on bail pending further investigation.

Through intelligence analysis and in-depth inquiries, customs officers uncovered the cases at several local logistics companies and express parcel centres. The department believes all of the seized suspected counterfeit goods were destined for transshipment to overseas regions.

In one instance, customs officers conducted a controlled delivery operation involving a batch of seized items. Last Wednesday, they arrested one person at an industrial unit in Kwai Chung and seized about 600 suspected counterfeit items, including watches and mobile phones, with an estimated market value of about HK$400,000.

The latest enforcement action is part of customs' ongoing efforts to combat the illegal trade in counterfeit goods passing through Hong Kong's logistics network.

**MANILA, Philippines** — Defense Secretary Gilbert Teodoro Jr. said Wednesday that t he communication lines between the Philippine and Chinese military remained suspended, alleging that Beijing has “abused” the channel where they funnel their twisted narratives to satisfy their greed.

Teodoro issued the statement after the Chinese Embassy in Manila accused Teodoro of shutting down military communication between the two countries for political self interests, warning that such move “pushes frontline personnel closer to confrontation.”

“That is inaccurate,” Teodoro said, clarifying that the decision to suspend military-to-military (mil-to-mil) communications was not a new policy and had been in place for about three years.

Speaking in Filipino and English, Teodoro said that direct communications between the Department of National Defense (DND) and its attached agencies and the Chinese defense establishment has been suspended "because our security has been compromised, the Chinese have abused every channel that has been opened to them, they have been twisting narratives and there is no basis to open communication."

Teodoro clarified that communications with Beijing were under the Department of Foreign Affairs and not with the Department of National Defense.

zh_title: 食环署推出第二阶段天网行动，瞄准公众街市
summary: 香港食物环境卫生署继第一阶段针对超市和餐馆的“天网行动”结束后，启动了第二阶段的“天网行动”，为期两周，打击公共市场的害虫和卫生问题。第一阶段进行了 1,930 次检查，120 名工作人员 [![图 1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编 10 月 14 日2026 香港时间 20:00 · 2 分钟阅读食物环境卫生署（食环署）周二公布
content:
香港
香港食物环境卫生署继针对超市和餐馆的第一阶段“天网行动”结束后，启动了第二阶段的“天网行动”，为期两周，打击公众街市的害虫和卫生问题。第一阶段共进行了 1,930 次检查、120 名工作人员

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

2026 年 10 月 14 日 20:00 香港时间 · 阅读 2 分钟

食物环境卫生署（食环署）周二宣布，继第一阶段以超级市场、食肆及其他食物业处所为重点的「天网行动」结束后，立即展开为期两周的特别巡查及执法行动，针对各区公众街市。

第一阶段从9月30日开始，共涉及1,930次检查。针对超级市场，执法人员进行了 1,177 次检查，发出 65 份法定消灭害虫通知书、25 份要求清洁和修缮食物场所的通知书以及两项警告，并提出了 14 项检控。
食肆方面，食肆进行了432次巡查，发出35份法定消灭害虫通知书、41份要求清洁及修葺食肆的通知书及六项警告，并提出检控65宗。当局又对其他食物业处所进行了321次巡查，发出20份法定消灭害虫通知书、17份要求清洁和修缮食物业处所通知书以及24项检控。

行动期间，食环署人员检讨这些处所的环境卫生和垃圾管理，以确保废物妥善处置，并检查货架、冰箱和食物储存区的清洁情况，并检查是否有虫鼠活动迹象，以找出根源和潜在风险。海关表示，会继续跟进调查结果，加强巡查，并在有需要时采取进一步执法行动。

食环署发言人提醒，任何售卖预制及预先包装熟食、寿司及刺身的处所，包括超级市场，均须取得食环署发出的相关牌照或限制性食物许可证，并遵守适用的发牌条件。
第二阶段，该署将严格要求摊位租户采取适当的食品卫生管理和灭鼠措施。市公安局表示，将根据群众投诉情况、检查结果、抓获鼠患数量、鼠患迹象以及各公共市场的实际风险情况，调整检查力度和灭鼠力度。

与此同时，食环署亦在辖下的熟食中心及公众街市进行代号为“清锋行动”的单独执法行动，通过突击巡查打击非法吸烟行为。自9月28日行动开始，截至10月12日，人员已就吸烟违法行为发出近50张定额罚款通知书。第二阶段的「天网行动」及「清刃行动」将同时进行，以确保公众街市的环境卫生。
