Hong Kong's Food and Environmental Hygiene Department has launched the second phase of Operation Skynet, a two-week crackdown on pest and hygiene problems at public markets, after the first phase targeting supermarkets and restaurants concluded. The first phase resulted in 1,930 inspections, 120 sta

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

14 Oct 2026 at 20:00 HKT · 2 min read

The Food and Environmental Hygiene Department (FEHD) announced on Tuesday the immediate launch of the second phase of "Operation Skynet", a two-week special inspection and enforcement operation targeting public markets across all districts, following the conclusion of the first phase that focused on supermarkets, restaurants and other food premises.

The first phase, which ran from September 30, involved 1,930 inspections in total. Against supermarkets, officers conducted 1,177 inspections, issued 65 statutory Notices of Elimination of Vermin, 25 Notices of Requirement to Cleanse and Repair Food Premises and two warnings, and initiated 14 prosecutions.

For restaurants, the department carried out 432 inspections, issuing 35 statutory Notices of Elimination of Vermin, 41 Notices of Requirement to Cleanse and Repair Food Premises and six warnings, and initiating 65 prosecutions. A further 321 inspections were conducted against other food premises, resulting in 20 statutory Notices of Elimination of Vermin, 17 Notices of Requirement to Cleanse and Repair Food Premises, and 24 prosecutions.

During the operation, FEHD officers reviewed environmental hygiene and refuse management at these premises to ensure proper waste disposal, checked goods shelves, refrigerators and food storage areas for cleanliness, and inspected for signs of pest and rodent activity to identify root causes and potential risks. The department said it will continue to follow up on these findings, step up inspections and take further enforcement action where necessary.

A spokesman for the FEHD reminded that any premises, including supermarkets, selling pre-made and prepackaged cooked foods, sushi and sashimi must obtain the relevant licence or restricted food permit issued by the FEHD and comply with the applicable licensing conditions.

In the second phase, the department will strictly require stall tenants to take proper food hygiene management and rodent control measures. It said it will adjust the intensity of inspections and rodent control efforts based on public complaints, inspection results, the number of rodents caught, rodent signs and actual risks at various public markets.

Meanwhile, the FEHD is also conducting a separate enforcement operation codenamed "Operation Clear Edge" across its cooked food centres and public markets to combat illegal smoking through blitz inspections. Since the operation began on September 28, officers have issued nearly 50 fixed penalty notices for smoking offences as of October 12. The second phase of "Operation Skynet" and "Operation Clear Edge" will be carried out concurrently to ensure the environmental hygiene of public markets.

title: UPACC chair faces arson complaint over burned Tarlac home
summary: A couple from Capas town in Tarlac asked the Department of Justice (DOJ) to investigate United Pilipino Against Crime and Corruption (UPACC) chairperson Pyra Nucum Lucas and three others over the burning of their newly-built home, which the
content:
A couple from Capas town in Tarlac asked the Department of Justice (DOJ) to investigate United Pilipino Against Crime and Corruption (UPACC) chairperson Pyra Nucum Lucas and three others over the burning of their newly-built home, which the Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP) classified as an intentional fire.

Emil and Analyn Cadiang accused Lucas, a social media personality; Arthur Aquino and two unidentified individuals of destructive arson in a complaint filed last month with the DOJ, according to documents, a copy of which was obtained by The Manila Times.

The BFP finding did not establish who was responsible for the June 28, 2025 blaze.

*   [Laguna mayors rally behind Aragones](https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/10/14/regions/laguna-mayors-rally-behind-aragones/2444954)

In a letter to Prosecutor General Richard Anthony Fadullon, the couple's lawyer sought the intervention of DOJ, citing safety concerns and difficulties participating in proceedings before the Tarlac provincial prosecutor's office.

In their joint affidavit, the Cadiangs said Emil saw Lucas and a heavyset man pulling down the roofing-sheet fence surrounding their property in Sitio Hotspring, Barangay Bueno, while a woman recorded the incident. Aquino was also allegedly present. Emil said another man chased him downhill after shouting, "May tao!" He later saw thick black smoke rising from the house.

The complainants alleged that the respondents watched the house burn from beside a white vehicle nearby. Emil said he later found gasoline containers on the property.

The allegations have yet to be established in court.

The couple said Aquino had been claiming about 260 square meters of the property since 2023 while Lucas attended barangay meetings as his attorney-in-fact.

*   ![Image 1: 44% expect Sara Duterte’s conviction in impeachment trial — survey](https://miopia.newsroom.bi/statics/i/ps/manilatimes.net/manilatimes/uploads/images/2026/10/14/1258812.jpeg?width=113&crop=113:85)
[44% expect Sara Duterte’s conviction in impeachment trial — survey](https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/10/14/news/44-expect-sara-dutertes-conviction-in-impeachment-trial-survey/2445251)

A June 9, 2025 letter signed by Lucas as UPACC chairperson asked the barangay captain to investigate and remove the fence and a hut on the disputed property.

The complaint also cited an alleged statement by Aquino days before the fire: "Si Ma'am Pyra na lang ang bahala sa inyo" (Ma'am Pyra will take care of you).

It further referenced a neighbor's account that Aquino allegedly said the group had agreed only to scare the family. The neighbor was not identified as a firsthand witness to the fire.

The BFP, meanwhile, classified the fire as intentional, citing clean burn patterns, substantial material loss in the middle of the structure and the absence of an accidental heat source.

*   ![Image 2: Marcos’ impeachment plot backfires](https://miopia.newsroom.bi/statics/i/ps/manilatimes.net/manilatimes/uploads/images/2026/10/13/1258203.jpg?width=113&crop=113:85)
[Marcos’ impeachment plot backfires](https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/10/14/opinion/columns/marcos-impeachment-plot-backfires/2444878)

Fire responders arrived at 5:37 p.m., when the blaze had already been extinguished. The BFP estimated the damage at P200,000 and said evidence had been submitted for forensic analysis.

In a letter to The Manila Times, Lucas denied committing or intending to commit destructive arson, saying her involvement in the dispute was limited to asking barangay officials to address the fence and nipa hut on land belonging to Aquino.

Lucas said she had written to barangay officials in Bueno, Capas, Tarlac, requesting an investigation into the structures, which she described as illegally built on Aquino’s property. She said she had asked officials to resolve the matter through lawful and peaceful means.

“We did not commit any illegal acts,” Lucas said.

*   ![Image 3: Lacson asks Padilla to clarify ‘disregard for law’ comment on Duterte trial](https://miopia.newsroom.bi/statics/i/ps/manilatimes.net/manilatimes/uploads/images/2026/10/13/1256725.jpg?width=113&crop=113:85)
[Lacson asks Padilla to clarify ‘disregard for law’ comment on Duterte trial](https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/10/13/news/lacson-asks-padilla-to-clarify-disregard-for-law-comment-on-duterte-trial/2444142)

She maintained that her presence in the area did not establish criminal liability and rejected the allegations against her.

“My mere presence in the area cannot be considered a crime,” she said, adding that she believed the accusations were politically motivated and intended to harass her and malign her reputation.

Lucas also alleged that, months before the complaint was filed, she had received information that the Cadiangs would be used to bring a fabricated case against her.

She offered a counter-account of the fire, saying passersby had seen Emil inside the nipa hut while it was burning. She described the structure as having been illegally built on Aquino’s property.

content:
商务
美国总统唐纳德·特朗普表示，台湾已同意购买阿拉斯加管道项目 30% 的液化天然气，商务部长霍华德·卢特尼克补充说，台湾承诺投资 44 亿美元。台湾政府尚未证实该交易，细节仍不清楚。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

香港时间 2026 年 10 月 14 日 11:46 · 阅读时间 2 分钟

美国总统唐纳德·特朗普周二表示，台湾已同意购买阿拉斯加拟议管道项目中 30% 的液化天然气 (LNG)，但交易条款尚未立即明确。特朗普是在共和党全国委员会在该州组织的一次集会上发表上述言论的。

出席集会的商务部长霍华德·卢特尼克表示，台湾已承诺投资 44 亿美元用于该管道的开发。负责监督能源政策的台湾经济部没有立即发表评论。

当被问及特朗普的言论时，台湾行政长官赵正台告诉记者，政府的工作是“稳定整个能源供应并增强其弹性，就像世界各地的政府一样”。
在此之前，台湾官员在二月份表示，他们将增加对美国天然气的采购，使其占台湾今年进口供应量的三分之一左右，并减少从其他国家的采购。台湾国有能源公司中油集团去年与阿拉斯加天然气开发公司签署协议，购买液化天然气并投资该管道项目。阿拉斯加州州长去年表示，台湾签署了一份意向书，每年从该项目购买 600 万吨液化天然气。

台湾总统赖清德当时表示，这项投资将确保台湾的能源安全。特朗普的言论没有明确表明最终协议是否已经签署。

去年，台湾总统府秘书长潘文安参观了阿拉斯加拟议的液化天然气项目现场，特朗普政府一直在向亚洲盟友推销该项目，作为供应选择。如果建成，阿拉斯加液化天然气项目每年将出口多达 2000 万吨过冷天然气。到目前为止，它已与亚洲买家和法国主要能源公司TotalEnergies签订了每年1300万吨的协议。它还需要另外 300 万吨的协议，并且必须将其转化为具有约束力的协议以确保融资。
该项目将使美国制造的液化天然气直接进入包括台湾在内的亚洲市场，而无需经过巴拿马运河或绕过非洲之角，从而减少运输时间和成本。台湾已承诺大幅增加从美国的采购，包括能源，以减少激怒华盛顿的巨大贸易顺差。特朗普上个月表示，韩国已同意投资这条价值 540 亿美元的管道，但首尔表示尚未敲定。

US President Donald Trump said Taiwan has agreed to buy 30 per cent of liquefied natural gas from an Alaska pipeline project, with Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick adding that Taiwan committed to invest $4.4 billion. Taiwan's government did not confirm the deal, and details remain unclear.

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

14 Oct 2026 at 11:46 HKT · 2 min read

US President Donald Trump said on Tuesday that Taiwan has agreed to buy 30 per cent of the liquefied natural gas (LNG) from a proposed pipeline project in Alaska, but the terms of the deal were not immediately clear. Trump made the remarks at a rally in the state organised by the Republican National Committee.

Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick, who also appeared at the rally, said Taiwan has committed to investing US$4.4 billion in the development of the pipeline. Taiwan's economy ministry, which oversees energy policy, had no immediate comment.

Asked about Trump's comments, Taiwan Premier Cho Jung-tai told reporters that the government's job is to "stabilise the entire energy supply and build its resilience, like governments everywhere."

The remarks come after Taiwan officials said in February they would ramp up purchases of US natural gas to constitute about a third of the island's imported supply this year, and reduce purchases from other countries. Taiwan state energy firm CPC Corp signed an agreement with Alaska Gasline Development Corp last year to buy LNG and invest in the pipeline project. Alaska's governor said last year that Taiwan signed a letter of intent to buy 6 million metric tons of LNG per annum from the project.

Taiwan President Lai Ching-te said at the time that the investment would ensure the island's energy security. Trump's comments did not make it clear whether a final deal had been signed.

Last year, Taiwan Presidential Office Secretary-General Pan Men-an visited the site of the proposed LNG project in Alaska, which the Trump administration has been promoting to Asian allies as a supply option. If built, the Alaska LNG project will export up to 20 million tons of the superchilled gas a year. So far it has lined up agreements covering 13 million tons a year from buyers in Asia and French major TotalEnergies. It needs agreements for another 3 million tons and must turn them into binding deals to secure financing.

The project would open direct access for US-made LNG to Asian markets, including Taiwan, without having to go through the Panama Canal or around the Horn of Africa, reducing transit time and costs. Taiwan has pledged to massively ramp up its purchases from the United States, including energy, to reduce a yawning trade surplus that has angered Washington. Trump said last month that South Korea had agreed to invest in the US$54 billion pipeline, but Seoul said it was not yet set in stone.

title: The ‘captain of the ship’ doctrine
summary: _**Dear PAO,**_ _**I am a victim of “plastic surgery gone wrong.” After the surgery, my face became permanently asymmetrical and swollen. When I confronted the head plastic surgeon, he argued that his assistant made a mistake in administeri
content:
_**Dear PAO,**_

_**I am a victim of “plastic surgery gone wrong.” After the surgery, my face became permanently asymmetrical and swollen. When I confronted the head plastic surgeon, he argued that his assistant made a mistake in administering the proper dosage of the medicine required during the surgery. However, since I directly transacted and conferred with this head surgeon before, during, and after the surgery, I want to implead him in the lawsuit. Can I file a lawsuit against him?**_

_**Paula**_

*   [Who should pay capital gains tax?](https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/10/12/legal-advice/who-should-pay-capital-gains-tax/2443313)

Dear Paula,

Yes, a lawsuit against the head plastic surgeon may be meritorious, notwithstanding the fact that it was his assistant who was directly negligent during the surgery.

In Dr. Milagros L. Cantre v. Sps. Go and Go, GR 160889, April 27, 2007, penned by Associate Justice Leonardo Quisumbing, the Supreme Court explained that the head surgeon or the surgeon in charge of an operation is liable for the negligence of his/her assistants, saying:

“In cases involving medical negligence, the doctrine of res ipsa loquitur allows the mere existence of an injury to justify a presumption of negligence on the part of the person who controls the instrument causing the injury, provided that the following requisites concur:

“1. The accident is of a kind which ordinarily does not occur in the absence of someone’s negligence;

*   ![Image 1: Duterte keeps 56% trust rating, Marcos remains at 36% – SWS survey](https://miopia.newsroom.bi/statics/i/ps/manilatimes.net/manilatimes/uploads/images/2026/10/14/1258343.jpeg?width=113&crop=113:85)
[Duterte keeps 56% trust rating, Marcos remains at 36% – SWS survey](https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/10/14/news/national/duterte-keeps-56-trust-rating-marcos-remains-at-36-sws-survey/2444939)

“2. It is caused by an instrumentality within the exclusive control of the defendant or defendants; and

“3. The possibility of contributing conduct which would make the plaintiff responsible is eliminated.

“As to the first requirement, the gaping wound on Nora’s arm is certainly not an ordinary occurrence in the act of delivering a baby, far removed as the arm is from the organs involved in the process of giving birth. Such injury could not have happened unless negligence had set in somewhere.

“Second, whether the injury was caused by the droplight or by the blood pressure cuff is of no moment. Both instruments are deemed within the exclusive control of the physician in charge under the ‘captain of the ship’ doctrine. This doctrine holds the surgeon in charge of an operation liable for the negligence of his assistants during the time when those assistants are under the surgeon’s control. In this particular case, it can be logically inferred that petitioner, the senior consultant in charge during the delivery of Nora’s baby, exercised control over the assistants assigned to both the use of the droplight and the taking of Nora’s blood pressure. Hence, the use of the droplight and the blood pressure cuff is also within petitioner’s exclusive control.”

*   ![Image 2: ICC prosecutor removes 253 items from evidence list in Duterte case](https://miopia.newsroom.bi/statics/i/ps/manilatimes.net/manilatimes/uploads/images/2026/10/13/1257681.jpg?width=113&crop=113:85)
[ICC prosecutor removes 253 items from evidence list in Duterte case](https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/10/13/news/icc-prosecutor-removes-253-items-from-evidence-list-in-duterte-case/2444598)

Thus, as the head surgeon, your doctor may be held liable not only for his own negligence, but also for the negligence of his assistants during the surgery or when such assistants were under his professional control. As the proverbial “captain of the ship,” the head surgeon may be impleaded and held directly liable for the medical malpractice or negligence committed by the assistants he is supervising.

title: Homeware line designed for dormers, young couples, small families

content:
College students in dorms and young couples starting out often need a few items to make their spaces more comfortable. These often include basics like flatware, plates, beddings and maybe a lamp or two.

While there are department stores and home store chains that offer pretty much the same kind of mix, one of the newer entrants is the Metro Retail Stores Group. Last month, it launched its own brand of home basics, Metro Living in its four Metro Department Stores located in Alabang, Market Market, Ayala Center Cebu, and Super Metro Colon.

Arranged on open shelves and in compact displays, the merchandise is basic and designed to work together.

“For Metro Living, we’ve shifted our entire retail philosophy from selling individual products to delivering fully integrated lifestyle solutions. Previously, customers had to navigate different aisles to assemble a look,” Joel Orense, Metro Retail President and COO told The Manila Times in an email interview.

“Through our dedicated shop-in-shop concept, we bring fully curated, pre-styled living spaces directly to the retail floor. It eliminates decision fatigue, offers immediate aesthetic inspiration, and maximizes customer convenience. We are elevating the overall shopping experience, and based on initial performance, we plan to scale this format to additional key stores next year,” he added.

content:
_"This same river where the plane crashed into is what supplies our drinking water. We have a water treatment machine at Aboto about seven kilometres away from here. The water doesn't come every day, and when it comes, it is this same water that flows there, pumped to be treated for our drinking. So, it means whatever happens, pollution is already in the river, either as a result of decayed bodies or as oil that dropped into the river."_

A humanitarian crisis may hit Igbokoda, the headquarters of Ilaje Local Government Area of Ondo State, following the pollution of the source of water for the community by decaying bodies of the victims of the**[Nigeria Air Force](https://x.com/NigAirForce "https://x.com/NigAirForce")** (NAF) plane that crashed there last week.

The traditional ruler of the community, Afolabi Odidiomo, told PREMIUM TIMES on Tuesday that the body of water has been polluted, leaving the people with contaminated water both for drinking and other domestic uses.

He also said the crash destroyed economic trees and fish, which are the community's source of livelihood.

Keep up with the latest headlines on [WhatsApp](https://whatsapp.com/channel/0029VaIdDi8Bqbr263erhw1K "https://whatsapp.com/channel/0029VaIdDi8Bqbr263erhw1K") | [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/allafrica/ "https://www.linkedin.com/company/allafrica/")

The NAF plane crashed into the swamp in the area on Monday, 5 October, killing the 25 people on board.

Efforts by divers and rescue teams to retrieve the wreckage of the plane and the bodies of the victims have been largely unsuccessful because of the terrain.

The search and rescue efforts deployed by a combined team of NAF, the Nigerian Navy, the police, the Igbokoda community and the state government about a week ago have only succeeded in retrieving pieces of human body parts as well as the broken parts of the airplane.

Officials confirmed that the main body of the airplane is yet to be located, as it is suspected to be deeply submerged in the underlay of the swamp where the crash occurred.

**Water pollution concern**

However, concerns have shifted from the initial shock following the crash to fresh fears of water pollution.

The body of water where the crash occurred is the same source of water for the Igbokoda community.

Rescuers have indicated that working on the site at the moment is hazardous as the area stinks badly of decayed human flesh littering the water.

The traditional ruler of Igbokoda, Mr Odidiomo, who spoke to PREMIUM TIMES at his palace on Tuesday, said the water has been polluted, leaving the people with contaminated water both for drinking and other domestic uses.

"The concern of everybody in this community today is that our government spent time, energy, money, and effort looking for people that had been chopped into pieces by the crash. The pieces that are floating everywhere in our rivers. The pieces that have decayed left so much stench that is unbelievable.

"Going close to the river is so scary now for children who usually go to swim when they return from school, because they see human flesh everywhere as they swim. Fish are also dying everywhere.

"So, the river that used to be friendly with children has become scary, as we wonder why the government cares so much for the dead rather than the living.

"This same river where the plane crashed into is what supplies our drinking water. We have a water treatment machine at Aboto about seven kilometres away from here. The water doesn't come every day, and when it comes, it is this same water that flows there, pumped to be treated for our drinking.

"So, it means whatever happens, pollution is already in the river, either as a result of decayed bodies or as oil that dropped into the river, and any other pollution that went into the water thereof."

The traditional ruler called for immediate clean-up of the water in order to prevent a worse disaster in the form of an epidemic due to the polluted water.

He said the lack of a plan to protect the people from the inherent pollution was unfair to the people, as the government could have cordoned off the area so that the polluted water could be kept back from flowing into the main river.

Mr Odidiomo said that besides the pollution, the crash also destroyed economic trees and fish, which are the community's source of livelihood.

"We are asking the government for cleanup. We are asking the government for remediation, a kind of restoration of the environment. The restoration now does not mean that we want the trees planted back, but we want the government to still do something in memory of those that died just as we have in Lagos and Ogun states," he said.

He also said efforts should be made, in addition to cleaning up the water, to also provide an alternative source of clean drinking water.

Also speaking on the pollution, Benjamin Omoyele, a resident of Igbokoda and a 100 Level student of Civil Engineering at the Federal University of Technology, Akure (FUTA), said the water pollution arising from the crash is a genuine concern that the people expect the government to look into urgently.

According to him, the body parts still left in the water are creating health concerns and contamination in the water, which might affect residents who depend largely on it.

However, Odunsola Dada, popularly called General at Igbokoda, said he believed that since the water is deep and keeps flowing down into the ocean, it would clean itself with time.

Mr Dada said the water would clean itself with time and that he did not see any present danger to the community.

"We are all humans, and what happened is a tragedy. We will all also die at our time. The water is deep and flowing steadily. It is not a well or a pool. It is a flowing river. In a short while everything will flow into the sea and people will be able to use it as before," he said.

Meanwhile, excavations are ongoing at the site with more machinery being deployed to assist in the removal of the remaining parts of the aircraft.

The search for the black box is the new focus of the operation as directed by the Chief of Air Staff, Sunday Aneke, during his visit to the site last week.

【看中国2026年10月14日讯】因涉嫌为中国政府从事间谍活动而被美国联邦调查局（FBI）逮捕的加州华人房地产经纪人[张婉莹](https://www.secretchina.com/news/gb/tag/%E5%BC%A0%E5%A9%89%E8%8E%B9)（Wanying Zhang），近日又被曝出拥有规模庞大的房地产资产。她与丈夫名下疑似拥有7套住宅，总价值约1,100万美元，远超她此前向司法部门申报的资产数量，其财富来源也因此受到关注。 [看中国网站 禁止建立鏡像網站。返回正版看中国网站。](https://www.secretchina.com/)

据《纽约邮报》报道，现年34岁的张婉莹，又名希瑟（Heather），被指与中国方面的人员合作，监视中华民国总统的儿子。她于10月4日在洛杉矶机场准备登上飞往上海的航班时被FBI逮捕，随后被控充当未登记的外国政府[代理人](https://www.secretchina.com/news/gb/tag/%E4%BB%A3%E7%90%86%E4%BA%BA)。 [看中国网站 禁止建立鏡像網站。返回正版看中国网站。](https://www.secretchina.com/)

检方指出，张婉莹被捕后，在接受审前服务部门调查时，没有如实申报自己拥有的房产和资产。她只申报了一处房产，但《纽约邮报》调查发现，她与丈夫似乎共同拥有七套住宅，估计总价值高达1,100万美元。

对此，张婉莹的律师克雷格・哈博（Craig Harbaugh）解释称，这是一场误会。不过，美国助理检察官阿曼达・埃尔博根（Amanda Elbogen）在洛杉矶法庭上指出，张婉莹本身就是房地产经纪人，理应清楚自己拥有多少房产。

[![Image 13](https://img6.secretchina.com/pic/2025/7-29/p3676411a560438137.jpg)](https://www.naturenergy.us/)

[![Image 14](https://img6.secretchina.com/pic/2024/11-2/p3556881a508884777.jpg)](https://naturexcels.com/language/zh/)

[![Image 15](https://img6.secretchina.com/bigpic/2024/11-4/p3557701a911506510.jpg)](https://naturexcels.com/language/zh/)

[![Image 16](https://img6.secretchina.com/pic/2025/7-29/p3676411a560438137.jpg)](https://www.naturenergy.us/)

上周，洛杉矶一名法官认定张婉莹存在潜逃风险，下令将她交由美国法警局拘押，不准保释。

**10年卖出125套房产 夫妻名下资产庞大**

《纽约邮报》调查发现，张婉莹与家人居住在加州橙县尔湾市（Irvine），生活相当富裕，经常搭乘飞机前往世界各地。

她与丈夫丁埃德里克（Edric Ding）都是南加州小型房地产经纪公司JC Pacific Capital的经纪人。

根据房地产网站Zillow的资料，张婉莹于2016年9月取得房地产经纪人执照。过去十年，她至少经手出售125套住宅，成交价格从51万美元到880万美元不等。

报道指出，张婉莹夫妇不仅替客户买卖房产，还积累了规模庞大的个人房地产资产。他们通过出售自己名下的住宅，获得了接近1,600万美元的销售收入。

不过，这些数字引起了同行的怀疑。

一名在JC Pacific Capital与张婉莹共事、要求匿名的房地产经纪人告诉《纽约邮报》，得知张婉莹拥有如此多房产后，感到十分震惊。

这名经纪人认为，单靠房地产交易佣金，很难积累如此庞大的财富，并怀疑张婉莹是否还有其他收入来源，甚至猜测她可能真的在为[中国](https://www.secretchina.com/)工作。

与此同时，检方还指控，张婉莹可以动用一个秘密的中国加密货币账户，涉及金额约19万美元，而且仍在从该账户获得收益。

检方还指出，张婉莹的兄弟与中国政府存在联系。

不过，报道并未证实张婉莹名下房产的资金来自中国政府，也没有证明这些房地产交易与她所面临的间谍指控存在直接关联。

**房产交易牵出另一名华商 FBI搜查其住所**

《纽约邮报》进一步调查张婉莹经手的房地产交易后发现，其中多套住宅位于加州亚凯迪亚市（Arcadia）。

今年5月，该市58岁的前市长王艾琳（Eileen Wang）曾承认，自己非法充当中国共产党的代理人。

报道指出，张婉莹经手的一笔房产交易，还涉及出生于中国的加州商人苗发台（Fatai Miao）。

现年54岁的苗发台从事建筑业，去年曾出售位于亚凯迪亚市的一栋六卧室豪宅，成交价约400万美元。

《纽约邮报》称，苗发台被认为就是联邦法院文件中提到的“1号人物”（Individual 1）。

根据法院文件，2025年9月，张婉莹涉嫌在西雅图监视[台湾](https://www.secretchina.com/news/gb/tag/%E5%8F%B0%E6%B9%BE)总统的儿子时，这名男子曾与她同行。

据称，监控摄像头拍下的照片显示，张婉莹与一名男子坐在汽车内，对台湾总统儿子的住宅及其近亲进行拍照。

不过，苗发台目前并未受到任何违法行为指控。

据哥伦比亚广播公司新闻（CBS News）报道，苗发台是FBI调查张婉莹案件时关注的一名相关人物。

苗发台的亲属表示，过去两周，他一直待在中国，照顾正在当地接受治疗的妻子。

张婉莹在洛杉矶机场被捕后不久，FBI探员于周日持搜查令进入苗发台位于尔湾的住宅，当时屋内无人。

苗发台的儿子苗佳琪（Jiaqi Miao，音译）向CBS新闻表示，事发当天中午，他与姐姐接到一通自称来自FBI的电话，对方表示持有搜查令。

苗佳琪起初以为遇到诈骗电话，但查看家中监控后，发现多名持枪执法人员站在屋外。

他试图通过手机远程开门，但执法人员已经使用破门工具进入住宅。

苗佳琪还透露，父亲与张婉莹认识超过十年，两人一直是朋友，张婉莹甚至曾暂时住在父亲位于亚凯迪亚市的房产内。

不过，他否认父亲是中国间谍，认为父亲没有能力策划此类行动，而且经常听从他人的意见。

苗佳琪还强调，父亲是家中唯一主动选择加入美国国籍的人，因此他认为父亲没有理由替中国政府工作。

《纽约邮报》还发现，在张婉莹经手的另一笔房地产交易中，一名刚从大学毕业的中国留学生，以超过350万美元的价格购买了一栋六卧室住宅。

JC Pacific Capital此前曾发表声明，确认已知悉张婉莹涉及联邦刑事指控。公司表示，理解这些指控的严重性及公众的关注，将全力配合联邦当局调查，并依法提供所需信息和协助。

title: US in ‘denuclearisation’ talks with Russia and China: Trump
zh_title: 特朗普：美国与俄罗斯和中国进行“无核化”谈判
source: 菲律宾在中国紧张局势中加强其最北端的防御
summary: _美国和俄罗斯各拥有4000多枚弹头。特朗普表示，中国将在五年内赶上他们。唐纳德·特朗普总统宣布，美国正在与俄罗斯和中国就核裁军问题进行谈判。特朗普周四表示，在弹头数量方面落后于美国和俄罗斯的中国正在奋起直追。他在接受美国广播公司 Newsmax 采访时补充说，华盛顿正在与其他国家讨论“无核化”的途径。 ## 推荐故事 3 项列表 * 3 项列表 1 [俄罗斯核弹
content:
_美国和俄罗斯各拥有4000多枚弹头。特朗普表示，中国将在五年内赶上他们。_

唐纳德·特朗普总统宣布，美国正在与俄罗斯和中国就核裁军问题进行谈判。

特朗普周四表示，在弹头数量方面落后于美国和俄罗斯的中国正在奋起直追。他在接受美国广播公司 Newsmax 采访时补充说，华盛顿正在与其他国家讨论“无核化”的途径。

## 推荐故事

3 项清单
* 3 项清单中的 1 项[俄罗斯核轰炸机坠毁，造成六人死亡](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/9/29/ Russian-nuclear-capable-bomber-plane-crashes-killing-six-people)
* 列表 2（共 3）[美国可以在伊朗使用的“炸弹之母”是什么？](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/10/15/what-is-the-mother-of-all-bombs-us-could-use-in-iran)
* 3 项清单中的 3 项[俄罗斯、中国否决联合国监督伊朗制裁的授权](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/9/17/Russia-china-veto-un-mandate-to-monitor-iran-sanctions)

列表末尾
中国拥有约620枚弹头，与美国和俄罗斯的4000多枚弹头相比相形见绌，但特朗普表示，他认为中国将在五年内“迎头赶上”。

特朗普说：“整件事是一种耻辱，因为如果可能的话，我希望实现无核化。” “我们实际上正在与俄罗斯讨论这一问题，我们正在与中国讨论无核化问题。”
他指出，中国似乎不愿意解除武装，但表示谈判仍在继续。据 Newsmax 报道，特朗普与中国国家主席习近平就此事进行了交谈，但没有透露有关与俄罗斯或中国会谈的更多细节。

（半岛电视台）

根据斯德哥尔摩国际和平研究所 (SIPRI) 的数据，俄罗斯拥有世界上最大的[核弹头]库存(https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/6/8/nuclear-risks-rise-as-powers-expand-and-modernise-arsenals-study-finds)，美国紧随其后。

据估计，两国拥有全球核武器总数的 86%。

据 SIPRI 称，中国拥有第三大核武库，去年已将其核弹头数量扩大至 620 枚。

特朗普的主张是在《削减战略武器条约》到期后不久提出的，该条约是美国和俄罗斯之间旨在限制其核武库的军备控制协议。

该条约到期一个月后，法国总统马克龙宣布了“前沿威慑倡议”，因为俄罗斯在乌克兰战争期间的核武力威胁令欧洲感到恐慌。

根据您的兴趣获取即时警报和更新。成为第一个知道重大事件发生的人。

澳大利亚前外交部长加雷斯·埃文斯告诉半岛电视台，世界对核武器风险的兴趣已经减弱。
他说：“世界……对核战争的风险已经变得令人震惊地自满，每一项主要的核军控协议都已失效、垂死或处于生命维持状态，而长期存在的禁止威胁或使用核武器的禁忌也逐渐消失。”

【原文 English Original】
_The US and Russia each have more than 4,000 warheads. China is set to catch up with them within five years, Trump says._

The United States is engaged in talks with Russia and China regarding nuclear disarmament, President Donald Trump has announced.

Trump said on Thursday that China – which lags behind the US and Russia in terms of the number of warheads it has – is racing to catch up. He added during an interview with US broadcaster Newsmax that Washington is discussing with its peers a route to “denuclearise”.

## Recommended Stories

list of 3 items
*   list 1 of 3[Russian nuclear-capable bomber plane crashes, killing six people](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/9/29/russian-nuclear-capable-bomber-plane-crashes-killing-six-people)
*   list 2 of 3[What is the ‘Mother of All Bombs’ US could use in Iran?](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/10/15/what-is-the-mother-of-all-bombs-us-could-use-in-iran)
*   list 3 of 3[Russia, China veto UN mandate to monitor Iran sanctions](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/9/17/russia-china-veto-un-mandate-to-monitor-iran-sanctions)

end of list
China’s nuclear stockpile of about 620 warheads is dwarfed by those of the US and Russia, which each have more than 4,000, but Trump said he thinks China will “catch up” within five years.

“The whole thing is a shame because I’d love to denuclearise if possible,” Trump said. “We’re actually talking ⁠to Russia about that, and ⁠we’re talking to China about that denuclearisation.”

China doesn’t seem willing to disarm, he noted, but said talks have continued. Newsmax reported that Trump spoke with Chinese President Xi Jinping on the subject, but no further details regarding the talks with either Russia or China were revealed.

(Al Jazeera)

Russia has the world’s largest stockpile of [nuclear warheads](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/6/8/nuclear-risks-rise-as-powers-expand-and-modernise-arsenals-study-finds), and the US is close behind, according to the Stockholm International Peace Research Institute (SIPRI).

The two countries together possess an estimated 86 percent of all nuclear weapons globally.

China has the third largest nuclear arsenal, according to SIPRI, having expanded it to 620 warheads in the past year.

Trump’s claims came shortly after the expiration of the Strategic Arms Reduction Treaty, an arms control agreement between the US and Russia to limit their nuclear arsenals.

A month after the treaty expired, French President Emmanuel Macron announced the Forward Deterrence Initiative as Russia’s nuclear sabre-rattling during its war on Ukraine has spooked Europe.

Former Australian Minister of Foreign Affairs Gareth Evans told Al Jazeera that the world’s interest in the risk of nuclear weapons has waned.

“[The] world … has become alarmingly complacent about the risks of nuclear war with every major nuclear arms control agreement dead, dying or on life support and the longstanding taboo against threat or use eroding,” he said

# Warm weather to persist across Taiwan through Saturday: CWA

10/16/2026 11:08 AM

[](jsvscript:)[](jsvscript:)[](javascript:void(0))[Listen](javascript:)

[Link](javascript:)[Whatsapp](javascript:)[Reddit](javascript:)[Line](javascript:)[Email](javascript:)

To activate the text-to-speech service, please first agree to the privacy policy below.

CNA file photo

Taipei, Oct. 16 (CNA) Mostly cloudy to sunny skies and warm weather are forecast across Taiwan on Friday and Saturday, although brief showers are possible in northern and northeastern Taiwan on Friday, according to the Central Weather Administration (CWA).

Daytime highs are forecast to reach 29-31 degrees Celsius in Keelung and the eastern half of Taiwan and 31-34 degrees elsewhere, the CWA said.

Showers are possible along the coast of Keelung City and in Yilan County in northeastern Taiwan and Hualien County in the east on Friday, the agency forecast.

Independent meteorologist Wu Der-rong (吳德榮) said daytime temperatures would remain relatively high, a pattern known locally as an "autumn tiger," or a lingering fall heat wave.

Some parts of Taiwan could see highs of up to 35 degrees Celsius, Wu predicted.

Partly cloudy skies with occasional brief showers can be expected in the eastern half of Taiwan through Oct. 20, while mostly sunny and stable weather is likely for other parts of the island during that time, he said.

Based on the latest forecasting models, Wu said northeasterly winds would strengthen on Oct. 21, bringing rain and lower temperatures across parts of Taiwan.

CWA graphic

As for Tropical Storm Champi, Wu said the latest CWA forecast showed the storm east of Guam and moving in a west-northwesterly direction.

The latest European model simulations suggest Champi could make a large turn northeast over waters south of Japan in the coming days, he said, but noted that its path remained uncertain.

(By Huang Chiao-wen and Ko Lin)

# TSMC evaluating Texas production, cooperation with Terafab

10/15/2026 07:51 PM

[](jsvscript:)[](jsvscript:)[](javascript:void(0))[Listen](javascript:)

[Link](javascript:)[Whatsapp](javascript:)[Reddit](javascript:)[Line](javascript:)[Email](javascript:)

A TSMC fab in Arizona. CNA file photo

Taipei, Oct. 15 (CNA) C. C. Wei (魏哲家), Chairman and CEO of Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. (TSMC), said Thursday that the chipmaker is evaluating the possibility of collaborating with Elon Musk's Terafab project in Texas.

Speaking at an investor conference, Wei said that while cooperation with Terafab was possible, any fab should be run by TSMC to control production.

[●TSMC raises 2026 sales growth forecast to 44%, leaves capex unchanged](https://focustaiwan.tw/business/202610150018)

He emphasized that the possible cooperation with the Terafab project was at the discussion stage.

Wei's remarks came after Musk said on social media that it was possible TSMC could sublease part of Terafab "but nothing more than that."

Wei said TSMC is working hard to expand its capacity in the United States and the expansion is necessary as its major American clients have asked the chipmaker to raise production to meet their demand. He added that the U.S. government has provided necessary assistance to TSMC for expansion.

He added that on the back of strong demand for smartphones, high-performance computing devices and artificial intelligence applications, TSMC's production capacity using its latest-generation 2-nanometer process will more than double from a year earlier in 2027.

CNA graph

Meanwhile, Wei said TSMC is developing the A14 process and trial production is slated for 2027 before mass production is scheduled to begin in 2028.

Compared with the 2nm process, the A14 process is expected to offer a 10-15 percent speed improvement at the same power, or a 25-30 percent power reduction at the same speed, while the new process is expected to boost logic density by almost 20 percent, according to TSMC.

According to Wei, nearly 20 fab projects worldwide are currently underway, including three new 3nm fabs.

In Taiwan, a 3nm fab in Tainan is expected to begin mass production in the first half of 2027, while another 3nm fab is also planned in Tainan and will start commercial production in the first half of 2028, Wei said.

In Arizona, a second fab using the 2nm process will start mass production in the third quarter of 2027, he added.

(By Chang Chien-chung and Frances Huang)

# Army to open Chengkungling base to public Oct. 24

10/15/2026 08:52 PM

[](jsvscript:)[](jsvscript:)[](javascript:void(0))[Listen](javascript:)

[Link](javascript:)[Whatsapp](javascript:)[Reddit](javascript:)[Line](javascript:)[Email](javascript:)

Chengkungling military base in Taichung. CNA file photo

Taipei, Oct. 15 (CNA) The Army will open its Chengkungling base to the public on Oct. 24, showcasing new equipment including M1A2T tanks and HIMARS rocket systems, while offering rides in eight-wheeled armored vehicles and other hands-on military experiences, the Ministry of National Defense (MND) said Thursday.

The event, part of the military's efforts to promote public understanding of national defense, will run from 8 a.m. to 3 p.m. and is free, said Maj. Gen. Wang Chun-chin (王俊欽), chief of staff of the 10th Army Corps, at an MND press briefing.

Visitors are required to bring a photo ID for identity checks. Foreign spouses must be accompanied by their Taiwanese spouses, while foreign caregivers must be accompanied by their care recipient, and present valid documents, Wang said.

The static display will feature 24 types of ground equipment, including M1A2T tanks and HIMARS systems, as well as the Navy's mobile missile launchers and the Air Force's Patriot and Tien Kung air defense missile systems.

The program will also include an aerial formation by AH-1W Cobra helicopters, fast-rope descents from UH-60M Black Hawk helicopters, helicopter-borne assault demonstrations using CH-47SD helicopters, drone displays, mixed martial arts demonstrations and a precision parachute landing by the Army's Shen Long parachute team.

Visitors can also ride in eight-wheeled armored vehicles and try pulling the firing mechanism of a towed 155mm howitzer. Other activities include military recruitment booths, civil defense education, air rifle shooting and a fair.

No private vehicles will be allowed inside the base, and traffic controls will be implemented on nearby roads. Free shuttle buses will run between the venue and designated stops at Chengkung Station, Xinwuri Station, Shuinan Transit Center, the Jingmao 6 free parking lot and Chengkung military supply station.

With the Nov. 28 local elections approaching, Wang reminded visitors that military events must remain politically neutral. Election-related clothing and the distribution or posting of campaign materials will be prohibited. Military officials said they would also urge visitors not to display campaign sashes worn as hair accessories or other ornaments.

(By Wu Su-wei and Sean Lin)

CTF Media & Entertainment (CTFME), formerly known as i-CABLE Communications, unveiled its new corporate logo on Thursday as it moves to expand its entertainment business and build an integrated media and entertainment ecosystem.

The company plans to invest in major overseas music and sporting events to tap into the fan economy, including merchandise sales beyond ticket revenue, it said. Its investment in the Korean edition of the electronic dance music festival EDC drew 100,000 attendees in early October, according to the company.

Locally, CTFME expects to open a live house at Kai Tak Sports Park by the end of this year to discover and nurture emerging Hong Kong musicians.

Chief executive and executive director Ivy Wong said the group also plans to venture into e-commerce and offer integrated marketing solutions.

The new logo combines the letters “M” and “E” for media and entertainment, reflecting the company’s “Screen-to-Experience” strategy to connect audiences through digital platforms and real-world experiences.

CTFME’s five business pillars are telecommunications, media, entertainment experiences, retail and e-commerce, and integrated marketing. Its businesses include i-CABLE’s broadband services and HOY’s television channels and OTT platform.

title: North Korea and China open new bridge after 12-year delay
zh_title: 朝鲜和中国延迟12年后开通新桥
summary: 6 小时前 埃维岛和朱莉安娜·汗 新鸭绿江大桥全长 3 公里（1.9 英里），从中国边境城市丹东到朝鲜新义州 据中国官方媒体报道，随着邻国之间贸易关系的改善，一座拖延已久的连接中国和朝鲜的公路大桥已经开通。中国是朝鲜最大的贸易伙伴，也是应对国际社会因平壤核武器计划而实施严厉制裁的生命线。新鸭绿江大桥全长 3 公里（1.9 英里），从中国边境城市丹东到朝鲜新义州，将成为朝鲜的主要陆路通道。
content:
6 小时前

埃威岛和

朱莉安娜·汗

新鸭绿江大桥全长 3 公里（1.9 英里），从中国边境城市丹东到朝鲜新义州

据中国官方媒体报道，随着邻国之间的贸易关系改善，一座拖延已久的连接中国和朝鲜的公路大桥已经开通。

中国是朝鲜最大的贸易伙伴，也是应对国际社会因平壤核武器计划而实施严厉制裁的生命线。

新鸭绿江大桥全长3公里（1.9英里），从中国边境城市丹东到朝鲜新义州，将成为两国之间贸易的主要陆路通道。

该项目最初定于 2014 年启动，但由于与北京的关系变得冷淡，朝鲜停止了道路和海关设施的建设，因此被无限期推迟。

中国国务院总理李强在周四的视频讲话中表示，这座大桥是“象征中朝传统友谊的新地标”，两国关系正在“翻开新的篇章”。

新鸭绿江大桥是具有数十年历史的中朝友谊大桥的替代方案，该大桥建于 1937 年至 1943 年日本帝国占领该地区期间。

中国外交部发言人毛宁周三表示，这座新大桥是两国之间“互联互通的重要设施”，并补充说这条路线将“进一步便利贸易和人员往来”。
去年，双边贸易额达到 27 亿美元，标志着恢复到大流行前的水平，这主要是由中国对朝鲜的出口推动的。

韩国外国语大学中国研究教授康俊英告诉英国广播公司，由于联合国对朝鲜的制裁仍然有效，跨境贸易“不太可能”突然增加。

“平壤还对突然涌入的中国进口产品保持警惕，这将大大扩大中国对其国内市场的影响力，”他补充道。

“中国很清楚这些担忧，因此贸易更有可能逐步增长。”

北京和平壤是长期盟友，双方签署了共同防御条约，这是中国与任何国家签署的唯一条约。这种关系经常被形容为“唇齿相依”，这是中国前领导人毛泽东首先提出的一句话。

但联盟并非没有紧张。

2010年代的大部分时间里，由于北京对平壤核武器计划的耐心逐渐减弱，两国关系一直处于冷淡状态。金正恩于 2017 年进行了核试验，此后加大了对被禁弹道导弹的试验力度，所有这些都增加了美国的警惕性，并加强了其与韩国和日本的军事联盟。

中国的态度最近发生了转变。
牛津大学讲师爱德华·豪厄尔（Edward Howell）告诉英国广播公司（BBC）：“虽然仅仅十年前，北京还公开批评朝鲜核化，甚至呼吁平壤无核化，但现在中国对此几乎没有说什么。”

观察人士称，原因之一是朝鲜因乌克兰战争而与俄罗斯走得更近。

至少 2,300 名朝鲜士兵[据信已死亡](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/clypr5985ejo) 在乌克兰为俄罗斯作战。作为回报，俄罗斯向朝鲜提供石油，这违反了联合国的制裁。据估计，2024 年俄罗斯已向平壤输送了[超过 10 亿桶石油](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cjr4pr0gyyzo) 作为平壤武器和战略物资的付款。

Koh Ewe and

Julianna Khan

The New Yalu River Bridge spans 3km (1.9 miles) from the Chinese border city of Dandong to Sinuiju in North Korea

A long-delayed road bridge linking China and North Korea has opened, Chinese state media report, as trade ties improve between the neighbours.

China is North Korea's largest trading partner and a lifeline against heavy international sanctions over Pyongyang's nuclear weapons programme.

The New Yalu River Bridge spans 3km (1.9 miles) from the Chinese border city of Dandong to Sinuiju in North Korea, and is set to become the main land route for trade between them.

Its launch, initially slated for 2014, had been indefinitely postponed after North Korea halted construction of its roads and customs facilities, as relations with Beijing turned frosty.

Chinese Premier Li Qiang, in a video address on Thursday, said the bridge was a "new landmark symbolising the traditional friendship between China and North Korea", and that the two countries were "opening a new chapter" in bilateral ties.

The New Yalu River Bridge is an alternative to the decades-old Sino-Korean Friendship Bridge, which was built between 1937 and 1943 during Imperial Japan's occupation of the region.

The new bridge is an "important facility for connectivity" between the two countries, Chinese Foreign Ministry spokesperson Mao Ning said on Wednesday, adding that the route would "further facilitate trade and people-to-people exchanges".

Last year, bilateral trade reached $2.7bn, marking a recovery to pre-pandemic levels, mostly fuelled by Chinese exports to North Korea.

A sharp and sudden increase in trade across the border is "unlikely" as the UN sanctions on North Korea remain in effect, Kang Jun-young, a professor of Chinese studies at the Hankuk University of Foreign Studies, tells the BBC.

"Pyongyang is also wary of a sudden flood of Chinese imports that would greatly expand China's influence over its domestic market," he adds.

"China is well aware of these concerns, so trade is more likely to grow gradually."

Beijing and Pyongyang are long-standing allies with a mutual defence treaty, the only one that China has with any country. The relationship is often described "as close as lips and teeth", a remark first made by China's former leader Mao Zedong.

But the alliance is not without tension.

Ties were frosty for much of the 2010s as Beijing's patience over Pyongyang's nuclear weapons programme wore thin. Kim Jong Un conducted a nuclear test in 2017 and has since ramped up tests of banned ballistic missiles - all of which increased US wariness, and strengthened its military alliances with South Korea and Japan.

China's attitude has shifted more recently.

"Whilst only a decade ago, Beijing was overtly critical of North Korea's nuclearisation - and indeed calling for Pyongyang's denuclearisation - China is now saying little, if anything, to this effect," Edward Howell, a lecturer at the University of Oxford, tells the BBC.

Observers say one reason is that North Korea has grown closer to Russia because of the Ukraine war.

At least 2,300 North Korean soldiers are [believed to have died](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/clypr5985ejo) fighting for Russia in Ukraine. In return, Russia supplies North Korea with oil, in violation of UN sanctions. In 2024, Russia was estimated to have sent [more than a billion barrels of oil](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cjr4pr0gyyzo) as payment for Pyongyang's weapons and troops.

Last month, North Korea and Russia opened their first road bridge, which Russian state media said would allow the movement of up to 300 vehicles and more than 2,000 people every day.

So Beijing is believed to be trying to reassert its sway over Pyongyang by rekindling ties.

Air China resumed direct flights between Beijing and Pyongyang in March after a six-year hiatus triggered by the pandemic. The two countries [reopened passenger train services](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cdxz8v58xvyo) the same month.

Chinese President Xi Jinping's first state visit of this year, in June, was to Pyongyang, where he met North Korean leader Kim Jong Un.

"The opening of the New Yalu River Bridge demonstrates bilateral relations are improving and that Xi Jinping's June visit to North Korea was more than symbolic," says Leif-Eric Easley, a professor at Ewha University in Seoul.

"But the long delay, including North Korea's pandemic self-isolation and domestic socioeconomic crackdowns, shows what a difficult partner Pyongyang can be for Beijing."

# Taipei hospital highlights long-term medical work in Eswatini

10/15/2026 05:10 PM

King Mswati III (center) poses for a photo during his visit to Taipei Medical University Hospital on Thursday. photo courtesy of the Taipei Medical University Hospital Oct. 15, 2026

Taipei, Oct. 15 (CNA) The Taipei Medical University Hospital (TMUH) said Thursday it has been providing medical services in Eswatini since 2009, following a visit by King Mswati III to the hospital on Oct. 12.

In a news release, TMUH said Mswati was received by hospital superintendent Shih Chun-ming (施俊明).

Eswatini's absolute monarch arrived in Taiwan last week to attend the Republic of China's National Day celebrations.

Shih said the partnership has expanded from clinical care to medical personnel training and healthcare system development over the past 17 years, helping strengthen Eswatini's medical system.

Shih said TMUH had provided more than 50,000 person-visits of teaching and training services in Eswatini. Through long-term on-site services and the sharing of professional expertise, the hospital has also helped strengthen the country's healthcare capacity.

TMUH Vice Superintendent Wang Wei (王偉) said the hospital's TAIP-X smart healthcare platform has been introduced at Manzini Government Hospital in Eswatini, helping the hospital transition from paper-based operations to digital outpatient services and improve efficiency.

Wang said TMUH and the medical teams there have also established telemedicine services in pediatrics, hematology and oncology, endocrinology, rheumatology and immunology, nephrology, and dermatology.

Taiwanese specialists work with Eswatini resident physicians to provide real-time remote consultations, helping strengthen local specialist care and clinical skills, he added.

Looking ahead, Shih said TMUH will continue to expand medical cooperation with Eswatini by drawing on its clinical expertise and smart healthcare technologies, as well as through professional exchanges and personnel training, to help strengthen local healthcare capacity and raise the international profile of Taiwan's medical expertise.

(By Shen Pei-yao and Ko Lin)

content:
香港
香港警方捣毁了一个与沉香树投资诈骗有关的跨国犯罪集团，逮捕了六人，并查获了与该计划有关的 1,400 万港元。大部分受害者为长者，损失介乎3万至190万港元。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

香港时间 2026 年 10 月 15 日 16:08 · 阅读时间 2 分钟

香港警方捣毁了一个与沉香树投资诈骗有关的跨国犯罪集团，逮捕了六人，并查获了与该计划有关的 1,400 万港元。受害者多为长者，每人损失介乎3万至190万港元。

被捕人士为两男四女，年龄介乎52至66岁，怀疑是负责招募投资者及推广投资计划的核心成员。他们面临包括通过欺骗手段获取财产等指控。警方正在调查每名嫌疑人的角色，并相信该犯罪团伙的主谋是持有外国护照的人。
商业罪案调查科总督察朱明伦表示，自上个月以来，警方已接获21名市民举报。受害者表示，自2017年起，他们参与了当地一家公司“好好集团”提供的投资计划。据称，该公司利用各种借口，逃避按照投资合同约定支付承诺的利息和返还本金。

该公司声称在全球设有办事处，并表示在马来西亚经营多个沉香树种植园，生产和销售装饰品和精油等产品。据称，该公司拥有强大的盈利能力，甚至还安排投资者参观种植园。

过去几年，该公司推出了至少四项投资计划，其中一项投资计划为投资者以1万港元购买一棵沉香树，每月保证回报300港元，三年后可全额偿还本金。去年，该公司推出了一项计划，允许投资者成为授权经销商，拥有推广公司产品的权利和责任，并保证25%的回报。该公司后来推出了自己的加密货币，声称可以将沉香树代币化，但自推出以来该货币已贬值超过 99%。

警方表示，该公司利用各种借口拖延投资者的提款请求，逃避还款义务。
[![图片3：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

主编

负责 CLB.org.hk 报道和编辑标准的主编。

【原文 English Original】
Hong Kong
Hong Kong police have dismantled a transnational syndicate linked to agarwood tree investment fraud, arresting six people and seizing HK$14 million in connection with the scheme. Most victims were elderly, with losses ranging from HK$30,000 to HK$1.9 million.

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

15 Oct 2026 at 16:08 HKT · 2 min read

Hong Kong police have dismantled a transnational criminal syndicate linked to an agarwood tree investment scam, arresting six people and seizing HK$14 million in connection with the scheme. The victims, mostly elderly, suffered losses ranging from HK$30,000 to HK$1.9 million each.

The arrested individuals, two men and four women aged 52 to 66, are suspected of being core members responsible for recruiting investors and promoting the investment plans. They face charges including obtaining property by deception. Police are investigating the role of each suspect and believe the syndicate's mastermind is a person holding a foreign passport.

Chief Inspector Chu Ming-lun of the Commercial Crime Bureau said police have received reports from 21 citizens since last month. The victims said they had participated in investment plans offered by a local company, "Good Good Group", since 2017. The company allegedly used various excuses to avoid paying promised interest and returning principal amounts as agreed in the investment contracts.

The company claimed to have offices worldwide and said it operated multiple agarwood tree plantations in Malaysia, producing and selling products such as ornaments and essential oils. It allegedly boasted strong profitability and even arranged for investors to visit the plantations.

Over the past few years, the company launched at least four investment plans, including one where investors could buy an agarwood tree for HK$10,000, with a guaranteed monthly return of HK$300 and full principal repayment after three years. Last year, it introduced a plan allowing investors to become licensed distributors, with the right and responsibility to promote the company's products, guaranteeing a 25 per cent return. The company later launched its own cryptocurrency, claiming to tokenise agarwood trees, but the currency has depreciated by more than 99 per cent since its launch.

Police said the company used various excuses to delay investors' withdrawal requests, evading repayment obligations.

title: 美前太平洋司令称中国灰色地带策略“空洞”，促台湾强化战时拒止能力
summary: 华盛顿 — 美国前国家情报总监、海军退役四星上将丹尼斯·布莱尔(Dennis Blair)星期三(10月14日)表示，中国在台湾周边持续进行海空演习及灰色地带行动，主要目的在于制造恐惧并迫使台湾作出政治让步。他称这种依赖台湾“不战而降”的策略是“空洞的”，台湾真正需要强化的是战时阻止解放军取得制海权和制空权的能力，同时防范中国将军事演习突然转为攻击行动。 曾任美军太平洋司令部司令的布莱尔当天通过视频，在台湾海洋委员会主办的“2026海线安全国际会议”上发表主题演讲。会议聚焦中
content:
华盛顿 —

美国前国家情报总监、海军退役四星上将丹尼斯·布莱尔(Dennis Blair)星期三(10月14日)表示，中国在台湾周边持续进行海空演习及灰色地带行动，主要目的在于制造恐惧并迫使台湾作出政治让步。他称这种依赖台湾“不战而降”的策略是“空洞的”，台湾真正需要强化的是战时阻止解放军取得制海权和制空权的能力，同时防范中国将军事演习突然转为攻击行动。

曾任美军太平洋司令部司令的布莱尔当天通过视频，在台湾海洋委员会主办的“2026海线安全国际会议”上发表主题演讲。会议聚焦中国灰色地带行动、海上封锁威胁及台湾的海线安全韧性。所谓灰色地带行动，一般是指低于公开武装冲突门槛、但旨在逐步改变现状或对对手施压的军事及准军事活动。

**“目标是恫吓台湾”**

布莱尔说，中国通过军机、军舰及其他政府船只在台湾周边活动，试图让台湾民众和领导人相信，由于中国拥有更大的体量和军事实力，北京最终吞并台湾是不可避免的。

“这场海空行动的总体目标就是恫吓--恫吓台湾民众及其领导人，”布莱尔说。“中国试图制造一种印象：仅凭它更大的体量和实力，就必然能够吞并台湾。”

他表示，北京希望借助这种压力促使台湾政府作出政治让步，并让国际社会逐渐接受中国所希望的结果。

“然而，中国的策略是空洞的，”他说。“因为它依赖台湾在没有真正被征服的情况下投降，依赖台湾作出让步。”

布莱尔认为，台湾能否抵御北京要求其放弃主权的压力，最终取决于台湾是否具备在战争中阻止中国取得海空控制权的能力，而不是取决于解放军在和平时期能够派出多少舰艇和军机。

“台湾抗拒中国要求其交出主权的能力，取决于它能否在战时阻止中国控制海域和空域，”他说。“这并不取决于中国在和平时期的行动。”

**以“陆战思维”处理海洋问题**

布莱尔用中世纪欧洲军队围城作为类比。他说，古代军队通常包围城市、挖掘壕沟并逐步接近城墙，迫使守城一方相信防线终将被突破，从而选择投降。

但他认为，这种围城思维不适用于台湾，因为台湾周围是海洋，中国的军机和舰艇在附近活动，并不等同于陆军实际占领了台湾管辖的土地或突破了台湾防线。

“中国目前的灰色地带策略不是由水兵设计的，而是由陆军设计的，”布莱尔说。“陆军并不了解海洋环境，而是以陆战概念看待问题。”

他表示，解放军舰艇和军机数量增加并更加靠近台湾，固然可能引发警觉，但距离台湾更近也可能使它们在战争爆发时更加容易遭到攻击。

“我知道，看到数量更多的解放军舰艇和军机比过去更靠近台湾，可能令人不安，”他说。“但对一名职业海军军官来说，它们越靠近台湾，一旦战争爆发，也就越容易被摧毁。”

这些看法是布莱尔个人的军事判断。其他美国和台湾安全专家警告，解放军频繁在台湾附近活动，也可能缩短台湾方面的预警时间、消耗其防务资源，并使外界更难判断北京何时会从演习转向实际军事行动。

**防范演习突然转为攻击**

布莱尔承认，台湾和其他海洋国家不能因此忽视中国的行动。解放军近年来在台湾周边演练导弹及空中攻击、海上封锁等军事行动，台湾必须防范北京利用演习部署发动突袭。

“从军事角度而言，台湾必须警惕中国可能从演习状态转为攻击行动，”他说。

布莱尔表示，每当中国举行大规模海空演习时，台湾都应提高整体战备水平，周边国家的武装力量也应加强警戒，以免措手不及。

他认为，关键问题并不是解放军在和平时期能够派出多少兵力，而是台湾能否在友好国家支持下，于战时击败或阻止承担攻击任务的解放军部队。

“如果台湾有信心依靠自身能力，并在朋友支持下击败中国的战时侵略，那么中国的灰色地带声明和行动，就只能产生经过媒体放大的表面恫吓效果，”他说。

**加强监控、执法和公共外交**

布莱尔建议台湾密切监视中国在周边海域的军方、海警、科考和民用船只活动，审慎配置执法资源，并运用无人系统、卫星、雷达和社交媒体等工具，及时向国内外公布相关活动。

他说，如果中国舰艇或飞机接近台湾领海或领空，应受到警告和伴随监视；如果实施发射武器、派遣突击队登陆，或侵害台湾民众和财产等敌对行为，则应受到制止，必要时可以使用武力。

布莱尔还呼吁台湾加强公共外交，用持续且具有新意的方式向国际社会说明中国行动的性质。

“台湾不能允许中国在国际公众认知中建立一个‘新常态’，”他说。最重要的是，台湾应强化并展示其军队和社会在战时反制中国海空攻击的能力。

布莱尔也肯定台湾近年来将“汉光演习”从以军方为主的演练，扩大为包含民防和全社会韧性的防卫演习。他认为，台湾展现保卫自身的决心和能力，有助于争取理念相近国家在危机发生时提供支持。

**中国扩大台湾东部海域活动**

布莱尔发表上述评论之际，中国军方、海警、科考船和其他公务船近年来持续扩大在台湾周边的活动。

路透社上星期援引台湾民营航空公司安捷航空(Apex Aviation)的监控报告说，该公司一架侦察机今年8月在台湾花莲海岸约50公里外，发现被台湾方面认定为中国海上民兵船的“闽福鼎渔07902”，与中国海警2502舰及“向阳红03号”科考船在同一区域活动。这是已知中国海上民兵船首次出现在台湾东部海域。相关船只当时均在台湾所称的“限制水域”以外。

台湾国防部指责中国以执法和科研为掩护扩大非冲突状态下的行动范围，试图制造拥有“事实管辖权”的假象。中国国台办和国防部没有回应路透社就这起事件提出的置评请求。

美国国务院随后对美国之音表示，中国在台湾以东的行动“深度破坏稳定”，只会加剧紧张局势。美国敦促北京停止对台湾施压，转而与台湾民选当局展开有意义的对话。

北京主张台湾是中国领土的一部分，并表示不排除使用武力实现统一。台湾政府拒绝北京的主权声索，强调台湾的未来只能由台湾人民决定。

# Wipe Away Su Lee's Tears from her Composing Nights

Dear friends, music lovers, and new music supporters,It’s me, Su Lee, and I am currently working on my dissertation concert (for my Ph.D. in composition) which will be held on Sept. 9th 2019 Monday at 7:30pm in Lippes Concert Hall in Slee Hall at University at Buffalo.The title of my dissertation composition and concert is Die Radikalen Tasten (The Radical Keys) in terms of aesthetics, Klang (sound), and theme.I am writing a concerto for organ with keyboard ensemble, namely for our own tremendous Fisk Op.95 organ at UB. It will involve organ soloist with 1 assistant, 2 pianos (1 quarter-tone flat piano), 2 harpsichords (1 quarter-tone flat harpsichord), and 2 vibraphones which is a very rare instrumentation for microtonal new music. The 1st half of the program features significant keyboard works from the 20th century such as Messiaen's solo organ work and Ives's quarter-tone piano pieces. As a special request from Dr. Fuller, who was in charge of the installation of the Fisk Op.95 organ at UB, I'm playing my very first organ transcription of Wagner's orchestral work.The 2nd half of the program features my own 'radical' politically inspired compositions including a choral piece with organ accompaniment (dedicated to the UUCB Choir family) and my dissertation organ concerto. Both works are based on the Korean Democratic Uprising in May 1980 and the protest song written for the victims of the subsequent Gwangju massacre - a song that has became widely popular for activists and protesters, including those participating in the on-going Hong Kong protests.Overall, it is a very colorful and unique combination and a rare program which is a you-don’t-want-to-miss concert.I am modestly asking you for a little or big help in making my dissertation concert happen smoothly, especially given my financial struggles in not being able to even work legally for money off campus in America due to my visa status.Your generous donation will be spent towards, (besides helping me wipe away all my tears and whining from composing numerous nights over the past few months and rehearsing in the upcoming days and nights):Nine Musicians’ Performance Fee, about $3,000 – 3,300Rent/Labor for Lippes Concert Hall in Slee Hall, about $1,000Other concert related costs; buying performing materials, copying/binding score/parts, printing poster/program book, audio/video recording, photographing, tuning, reception, etc. about $1,200 – 1,500In Total $5,200 – 5,800Fortunately, I got awarded the MDRF (research fund) for $3,000 at UB so that I can be reimbursed afterwards, but I need money upfront now to pay first, and possibly more, to pay my dream team musicians fairly and to cover other costs.Your genuine help means SO MUCH to me being an international Ph.D. student with many restrictions on earning money (3 months summer break without job, seriously!), as it will lighten my financial burdens and psychological anxiety when I absolutely need to focus more on my creative activities. Simply speaking, you are contributing to a potentially "fabulous" new music piece, stimulating my further musical activities and making me believe that life (and the world) is so beautiful!Every single one of your names will be acknowledged in my concert program book, and to thank you all, but not nearly enough, I like to give you in return as below:$1~$49: a thank-you-card with a cover of a handwritten excerpt of my score$50~$99: a thank-you-card like above AND a dvd of my dissertation concert (after my concert)$100~$199: a thank-you-card AND a dvd like above, PLUS the autographed full score of my dissertation composition$200~$299: EVERYTHING above AND one additional dvd of my Masters organ recitals (your choice of “Über den Namen B-A-C-H” or “Celebrating Lou Harrison’s 100th Birth-Year at Thunder Night”)$300 or more: EVERYTHING above, PLUS a gift pack of Korean snacks/sweets/tea etc.Please write me an email with your home address!I am really excited to prepare my dissertation concert. Though I feel like this is sadly going to be my last self designed concert during my time in Buffalo (at UB), so I cannot wait to see many of you there!Thank you so much for reading this and considering your donation. I promise to pay you back with my "fabulous" new compositions and my performance, with the great help of my dream team of musician fellows!Please feel free to spread the link to your social pages like Facebook, Instagram, or Twitter, or to emails, to help get the word out! FYI, I am collecting your donations from now till October and GoFundMe takes 2.9% for transaction fee plus $0.30 PER Donation. Or you can donate by sending me a check to my place (email me for asking my address please!)Fondly,Su Lee

PHILIPPINE Feng Shui Queen Marites Allen unveiled her exclusive Year of the Fire Sheep 2027 forecast at her annual media press conference at Spaces, Penthouse, World Plaza Tower, Bonifacio Global City (BGC), on Oct. 12, 2026.

[![Image 1: 2027 FORECAST Marites Allen unveils her exclusive Year of the Fire Sheep 2027 forecast at her annual media press conference at Spaces, Penthouse, World Plaza Tower, Bonifacio Global City, on Oct. 12, 2026. PHOTO FROM MARITES ALLEN ](https://manilatimes.net/manilatimes/uploads/images/2026/10/14/1258838.jpg)](https://manilatimes.net/manilatimes/uploads/images/2026/10/14/1258838.jpg)
2027 FORECAST Marites Allen unveils her exclusive Year of the Fire Sheep 2027 forecast at her annual media press conference at Spaces, Penthouse, World Plaza Tower, Bonifacio Global City, on Oct. 12, 2026. PHOTO FROM MARITES ALLEN

The briefing covered prosperity, careers, relationships and the 12 animal signs, alongside Destara – Destiny Is in Your Stars – her pioneering artificial intelligence (AI) lifestyle and destiny-guidance platform.

“Briefly, 2026 was about movement; 2027 is about making that movement meaningful,” Allen said.

**2027: A year to build, nurture and grow**

[![Image 2: YEAR OF THE SHEEP In Chinese calendar, the Year of the Sheep begins on Feb. 6, 2027 and this year the element is Fire, which encourages inspiration and visibility. IMAGE FROM MARITES ALLEN](https://manilatimes.net/manilatimes/uploads/images/2026/10/14/1258839.png)](https://manilatimes.net/manilatimes/uploads/images/2026/10/14/1258839.png)
YEAR OF THE SHEEP In Chinese calendar, the Year of the Sheep begins on Feb. 6, 2027 and this year the element is Fire, which encourages inspiration and visibility. IMAGE FROM MARITES ALLEN

The lunar Year of the Fire Sheep begins Feb. 6, 2027.

For Four Pillars calculations, the astrological year turns at the traditional Beginning of Spring, around Feb. 4.

In Allen’s interpretation, Yin Fire encourages inspiration and visibility, while Sheep Earth favors responsibility and lasting results.

The absence of visible metal in her annual destiny chart places added emphasis on structure, clear agreements and accountability.

Her global outlook highlights preparation for developments in AI, business transformation, infrastructure and financial resilience.

Under Allen’s annual Flying Star chart, the Southeast holds the No. 8 Wealth Star; the Northwest, No. 1 Victory Star; the Southwest, No. 6 Mentor Star; and the South, No. 4 Romance and Scholastic Star. The No. 9 Future Prosperity Star occupies the Center. Greater care is advised in the North, West, Northeast and East.

**The 12 animal signs: Marites Allen’s exclusive outlook**

*   ![Image 3: Marcos’ impeachment plot backfires](https://miopia.newsroom.bi/statics/i/ps/manilatimes.net/manilatimes/uploads/images/2026/10/13/1258203.jpg?width=113&crop=113:85)
[Marcos’ impeachment plot backfires](https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/10/14/opinion/columns/marcos-impeachment-plot-backfires/2444878)

**Winners – Prosperity and Progress:**Boar (allies and new beginnings), Horse (connections and learning), Dog (victory, with diplomacy needed), Dragon (wealth and recognition) and Snake (strategy and partnerships).

**Stable – Growth and Opportunities:** Monkey (mentors and guidance), Sheep (leadership and personal growth) and Rabbit (supportive relationships, balanced by caution over finances and trust under the No. 7 Star).

**Challengers – Navigate with Care:** Tiger (thoughtful communication), Rooster (wellness and balance), Rat (savings and clarity) and Ox (diplomacy and due diligence).

Allen emphasizes that these are general annual tendencies: “Individual destiny charts matter more than the animal sign alone.”

A full chart requires exact birth details and verified calendar and time calculations.

**On politics and accountability**

Asked about current political issues, Allen declined to speculate on individual outcomes and emphasized fairness and due process.

“Everyone deserves due process and the right to be heard. Feng Shui may guide us in understanding the times, but it cannot decide legal matters. When an issue reaches that stage, it is no longer in the stars; it is in the hands of the law,” she told _The Manila Times_ for this exclusive otherwise off-the-record question.

**Destara: The Marites Allen IP Brain**

Destara grew from a practical challenge: intense demand for Allen’s time, particularly around Chinese New Year.

[![Image 4: DESTINY-GUIDANCE PLATFORM DESTARA – Destiny Is in Your Stars – is Allen’s pioneering artificial intelligence lifestyle and destiny-guidance platform, on Google Play for Android users; iPhone users may scan its official QR code or visit destara.app in a browser to download. iMAGE FROM MARITES ALLEN](https://manilatimes.net/manilatimes/uploads/images/2026/10/14/1258840.png)](https://manilatimes.net/manilatimes/uploads/images/2026/10/14/1258840.png)
DESTINY-GUIDANCE PLATFORM DESTARA – Destiny Is in Your Stars – is Allen’s pioneering artificial intelligence lifestyle and destiny-guidance platform, on Google Play for Android users; iPhone users may scan its official QR code or visit destara.app in a browser to download. iMAGE FROM MARITES ALLEN

Technology professionals in her family, including those working in data science and software architecture for international clients, helped inspire a platform that could make her knowledge more accessible.

For Allen, a Computer Science graduate who later earned an MBA from the Ateneo Graduate School of Business, the venture brings together her original training and professional practice.

The proprietary Marites Allen IP Brain is being developed around her Feng Shui methods and precise chart-calculation rules.

General-purpose AI models can explain concepts, but should not be relied upon alone to produce verified, personalized Four Pillars charts.

Destara continues to be refined and is intended to complement, not replace, professional consultations.

“Use AI responsibly. It should strengthen your judgment, not replace it. If you refuse to learn how to use it, you may be overtaken by someone who does,” she said.

Allen also views the platform as a legacy project, created to preserve and extend her life’s work for future generations.

**Publications, access and media contact**

Allen also presented the Marites Allen 2027 Horoscope Guides, Feng Shui Almanac 2027 and Feng Shui Planner 2027.

The Marites Allen × INA Fine Jewellery collection is available by private inquiry only.

Destara is available on Google Play for Android users. iPhone users may scan its official QR code or visit destara.app in a browser; the dedicated App Store version is coming soon.

The 2027 books are available at frigga.com.ph and through Frigga Charmed Life on Shopee and Lazada.

The beauty of Feng Shui, Allen says, lies in preparation and knowing when to let go, “And peace is priceless,” she asserts.

Her guiding principle remains: “Feng Shui is a forecast, not a prediction.”

**Coming up**

Follow Marites Allen on her official social media channels for her 2027 Chinese New Year forecast and media appearances.

Pre-book your seats for the February 5, 2027 Chinese New Year Countdown at Manila House Private Members’ Club, BGC: 0920 950 9390.

Shop Marites Allen 2027 Almanac, Planner & Horoscope Guides at title: HKUMed to host World Health Summit Regional Meeting 2027 in Hong Kong
zh_title: 港大医学院将于香港主办2027年世界健康峰会区域会议
summary: 香港 香港将于 2027 年 5 月首次主办由香港大学医学院主办的世界健康峰会区域会议。该活动以“健康跨界”为主题，预计将吸引约2,000名参与者前往香港会议展览中心。 [![图片 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编 2026 年 10 月 14 日香港时间 04:09 · 1 分钟阅读香港李嘉诚医学院 (HKUMed) 正式接获主办世界卫生大会的接力棒
content:
香港
香港将于2027年5月首次主办由香港大学医学院主办的世界健康峰会区域会议。该活动以“健康跨界”为主题，预计将吸引约2,000名参与者前往香港会议展览中心。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

2026 年 10 月 14 日 04:09 香港时间 · 阅读时间 1 分钟

香港大学李嘉诚医学院（HKUMed）正式接手在中国香港举办2027年世界健康峰会（WHS）区域会议的接力棒。交接于 2026 年 10 月 11 日在柏林举行的 WHS 开幕之夜举行，2026 年主办国内罗毕接替了这一角色。

该会议定于 2027 年 5 月 7 日至 9 日在香港会议展览中心举行，这将标志着香港首次主办全球健康对话的领先国际平台。此次活动以“健康跨越国界”为主题，预计将迎来约2,000人参加。

即将上任的2027年世界健康峰会国际主席兼港大医学院院长刘泽声教授表示：“从内罗毕接过接力棒是一种荣幸，港大医学院已准备好帮助塑造全球卫生合作的新篇章。我们将利用香港作为超级联络人的角色，将领导者和变革者聚集在一起。”
港大医学院于2024年加入WHS学术联盟，成为香港首间加入国际学术网络的院校。它被选为 2027 年区域会议的主办国，突显了它与全球卫生界日益密切的接触。

世界卫生峰会主席阿克塞尔·R·普里斯教授表示，区域会议将区域优先事项和专业知识提升到全球卫生对话中，2027 年会议将为合作应对卫生挑战提供一个中心平台。

会议将举行 40 多场会议，涵盖五个主题：健康公平；数字时代的健康；伙伴关系作为健康之路；科学与创新；以及卫生政策的多部门性。恰逢香港特别行政区成立30周年及香港大学医学院成立140周年。

[![图片3：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

主编

负责 CLB.org.hk 报道和编辑标准的主编。

【原文 English Original】
Hong Kong
Hong Kong will host the World Health Summit Regional Meeting for the first time in May 2027, organised by HKUMed. The event, themed 'Health Across Borders', is expected to draw about 2,000 participants to the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre.

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

14 Oct 2026 at 04:09 HKT · 1 min read

The University of Hong Kong's LKS Faculty of Medicine (HKUMed) has officially received the baton to host the World Health Summit (WHS) Regional Meeting 2027 in Hong Kong, China. The handover took place at the WHS Opening Night in Berlin on October 11, 2026, with Nairobi, the 2026 host, passing on the role.

The meeting, scheduled for May 7 to 9, 2027, at the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre, will mark the first time Hong Kong hosts the leading international platform for global health dialogue. Under the theme "Health Across Borders", the event is expected to welcome about 2,000 participants.

Professor Lau Chak-sing, incoming International President of the World Health Summit 2027 and Dean of Medicine at HKU, said: "Receiving the baton from Nairobi is such a privilege, and HKUMed is ready to help shape the next chapter of global health collaboration. We will harness our city's role as a super connector to bring together leaders and changemakers."

HKUMed joined the WHS Academic Alliance in 2024, becoming the first institution from Hong Kong to join the international academic network. Its selection to host the 2027 Regional Meeting underscored its growing engagement with the global health community.

Professor Axel R. Pries, President of the World Health Summit, said the regional meetings elevate regional priorities and expertise to the global health dialogue, and that the 2027 meeting will provide a central platform for collaboration on health challenges.

The meeting will feature more than 40 sessions across five thematic tracks: Equity in Health; Health in the Digital Era; Partnerships as Pathways in Health; Science and Innovation; and the Multi-sectorality of Health Policy. It will coincide with the 30th anniversary of the Hong Kong SAR and HKUMed's 140th anniversary.

title: PH qualifies for AFC U17 Women’s Asian Cup
summary: THE Philippine Under-17 Women’s National Football Team (Filipinas U17) qualified for the AFC U17 Women’s Asian Cup for the third consecutive time, sweeping Group H of the 2027 qualifying tournament with a 3-0 win over Bangladesh on Sunday a
content:
THE Philippine Under-17 Women’s National Football Team (Filipinas U17) qualified for the AFC U17 Women’s Asian Cup for the third consecutive time, sweeping Group H of the 2027 qualifying tournament with a 3-0 win over Bangladesh on Sunday at Do’stlik Stadium Training Pitch 1 in Tashkent, Uzbekistan.

The Philippines had earlier beaten host Uzbekistan, 4-0, on Oct. 5.

“Qualifying once is an achievement. Qualifying three times in a row tells us the work behind this program is sustainable. Each batch of the Filipinas U17 has built on the one before it, and we are proud of every player, staff member and supporter who made this possible,” said PFF President John Anthony Gutierrez.

*   [Eala slump continues with Wuhan exit](https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/10/14/sports/eala-slump-continues-with-wuhan-exit/2445012)

Bangladesh held the Philippines scoreless for 72 minutes. Noelle Granger had a shot in front saved by goalkeeper Meghla Rani Roy in the fifth minute and Aryanna Capsa’s shot from the left was saved in the sixth. Ariana Enderes’ lob from the top was saved in the 16th, and Granger’s running shot from the right was saved in the 24th.

Bangladesh created chances of its own before halftime. Defender Mousumi Akter headed a left corner slightly wide in the 44th minute, and striker Alpi Akter’s lob from outside the box hit the crossbar in first-half stoppage time.

The Philippines broke through in the 73rd minute. Right back Maya Rose Bascara tapped the ball in during a scramble after a left corner. Goalkeeper Abigail Garcia kept the lead intact in the 79th by saving Alpi Akter in a one-on-one counterattack.

Granger sealed the result late. In the 90th minute, she scored from the front right off a nifty midfield through ball from substitute Ariana Gementiza.

Granger completed her brace less than a minute later, scoring again off a running strike, after Savannah Chheng’s interception and long ball. The incoming Florida Gator scored five goals in the two qualification games, having scored a hat trick against Uzbekistan last Monday.

*   ![Image 1: Marcos’ impeachment plot backfires](https://miopia.newsroom.bi/statics/i/ps/manilatimes.net/manilatimes/uploads/images/2026/10/13/1258203.jpg?width=113&crop=113:85)
[Marcos’ impeachment plot backfires](https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/10/14/opinion/columns/marcos-impeachment-plot-backfires/2444878)

The result extends a run of Asian Cup qualifications by the Filipinas U17, and players from earlier batches are now part of the senior Filipinas squad. Alexa Pino, Jael Guy and Ariana Markey of Batch ’24, and Aiselyn Sia, Tea Pidding and Leah Bradley of Batch ’26, are now regular members of the national team. The senior Filipinas are seeking a second straight FIFA Women’s World Cup appearance next year.

“Sustainable excellence means a young player can see a path from the U17 team to the senior national team. Alexa, Jael, Ariana, Aiselyn, Tea and Leah are examples of that path, and they are helping the Filipinas as the senior team pursues a second straight World Cup. We want every new batch to follow them, and we are seeing great potential in the current U17 Filipinas,” Gutierrez said.

Team manager Selu Lozano said the qualification is an achievement the whole team shares.

**“Credit goes to our players, coaches, staff and everyone who has supported this journey,” he said.**

[Court agrees to drop 3 charges vs VP Sara](https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/10/14/news/court-agrees-to-drop-3-charges-vs-vp-sara/2444853)

He also credited former Filipinas head coach Alen Stajcic for his guidance during the tournament.

Filipinas U17 will set their sights on the 2027 AFC U17 Women’s Asian Cup in April 2027 in China. The tournament’s draw will be held in December 2026.

title: Hong Kong police investigate 110 credit card fraud cases in Apple foldable phone pre-orders, losses hit HK$4.6 million
zh_title: 香港警方调查110起苹果折叠手机预购信用卡诈骗案 损失达460万港元
summary: 香港 香港警方已收到超过 110 起与苹果最新可折叠手机预购有关的信用卡诈骗举报，损失总计约 460 万港元。最大单笔亏损近23万港元。警方对苹果公司没有启动 3DS 认证表示遗憾，这是一项标准 [![图片 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编 2026 年 10 月 17 日， 17:02 HKT · 2 分钟读 香港警方已收到超过 110 份来自居民的举报
content:
香港
香港警方已收到超过 110 起与苹果最新可折叠手机预购有关的信用卡诈骗举报，损失总计约 460 万港元。最大单笔亏损近23万港元。警方对苹果公司未激活 3DS 认证表示遗憾，这是一项标准

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

2026 年 10 月 17 日，香港时间 17:02 · 阅读 2 分钟

香港警方已收到超过110起居民举报，涉嫌未经授权使用信用卡预购苹果最新款可折叠手机，总损失约460万港元。警方10月17日称，单笔最大损失近23万港元，涉及多家银行。

警方已将案件列为“以诈骗手段获取财物”，并移交网络安全及科技罪案调查科调查。警方表示，对此类事件再次发生高度关注。
网络安全及科技罪案调查科高级督察罗港江表示，继上一次iPhone 18 Pro预购诈骗事件发生后，警方、香港金融管理局和银行界已严肃对待此事。除了刑事调查外，警方还与苹果公司保持密切联系，探讨一切可行的预防措施。罗援引苹果公司的话说，它已采取一些措施，包括审查和调整其欺诈风险模型以及加强交易监控。

罗指出，警方曾多次建议苹果公司启动3DS，这是一种国际通用的在线信用卡交易验证机制，要求持卡人完成额外的身份验证，例如输入一次性密码或通过银行的移动应用程序进行确认。然而，苹果在前一天晚上的预购活动中仍未激活3DS，未能有效阻止类似的欺诈行为。警方对苹果公司没有积极履行企业责任，给不法分子留下可乘之机表示高度关注和深切遗憾。
警方敦促苹果公司尽快采取有效的预防措施，包括激活3DS，以防止类似的欺诈行为再次发生。他们提醒公众，如果发现信用卡上有可疑交易，请立即通知发卡银行、苹果公司和警方。罗表示，警方将继续与苹果公司密切合作，尽快取消所有可疑交易，以确保居民不遭受损失。

对于此前发生的iPhone 18 Pro预购欺诈事件，警方表示，涉及大量交易数据的调查仍在进行中。至今，已接获1,572宗举报，涉案金额约3,100万港元，尚未有人被捕。

Hong Kong police have received over 110 reports of credit card fraud linked to pre-orders of Apple's latest foldable phone, with losses totalling about HK$4.6 million. [![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

17 Oct 2026 at 17:02 HKT · 2 min read

Hong Kong police have received more than 110 reports from residents whose credit cards were allegedly used without authorisation to pre-order Apple's latest foldable phone, with total losses amounting to about HK$4.6 million. The largest single loss was nearly HK$230,000, and multiple banks are involved, police said on 17 October.

The police have classified the cases as “obtaining property by deception” and handed them over to the Cyber Security and Technology Crime Bureau for investigation. The force said it is highly concerned about the recurrence of such incidents.

Senior Inspector Lo Kong-kong of the Cyber Security and Technology Crime Bureau said that after the previous iPhone 18 Pro pre-order fraud, police, the Hong Kong Monetary Authority and the banking sector had taken the matter seriously. Apart from criminal investigations, police have maintained close contact with Apple to explore all feasible preventive measures. Lo cited Apple as saying it had taken some steps, including reviewing and adjusting its fraud risk model and increasing transaction monitoring.

Lo noted that police had repeatedly advised Apple to activate 3DS, an internationally used online credit card transaction verification mechanism that requires cardholders to complete additional authentication, such as entering a one-time password or confirming via a bank's mobile app. However, Apple had still not activated 3DS during the pre-order event the previous evening, failing to effectively block similar fraud. Police expressed high concern and deep regret that Apple had not actively fulfilled its corporate responsibilities, leaving loopholes for criminals to exploit.

Police urged Apple to implement effective preventive measures as soon as possible, including activating 3DS, to prevent similar fraud from recurring. They reminded the public to immediately notify their issuing bank, Apple and the police if they spot suspicious transactions on their credit cards. Lo said police would continue to work closely with Apple to cancel all suspicious transactions as soon as possible to ensure residents do not suffer losses.

Regarding the earlier iPhone 18 Pro pre-order fraud, police said the investigation involving a large volume of transaction data was still ongoing. So far, 1,572 reports have been received, involving about HK$31 million, and no arrests have been made yet.

# Taiwanese visits to China rise nearly 20% despite travel warning: Agency

10/17/2026 04:19 PM

[](jsvscript:)[](jsvscript:)[](javascript:void(0))[Listen](javascript:)
