title: Strategic Implications of the US-China Summit - International Institute for Iranian Studies
summary: 12:14 pm - 15 Oct 2026 The recent bilateral [summit](https://www.whitehouse.gov/fact-sheets/2026/09/fact-sheet-president-donald-j-trump-advances-a-fair-and-reciprocal-relationship-with-china-while-hosting-historic-state-visit/) between US P
content:
12:14 pm - 15 Oct 2026

The recent bilateral [summit](https://www.whitehouse.gov/fact-sheets/2026/09/fact-sheet-president-donald-j-trump-advances-a-fair-and-reciprocal-relationship-with-china-while-hosting-historic-state-visit/) between US President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping in Washington highlighted the complex, transactional state of global superpower relations. While the meeting was framed as an effort to restore strategic stability, it primarily underscored deep structural divergence across technology policy, trade sanctions and regional security conflicts. High-stakes negotiations over artificial intelligence (AI) governance remains stalled beneath intense commercial competition. Meanwhile, the economic fallout from the escalating conflict with Iran has exposed limits in Washington’s tariff enforcement and sanctions posture. These realities demonstrate a dynamic where both nations pursue tactical economic flexibility while advancing aggressive strategic rivalry, mirroring the multifront economic statecraft of Cold War strategic balancing.

This strategic divergence is most acute in the AI race, where the competition over AI is rapidly accelerating across hardware infrastructure and model deployment. US technological dominance relies on massive capital expenditure. According to the [Stanford AI Index Report](https://hai.stanford.edu/assets/files/ai_index_report_2026.pdf), private US investment in AI reached $285.9 billion in 2025, far outpacing China’s direct private spending of $12.4 billion. Individual US cloud technology providers are committing upwards of $150 billion in annual infrastructure spend to maintain compute dominance. The US economy has become heavily tied to this infrastructure buildout, with equity markets and national growth increasingly dependent on sustained corporate spending.

China is countering this capital disparity through an aggressive [open-source model ecosystem](https://www.uscc.gov/sites/default/files/2026-03/Two_Loops--How_Chinas_Open_AI_Strategy_Reinforces_Its_Industrial_Dominance.pdf). By distributing high-performing open-source weights globally, Chinese tech developers compress inference pricing and put severe commercial pressure on proprietary US AI firms. US companies must justify hundreds of billions in capital expenditures while competing against comparable open-source alternatives that reduce deployment costs globally. This structural split carries profound economic and geopolitical consequences for the trajectory of the technology race, resembling historical Cold War efforts to build sphere-of-influence technology networks. As US firms shoulder the immense cost of training proprietary frontier models, Chinese open-source releases lower token costs, directly undercutting US enterprise margins and lowering long-term returns on capital. Furthermore, by making open-source models the default choice for cost-conscious foreign enterprises and Global South economies, Beijing embeds its technological ecosystem globally and builds systemic dependency without violating Western hardware controls. This architectural gap ultimately paralyzes regulatory progress, as Washington focuses on frontier safety risks and intellectual property protections, while Beijing leverages open distribution to counter Western containment, rendering joint oversight improbable.

Efforts toward bilateral AI regulation face severe structural challenges amidst these divergent strategies. Both governments remain intentionally vague on governance standards, preferring strategic ambiguity over binding limits that might restrict native development. US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent [noted](https://es.tradingview.com/news/benzinga:e3d5d00f2094b:0-scott-bessent-says-us-china-to-meet-in-2-months-on-ai-threats-we-want-to-start-discussing-protocols/) that follow-up bilateral talks might occur in Shenzhen in two months, yet no formal agenda or firm date has been set. With neither state willing to risk technological subordination, effective joint oversight remains improbable.

Beyond technological friction, broader economic vulnerabilities stemming from the Middle East crisis have severely constrained Washington’s capacity to execute its trade strategy against Beijing. China’s primary exposure in the conflict stems from its energy import structure, as maritime blockades and shipping threats around Iranian ports and the Strait of Hormuz have disrupted Beijing’s direct purchases of Iranian crude, forcing Chinese state refiners to rely more heavily on Russian and Gulf-based alternatives. At the same time, surging global energy costs driven by these Middle Eastern disruptions forced pragmatic tactical adjustments in US foreign policy. The US decision to strike a supply deal with Moscow alongside the US Treasury Department’s OFAC license [authorizing](https://ofac.treasury.gov/recent-actions/20261009_33) Russian-origin diesel fuel imports, aimed at delivering massive volumes of diesel to global and domestic markets, demonstrates how energy inflation overrides broader economic pressure campaigns.

This shift directly weakens the credibility of enforcement under legislative frameworks such as the [Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act](https://www.whitehouse.gov/briefings-statements/2026/09/congressional-bill-h-r-5334-signed-into-law/), which mandates targeted secondary tariff penalties of up to 100% on major importers of Russian energy assets. China remains the premier buyer of Russian crude oil and secondary energy products. Expecting Beijing to comply with US tariff demands or secondary sanctions becomes unenforceable when Washington grants itself policy carve-outs to stabilize domestic fuel supplies. When domestic macroeconomic conditions threaten consumer stability, primary sanctions mechanisms lose deterrence power. Beijing recognizes that the United States cannot simultaneously manage severe Middle Eastern energy disruptions and enforce aggressive tariff schedules against its largest trade partner without inducing economic self-harm.

During summit discussions, the escalation in Iran reflected a shared tactical desire to contain broader regional spillover rather than a sign of strategic alignment. Xi emphasized preserving freedom of navigation through the Strait of Hormuz to safeguard global maritime trade and secure critical energy transit for Chinese industrial needs. For Washington, keeping critical shipping lanes open is essential to preventing secondary oil shocks from further worsening domestic fuel inflation. While both leaders voiced support for de-escalation frameworks and protecting international shipping, Beijing stopped short of offering concrete commitments to reduce its economic ties with Tehran or join Western pressure campaigns. This posture preserves China’s flexibility across the Middle East while leaving US diplomatic and financial bandwidth tied down in regional crisis management.

Ultimately, the latest summit confirms that US-China relations are governed by transactional balancing rather than comprehensive reconciliation. In technology, heavy US capital investment faces persistent pressure from Chinese open-source innovation, while structured AI regulation remains stalled. In trade, US energy vulnerabilities arising from the Middle East conflict have undermined tariff policy consistency. As long as global energy shocks and technological competition persist, bilateral engagement will produce tactical pauses rather than long-term strategic alignment.

title: Hong Kong consumer body logs 29 moving complaints in first nine months, urges clearer pricing
zh_title: 香港消费者协会前九个月收到29起感人投诉，敦促更清晰的定价
summary: 香港消费者委员会今年首9个月共收到29宗有关搬家服务的投诉，高于去年同期的25宗。争议包括含糊的报价和延误以及损害赔偿。该委员会敦促公司提前披露附加费和索赔条款，并建议消费者这样做 [![图 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编 10 月 15 日2026 at 10:42 HKT · 3 分钟读 消费者委员会称已接获 29 宗有关搬家的投诉
content:
香港
今年首9个月，消费者委员会共收到29宗有关搬家服务的投诉，较去年同期的25宗有所增加。争议包括含糊的报价和延误以及损害赔偿。该委员会敦促公司提前披露附加费和索赔条款，并建议消费者这样做

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

香港时间 2026 年 10 月 15 日 10:42 · 阅读时间 3 分钟

消委会表示，今年首9个月共接获29宗有关搬家服务的投诉，高于去年同期的25宗。该委员会在周四的一份声明中表示，争议涉及广泛的问题，包括报价不明确、服务延误和损坏物品的赔偿。

该委员会敦促业界提高信息透明度，并表示各种特殊费用的计算标准，以及家具损坏或延迟交货的索赔条款和机制，应在报价时向消费者提供和解释。
在该委员会引用的一个案例中，一个计划从香港搬迁到澳大利亚墨尔本的家庭在一月份聘请了一家公司进行海外搬迁。由于货品不多，他们选择拼柜运输，总成本约28,000港元。由于该批货物需等待其他货物装满集装箱，服务合同中未注明交货日期，投诉人一直等待该公司的装运通知。 2月初，该公司表示预计货物将在月底发货，但随后没有进一步的更新。 3月初，该公司表示发货日期不得不推迟至3月下旬，但仍无法提供确认的船期。由于担心货物取货后延误可能无限期地持续两个多月，申诉人向市议会寻求帮助。
在另一宗个案中，投诉人以约港币9,000元聘请一家公司搬运家居用品，包括一台75寸液晶电视。该公司还负责对无法装入盒子的大型电器进行简单包装和保护。投诉人其后发现电视屏幕上方有明显裂纹，开机后屏幕无法正常显示图像。投诉人向搬家公司索要赔偿，但该公司只给予港币300元。投诉人表示，该电视机虽然已使用一年，但购买价格约为11,000港元，并以远低于电视机价值为由拒绝了报价。双方未能达成协议，申诉人向市议会求助。

The Consumer Council received 29 complaints about moving services in the first nine months of this year, up from 25 a year earlier. Disputes ranged from vague quotes and delays to damage compensation. The council urged firms to disclose surcharges and claims terms upfront and advised consumers to do

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

15 Oct 2026 at 10:42 HKT · 3 min read

The Consumer Council said it had received 29 complaints about moving services in the first nine months of this year, up from 25 in the same period last year. The disputes covered a wide range of issues, including unclear quotations, service delays and compensation for damaged belongings, the council said in a statement on Thursday.

The council urged the industry to improve information transparency, saying that the calculation criteria for various special charges, as well as the terms and mechanisms for claiming compensation for damaged furniture or delayed deliveries, should be provided and explained to consumers at the time of quotation.

In one case cited by the council, a family planning to relocate from Hong Kong to Melbourne, Australia, hired a company in January for an overseas move. As the items were not numerous, they chose a consolidated container shipment at a total cost of about HK$28,000. Because the shipment had to wait for other cargo to fill the container, no delivery date was stated in the service contract, and the complainant kept waiting for the company's shipping notice. In early February, the company said the goods were expected to be shipped by the end of that month, but no further update followed. In early March, the company said the shipment date had to be postponed to late March, but still could not provide a confirmed vessel schedule. Concerned that the delay might continue indefinitely more than two months after the goods were collected, the complainant sought help from the council.

In another case, a complainant hired a company to move household items, including a 75-inch liquid crystal display television, for about HK$9,000. The company was also responsible for simple packaging and protection of large appliances that could not fit into boxes. The complainant later found obvious cracks on the top of the television screen, and after switching it on, the screen could not display images properly. The complainant asked the moving company for compensation, but the company offered only HK$300. The complainant said the television, although used for a year, had been bought for about HK$11,000, and rejected the offer as far below the set's value. The two sides failed to reach an agreement, and the complainant turned to the council.

The council advised consumers to ask moving firms about the features and charges of different transport methods in advance, agree on expected shipping and arrival dates, and keep records or ask for such details to be written into the service contract or invoice. It noted that overseas moves involve uncontrollable factors such as customs clearance, and recommended consumers leave flexibility in their moving and move-in arrangements.

The council also suggested consumers prepare an inventory of items before moving and take photos of valuable, large or fragile goods to record their condition beforehand. If the company offers packing and appliance protection services, consumers should check that boxes are properly sealed and protection is secure, and number the boxes for easy counting upon arrival.

# HELP BRING MY SON BACK HOME

My name is Nelson Wells, Sr. and I write to you on behalf of my wife, Cynthia Wells, and our family, asking for your assistance in our fight to bring home our son, Nelson Wells, Jr., who has been unjustly imprisoned in China for more than eight years. We are natives of Louisiana, who have served our country for decades. I served in the United States Army for more than 20 years, and Cynthia, served at the Department of Defense for nearly 28 years. We’ve traveled all over the United States and world and have a host of extended family and friends, who join us in the fight for our son. This includes Nelson’s wife and three children, who are desperate to have him returned to our family unit. Like us, Nelson, Jr. loved to travel, and it was this love of travel that inspired him to live in Japan and visit China. Unfortunately, it was on one of these visits there that Nelson was arrested and later convicted on a drug charge with little evidence of his guilt, opportunity to defend himself, or due process prior to this conviction and incarceration. He was stripped of his freedom without the opportunity to tell his story. Indeed, it took months for us to learn what happened to him. We’ve fought for years to help our son, working behind the scenes with advocates, lawyers and diplomatic officials in the United States and China. We were told that this quiet strategy was the best strategy to keep him safe, but after nearly a decade with little progress, we’ve decided to tell our story, Nelson’s story. It breaks our heart to say it, but Nelson is now sick. The weight of incarceration has taken a toll on his physical and mental health. As you can see from the photos, our child has gone from a healthy man to an emaciated one, who has lost more than 100lbs and is in poor health. He is suffering from life-threatening medical problems in a prison in Chongqing Southwest China far from us, far from his wife and children. Indeed, we have not seen him during these eight long years. We are sustained by periodic calls from him, and for that, we are thankful to God, the United States State Department, and the Chinese government and prison officials. Still, we fear that he will not last much longer. It is time to bring Nelson home, perhaps through medical parole. Whatever the pathway, getting help for him is more urgent now than ever and so we are turning to the public for help with legal fees and welfare support on his behalf. No amount is too small, and we promise that your donations will only be used to directly secure the release and return of our son. We also invite you to leave a comment alongside your donation with a note of inspiration that we can share with Nelson, a personal reflection about Nelson for those who know him, or a testimonial about why you are deciding to join our fight. Thank you for considering this request. Thank you for your thoughts and prayers for Nelson. Thank you, in advance, for your generosity. Even the act of creating this go fund me page and sharing our story publicly has given us – including Nelson – purpose and hope for the future when we can be reunited. Until then we are heartbroken, but we fight on. Mr. Nelson Wells, Sr. and Mrs. Cynthia Wells Louisiana

# England launches campaign to create 10,000 foster care places — The Guardian

[Fedir Kryshtovskyi](https://ua.news/en/%D0%A4%D0%B5%D0%B4%D1%96%D1%80%20%D0%9A%D1%80%D0%B8%D1%88%D1%82%D0%BE%D0%B2%D1%81%D1%8C%D0%BA%D0%B8%D0%B9) 14 October 2026 02:22

[](https://twitter.com/intent/tweet?text=https%3A%2F%2Fua.news%2Fen%2Fworld%2Fv-angliyi-zapuskaiut-kampaniiu-zi-stvorennia-10-tisiach-mists-u-priiomnikh-simiakh-the-guardian)

In England, the government is launching its first nationwide campaign to find foster carers, aiming to create 10,000 new foster care places by the end of the parliamentary term. The initiative is primarily aimed at people aged 30 to 49 and is intended to involve them in caring for children who need care.

As [The Guardian reports](https://www.theguardian.com/society/2026/oct/14/fostering-in-crisis-can-flexible-care-models-fix-englands-child-placement-shortfall), the number of households taking in children has fallen by 10% since 2021. More than a third of current foster carers are aged over 60.

## Flexible care formats

At the same time, the government will trial new models of foster care, including short-term placements and weekend fostering. Children’s Minister Josh MacAlister said such formats should make fostering more accessible to a wider range of people, including through intergenerational or part-time care.

More current news is available on the UA.News Telegram channel [Telegram](https://telegram.me/uanewsstream).

According to him, without a rapid and substantial expansion of the system, children who could live in a family environment will remain in residential care facilities or live far from the places where they grew up.

## Carer shortage and financial pressure

Foster care is the main form of care for children in state care in England. Of the 81,770 such children, around 56,400 are living with foster families at any one time.

Research by the Coram Institute for Children found that more than half a million adults want to become foster carers, while around 3.4 million are interested in the possibility. At the same time, care-sector organisations stress not only the recruitment of new people but also the retention of current carers. Reasons cited for their departure include feeling undervalued, problems in interactions with social workers and financial pressure. According to the Fostering Network, only 33% of carers believe that payments fully cover the costs of raising a child.

China and Pakistan on October 14 launched their first-ever joint ground forces exercise, Karakoram 2026, in the northwest of China's Xinjiang Uyghur Autonomous Region. The opening ceremony was held at a training base in the city of Korla.

## Karakoram 2026 exercise

As [Anadolu Agency reports](https://www.aa.com.tr/en/asia-pacific/china-pakistan-begin-first-ever-joint-army-training-exercise/4088986), China Military Bugle, the official media outlet of China's armed forces, announced the start of the exercise. During the event, representatives of the two sides exchanged experience in counterterrorism.

Pakistani military personnel also inspected some examples of Chinese weapons and equipment, the outlet noted.

More current news is available on the UA.News Telegram channel [Telegram](https://telegram.me/uanewsstream).

## Training in high-altitude terrain

The exercise focuses on joint counterterrorism operations in high-altitude areas. The program includes training in drone operation, searching for and engaging moving targets, as well as long-range sniper shooting.

In addition, participants will conduct joint command training and exercises involving personnel in practical scenarios. According to China Military Bugle, Karakoram 2026 is intended to deepen cooperation between the sides and enhance their interoperability in counterterrorism.

We have a state of emergency declared in Virginia!

And right now we’re seeing what looks like a massive police state closing in on the state capitol where there will be a huge rally on Monday.

This is a very divisive issue that’s generating a lot of media spin and disinformation. And chaos could break out in Richmond.

It is crucial that there be independent, on-the-ground reporting in Richmond, especially given what happened in Charlottesville — where many people argue police actually instigated some of the violence and things definitely got out of hand.

In the past, when massive Yellow Vests protests were taking place in Paris, I was there [reporting on the ground](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hTzwJqUPeqk) and risking safety as protesters were losing eyes due to police brutality. I have also been to places like [Somalia,](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UooepLs3Fqs)[Venezuela](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UOQb7Y5QVO8) and[Cheran](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=r3qRm3sXVRU), once the most violent, dangerous area in Mexico. And more recently, I reported on the ground amid huge protests in Hong Kong.

Now lots of people are asking me to go to Richmond, so they can get the truth about what’s happening there.

So I’ve decided to go, if we can raise enough funds for it.

A trip to Virginia isn’t as expensive as going to Hong Kong, where I provided you in-depth, on-the-ground reports on one of the world’s most important protest movements.

But it’s not free either. I still need to cover airfare/gas, hotel and equipment expenses. And I’m planning on hiring a cameraman and video editor. I estimate this will cost around $1,500.

If you value reporting on the events in Virginia that is free of spin and manipulation and provides a real, honest look at what is happening, then your support is essential.

Thank you so much for funding independent media and for allowing me to continue doing the job I love!

content:
香港
香港交通局局长陈美宝以现有规则和执行情况为由，拒绝支持因公共交通滋扰而罚款。去年投诉增加了 50%，达到 66 起，其中包括噪音和不卫生行为。陈指出目前的处罚和教育活动，而不是遵循 S

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

2026 年 10 月 14 日 18:09 香港时间 · 阅读 2 分钟

运输及物流局局长陈美宝不支持对公共交通滋扰行为处以罚款，而是指出现有规则和执法措施。在回答立法者的提问时，陈强调了目前针对不同运输方式的不当乘客行为的规定。

立法会议员张浩峰询问，对大声播放视频或把脚放在座位上等无礼行为的投诉是否有所增加。陈表示，运输署和环境保护署去年共收到66宗投诉，较上年增加50%。其中涉及噪音的案件有 24 起，涉及不当或不卫生行为的案件有 42 起，而去年分别有 11 起和 33 起。
当被问及香港是否会效仿新加坡9月份的举措，对公共交通上的不文明行为处以最高500新元（约合3000港元）的罚款时，陈没有直接回应。相反，她指出，现有立法已经包含了对不同交通方式中乘客不当行为的处罚。

陈说，在专营巴士上，乘客须遵守告示，禁止大声播放电子设备或将脚放在座位上。前线员工在处理不当行为时遵循指引，包括发出提醒和采取跟进行动，并在必要时将案件移交执法机构。

陈补充，港铁工作人员在例行检查时，如发现乘客违反规定，会发出提醒并采取跟进行动。运输署亦一直与营办商合作开展宣传和教育活动，以促进乘客安全、顾及他人及尊重同行旅客。

关于试点“安静区”或“安静车厢”的可能性，陈表示，运营商需要考虑包括其运营模式、车厢空间和设计以及对整体客运能力的影响等因素。她表示，政府将继续监控乘客行为，并与运营商合作，推广良好的公共交通礼仪和舒适的出行环境。

Hong Kong's transport chief Mable Chan declined to back fines for public transport nuisances, citing existing rules and enforcement. Complaints rose 50 per cent last year to 66, including noise and unhygienic behaviour. Chan pointed to current penalties and education campaigns instead of following S

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

14 Oct 2026 at 18:09 HKT · 2 min read

Secretary for Transport and Logistics Mable Chan has stopped short of backing fines for public transport nuisances, pointing instead to existing rules and enforcement measures. Responding to a lawmaker's question, Chan highlighted current provisions against improper passenger conduct across different modes of transport.

Lawmaker Chong Ho-fung had asked about a rise in complaints over discourteous behaviour, such as playing videos loudly or putting feet on seats. According to Chan, the Transport Department and Environmental Protection Department received 66 complaints last year, up 50 per cent from a year earlier. The cases included 24 involving noise and 42 involving improper or unhygienic behaviour, compared with 11 and 33 respectively in the previous year.

Asked whether Hong Kong would follow Singapore's September move to impose fines of up to S$500 (about HK$3,000) for uncivil behaviour on public transport, Chan did not respond directly. Instead, she noted existing legislation already contains penalties for improper passenger conduct across different transport modes.

On franchised buses, passenger notices prohibit playing electronic devices loudly or putting feet on seats, Chan said. Frontline staff follow guidelines when dealing with inappropriate behaviour, including issuing reminders and taking follow-up action, with cases referred to law enforcement agencies where necessary.

Chan added that MTR staff issue reminders and take follow-up action during routine inspections when passengers breach regulations. The Transport Department has also been working with operators on publicity and education campaigns promoting passenger safety, consideration for others and respect for fellow travellers.

On the possibility of pilot 'quiet zones' or 'quiet carriages', Chan said operators would need to consider factors including their operating models, carriage space and design, as well as the impact on overall passenger capacity. She said the government would continue to monitor passenger behaviour and work with operators to promote good public transport etiquette and a comfortable travel environment.

summary: 香港政府律政司司长动议二读《2026年调解（修订）条例草案》，赋予香港调解资历评审协会有限公司在特定情况下决定调解员人数或委任调解员的法定权力。该法案旨在精简我 [![图片 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编 2026 年 10 月 14 日 14:27 香港时间 · 4 分钟阅读 香港政府已向立法会提出法案

政府
香港律政司司长动议二读《2026年调解（修订）条例草案》，赋予香港调解资历评审协会有限公司在特定情况下决定调解员人数或委任调解员的法定权力。该法案旨在精简我

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

香港时间 2026 年 10 月 14 日 14:27 · 阅读时间 4 分钟

香港政府向立法会提出修订《调解条例》的法案，赋予香港调解资历评审协会有限公司（调评会）打破调解程序僵局的法定权力。

律政司司长林郑月娥周三提出二读《2026年调解（修订）条例草案》，表示该条例草案将允许任何一方向调评会申请决定调解员人数，或在调解协议各方未就此类事宜达成一致时委任一名调解员。此举是根据 2024 年 10 月成立的一个工作组的建议，该工作组负责研究香港的调解监管制度。
经过详细审查、研究和利益相关者咨询后，工作组最终确定了七项建议。这些内容涵盖三个核心点：调解在香港仍应属于非领牌活动，与澳大利亚、加拿大、新加坡和英国等发达普通法司法管辖区的国际惯例一致，这些司法管辖区不强制注册或认证；调解员应继续受到调评会的严格专业监督；结合立法和行政手段，强化调评会的职能和领导。

该法案赋予调评会法定权力，可在调解协议各方无法达成协议的特定情况下决定调解员人数或任命调解员。该部门强调，该法案维护了调解的自愿和灵活性质，各方可以自由地不进行调解、同意其他方式或任命不同的调解员。香港法院在调解或案件管理方面发出指示或命令的权力，包括选择调解员的权力不受影响。
HKMAAL于2012年成立，是由香港大律师公会、香港律师会、香港国际仲裁中心及香港和解中心联合成立的担保有限公司。此后，其机构成员数量增加了一倍多，现在包括香港家庭福利会和专业机构等机构。其登记册上列出了 2,400 多名经认可的普通调解员和 360 多名经认可的家庭调解员。

政府于2025年6月2日咨询司法及法律事务委员会，并于2025年9月咨询利益相关者，大多数受访者支持建议。草案的主要条文于2026年6月至7月进行进一步磋商。香港调解资历评审协会有限公司将获法定权力决定调解员人数或在当事人未达成一致时委任调解员，有助打破僵局，同时保留调解的自愿性质。

Government
Hong Kong's Secretary for Justice has moved the second reading of the 2026 Mediation (Amendment) Bill, which would give the Hong Kong Mediation Accreditation Association Limited statutory power to decide mediator numbers or appoint mediators in specified circumstances. The bill aims to streamline me

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

14 Oct 2026 at 14:27 HKT · 4 min read

The Hong Kong government has introduced a bill in the Legislative Council to amend the Mediation Ordinance, giving the Hong Kong Mediation Accreditation Association Limited (HKMAAL) statutory power to break deadlocks in mediation proceedings.

Moving the second reading of the 2026 Mediation (Amendment) Bill on Wednesday, Secretary for Justice Paul Lam said the bill would allow either party to apply to HKMAAL to decide the number of mediators or appoint one when mediation agreement parties have not agreed on such matters. The move follows recommendations from a working group set up in October 2024 to study the territory's mediation regulation system.

The working group finalised seven recommendations after detailed review, research and stakeholder consultation. These cover three core points: mediation should remain a non-licensed activity in Hong Kong, consistent with international practice in developed common law jurisdictions such as Australia, Canada, Singapore and the UK, which do not impose mandatory registration or certification; mediators should remain under rigorous professional oversight through HKMAAL; and legislative and administrative measures should be used together to strengthen HKMAAL's functions and leadership.

The bill would give HKMAAL the statutory power to decide the number of mediators or appoint a mediator in specified circumstances when mediation agreement parties cannot reach agreement. The department stressed the bill upholds the voluntary and flexible nature of mediation, with parties remaining free not to mediate, to agree otherwise, or to appoint a different mediator. The Hong Kong Court's powers to give directions or orders in mediation or case management, including on mediator selection, are unaffected.

HKMAAL was established in 2012 as a company limited by guarantee by the Hong Kong Bar Association, the Law Society of Hong Kong, the Hong Kong International Arbitration Centre and the Hong Kong Mediation Centre. Its institutional membership has since more than doubled, now including bodies such as the Hong Kong Family Welfare Society and professional institutes. Its register lists more than 2,400 accredited general mediators and more than 360 accredited family mediators.

The government consulted the Panel on Administration of Justice and Legal Affairs on June 2, 2025, and stakeholders in September 2025, with most respondents supporting the recommendations. Further consultation on the draft bill's key provisions took place from June to July 2026. The Hong Kong Mediation Accreditation Association Limited would be given statutory power to decide the number of mediators or appoint mediators when parties have not agreed, helping break deadlocks while preserving the voluntary nature of mediation.

 Source: 香港特區政府新聞公報 原文標題：立法會：律政司司長動議二讀《2026年調解（修訂）條例草案》發言全文（只有中文） 發布：2026-10-14 14:27:00 可選類別（只選一個，輸出其slug）：hong-kong, government, china, business, artificial-intelligence 來源資料： 立法會：律政司司長動議二讀《2026年調解（修訂）條例草案》發言全文（只有中文） 主席： 我謹動議二讀《2026年調解（修訂）條例草案》（《條例草案》）。《條例草案》旨在修訂《調解條例》（第620章）（《調解條例》），以賦予香港調解資歷評審協會有限公司（香港調評會）法定權力，在訂明情況下決定調解員的人數或委任調解員，從而有效打破調解程序中可能出現的僵局。 調解監管制度工作小組的建議 為落實《施政報告》有關加強香港調解專業認證及紀律監管制度的政策方向，律政司於二○二四年十月成立調解監管制度工作小組（工作小組）。工作小組經詳細檢視、研究和諮詢持份者後，敲定七項建議，涵蓋三大核心要點： 第一，調解在香港應繼續作為非持牌活動，調解員毋須受強制發牌規管。這做法與國際發展趨勢一致。已發展普通法司法管轄區例如澳洲、加拿大、新加坡或英國等均無實施強制性的註冊、發牌或認證制度。採取非持牌模式不僅符合調解自主自願的核心價值，更可避免妨礙海外資深調解員來港提供調解服務，亦為市場提供更大發展空間，同時有助推動調解作為普及的日常技能。 第二，雖毋須強制發牌，但調解員仍受嚴謹的專業監督。香港調評會將繼續以擔保有限公司形式運作，履行其作為業界主導的資歷認可及監管機構角色。已發展普通法司法管轄區在調解員專業認可及規管方面，普遍由非法定機構實施自律規管，在推動行業發展及維持有效規管之間取得合適平衡。 第三，以立法及行政措施雙管齊下，進一步強化香港調評會的職能及領導地位。立法方面，正是今日《條例草案》的建議，賦予香港調評會法定權力；行政方面，建議香港調評會落實一系列措施，包括更新現有《香港調解守則》、優化投訴及紀律處分機制和加強國際協作等，全面提升本港調解服務的質素。 主要修訂 就《條例草案》的主要條文，修訂建議旨在透過賦予香港調評會法定權力達致以下效果： （i）如調解協議當事人沒有議定調解員人數，任何一方均可向香港調評會提出申請，由其決定調解員的人數。 （ii）另外，如調解協議當事人沒有就調解員人選或委任程序達成共識，或已同意的委任程序未被執行，任何一方均可向香港調評會提出申請，委任調解員。 必須強調，《條例草案》充分維護調解程序的自願性和靈活性的核心原則，明確重申即使香港調評會作出相關決定或委任，當事人仍可自由選擇不進行調解、另行議定調解員人數及委任程序，或委任不是由香港調評會決定的調解員。同時，香港調評會的決定或委任，並不影響法院為調解或在其他方面為案件管理發出指示或作出命令的權力，包括就調解員的人選作出指示或命令的權力。 《條例草案》的建議能有效理順調解程序、減低因委任分歧引動程序停滯的風險，是完善本港調解框架的關鍵措施之一。《條例草案》配合工作小組的其他建議，將全面鞏固整體調解框架，加強公眾對調解的信心。 香港調評會 香港調評會是行使上述法定委任權力的合適機構。香港調評會於二○一二年成立，以擔保有限公司的形式註冊。當時的創會成員為香港大律師公會、香港律師會、香港國際仲裁中心及香港和解中心。發展至今，香港調評會的機構成員已增至原來的兩倍以上。及後加入的機構成員涵蓋多個重要專業界別，目前包括香港家庭福利會、香港仲裁師協會、香港營造師學會、專業調解顧問中心有限公司、香港建築師學會、香港測量師學會及香港工程師學會。這充分彰顯香港調評會在法律及爭議解決業界具備廣泛的代表性與權威地位。香港調評會具備獨一無二的職能與卓越往績，深受業界認可及信任。自成立以來，香港調評會一直是由業界主導的調解資歷評審及監管機構，負責制定調解員及調解培訓課程的認可標準，就成為認可調解員和認可培訓課程的申請進行評核，並監管認可調解員。其認可的調解員及調解培訓課程均具質素保證。目前，香港調評會的名冊上已有超過2 400名認可綜合調解員及超過360名認可家事調解員。有別於香港大多數調解機構，香港調評會並不提供任何牟利或非牟利性質的調解服務或調解培訓課程，因此賦予香港調評會法定權力而引致利益衝突的可能性極低。此外，根據《香港特別行政區政府調解規則（2025版本）》，在各方當事人沒有就調解員人選達成共識時，香港調評會已獲指派為各方委任調解員。Source material (Chinese): 立法會：律政司司長動議二讀《2026年調解（修訂）條例草案》發言全文（只有中文） - 香港特區政府新聞公報 (2026-10-14{

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

2026 年 10 月 14 日 13:56 香港时间 · 阅读 2 分钟

10 月 14 日，香港一家智障人士护理院的一名前助理院长因对一名院友实施五项强奸罪被判处 13 年监禁。高等法院在八月和九月的审判后作出了判决。

警方称，这些罪行发生在2024年7月至8月期间。受害人当时21岁，有轻度智力障碍，心理年龄相当于9岁零8个月的儿童。她住在一家为智障人士提供住宿照顾和职业培训的宿舍。

事件发生期间，男助理典狱长将受害人带到教职员休息室并对她进行了性侵犯。受害人在后来的一次会面中透露了虐待事件后，案件才曝光。警方展开多角度侦查，调阅闭路电视录像，很快锁定了犯罪嫌疑人，当时犯罪嫌疑人38岁。
调查人员访问了受害人的家人、宿舍职员、社会福利署的临床心理学家和精神科医生，以评估受害人的智力、精神状况和心理状况。闭路电视录像显示，被告多次将受害人独自带到员工休息室或独自进入她的房间。在对受害者进行详细的视频采访后，警方确定了五起不同的性侵犯事件。

警方称，被告利用其看护者的权力和身份对一名精神上无行为能力的人进行性侵犯。他被指控犯有五项强奸罪，所有指控均在 8 月 21 日至 9 月 2 日高等法院审判期间得到证实。

大埔警区刑事科总督察谭庆山对判决表示欢迎，称这对类似犯罪具有震慑作用。她形容此案令人痛心，并指出被告通过其作为看护者的角色滥用了受害者的信任。她表示希望案件结束后，受害者及其家人能够开始新的生活。

谭还呼吁公众举报可疑事件，并表示社区保持警惕对于解决性暴力至关重要。

A former assistant warden at a Hong Kong care home for the disabled was sentenced to 13 years in prison on 14 October for five counts of rape against a 21-year-old resident with mild intellectual disability. Police welcomed the ruling, saying it serves as a deterrent.

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

14 Oct 2026 at 13:56 HKT · 2 min read

A former assistant warden at a Hong Kong care home for people with intellectual disabilities was sentenced to 13 years in prison on 14 October after being convicted of five counts of rape against a resident. The High Court handed down the sentence following a trial in August and September.

Police said the offences occurred between July and August 2024. The victim, then 21 years old, had a mild intellectual disability and a mental age equivalent to a child of nine years and eight months. She lived in a hostel that provided residential care and vocational training for people with intellectual disabilities.

During the incidents, the male assistant warden took the victim to a staff rest room and sexually assaulted her. The case came to light after the victim disclosed the abuse during a later meeting. Police launched a multi-angle investigation, reviewed closed-circuit television footage, and quickly identified the suspect, who was then 38 years old.

Investigators interviewed the victim's family, hostel staff, a clinical psychologist from the Social Welfare Department and a psychiatrist to assess the victim's intelligence, mental state and psychological condition. CCTV footage showed the defendant repeatedly taking the victim alone into the staff rest room or entering her room by himself. After detailed video-recorded interviews with the victim, police identified five separate incidents of sexual assault.

The defendant used his authority and identity as a caregiver to sexually assault a person who was mentally incapacitated, police said. He was charged with five counts of rape, and all charges were found proven during the High Court trial from 21 August to 2 September.

Chief Inspector Tam Ching-shan of the Tai Po District Criminal Division welcomed the sentence, saying it would act as a deterrent against similar crimes. She described the case as distressing, noting that the defendant abused the victim's trust through his role as a caregiver. She expressed hope that the victim and her family could start a new life after the case concluded.

Tam also called on the public to report suspicious incidents, saying community vigilance is essential in tackling sexual violence.

title: Hong Kong proposes law to transfer HK$4.1bn from environment fund to government coffers
zh_title: 香港拟立法将41亿港元从环境基金转入国库
summary: 政府 香港政府提出修订《环境及自然保育基金条例》的法案，允许将 41 亿港元从该基金转入政府一般收入。此举旨在整合财政资源，同时保留21亿港元用于该基金五年内的运营。 [![图片 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编 2026 年 10 月 14 日 14:10 HKT · 2 分钟阅读政府已提出环境与保护基金
content:
政府
香港政府提出修订《环境及自然保育基金条例》的法案，允许将41亿港元从该基金转入政府一般收入。此举旨在整合财政资源，同时保留21亿港元用于该基金五年内的运营。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

2026 年 10 月 14 日 14:10 香港时间 · 阅读 2 分钟

香港政府已向立法会提交《2026年环境及自然保育基金（修订）条例草案》，寻求将基金中的41亿港元转入政府收入。财政司司长陈茂波提出了这项修正案，这是巩固和更好地利用财政资源的更广泛努力的一部分。

该法案是在对 2025-26 年度预算中概述的政府账户之外持有的 42 项法定基金进行审查之后提出的。 2025年8月，政府已从六大种子基金转移了615亿港元。目前，2026-27年度财政预算案建议从环境及自然保育基金等7个基金收回约158亿港元。
该基金根据《环境及自然保育基金条例》设立，以信托形式运作，支持环境教育、研究及相关工作。截至2026年3月末，该基金持有余额约62亿港元。过去三年，平均每年开支约为2.3亿港元。

根据建议，21亿港元将保留以应付基金未来五年的需要，而41亿港元将转入政府一般收入。基金的政策目标、运营模式和管理安排保持不变。环境生态局于2026年3月就修订后的财务安排咨询基金委员会。

由于现行条例缺乏将盈余余额转入政府收入的规定，该法案引入了新条款，授权财政司司长在基金用途不合理需要的情况下，可以转移部分基金余额。财政司司长可考虑现金流量需求及累积投资收益等因素。该法案明确规定，转移金额不包括该基金收到的捐款或此类捐款所产生的收入。

政府计划在条例草案通过后，向立法会财务委员会寻求批准转移安排。

[![图片3：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)
主编

【原文 English Original】
Government
Hong Kong's government has introduced a bill to amend the Environment and Conservation Fund Ordinance, allowing the transfer of HK$4.1 billion from the fund to general revenue. The move aims to consolidate fiscal resources while retaining HK$2.1 billion for the fund's operations over five years.

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

14 Oct 2026 at 14:10 HKT · 2 min read

The Hong Kong government has tabled the Environment and Conservation Fund (Amendment) Bill 2026 in the Legislative Council, seeking to transfer HK$4.1 billion from the fund to government revenue. Financial Secretary Paul Chan proposed the amendment, which is part of broader efforts to consolidate and better use fiscal resources.

The bill follows a review of 42 statutory funds held outside government accounts, as outlined in the 2025-26 Budget. In August 2025, the government already transferred HK$61.5 billion from six large seed funds. Now, the 2026-27 Budget proposes recovering about HK$15.8 billion from seven funds, including the Environment and Conservation Fund.

Established under the Environment and Conservation Fund Ordinance, the fund operates as a trust to support environmental education, research and related work. As of the end of March 2026, the fund held a balance of approximately HK$6.2 billion. Over the past three years, average annual spending was about HK$230 million.

Under the proposal, HK$2.1 billion will be retained to cover the fund's needs for the next five years, while HK$4.1 billion will be transferred to the government's general revenue. The fund's policy objectives, operational model and management arrangements will remain unchanged. The Environment and Ecology Bureau consulted the fund's committee in March 2026 on the revised financial arrangements.

Because the current ordinance lacks provisions for transferring surplus balances to government revenue, the bill introduces new clauses empowering the Financial Secretary to transfer part of the fund's balance if it is not reasonably required for the fund's purposes. The Financial Secretary may consider factors such as cash flow needs and accumulated investment income. The bill explicitly states that transferred amounts will not include donations received by the fund or income derived from such donations.

The government plans to seek approval from the Legislative Council's Finance Committee for the transfer arrangement after the bill is passed.

source: 澳洲唐人街 – Australia ChinaTown News 中文华人新闻

content: 又有华人赴泰国旅游失联！ 10月6日，38岁的胡星和35岁宋华婷在赴泰国旅游后失联。家人根据两人最后发送的照片和定位报警，泰国警方初步判断，两人可能已被转移至缅甸。 10月9日，胡星突然给家人打来电话，但通话后仍不能确认两人的具体下落。 截至10月12日，家人仍在等待警方和有关方面的消息，希望能尽快找到两人，确认他们人身安全。 三人结伴赴泰，两人外出后失联 据极目新闻等媒体报道，10月4日，宋先生与姐夫胡星、弟弟宋华婷一同抵达泰国曼谷，开始国庆假期旅行。 胡星38岁，是一名IT工程师；宋华婷35岁，此前主要在老家靠开货车谋生。 10月5日，三人游玩了一天。当天晚上，宋先生身体不适，决定第二天留在酒店休息，胡星和宋华婷则计划外出逛逛。 出门前，宋先生特意叮嘱两人，路上记得发消息报平安。 10月6日下午2时左右，宋先生陆续收到胡星发来的消息，包括定位和照片。 下午3时左右，胡星又发来一组照片，记录两人乘车的过程。期间，他们更换过一次车辆。 最后一张照片中，一辆皮卡停在树林附近，周围环境似乎较为偏僻。 宋先生察觉异常，立即拨打胡星的电话，却无人接听。随后发送的消息也没有得到回复。与此同时，宋华婷同样无法联系。 当天5时左右，宋先生向泰国警方报案。 警方怀疑两人已被转往缅甸 10月7日上午，泰国警方根据两人此前发送的定位和照片，告诉宋先生，两人可能已经被转移至缅甸。 泰国达府位于泰国西部，与缅甸接壤。其中，湄索与缅甸妙瓦底地区隔河相望。 近年来，妙瓦底多次出现在涉及电信诈骗、非法拘禁和人口贩运的案件报道中。 不过，目前尚无公开证据能够确认两人已经进入缅甸，更无法确定他们具体身在何处，是否遭到拘禁。 10月8日，宋先生前往中国驻泰国大使馆求助。家属随后也联系中国驻缅甸大使馆，希望通过有关渠道寻找亲人。 据宋先生向媒体介绍，使馆方面表示将督促当地警方依法办案，如有消息会通过电子邮件回复。 截至相关报道发稿时，家属仍未获得两人获救或确切下落得到确认的消息。 失联第三天，妻子接到丈夫电话 10月9日，失联第三天，胡星的妻子终于接到丈夫打来的微信电话。 胡星告诉妻子不用担心，自己“在里面很好”，让她等他出来。 通话中，胡星还表示，宋华婷也和自己在一起。妻子询问弟弟的情况，却始终没有听到宋华婷亲自说话。 这通电话带来一丝安慰，却也留下了更多疑问。他说的“里面”究竟是什么地方？他是否能够自由行动？为什么不能直接回家？ 这些疑问困扰着家人，宋先生因此更加担忧。 据他介绍，弟弟只有初中学历，此前主要靠开货车谋生，平时打字还需要依靠手写输入。家人担心弟弟目前的处境，也不知道他是否有机会独立与外界联系。 家人认为，这通电话至少表明胡星当时仍有某种方式能够联系家人，但仅凭通话内容，还无法判断两人的实际处境。 家属希望警方尽快核实通话相关定位和两人的具体位置。 宋先生说，他家中姐弟三人，父亲于2001年去世，此后一直由母亲独自抚养他们长大。 如今，母亲已经59岁。弟弟和姐夫同时失联后，家人起初不敢告诉老人，担心她承受不了打击。但随着网上寻人信息传播，母亲最终还是知道了此事。 胡星的妻子刚怀孕一个月，丈夫突然失联，更让这个家庭承受巨大压力。 10月9日晚，宋先生回到国内，准备赶回老家陪伴母亲、安慰家人。 总领馆：曾收到游客失联求助 中国驻宋卡总领事馆此前发布提醒，指曾收到有关中国游客在泰国失联的求助。 总领馆称，游客出行前，应将航班、住宿地址和行程告知亲友；旅行期间保持通信畅通，定时向家人报平安。如果一旦出现异常定位、行程不明、电话突然无法接通等情况时，应及时核查。 如果确认失联，应及时联系酒店、同行人员和当地警方，并向中国驻当地使领馆寻求领事协助。 随着中国公民在泰国失联事件受到关注，泰国皇家部队内部安全行动司令部(ISOC)相关人士也接受媒体采访时，特别提醒外国游客注意出行安全。 第一，不要随意乘坐他人安排的车辆。 对于自由行游客，临时搭车或接受陌生人接送，可能看似方便，却会增加行程失控的风险。 如果司机身份不明、目的地不清楚，或者途中频繁换车、突然改变路线、被要求前往偏僻地点，都应提高警惕。不要因为对方声称是朋友介绍、酒店安排或正规接送，就放松核实。 第二，谨慎对待赴泰工作邀约 泰方人士提醒，有人邀请赴泰工作时，应要求对方提供办理工作许可证所需的文件，并核实雇主、工作地点和具体岗位，不要仅凭口头承诺出发。 按照泰国法律，外国人在当地工作须符合相应的工作许可和岗位规定，部分职业对外国人设有限制。违法就业可能面临处罚、遣返等后果。

title: Yonhap News Summary
summary: 以下是韩联社周二推送的第二次重大报道摘要。 ----------------- ■ (LEAD) 外交部、统一部、国防部将于 2031 年迁至世宗 首尔 - 内政部周二表示，作为影响近 10,000 名公务员的更广泛的政府机构搬迁计划的一部分，外交部、统一部和国防部将于 2031 年从首尔迁至中央行政城市世宗。继上个月决定将一些政府部门和公共机构迁往世宗后，该部门宣布了该计划。
content:
以下是韩联社周二推送的第二次重大报道摘要。

-----------------

■ (LEAD) 外交部、统一部、国防部将于2031年迁往世宗

首尔——内政部周二表示，外交部、统一部和国防部将在 2031 年之前从首尔搬迁到中央行政城市世宗，这是影响近 1 万名公务员的更广泛的政府机构搬迁计划的一部分。

继上个月决定从明年开始将部分政府部门和公共机构迁至首尔以南约 110 公里的世宗市后，该部宣布了该计划。

[https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20261013006951315](https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20261013006951315)

2026年10月13日，内政部长官尹浩正（右二）在首尔政府大楼就政府机构迁往中央行政城市世宗市的计划举行新闻发布会。（韩联社）

-----------------

■（第二LD）首尔股市下跌超过5%，因人工智能和通胀问题再次引发科技股抛售

首尔——由于人工智能 (AI) 行业和通胀再度陷入困境，科技股重挫，首尔股市周二暴跌超过 5%，连续第五个交易日下跌。

韩元兑美元汇率走低。

基准韩国综合股价指数（KOSPI）开盘下跌 3.1% 后，下跌 348.89 点，跌幅 5.46%，至 6,035.35 点。
[https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20261013007552320](https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20261013007552320)

-----------------

■ (LEAD) 朝鲜在新国防博物馆展示 Hwasong-20 洲际弹道导弹和战略武器

首尔——据官方媒体周二报道，朝鲜在新开放的国防博物馆展示了火星20洲际弹道导弹(ICBM)、潜射弹道导弹和其他先进武器。

据朝鲜中央通讯社（朝中社）报道，朝鲜于周日（10 月 10 日）朝鲜劳动党（WPK）成立 81 周年之际举行了国防革命博物馆开馆仪式。

[https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20261013002751315](https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20261013002751315)

-----------------

■ 特别检察官敦促上诉法院维持尹恩的选举法定罪

男星張捷去年底轉行投入房仲業，與女星夏如芝結婚後育有女兒「芝麻」，一家三口生活幸福美滿，夫妻倆不時透過社群分享家庭日常。近日張捷透露，一家人前往峇里島旅遊，還驚喜解鎖人生第一次搭乘商務艙的體驗，他感性表示，這趟旅程也成為激勵自己繼續努力工作的動力。

張捷在臉書發文透露，「芝麻的熊貓之旅確定達標，但……因為今年行程有點滿！所以這次是先去峇里島～」，他也開心分享，這次多虧老婆夏如芝，讓自己終於有機會體驗人生第一次商務艙，語氣中充滿新鮮感與感謝，「拖老婆的福，這是我第一次坐商務艙」。

對張捷而言，這趟旅程不只是帶著家人出國度假，更讓他有機會重新思考工作與生活的平衡，他坦言，搭乘商務艙的經驗也成為激勵自己的契機，「也趁這機會也好好激勵自己，默默告訴自己要繼續努力，讓自己有能力享受更好的生活」。

張捷也感性寫下：「果然，一回國工作就超滿，加油～張捷，要會賺錢，也要會照顧家人！更要好好享受努力換來的生活」短短幾句話，道出轉行後對事業的期待，以及身為丈夫、父親想給家人更好生活的責任感。

貼文曝光後，不少網友紛紛留言替他加油，並送上祝福，「一家人一起出國，是最幸福的」、「賺錢就是要花，闔家旅遊舒心」、「業績一定繼續紅不讓，捷足先登喔！好歡樂幸褔的氛圍」。

# BASEBALL/Gant's eight scoreless innings lift Dragons to win in Taiwan Series opener

10/17/2026 08:26 PM

[](jsvscript:)[](jsvscript:)[](javascript:void(0))[Listen](javascript:)

[Link](javascript:)[Whatsapp](javascript:)[Reddit](javascript:)[Line](javascript:)[Email](javascript:)

To activate the text-to-speech service, please first agree to the privacy policy below.

Wei Chuan Dragons right-hander John Gant. CNA photo Oct. 17, 2026

Taipei, Oct. 17 (CNA) John Gant pitched eight scoreless innings to lead the Wei Chuan Dragons to a 3-0 win over the CTBC Brothers in Game 1 of the Chinese Professional Baseball League's Taiwan Series at Taipei Dome on Saturday.

The American right-hander allowed just two hits and two walks while striking out six on 100 pitches, earning Game 1 MVP honors and giving the Dragons a 1-0 lead in the championship series.

Gant held the Brothers scoreless through four innings before his teammates gave him run support, then protected Wei Chuan's lead through the eighth.

The outing continued the success he had against CTBC in the regular season. He went 2-0 with a 2.19 ERA in six starts against the Brothers, and the Dragons won all six games.

Across those outings, Gant struck out 32 and allowed 25 hits and nine earned runs over 37 innings. Five were quality starts, meaning he pitched at least six innings and allowed no more than three earned runs.

He went 9-2 in the regular season and led the league with a 1.49 ERA and 136 strikeouts.

Wei Chuan Dragons players bow after completing a perfect game at Taipei Dome on Saturday. CNA photo Oct. 17, 2026

Saturday's game pitted him against Mario Sanchez, whose 125 regular-season strikeouts ranked second in the league. Sanchez had started the Brothers' playoff opener against the Uni-President 7-Eleven Lions, earning the win after allowing one run over seven innings.

Against Wei Chuan, Sanchez kept the game scoreless through four innings before the Dragons broke through with two runs in the fifth and added another in the sixth.

He went seven innings, allowing three runs on six hits, with three strikeouts and no walks.

CTBC Brothers' pitcher Mario Sanchez. CNA photo Oct. 17, 2026

The loss put the Brothers in an unfavorable position: they have finished as runners-up in all seven previous Taiwan Series in which they lost the opener.

Those series came in 2009, 2014, 2015, 2017, 2019, 2020 and, most recently, 2025, when they lost to the Rakuten Monkeys in five games.

This is the first Taiwan Series between the Dragons and the Brothers, and the first scheduled to be played entirely at a single venue, Taipei Dome.

Game 2 of the best-of-seven series is set for 5:05 p.m. Sunday at Taipei Dome.

(By Chao Yen-hsiang)

title: Three arrested in Hong Kong elevator safety fraud released on bail
zh_title: 香港电梯安全诈骗案三人被捕获保释
summary: 香港 三名男子因在公共住宅区进行欺诈性电梯升级而被捕，已于 11 月获得保释，等待警方报告。嫌疑人包括一名79岁的承包商董事和两名分别为82岁和63岁的注册工程师。 [![图1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，编辑Chief 2026 年 10 月 17 日，香港时间 16:31 · 读了 2 分钟 三名男子因涉及公共住房关键电梯升级的重大安全欺诈调查而被捕
content:
香港
三名因在公共住宅区进行欺诈性电梯升级而被捕的男子已被保释，等待 11 月份警方的报告。嫌疑人包括一名79岁的承包商董事和两名分别为82岁和63岁的注册工程师。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

香港时间 2026 年 10 月 17 日 16:31 · 阅读时间 2 分钟

警方周六证实，因涉及公共住宅区关键电梯升级的重大安全欺诈调查而被捕的三名男子已获保释。

新界南总区总部表示，嫌疑人包括一名79岁的电梯承建商董事和两名分别为82岁和63岁的注册工程师，必须在11月中旬向警方报案。

此次逮捕是在对承包商泰尊电梯有限公司（香港）有限公司进行电气和机械安全调查后进行的。该公司被发现谎报沙田博康村及观塘翠屏（北）村防火电梯门已完成安装，令住户面临重大安全隐患。
虽然三人均已获得临时保释，但他们仍因串谋诈骗而受到积极的刑事调查，并依法要求下个月向新界南警察总部报到。警方对承包商位于柴湾的办公室进行了大规模突击搜查，警方查获了重要的公司记录，包括住房合同、会议记录和人事档案，随后作出了保释安排。

这些刑事指控源于政府对观塘和沙田住宅区 48 部电梯进行的一系列突击审计。虽然承包商提交了官方防火认证文件，但检查人员发现，该公司只安装了防火门板，而完全省略了配套的防火门框——火灾期间防止有毒烟雾从建筑物中升起所需的关键防御屏障。

根据当地法律，承包商和注册检验人员均被指控故意隐瞒这些建筑缺陷，以向各自屋村的业主立案法团谎称合同付款并逃避监管处罚。机电工程署警告称，将在正在进行的刑事调查的同时，寻求独立的专业和纪律制裁。

[![图片3：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

Hong Kong
Three men arrested over fraudulent elevator upgrades in public housing estates have been released on bail pending a police report in November. The suspects include a 79-year-old contractor director and two registered engineers aged 82 and 63.

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

17 Oct 2026 at 16:31 HKT · 2 min read

Three men arrested in connection with a major safety fraud investigation involving critical elevator upgrades in public housing estates have been released on bail, police confirmed on Saturday.

The New Territories South Regional Headquarters said the suspects—including a 79-year-old elevator contractor director and two registered engineers aged 82 and 63—must report back to police in mid-November.

The arrests followed an electrical and mechanical safety probe into contractor Taizoom Elevator Company (HK) Limited. The firm was found to have falsely reported the completion of fire-rated elevator door installations at Pok Hong Estate in Sha Tin and Tsui Ping (North) Estate in Kwun Tong, leaving residents exposed to significant safety hazards.

While all three have been granted temporary bail, they remain under active criminal investigation for conspiracy to defraud and are legally required to report back to New Territories South police headquarters next month. The bail arrangements come after a large-scale police raid on the contractor's offices in Chai Wan, where detectives seized vital corporate records, including housing contracts, meeting minutes, and personnel files.

The criminal charges stem from a series of surprise government audits on 48 elevators across the Kwun Tong and Sha Tin residential estates. While the contractor had submitted official fire-resistance certification documents, inspectors discovered that the company had installed only the fire-resistant door panels while completely omitting the matching fire-resistant door frames—a critical defensive barrier required to prevent toxic smoke from rising through the building during a fire.

Under local laws, both the contractor and the registered inspectors are accused of deliberately concealing these building defects to falsely obtain contract payments from the respective housing estates’ owners' corporations and evade regulatory penalties. The Electrical and Mechanical Services Department has warned that it will pursue independent professional and disciplinary sanctions alongside the ongoing criminal investigation.

content:
2026 年 3 月 12 日，菲律宾苏比克湾，第 25 步兵师的美国士兵和菲律宾当地合作伙伴在接收、集结、后续操作和整合 (RSOI) 期间卸下设备和车辆。美国陆军照片

美国陆军在本月发布的新作战指南中制定了为太平洋第一岛链长期作战做准备的计划。

几十年来，地面部队一直指挥部队应对来自中东、欧洲和朝鲜半岛的叛乱威胁和高强度作战行动。近年来，西太平洋地区与中国的紧张局势促使陆军制定一种新型作战区域的计划，该作战区域涵盖大片群岛和海洋环境。

10 月 7 日发布的[“陆军如何作战”文件](https://www.army.mil/article/295971/army_releases_how_the_army_fights_operational_warfighting_guidance)中列出的一个关键事实承认，人民解放军有能力提供重要的“反干预[反介入/区域拒止]框架”，可以破坏试图接近西方的美国军队来自美国大陆的太平洋。
根据作战指南，地面服务的新重点是发展基础设施，以加强指挥和控制、战区后勤和充足的弹药储备来支持第一岛链内的部队。

2026 年 6 月 15 日，菲律宾拉洛机场，分配到第 36 空运中队的美国空军飞行员和分配到第 25 步兵师 2-11 远程火力营布拉沃炮台的美国陆军士兵，准备将高机动火炮火箭系统装载到来自第 36 AS 的 C-130J 超级大力士上。美国空军照片

文件中写道，部队必须在西太平洋地区“做好准备，在冲突发生的第一天就立即采取行动”，通过能够支持高强度作战行动的[预先部署的库存](https://news.usni.org/2026/04/22/u-s-army-stages-equipment-at-american-owned-subic-bay-facility-for-balikatan-alliance-contingcies)。新的陆军总兵力投送装备概念（以前被称为陆军预置库存）希望建立准备好的库存，以保证轮换和前沿部署的部队在冲突爆发时得到维持。

“在太平洋地区，陆军将通过改善整个地区的作战基础设施来抵消节奏威胁。节奏威胁的快速部署能力需要不依赖于传统的、漫长的部署时间表的地面力量选择，”作战指导文件中写道。
陆军计划从这些前沿部署的部队和库存中部署配备远程导弹、建制防空、网络和电子战能力的多域特遣部队，以破坏中国的反介入/区域拒止网络。该军种还设想将陆军船只、无人水面舰艇和无人机作为联合部队跨越太平洋的重要补给能力。

2026 年 4 月 10 日，在菲律宾阿吉拉的苏比克湾港口，商业运输船“合恩角”号上的起重机将一个美国海军陆战队集装箱装载到一辆商用卡车上，该卡车前往参加“肩并肩”国际联合演习的部队。美军照片

【原文 English Original】
U.S. Soldiers from 25th Infantry Division and local partners in the Philippines offload equipment and vehicles during Reception, Staging, Onward Operation and Integration (RSOI) at Subic Bay, Philippines, March 12, 2026. US Army photo

The U.S. Army laid out its plans to prepare for a prolonged fight in the Pacific along the First Island Chain in the service’s new warfighting guidance released this month.

For decades, the ground branch has oriented troops against insurgent threats and high-intensity combat operations from the Middle East, Europe and the Korean Peninsula. In recent years, tensions in the Western Pacific with China [have pushed the Army](https://news.usni.org/2023/10/17/u-s-army-leaders-argue-services-relevance-in-the-pacific) to formulate plans for a new type of operations area – one that encompasses vast swathes of archipelagos and maritime environments.

A key fact listed in the [“How the Army Fights” document](https://www.army.mil/article/295971/army_releases_how_the_army_fights_operational_warfighting_guidance) released on Oct. 7 acknowledges the People’s Liberation Army’s ability to deliver significant “counter-intervention [anti-acess/area-denial] frameworks” that can disrupt American forces attempting to approach the Western Pacific from the Continental United States.

The ground service has a new focus on developing infrastructure to support forces within the First Island Chain with hardened command and control, in-theater logistics and adequate munition reserves, according to the warfighting guidance.

U.S. Air Force Airmen assigned to the 36th Airlift Squadron and U.S. Army soldiers assigned to Bravo Battery, 2-11 Long Range Fires Battalion, 25th Infantry Division, prepare to load a High Mobility Artillery Rocket System onto a C-130J Super Hercules from the 36 AS at Lal-lo Airport, Philippines, June 15, 2026. US Air Force photo

The force must be “postured to act immediately on day one of a conflict” in the Western Pacific through [pre-positioned stocks](https://news.usni.org/2026/04/22/u-s-army-stages-equipment-at-american-owned-subic-bay-facility-for-balikatan-alliance-contingencies) that can support high-intensity combat operations, reads the document. The new Total Army Power Projection Equipment concept, formerly designated as Army Prepositioned Stock, wants to create prepared stockpiles designed to keep rotationally and forward-deployed units sustained from the onset of a conflict.

“In the Pacific, the Army will counterbalance the pacing threat by improving its warfighting infrastructure across the region. The pacing threat’s rapid deployment capabilities require land power options that do not rely on traditional, lengthy deployment timelines,” reads the operational warfighting guidance document.

From these forward-deployed forces and stocks, the Army plans to field multi-domain task forces equipped with long-range missiles, organic air defenses, cyber and electronic warfare capabilities to disrupt China’s anti-access/area-denial networks. The service also envisions Army watercraft, unmanned surface vessels and unmanned aerial vehicles as a crucial resupply capability for the joint force across the vast distances of the Pacific.

A crane aboard the commercial transport vessel Cape Horn downloads a U.S. Marine Corps shipping container onto a commercial truck headed for units participating in joint international exercise Balikatan, April 10, 2026, at the Subic Bay port, in Agila, Philippines. US Army photo

In the Second Island Chain, the ground branch wants to establish hardened fuel and munition nodes to support the First Island Chain formations. Forward-deployed engineering, medical and air defense units were highlighted in the guidance as ways to sustain these distribution networks.

Elements of these plans have been demonstrated since the beginning of the second iteration of the Army’s Pathways exercise series in 2018 across the Western Pacific and recent infrastructure developments in the region. The service’s [newest long-range cruise](https://news.usni.org/2025/07/17/army-bullseyes-maritime-target-with-sm-6-fired-from-portable-launcher) and hypersonic missiles are assigned to Indo-Pacific Command, including the SM-6 and Tomahawk-equipped ground-based Mark 41 vertical launching system Mid-Range Capability. A [presentation this week](https://www.dvidshub.net/video/1026142/2026-ausa-warriors-corner-posture-advantage-united-states-army-pacific-command-usarpac-ready-forward) at the 2026 AUSA Annual Meeting and Exposition showcased the U.S. Army Pacific’s logistics and warehousing facilities in Japan, Australia, the Philippines, Singapore and Guam.

In the guidance, the Army also acknowledged the need to address an operational challenge pertaining to the capacity and volume of long-range strike munitions required for Western Pacific ground and maritime targets.

# [UAT-11985 Uses Fake Event Invites to Target Taiwan Research Affiliates With Google AitM Phishing](https://thehackernews.com/2026/10/uat-11985-uses-fake-event-invites-to.html)

__ Ravie Lakshmanan __ Oct 16, 2026 Phishing / Artificial Intelligence

[![Image 7](https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEiPclyw7bJ19im5Qmzj9jgFlsM4XJqPK6hyphenhyphenRDCcQ0bnpWrteeTWgPNlip5T0P_oj_AC6V3osZ2xIpYipKjXWQw3BfFEQ1n28dleNCLRi7difLnPLY8Yc-oJ6BCVZ1V0VBpF_ZNu36qM_yCvyvbgBsSfh2AXq-IBIk7QjnBSR_T7s8ajMCOkIEhA5YGeYWg4/s1700-nu-rw-lo-l85-e365/google-phish.jpg)](https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEiPclyw7bJ19im5Qmzj9jgFlsM4XJqPK6hyphenhyphenRDCcQ0bnpWrteeTWgPNlip5T0P_oj_AC6V3osZ2xIpYipKjXWQw3BfFEQ1n28dleNCLRi7difLnPLY8Yc-oJ6BCVZ1V0VBpF_ZNu36qM_yCvyvbgBsSfh2AXq-IBIk7QjnBSR_T7s8ajMCOkIEhA5YGeYWg4/s1700-nu-rw-lo-l85-e365/google-phish.jpg)

Cybersecurity researchers have disclosed details of an advanced persistent threat (APT) spear-phishing campaign that has targeted individuals affiliated with Taiwan research organizations to direct victims to an adversary-in-the-middle (AitM) phishing framework designed to harvest their Google account credentials and multi-factor authentication (MFA) codes.

The activity is being tracked by Cisco Talos under the moniker **UAT-11985**, describing it as likely fueled by artificial intelligence (AI)-assisted content generation so as to quickly craft bespoke lures aimed at different targets within the confines of a common social engineering framework. The campaign was first observed in mid-2026.

"The operation leveraged legitimate public event themes and impersonated reputable academic and policy institutions to establish credibility," Talos researcher Joey Chen [said](https://blog.talosintelligence.com/uat-11985/) in an analysis.

"Beyond traditional email phishing, the actor incorporated QR code phishing (quishing) techniques by modifying legitimate event posters with malicious QR codes, expanding the attack surface beyond email recipients to secondary victims who may encounter printed materials."

Central to the operation is the use of legitimate or plausible public event information in spear-phishing emails and embedding within them a URL that points to attacker-controlled infrastructure, while hovering over the hyperlink displays a legitimate-looking Google Forms URL.

[![Image 8: Cybersecurity](https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEh-69Sxi6ukfnlM_EpqEB_hRVymcXAcWTNAJetA9huKutPZuG0OOBUvByDCtP_HokC-gM-AzjX0ZhgneUFVzjCyIduRINFj6Yf0JXRFE17_z82UioyT9eoxH2-XQDoD_hInCxc8V2bQrmtnMN-GUR63bseKn7pLRISqlvUJlfuJq8pgCL-Fot7sQDas9D05/s728-nu-rw-lo-l85-e365/nudge-3-d.png)](https://thehackernews.uk/ai-agent-methods-d)

These invitation emails feature nearly identical syntactic structures despite the breadth of geopolitical topics being discussed, indicating the content was mass-produced from a reusable prompt template rather than painstakingly crafted for each target.

Specifically, the emails follow a three-part structure -

*   The opening section offers a "polished (but overly elaborate) description" of the geopolitical or policy context.
*   The second section is tailored to the recipient and paints them in a flattering light in an attempt to trigger engagement.
*   The third and final section provides details of event logistics, including the topic, date, venue, and registration instructions.

The threat actor has been found to impersonate legitimate Taiwan-based institutions like the Taiwan European Union Centre, NCCU Institute of International Relations, and Taiwan Research Institute, fabricating the sender identities to make the messages appear more convincing.

"Taken together, the reuse of an almost-identical narrative structure, rhetorical style, personalized flattery, institutional impersonation, and deceptive registration mechanism strongly suggests a coordinated and carefully targeted spear-phishing campaign rather than three independent invitations," Talos said.

[![Image 9](https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEgdHO3Er0XfVtdn3shorgjgruguA7DkP828B1DJBSX4Xr3mpLtWO2agxZ6EuPbQEYw-SgiyeRkqfiqEaEG-UHFDrsoj7_TAyODnzZzX5XoEXrlVyCgBLt-xfGVMevpez2agga-8C4nzORFK8GHap1izR8y37YKRQunLLts7YSyHvR6f_8oPbg8P1Wg77hoG/s1700-nu-rw-lo-l85-e365/flow.jpg)](https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEgdHO3Er0XfVtdn3shorgjgruguA7DkP828B1DJBSX4Xr3mpLtWO2agxZ6EuPbQEYw-SgiyeRkqfiqEaEG-UHFDrsoj7_TAyODnzZzX5XoEXrlVyCgBLt-xfGVMevpez2agga-8C4nzORFK8GHap1izR8y37YKRQunLLts7YSyHvR6f_8oPbg8P1Wg77hoG/s1700-nu-rw-lo-l85-e365/flow.jpg)

In a subset of cases, the phishing emails incorporate legitimate event posters scraped from legitimate websites, but with the QR codes modified to trick victims into scanning the malicious QR code to "register" for the event.

The phishing site imitates the look of a legitimate Google Form, but the primary goal of the site is to serve a pop-up that prompts the victim to sign-in with their Google account to complete the form. Doing so takes them to a bogus site featuring a spoofed Google login panel to capture their credentials and authentication challenges.

The pixel-perfect replica site is an adversary-in-the-middle (AitM) proxy that uses obfuscated JavaScript to gather and exfiltrate the entered information in real-time over a WebSocket connection, while simultaneously forwarding it to legitimate Google authentication servers.

[![Image 10: Cybersecurity](https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEjVV2rRkX8tRMF6gCzemvQNpwFwGxRWxY1cJEYfoLLSj1EZYJOlj5WTR77t0i6kELXujYcaHTpRDqTjCbVHH5Pnh7wzxUiKP5j4dsDkWIMlp2bmpZsL0jeAsA_19pHH5UPtyBvNkZdyGEULOAsXPcraMP5CYjQRFefhXRSdEjYkrdcpUnc4ILcvcdEfAauE/s728-nu-rw-lo-l85-e365/tl-d.jpg)](https://thehackernews.uk/network-defense-d)

Prior to establishing the WebSocket connection, the JavaScript payload collects device and browser information, including the locale, user agent, screen dimensions, and mobile-device status, which are then reported to the command-and-control (C2) server via a "google_login_start" request.

When the victim submits the password, the phishing page transmits the password, along with the account identifier and browser user-agent information, to the actor's HTTP C2 server through a "google_login_check" request. The threat actor's server, placed in an AitM position, then forwards the credentials to the actual Google authentication service.

"The spoofed Google login panels only support Simplified Chinese (zh-CN), Traditional Chinese (zh-TW), and English locales, with region detection based on the victim's browser 'navigator.languages,' strongly suggesting targeting of Chinese-speaking users," Chen explained.

"By deliberately splitting one-shot uploads with POST requests from low-latency state updates with WebSocket connection, the threat actor has engineered a seamless credential-harvesting relay. This allows the threat actor to mirror Google's dynamic authentication state in real time, ultimately achieving full account takeover without raising the victim's suspicion."

summary: 追光者 2026-10-15 【致不屈的靈魂｜《唯紅花綻放》作者馮哲芸專訪 感動港人在高壓下的堅定與韌性】 今年7月，香港兩間獨立書店「留下書舍」和「田園書屋」遭搜查，涉事 書籍包括《唯紅花綻放》。一本書，可以如何「煽動」？作者馮哲芸（Emily Feng）在2019年前往返北京和香港報道，接受《追光者》專訪時說：「去香港總像是進入了另一個世界」。看到書店遭查，她不諱言「真的不知道」書煽動了甚麼，但看到香港人關心書店和言論自由，就感慨「即使他們現時無法在公共空間聚集並定期公
content: 追光者  2026-10-15 【致不屈的靈魂｜《唯紅花綻放》作者馮哲芸專訪 感動港人在高壓下的堅定與韌性】 今年7月，香港兩間獨立書店「留下書舍」和「田園書屋」遭搜查，涉事 書籍包括《唯紅花綻放》。一本書，可以如何「煽動」？作者馮哲芸（Emily Feng）在2019年前往返北京和香港報道，接受《追光者》專訪時說：「去香港總像是進入了另一個世界」。看到書店遭查，她不諱言「真的不知道」書煽動了甚麼，但看到香港人關心書店和言論自由，就感慨「即使他們現時無法在公共空間聚集並定期公開表達，人們依然有一種韌性與堅定去維持本真、做他們自己」。 《唯紅花綻放：習近平時代的認同與歸屬》是一本關於身份認同的書，書中的人物歷經磨難，對自己的身份認同有掙扎過，也失落過。現任NPR（美國全國公共廣播電台）駐華府記者馮哲芸在書中寫道，幾年前往返中國與香港報道時，在機場遇到的海關人員跟她說，即使在海外長大，「本質」仍是中國人，應透過報道「說好中國故事」。隨後幾年，她被官方貼上「民族叛徒」標籤，被指勾結境外敵對勢力。她在2022年被中國拒絕入境後，就開始寫這本書。 一個維權律師、震驚社會的鐵鍊女、一個流亡異鄉的維吾爾父親，乃至「銅鑼灣書店」店長林榮基和流亡海外的香港人，在習近平治下的年代，人們到底如何生活，一個只容許紅花綻放的國度，不屈的生存着，已是一件不容易的事。哪怕只是有尊嚴地賣書、讀書，也成為了一種難以言喻的艱辛。 在中國報道多年，馮哲芸對這片土地上的人的身份認同最感興趣，「因為它是人們行為背後的核心原因，它塑造了社群，塑造了我們的動機，也塑造了政策」。她觀察到，人們往往透過身份認同進行反抗，建立屬於自己的社群和身份，而身份認同的定義相當廣泛，可以是政治身份、性別身份，或是民族與語言身份。 ｜採訪香港抗爭者：非常直接和敢言的社會 很欣賞 書中有幾個章節的人物，都是香港人，除了賣書的林榮基，還有2019年的抗爭者，和坐船離開香港的逃亡者。2019年，馮哲芸剛好在NPR擔任駐中國記者，頻繁往返北京和香港，每個周末都飛到香港報道，「去香港總像是進入了另一個世界」，她笑言不敢自稱是香港問題專家，沒有在香港工作或生活過，但認為香港是一個很有意思的對照，「讓人理解中國『是甚麼』或『不是甚麼』」。 書中其他章節都是獨立的人物，然而關於香港的三章，卻隱約有着互相串聯的地方，「因為香港的故事是全球性的，我在香港遇到的人最終可能去了台灣或美國」。她更說自己在中國採訪時，總有些被訪者是啟發自香港的抗爭運動，從而影響他們在中國的行動。 2019年的採訪已是7年前的事，跟進採訪也已過了4、5年，她對香港的印象，就是一個「非常直接和敢言的社會」，「這是我很欣賞的」。而報道香港時最令她感到衝擊的，是每當從北京到達香港，就是從一個言論受到極其嚴格控制的城巿，突然身處一個喧鬧的示威現場。那種對比令她相當震驚，這也是香港引人入勝的地方，「讓我如此熱愛報道這場示威的原因，就是想去理解是甚麼驅使這些人，這不是突然出現一條法例的草案把大家帶上街頭，背後必然有多年積怨的沉澱」。 ｜感動港人關心書籍：人們依然有一種韌性與堅定去維持本真 7年過去，她把那時遇到的人們寫下來，而這本書卻成為了「煽動刊物」，賣書的店員被捕、書店被迫關閉，到底對香港政府來說，這本書為何如此敏感？又煽動了甚麼？馮哲芸輕輕搖頭：「我真的不知道」。但她承認，此書不是對中國目前政治治理「歌功頌德」，但同時亦不認為它是一本特別激進或帶有強烈社運色彩的書，「我只是有話直說，不會迴避我發現的任何事實。但我當然知道關於維吾爾族、新疆以及香港示威的報道在中國大陸變得極其敏感」。 然而，書中探討的身份認同問題，或者正好揭開中共的傷疤。「他們認為如果操控（身份認同）得當能鞏固執政，但如果失去控制，對國家政權來說將會非常危險。」 2019年年底後，她再也沒有去過香港了，那是《國安法》實施前，也沒有跟被訪的香港人聯繫。幾個月前得悉書籍被港府查抄的消息，甚至成為針對獨立書店店主和店員的調查一部分時，她好像不得不重新審視過去在中國的報道，被拒絕入境已有4年，「當我在不自願的情況下離開中國時，我非常想回去，但我回不去了」。 不能回到中國和香港，但她依然想跟香港人說：「港人關心書籍、關心書店經營者，仍關心言論自由，讓我非常感動。」當看見書店店員被扣上手銬帶上警車時的昂首闊步，讓她更了解香港人有獨立思考能力，擁有自己的價值觀和想法，「即使他們現時無法在公共空間聚集並定期公開表達，人們依然有一種韌性與堅定去維持本真、做他們自己」。 她的新作《為故土焚心：敘利亞戰場上的維吾爾人》（Our Hearts Burned for Home: Uyghur Militants in Syria’s Civil War）已出版，描繪數千名維吾爾人，因在新疆被壓迫和敘利亞內戰，而遠赴他鄉，新書揭示北京的嚴密監視與文化抹殺，如何將整整一代人推向流亡，並影響中東局勢。

# How Chinese Clean Tech Is Reshaping Ukraine’s Wartime Energy Security

Despite China’s close ties with Russia, Chinese solar energy technology is giving Ukraine badly needed energy resilience.

By **Hao Tan**

October 15, 2026

[](https://www.linkedin.com/shareArticle?url=https%3A%2F%2Fthediplomat.com%2F2026%2F10%2Fhow-chinese-clean-tech-is-reshaping-ukraines-wartime-energy-security%2F&title=How+Chinese+Clean+Tech+Is+Reshaping+Ukraine%E2%80%99s+Wartime+Energy+Security "Share on LinkedIn")[](https://www.facebook.com/sharer.php?u=https%3A%2F%2Fthediplomat.com%2F2026%2F10%2Fhow-chinese-clean-tech-is-reshaping-ukraines-wartime-energy-security%2F "Share on Facebook")[](https://bsky.app/intent/compose?text=How+Chinese+Clean+Tech+Is+Reshaping+Ukraine%E2%80%99s+Wartime+Energy+Security%0Ahttps%3A%2F%2Fthediplomat.com%2F2026%2F10%2Fhow-chinese-clean-tech-is-reshaping-ukraines-wartime-energy-security%2F "Share on Bluesky")[](https://twitter.com/intent/tweet?text=How+Chinese+Clean+Tech+Is+Reshaping+Ukraine%E2%80%99s+Wartime+Energy+Security&url=https%3A%2F%2Fthediplomat.com%2F2026%2F10%2Fhow-chinese-clean-tech-is-reshaping-ukraines-wartime-energy-security%2F "Share on X")

A worker on a cherry picker installs solar panels on a building in Kyiv, Ukraine, May 9, 2026.

Credit: [Shutterstock](https://www.shutterstock.com/image-photo/kyiv-ukraine-may-9-2026-editorial-2778680709?trackingId=106fc2f5-479f-4bb0-adae-654795817c83&listId=searchResults)

Russia’s war against Ukraine has shown that energy security is no longer just about access to fuels, pipelines, and large power stations. It also depends on solar panels, batteries, and other distributed energy equipment that can keep homes, businesses, and critical services operating when the electricity grid is under attack.

Ironically, most of the equipment helping Ukraine keep the lights on comes from China.

Beijing has maintained close strategic ties with Russia. Yet through trade and global supply chains, Chinese-made clean energy technologies are helping Ukraine reduce the vulnerability created by Russian attacks on its energy system.

Russia’s attacks exposed the vulnerability of Ukraine’s highly centralized power system. The International Energy Agency (IEA) [estimated](https://www.iea.org/reports/ukraines-energy-security-and-the-coming-winter) that around half of Ukraine’s generation capacity was occupied, damaged or destroyed during 2022-23, while around half of its large network substations were damaged by missiles and drones. After another wave of attacks in spring 2024, Ukraine [lost](https://www.iea.org/reports/ukraines-energy-security-and-the-coming-winter) a further 9 GW of generation capacity, leaving it with only around one-third of its pre-war capacity. On January 20, 2026, another [major Russian attack](https://www.scmp.com/news/world/europe/article/3340587/almost-half-kyiv-without-heat-and-power-after-massive-russian-drone-strike)on energy infrastructure left almost half of Kyiv without heat and power.

Such attacks turned Ukraine’s large, fixed energy assets into major points of vulnerability, making energy [decentralization](https://www.csis.org/analysis/striving-access-security-and-sustainability) an increasingly important source of resilience. Consequently, there has been a resurgence of solar power in Ukraine.

The country was already a significant solar market before Russia’s full-scale invasion, [ranking](https://www.ren21.net/wp-content/uploads/2019/05/gsr_2020_full_report_en.pdf) ninth globally for new solar capacity addition in 2019. But deployment and trade collapsed after February 2022. Chinese module exports to Ukraine [fell](https://www.infolink-group.com/energy-article/tw/solar-topic-solar-energy-ukraine) from 83.9 MW in February 2022 to just 7.5 MW in March, and totaled only 15.8 MW in 2023.

Since then, the market has recovered. The Solar Energy Association of Ukraine [estimated](https://aseu.org.ua/en/in-2025-almost-twice-as-many-solar-power-plants-were-installed-in-ukraine-as-in-the-previous-year/) that around 800 MW of solar was installed in 2024 and 1.5 GW in 2025. Businesses and households have been installing solar power to reduce their dependence on the grid. Distributed solar PV, often combined with battery storage, has therefore [become](https://www.iea.org/reports/policy-options-to-accelerate-distributed-solar-pv-in-ukraine) an important part of Ukraine’s wartime energy security.

International organizations, such as the [IEA](https://www.iea.org/reports/empowering-ukraine-through-a-decentralised-electricity-system) and the [Center for Strategic and International Studies](https://www.csis.org/analysis/striving-access-security-and-sustainability), have recently examined Ukraine’s energy reconstruction, covering aspects such as decentralization, solar power, battery storage, financing, and electricity-market reform. However, these reports tell us remarkably little about the sources of the equipment needed for this transition.

In particular, the role of Chinese-made equipment in this shift has received much less attention. According to the IEA, China [accounts](https://www.iea.org/reports/energy-technology-perspectives-2026) for around 85 percent of global solar supply-chain production capacity and around 80 percent of lithium-ion battery production capacity. Its share in some specific segments is even higher – for example, China supplies around 95 percent of global PV wafer capacity.

content:
中新社台北10月15日电 交易商称，台湾股市周四遭遇第六大单日跌幅，暴跌逾1,600点，因华盛顿隔夜公布高于预期的通胀数据后，科技股受到美联储加息担忧的打击。

台湾证券交易所基准指数在 46,795.38 点至 48,382.75 点之间波动，最终下跌 1,655.96 点，至 46,969.87 点，跌幅为 3.41%。成交总额为新台币 1.32 万亿（409.8 亿美元），而周三为新台币 9,781.4 亿。

“看看成交量的扩大。我认为投资者在恐慌中争相减持，”华南证券分析师Kevin Su表示。 “他们对美国9月份通胀数据感到失望，引发了对鹰派美联储的担忧。”

周三，美国9月消费者价格指数(CPI)数据显示，通胀上涨3.7%，高于市场预期的3.6%。

“利率上升将提高人工智能公司的融资成本，”苏说。 “在科技股估值较高的时期，这种负面影响被放大，导致其股价陷入混乱。”

苏表示，东京和首尔市场半导体股票的下跌增加了台北市场的抛售。
在美国存托凭证下跌3.40%后，占总市值超过40%的台积电(TSMC)下跌2.01%，收于新台币2,440.00元，带动电子指数下跌3.84%。

IC封装测试公司日月光跌10%，创单日最大跌幅，收于新台币673.00元；智能手机IC设计公司联发科跌6.93%，收于新台币4,165.00元。

同样在科技板块，电源管理解决方案提供商台达电子股价下跌 8.68%，收于新台币 1,630.00 元；iPhone 组装商和人工智能服务器制造商鸿海精密工业股份有限公司 (Hon Hai Precision Industry Co.) 收盘下跌 1.44%，收于新台币 239.50 元。

“从科技股的损失来看，我怀疑外国机构投资者继续站在卖方一边，并将资金撤出本地市场，”苏说。

据台湾证券交易所称，周四外国机构投资者在主板净售出新台币3025.6亿美元的股票。

苏表示，随着科技股暴跌，投资者希望将资金投入防御性股票。

中华电信上涨2.69%，收于新台币152.50元；台湾大哥大收涨3.65%，收于新台币131.00元；远传电信上涨4.63%，收于新台币113.00元。

此外，食品品牌统一企业收涨1.66%，至新台币79.50元；味全食品收涨0.44%，至新台币11.50元。
轮动买盘提振金融板块上涨0.73%。玉山金控涨3.17%，报48.80元新台币；兆丰金控涨2.74%，报52.50新台币。

“台交所跌破20日移动平均线48,041点，技术面变得脆弱，”苏说。 “我预计，在指数接近 46,000 点之前，未来还会出现更多损失。”

（弗兰西斯·黄）

结局/ASG

【原文 English Original】
Taipei, Oct. 15 (CNA) Shares in Taiwan suffered their sixth-steepest single-day point loss on Thursday, plunging over 1,600 points as tech stocks were hammered by fears of a Federal Reserve rate hike after Washington released higher-than-expected inflation data overnight, dealers said.

The Taiex, the Taiwan Stock Exchange's benchmark index, ended down 1,655.96 points, or 3.41 percent, at 46,969.87 after moving between 46,795.38 and 48,382.75. Turnover totaled NT$1.32 trillion (US$40.98 billion), compared with NT$978.14 billion Wednesday.

"Look at the expanded turnover. I think investors scrambled to trim their holdings in panic," Hua Nan Securities analyst Kevin Su said. "They were disappointed with the U.S. September inflation data, raising concerns over a hawkish Fed."

On Wednesday, the U.S. consumer price index (CPI) data for September showed that inflation rose 3.7 percent, higher than the market forecast of 3.6 percent.

"Rising interest rates will raise fundraising costs for AI companies," Su said. "At a time of high valuations of tech stocks, such negative leads were amplified, sending their stock prices into a tailspin."

Su said losses for semiconductor stocks in the Tokyo and Seoul markets added selling in Taipei.

After its American depositary receipts lost 3.40 percent, Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. (TSMC), which accounts for over 40 percent of total market value, lost 2.01 percent to close at NT$2,440.00, sending the electronics index down 3.84 percent.

IC packaging and testing firm ASE Technology Holding Co. tumbled 10 percent, the maximum daily decline, to end at NT$673.00, and smartphone IC designer MediaTek Inc. slid 6.93 percent to close at NT$4,165.00.

Also in the tech sector, power management solution provider Delta Electronics Inc. shed 8.68 percent to end at NT$1,630.00, while iPhone assembler and AI server maker Hon Hai Precision Industry Co. closed down 1.44 percent at NT$239.50.

"Judging from the tech losses, I suspect foreign institutional investors continued to stand on the sell side and move their funds out of the local market," Su said.

According to the Taiwan Stock Exchange, foreign institutional investors sold a net NT$302.56 billion of shares on the main board Thursday.

Su said that with tech stocks plunging, investors looked to park their money in defensive stocks.

Chunghwa Telecom Co. rose 2.69 percent to end at NT$152.50 and Taiwan Mobile Co. closed up 3.65 percent at NT$131.00, and Far EasTone Telecommunications Co. ended up 4.63 percent at NT$113.00.

In addition, food brand Uni-President Enterprises Corp. closed up 1.66 percent at NT$79.50, and Wei Chuan Foods Corp. ended 0.44 percent higher at NT$11.50.

Rotational buying lifted the financial sector 0.73 percent. E. Sun Financial Holding Co. closed up 3.17 percent at NT$48.80 and Mega Financial Holding Co. ended up 2.74 percent at NT$52.50.

"The Taiex fell below the 20-day moving average of 48,041 points and became technically fragile," Su said. "I expect more losses ahead until the index gets closer to 46,000 points."

(By Frances Huang)

Enditem/ASG
