summary: 中新社台北10月15日电 菲律宾2026年世界集邮锦标赛展览将于11月在台北举行，为期六天，活动组织者周四表示，以纪念台湾国有邮政服务中华邮政成立130周年。中华邮政的历史可追溯至 1896 年清光绪年间在中国成立的大清邮政。中华民国取代清朝后，国有邮政于1912年改现名。2026年是邮政成立130周年。免费活动的组织者是
content:
中新社台北10月15日电 菲律宾2026年世界集邮锦标赛展览将于11月在台北举行，为期六天，活动组织者周四表示，以纪念台湾国有邮政服务中华邮政成立130周年。

中华邮政的历史可追溯至 1896 年清光绪年间在中国成立的大清邮政。

中华民国取代清朝后，国营邮政于1912年更名为现名。

2026 年是邮政服务诞生 130 周年。

此次免费活动由中华邮政和台湾中华台北集邮联合会（CTPF）主办。这也标志着该国举办世界集邮锦标赛十周年。

主办方表示，该博览会已获得国际集邮联合会（FIP）的批准，将设有约100个展位，以满足来自世界各地的邮政组织、集邮者、贸易商和出版物的需求。

CTPF名誉主席陈友安表示，展会将聚焦创新和可持续发展。

他表示，此次活动预计将吸引来自全球90多个国家和地区的邮政部门代表参加。

此外，陈先生透露，此次活动将展出约2000幅邮票，涵盖从历史到流行文化等广泛题材。
据中华邮报报道，博览会期间还将举办特别主题日，吸引各年龄段、各界人士参加。

例如，中华邮政宣布，在11月20日展览开幕当天，该活动将设有“邮政日”，与会者将能够看到为庆祝世界集邮锦标赛展览而设计的纪念邮票。

与此同时，参加活动“艺术和文学日”的游客将看到以台湾故宫博物院文物为灵感的邮票，而在“收藏家日”参加活动的人们将看到围绕全球流行的神奇宝贝集换式卡牌游戏设计的邮票。

活动中还将展示历史邮票，以教育参观者。

集邮作家俱乐部主席何辉庆表示，将向参观者介绍旧邮票，例如越南民主共和国（越南北部共产主义国家）在 1945 年至 1976 年期间发行的邮票。

何说，未来的集邮爱好者将有机会看到包含针对美国军方的政治宣传的 DRV 邮票，这为从不同角度看待越南战争提供了难得的机会。

菲律宾2026年世界集邮锦标赛展览将于11月20日至25日举行。

主办方欢迎感兴趣的参观者和热心的集邮爱好者参加免费展览。

（詹姆斯·罗）

结局/AW

【原文 English Original】
Taipei, Oct. 15 (CNA) The PHILATAIPEI 2026 World Stamp Championship Exhibition will be held for six days in November in Taipei, marking the 130th anniversary of Chunghwa Post, Taiwan's state-owned postal service, organizers of the event said Thursday.

Chunghwa Post traces its origins to the Great Qing Post, established in China in 1896 during the Qing dynasty under Emperor Guangxu.

After the Qing Dynasty was replaced by the Republic of China, the state-owned postal service was given its current name in 1912.

2026 marks the 130th anniversary of the postal service.

The free event is organized by Chunghwa Post and Taiwan's Chinese Taipei Philatelic Federation (CTPF). It will also mark a decade since the country hosted a World Stamp Championship Exhibition.

Organizers said that the expo has been sanctioned by the International Philatelic Federation (FIP) and will feature around 100 booths to cater to postal organizations, stamp collectors, traders and publications from around the world.

CTPF Honorary chairman Chen Yu-an (陳友安) noted that the exhibition will focus on innovation and sustainability.

He said that the event is expected to attract representatives from postal services in over 90 countries and regions around the world.

In addition, Chen revealed that the event will exhibit about 2,000 frames of stamps, covering a wide range of subjects, from history to pop culture.

According to Chunghwa Post, it will also organize special themed days during the expo to attract attendees of all ages and from all walks of life.

For example, Chunghwa Post announced that on the exhibition's opening day, Nov. 20, the event will feature a "postal day" where attendees will be able to see commemorative stamps designed to celebrate the World Stamp Championship Exhibition.

Meanwhile, visitors to the event's "arts and literature day" will be introduced to stamps inspired by artifacts from Taiwan's National Palace Museum, while people who go to the event during "collectors day" will see stamps designed around the globally popular Pokémon Trading Card Game.

Historical stamps will also be presented at the event to educate visitors.

Ho Huei-ching (何輝慶), President of the Philatelic Writers' Club, said visitors will be introduced to old stamps such as those issued by the Democratic Republic of Vietnam (DRV), the communist state in north Vietnam from 1945-1976.

Ho said prospective philatelists will get the chance to view DRV stamps containing political propaganda directed at the American military, providing a rare opportunity to view the Vietnam War from a different perspective.

The PHILATAIPEI 2026 World Stamp Championship Exhibition will be held from Nov. 20-25.

Organizers welcome interested visitors and avid philatelists to attend the free exhibition.

(By James Lo)

Enditem/AW

title: Chinese startup DexForce uses virtual training to cut humanoid robot costs
zh_title: 中国初创公司 DexForce 使用虚拟训练来降低人形机器人成本
summary: 人工智能 中国初创公司 DexForce 使用模拟或合成数据训练人形机器人，以降低成本并提高效率。这家总部位于深圳的公司表示，这种方法可以加速“物理通用人工智能”的进展，并得到了大型企业集团和国家基金的支持。 [![图片 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编 2026 年 10 月 15 日 16:19 HKT · 2 分钟阅读中国初创公司DexForce 正在使用模拟训练来教学
content:
人工智能
中国初创公司 DexForce 使用模拟或合成数据来训练人形机器人，以降低成本并提高效率。这家总部位于深圳的公司表示，这种方法可以加速“物理通用人工智能”的进展，并得到了大型企业集团和国家基金的支持。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

香港时间 2026 年 10 月 15 日 16:19 · 阅读时间 2 分钟

中国初创公司 DexForce 正在使用模拟训练来教人形机器人执行广泛的现实世界任务，该公司表示，这种方法比从人类工人那里收集数据更快、更便宜。这家总部位于深圳的公司展示了一个屏幕，显示一个虚拟机器人反复将物体放在桌子上，同时其手臂的角度、桌子的颜色和物体本身都发生了变化。
首席执行官贾奎告诉路透社，依靠虚拟环境中生成的合成数据可以更快地推动机器人能力的突破，类似于 ChatGPT 在 2022 年发布后引发的突破，帮助推动生成式人工智能进入主流。 “试图纯粹通过现实世界的数据收集来实现‘物理通用人工智能’将需要 10 万亿个样本……对无限的人类任务进行手动（数据）收集从根本上来说是低效的，”他说，指的是类人机器人可以在不熟悉的环境中按照命令完成新任务的里程碑。

中国已经开发出能够在跑步和跳跃方面超越人类的类人机器人，但更严峻的商业考验在于它们是否能够在工厂、办公室和家庭中可靠地执行有用的工作。许多中国机器人制造商正试图通过从现实世界中重复执行任务的人类工人那里收集大量数据来应对这一挑战。然而，DexForce 开发的人工智能软件旨在模拟物理环境和模型，旨在预测物体如何移动和交互。它创建工作场所或任务的数字版本，在模拟中训练机器人，然后将学习成果转移到物理机器上。
该公司表示，这个过程比从人类训练师那里收集数据更快、更便宜，人类训练师可能需要重复一个动作 100 多次才能生成精确的示例。目前，全国范围内耗巨资建设了数十个仿人机器人数据培训中心，而且往往严重依赖政府补贴。大多数中国机器人制造商都结合使用模拟数据和真实数据，许多人表示获取高质量训练数据仍然是一个关键瓶颈。

贾跃亭是香港中文大学（深圳）的机器学习教授，于 2021 年创立了 DexForce。这家约有 500 名员工的初创公司得到了联想旗下投资部门联想创投、蓝思科技以及多家国有基金的支持。它在最近的 B 轮融资中筹集了 10 亿元人民币（1.47 亿美元），估值超过 100 亿元人民币。彭博社报道称，该公司正在考虑在香港首次公开募股，但贾拒绝发表评论。

该公司的软件被丰田、三星、松下、富士康、海尔和海信等国内外制造商用于工业环境，其仿人机器人则在全国超过 15 个城市的商场和旅游景点制作咖啡并为顾客提供服务。

[![图3：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-

【原文 English Original】
Artificial Intelligence
Chinese startup DexForce trains humanoid robots using simulated, or synthetic, data to cut costs and improve efficiency. The Shenzhen-based firm says the approach could accelerate progress toward "physical artificial general intelligence", and it is backed by major conglomerates and state funds.

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

15 Oct 2026 at 16:19 HKT · 2 min read

Chinese startup DexForce is using simulated training to teach humanoid robots a wide range of real-world tasks, an approach it says is faster and cheaper than collecting data from human workers. The Shenzhen-based company displayed a screen showing a virtual robot repeatedly placing objects on a table while the angle of its arms, the colour of the table and the objects themselves changed.

Chief Executive Jia Kui told Reuters that relying on synthetic data generated in virtual environments could more quickly power a breakthrough in robot capability, similar to the one ChatGPT triggered after its 2022 release helped propel generative AI into the mainstream. "Trying to achieve 'physical artificial general intelligence' purely through real-world data collection would require 10 trillion samples ... manual (data) collection for infinite human tasks is fundamentally inefficient," he said, referring to a milestone where a humanoid can complete new tasks in an unfamiliar environment on command.

China has developed humanoids capable of outperforming humans in running and jumping, but the harder commercial test lies in whether they can reliably carry out useful work in factories, offices and the home. Many Chinese robot makers are trying to meet that challenge by collecting large volumes of data from human workers repeatedly performing tasks in the real world. DexForce, however, develops AI software designed to simulate physical environments and models intended to predict how objects move and interact. It creates a digital version of a workplace or task, trains a robot in the simulation and then transfers that learning to physical machines.

The company says the process is faster and cheaper than collecting data from human trainers, who may need to repeat a movement more than 100 times to generate precise examples. Dozens of humanoid robot data training centres are currently being built nationwide at great expense, and are often heavily reliant on government subsidies. Most Chinese robot makers use a combination of simulated and real-world data, and many say access to high-quality training data remains a key bottleneck.

Jia, a machine-learning professor at the Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen, founded DexForce in 2021. The roughly 500-employee startup is backed by Lenovo Capital, the investment arm of Lenovo, and Lens Technology, as well as several state-owned funds. It raised 1 billion yuan ($147 million) in a recent Series B funding round at a valuation of more than 10 billion yuan. Bloomberg reported it was considering a Hong Kong IPO, but Jia declined to comment.

The firm's software is used in industrial settings by Chinese and foreign manufacturers including Toyota, Samsung, Panasonic, Foxconn, Haier, and Hisense, while its humanoid robots make coffee and serve customers at malls and tourist sites in more than 15 cities nationwide.

content: 作者：呉祚來 央廣 Rti  2026-10-14 韌性是一種綿軟的力量，或者說是難以脆斷的內在生命力，前總統蔡英文在美西時間 8 日出席史丹佛大學胡佛研究所舉辦的論壇，以「新聞標題之外的臺灣：臺灣如何用民主建構韌性」為題發表演說，在蔡英文看來，臺灣的韌性，來自民主制度的保障、社會團結的力量、務實的安全防衛、創新的經濟基礎，以及持續自我更新的能力。臺灣的韌性，是人民選擇自由，並在挑戰中不斷前行的力量。 而哥倫比亞大學教授黎安友二十多年前提出的威權韌性理論，曾經揭示中共制度化改革對於政權延續的重要意義。今天，隨著最高權力重新集中、接班慣例弱化、社會自主空間收縮，一個新的問題出現了：當原先支撐威權韌性的制度化機制受到削弱，政權還能在多大程度上依靠組織控制和行政動員應對新的危機？高度集中的權力能夠迅速作出決策，但如果缺乏真實的資訊反饋與有效的糾錯機制，也可能使局部錯誤演變為全局風險。 本文將就上述話題分別綜述與分析，以比照民主體制與威權體制社會的韌性及其可持續性。 臺灣的韌性：民主社會面對挑戰的力量 蔡英文在演講中分析了臺灣的韌性究竟是什麼？它不僅是面對外部威脅時的抵抗能力，更是一個民主社會在危機中保持自由、凝聚共識、維護安全並不斷發展的綜合能力。 蔡英文認為民主有時顯得吵雜與混亂，然而在真正關鍵的時刻，人們願意保持彈性、放下分歧、形成共同力量並尋找共識，這正是所謂的「民主韌性」。她同時強調，臺灣不希望外界僅因所面對的危險或外部威脅而認識自己，而是希望世界看見臺灣人民共同建立的社會。面對網路攻擊、假訊息操作、供應鏈中斷等日益複雜的挑戰，臺灣持續參與世界、為世界做出貢獻的決心不會動搖。 在兩岸關係上，蔡英文表示，處理相關問題需要充分準備與必要的克制。臺灣社會已形成「維持兩岸現狀、避免不必要挑釁、保護自身民主與安全」的廣泛共識；民主的韌性也要靠軍事實力維繫，蔡英文提到：「在我擔任總統的 2016 到 2024 年之間，臺灣也從不同面向強化韌性。國防支出增加超過八成，同一期間 GDP 成長將近四成；我們也投入更多資源，強化不對稱戰力以及關鍵基礎設施。」以強大的實力平衡兩岸關係，使臺灣和平不至於因武統力量的強大而被破壞。 她進一步提到，臺灣提供給世界的不僅是半導體與科技，更是一個有豐富經驗、有能力與他人分享的夥伴。她呼籲民主國家結合各自優勢，共同打造更具韌性的合作體系，讓安全、產業與民主得以相互支撐。 我認同蔡英文的演講觀點，要補充的是，臺灣民主韌性，不僅來自制度，也來自沒有割裂傳統人文道德倫理精神，我多次到臺灣參觀考察時，既能感受到民間社會的自由隨意，也能感受到特有的人情良善，傳統德性與現代政治體現了完美融合，臺灣不僅有現代政治文明帶來的自由平等紅利，也有傳統文化多元，社會高親善度的深厚背景。 地緣政治與國際政治上，臺灣與美國、日本等民主國家親善，形成文明國家共同體，保障了臺灣在戰略上的安全，臺灣不僅是臺灣人民的臺灣，也是第一島鏈居核心地位的軍事要津，並關乎印太特別是南中國海的航行安全。 本文還要進一步強調，臺灣制度的韌性，在外交領域也表現卓異，中共利用金元外交，使許多中小國家與臺灣斷交，但臺灣卻表現出不凡的外交智慧，既強化印太區域合作，與制度相同的國家、國家利益一致的國家形成合力，又與歐美文明國家議會或社會各界合作，使臺灣議題得以提升與關注。 無論政治、經濟、外交還是軍事位置，臺灣憑藉自身的制度韌性、經濟實力、國際合作及重要戰略位置，不僅增強了自身應對危機的能力，也成為影響印太地區安全與全球經濟穩定的重要力量。 中共政權的威權韌性是否依舊？ 中共政權是不是也有制度性的韌性？美國哥倫比亞大學政治學者黎安友（ Andrew J. Nathan ）於 2003 年發表《威權韌性》一文，黎安友最初認為，中共具備韌性是因為它擺脫了毛澤東時代的個人獨裁，走向了「制度化威權」 —— 包括建立有規律的高層接班機制、黨內規範化協商、功能專業化的官僚體系，以及有限度的社會表達空間。 黎安友對習近平時代的分析指出，中共高層政治在集權化進程中發生了顯著變化。習近平上台後打破了許多此前相對制度化的安排，將大量權力收歸自身，通過強化集中領導和政治紀律壓縮公民社會空間，並把反腐與黨紀整頓轉變為由最高層直接掌控的垂直體系。從組織與紀律角度看，官僚機器因此顯得更為嚴密強大；但高壓環境也帶來資訊上的脆弱，基層與官員因畏懼而不敢如實反映情況，最高決策層難以準確掌握公眾與民間的真實想法，增加了決策脫離現實的風險。（美國之音 2018 年 2 月 28 日） 有限任期的修憲改變進一步放大了這種不確定性：國家主席任期限制被廢除、終身化執政格局形成後，高層政治失去了可預測的接班規則，潛在的權力鬥爭與不穩定性隨之上升，這也使最高權力交接面臨新的不確定性。在經濟與政權存亡的關係上，黎安友並不認同簡單的「經濟崩潰論」，國際層面，習近平領導下的中共仍通過經濟、外交與軍事等手段積極擴大影響力。 我認同黎安友教授上述精闢的分析，我想進一步強調，在鄧、江、胡時代，政權的韌性主要依賴經濟的高速增長，而這與美國、歐洲對華政策相關。中國加入世界貿易組織，與美國及歐洲主要經濟體的市場開放、國際資本和全球產業鏈的深度參與密切相關。世界資本主義的血不僅使經歷文革大潰敗的中國獲得了生機，同時也成長為紅色巨龍，這是當年中共強有力韌性的前提條件。 當時中共內部不成文的規則：「七上八下」的高層退出機制與「隔代指定」的最高領導繼位方式的確立，使高層權力過渡平穩有序，也保證了高層的派系平衡。相比毛的終身制與習的修憲後連任，它使中共內政有了韌性，難以脆斷。 我們再看經濟，中共政權在兩個層面上均已失去韌性：一是國內經濟依賴的人口與地產紅利盡失，地方政府正在失去經濟支撐；二是世界工廠優勢的外向出口，因歐美相關進口關稅，使大量企業外移，隨著歐美強化關稅管控、甚至在高端技術與產品上實施禁運，為了經濟安全一步步與中共脫鉤，即便中共經濟一時不會脆斷，但已失去可持續發展的內外動力，原有的經濟韌性，也隨之弱化。 還有就是中共體制性的脆弱性：體制內與體制外、城市與鄉村、發達地區與邊遠不發達區域，貧富分化加劇，使中國社會極易產生不穩定因素，一旦經濟或政治危機爆發，社會就會劇烈動盪，政權極易更替。 結語：真正的韌性，是制度能夠糾正自身的錯誤 比較臺灣與中國大陸的制度韌性，我們發現一個值得深思的政治現象：威權體制可以擁有強大的組織動員能力，能夠集中資源、控制社會、維持政權運轉；民主社會則通過權力競爭、公民參與、社會自治和公開討論，形成另一種制度適應能力。威權體制無法遏制通過集權走向極權的危境，可以說，集權度越高，剛性越強，韌性越弱，而這極大增加了威權體制的脆斷風險。 臺灣的經驗則提供了另一種觀察視角：民主政治不保證沒有爭吵、失誤和危機，但它允許人民批評政府、通過選舉更換領導人，並借助公民社會的自主力量參與公共事務。臺灣的民主韌性還與傳統人文倫理、現代經濟創新和國際合作相互聯繫，使政治制度之外的社會資源能夠參與危機應對，所以臺灣的韌性背後有更多的力量維繫與支撐，安全上有文明世界的協力、協防，政治上有更多的互信、互動，經濟上有更多的互利、互補。這使得臺灣的韌性是網狀的，而非集權政治韌性的單線模式（黨政一體）。 因此，判斷一種制度是否具有韌性，不能只看它維持了多少年的統治，也不能只看國家機器擁有多強的控制能力。我們還需要追問：面對錯誤，誰有權提出批評？面對危機，社會能否自主行動？面對權力失誤，制度能否實現和平糾正？   作者》 吳祚來   獨立學者，專欄作家。

title: The 'Small Power Forward'
summary: As we continue to fantasize about building twin towers for our national team, successful teams in the NBA are redefining positions to fit the modern game. The Golden State Warriors redefined the game in 2015 and made it a shooting league, a
content:
As we continue to fantasize about building twin towers for our national team, successful teams in the NBA are redefining positions to fit the modern game. The Golden State Warriors redefined the game in 2015 and made it a shooting league, and the paradigm of the typical starting five has changed drastically.

**Height Not Might?**

The adage of “height is might” has been floated since basketball began. After all, it is clearly a vertical sport with a 10-foot rim. Being tall allowed one to reach the goal quicker and easier. Thus, the early dominant players in the sport were centers, and the best example is George Mikan of the Minneapolis Lakers.

*   [Rising Spanish tennis star handed code violation for swearing at ballboy](https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/10/14/sports/rising-spanish-tennis-star-handed-code-violation-for-swearing-at-ballboy/2445568)

After Mikan, new generations of big men emerged like the rivalry of Bill Russell and Wilt Chamberlain. The 1980s saw Patrick Ewing, Hakeem Olajuwon, and David Robinson. Up until the 1990s, being tall pretty much guaranteed a ticket to the NBA.

Nowadays, being tall is no longer much of an advantage, and it’s not just in the NBA. As seen in the recent Asian games, the tallest team (China) got walloped by Akatsuki Japan, a team well-entrenched in the modern style of play.

**Skillset Over Positional Size**

It’s ironic to brush off height these days now that Victor Wembanyama has become a dominant force. Having a unicorn type center still matters, and more Wemby-types are on the way. Teams still need a center, but the traditional frontcourt mate has evolved.

In the recent NBA Finals, the starting power forwards were OG Anunoby and Julian Champagnie. Both were 6’7, and were more attuned as small forwards rather than the traditional power forward. LeBron James, Pascal Siakam, Jayson Tatum, Kevin Durant were former All-Stars as small forwards.

*   ![Image 1: Laguna mayors rally behind Aragones](https://miopia.newsroom.bi/statics/i/ps/manilatimes.net/manilatimes/uploads/images/2026/10/14/1257533.jpg?width=113&crop=113:85)
[Laguna mayors rally behind Aragones](https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/10/14/regions/laguna-mayors-rally-behind-aragones/2444954)

That doesn’t mean there is no more space for tall power forwards. Chet Holmgren is the power forward in the OKC Thunder’s twin tower starting combo. But Holmgren is the modern big–mobile, with three-point shooting range and able to play facing the basket.

The game has changed and there are less post-up plays and more three-point shots. That results in long rebounds and more fastbreak attempts. Even tall players need to be quick and run back on defense.

It can be recalled that Anthony Davis famously complained about being played as a center, and demanded a trade. He can’t avoid that now, as it would be considered a waste of a position to place him with a big bruiser. Fortunately, young starter Alex Sarr has European-developed skills.

Athleticism, lateral quickness, and strength override height. For the international game, that’s what Gilas should look for, more than seeking someone who’s simply 6’10. Younger players with those skills like Scottie Barnes and Jalen Johnson started as small forwards, but are now converted. For Gilas, players like Carl Tamayo and Zavier Lucero could play that role.

**PBA Draft 2027 Prospects**

The PBA Draft 2027 is a couple of months away, and it has a deep bag of talent including two graduating seasons of the UAAP.

Here is a list of the realistic prospects which PBA teams could choose from. This is by no means final since the deadline to declare is still far off. FIl-foreign players who are not FIBA eligible like Kymani Ladi are here since they also would not qualify for the B.League or KBL. Mike Phillips, who is already in the B.League, is not listed anymore.

Some of the local prospects here could get their aspired call-up as Asian imports (Mason Amos is rumored), while other names like Remy Martin, Kihei Clark, and Kamaka Hepa are still longshots at this time.

title: What is the SIRA Act, and why does the US want to strengthen research security?
summary: The US House Select Committee on the Chinese Communist Party (CCP) has called on Congress to pass legislation aimed at preventing the alleged theft and misuse of American taxpayer-funded research by entities linked to [China.](https://www.f
content:
The US House Select Committee on the Chinese Communist Party (CCP) has called on Congress to pass legislation aimed at preventing the alleged theft and misuse of American taxpayer-funded research by entities linked to [China.](https://www.financialexpress.com/policy/economy/indias-exports-to-china-jump-40-yet-trade-deficit-widens-to-105-93-bn-in-january-sept/4361369/?ref=articlehyperlinking)

In a report titled ‘How to Stop China’s Theft of America’s Taxpayer-Funded Research’, committee chairman John Moolenaar, a Republican from Michigan, claims that the US needs stronger safeguards to protect research funded by the federal government.

The report calls for the passage of the Securing Innovation and Research from Adversaries (SIRA) Act, which seeks to establish consistent restrictions on federally funded research collaborations involving entities on US government restricted lists.

The report draws on congressional investigations, federal enforcement actions and inspector general findings. It also addresses concerns that stricter research security rules could affect academic freedom, slow scientific progress and increase the administrative burden on universities. Here is what the proposed legislation seeks to do and why it matters.

ALSO READ

## What is the SIRA Act?

The Securing Innovation and Research from Adversaries (SIRA) Act is proposed legislation aimed at protecting US-funded research from potential security risks linked to foreign entities.

The legislation would establish government-wide restrictions on federally funded research collaborations involving entities listed on [US government](https://www.financialexpress.com/market/global-markets/us-treasury-yields-could-stay-high-for-the-rest-of-the-decade-heres-what-economists-say/4359783/?ref=articlehyperlinking)restricted lists. These lists identify organisations or other entities that face restrictions because of concerns such as national security risks.

The main objective is to ensure that money provided by American taxpayers for scientific research does not support collaborations with entities that the US government has identified as security risks.

Federal funding supports research in areas such as science, [technology,](https://www.financialexpress.com/life/technology/nvidia-ceo-jensen-huang-claims-ai-is-insanely-profitable-as-he-courts-billionaire-families/4258255/?ref=articlehyperlinking)engineering and medicine. The proposed legislation seeks to ensure that such funding is used in ways that protect American research interests and national security.

The report argues that research security rules should be consistent across federal agencies rather than vary significantly depending on which agency provides the funding.

## Why has the US raised concerns about research security?

The committee’s report focuses on cases in which researchers allegedly failed to disclose foreign appointments, financial arrangements or participation in overseas talent recruitment programmes.

According to the committee, records examined by federal investigators include cases involving researchers who received compensation from institutions in the People’s Republic of China (PRC) without making the required disclosures to US research funding agencies.

The records also describe alleged conflicts of commitment. These arise when a researcher has obligations to multiple institutions that could affect the time, responsibilities or resources available for their federally funded work.

Another concern is the failure to disclose information about foreign employment and research affiliations. Federal funding agencies rely on such disclosures to assess potential conflicts of interest, overlapping commitments and national security risks.

ALSO READ

The committee argues that these issues require stronger oversight because some of the reported disclosure failures continued across several years, research grants and institutions.

The allegations in individual cases do not, by themselves, establish that every researcher with a foreign affiliation engaged in wrongdoing. The report uses the investigated cases to argue for more consistent disclosure requirements and safeguards.

## What does the committee want the law to change?

The report recommends several measures to strengthen the protection of federally funded research.

**Restrictions on certain research collaborations:**The SIRA Act would introduce consistent restrictions across the federal government on research collaborations involving entities on US government restricted lists. This would provide agencies with a common framework for determining which collaborations should not receive federal research funding.

**Stronger monitoring after grants are awarded:**The committee wants federal agencies to monitor research projects more closely even after funding has been approved. This could help identify changes in researchers’ affiliations, undisclosed financial arrangements or other concerns that emerge during a project’s duration.

**Consistent security standards across agencies:**The report calls for common research security standards across federal agencies. The aim is to reduce differences in how agencies handle disclosures, assess risks and oversee research grants.

**Incentives for universities:**The committee recommends incentives for universities that voluntarily introduce strong research security measures. These could encourage institutions to improve their disclosure procedures and internal checks.

**Stronger enforcement:** The report also calls for greater use of suspension and debarment powers when supported by investigative findings. These measures can restrict an individual or organisation from receiving federal funding or participating in government-funded programmes. Their use would depend on the relevant findings and applicable procedures.

## Why has the committee released more than 700 pages of records?

Alongside the report, the committee released more than 700 pages of previously non-public, unclassified investigative records related to cases examined by the National Science Foundation Office of Inspector General (NSF OIG).

The documents include investigative reports, recommendations on suspension and debarment, official correspondence, financial records, federal grant disclosures and material related to foreign employment and talent recruitment programmes.

According to the committee, the records show cases involving undisclosed foreign appointments, payments from Chinese institutions and failures to report information required by federal funding agencies.

The committee said making the documents public would allow researchers, universities, policymakers and taxpayers to examine the evidence behind its recommendations.

It also argued that repeated failures to disclose foreign affiliations or financial arrangements should not automatically be treated as minor paperwork mistakes. The committee believes such cases require closer scrutiny, particularly when they involve federally funded research.

The release of these records is intended to support the committee’s argument that existing oversight measures need to be strengthened.

How could the SIRA Act affect universities and researchers?

If enacted, the proposed legislation could require universities and researchers receiving federal funding to pay closer attention to their research partnerships and institutional affiliations.

Universities may need to strengthen procedures for checking whether research partners appear on government restricted lists. Researchers could also face closer scrutiny of their foreign appointments, financial support and other professional commitments.

Federal agencies would have a more consistent framework for determining which research collaborations are eligible for government funding. The proposed changes could also increase the responsibility of universities to identify and report potential risks.

The precise impact would depend on the final legislation, its implementation and the rules adopted by federal agencies.

The proposal does not mean that every research collaboration with a Chinese institution would automatically be prohibited. Its stated focus is on collaborations involving entities identified on US government restricted lists.

One of the concerns examined in the report is that tighter research security measures could restrict academic freedom and make international scientific cooperation more difficult.

Universities and researchers rely on international partnerships to exchange knowledge, conduct experiments and develop new technologies. Additional checks could increase administrative work and make some collaborations harder to establish or maintain.

The committee argues that these concerns do not outweigh the need to protect taxpayer-funded research. It maintains that universities should not be left solely responsible for addressing risks involving restricted entities.

The report also challenges the argument that existing university oversight is sufficient. It points to investigative records as evidence that disclosure failures can continue across multiple grants and institutions.

The debate, therefore, centres on how the US can protect sensitive research without unnecessarily limiting legitimate academic cooperation. The report presents the case for stronger safeguards, while the practical effects would depend on how the proposed rules are framed and enforced.

The report is a call for Congress to pass the SIRA Act. Its release does not mean that the proposed legislation has automatically become law.

Congress would need to take the necessary legislative steps before the proposal could establish binding requirements. Federal agencies would then need to implement any enacted provisions through their funding and oversight processes.

The committee has also recommended measures that extend beyond the proposed legislation, including closer monitoring of grants, common security standards and stronger enforcement when investigations support action.

The release of the investigative records is another part of the committee’s effort to build support for these changes by making the evidence behind its recommendations available for public examination.

title: Promising outlook for Sino-Indian tech collaboration
summary: By Arunava Das in Kolkata and Xu Weiwei in Hong Kong | chinadaily.com.cn | Updated: 2026-10-14 19:59 [![Image 1](https://www.chinadaily.com.cn/image_e/2020/facebook.png)](https://www.facebook.com/sharer.php?title=Promising%20outlook%20for%2
content:
By Arunava Das in Kolkata and Xu Weiwei in Hong Kong | chinadaily.com.cn | Updated: 2026-10-14 19:59 [![Image 1](https://www.chinadaily.com.cn/image_e/2020/facebook.png)](https://www.facebook.com/sharer.php?title=Promising%20outlook%20for%20Sino-Indian%20tech%20collaboration&u=https://www.chinadaily.com.cn/a/202610/14/WS6acf6eb4e4b06d4aa0562d18.html "facebook")[![Image 2](https://www.chinadaily.com.cn/image_e/2024/twitter.png)](https://twitter.com/share?text=Promising%20outlook%20for%20Sino-Indian%20tech%20collaboration&url=https://www.chinadaily.com.cn/a/202610/14/WS6acf6eb4e4b06d4aa0562d18.html "twitter")[![Image 3](https://www.chinadaily.com.cn/image_e/2020/linkedin.png)](http://www.linkedin.com/shareArticle?mini=true&title=Promising%20outlook%20for%20Sino-Indian%20tech%20collaboration&url=https://www.chinadaily.com.cn/a/202610/14/WS6acf6eb4e4b06d4aa0562d18.html "linkedin")[![Image 4](https://www.chinadaily.com.cn/image_e/2017/more_art.gif)](https://www.chinadaily.com.cn/a/202610/14/WS6acf6eb4e4b06d4aa0562d18.html "More")

Following the conclusion of the 18th BRICS Summit in New Delhi, observers see significant opportunity and potential in India-China technology collaboration, particularly in the field of artificial intelligence (AI).

Even though competition remains in the technology area, both China and India have their respective advantages so there is also a powerful complementarity, the experts said.

"While India can contribute the software, talent, services and global application layer, China could contribute manufacturing, hardware, industrial deployment and AI engineering at scale," said Dipankar Chakrabarti, founder and managing director, BDSCube Technology Private Limited.

"The BRICS New Delhi Declaration explicitly supports AI cooperation," said Swaran Singh, a former professor of international relations at Jawaharlal Nehru University in Delhi, India.

AI, climate modelling, public health, disaster forecasting, agricultural innovation and affordable digital public infrastructure offer practical entry points for the two countries to work together in technology, the expert said.

Chakrabarti, who formerly was executive director and India leader for data control office at PwC, told China Daily that the most interesting signal from the BRICS Summit in New Delhi is that AI has moved from being a technology issue to being part of the geopolitical architecture of the Global South.

"The BRICS declaration explicitly calls for international cooperation on AI accessibility, safety, innovation and governance," he said. "India and China could cooperate on AI safety and governance. This is particularly plausible because both countries want greater representation for developing countries in global AI governance."

Debashis Sen, a former senior bureaucrat, told China Daily that the BRICS Summit serves as an invitation for countries to look beyond competition toward areas where cooperation could benefit all.

"AI and robotics are among the most promising. The New Delhi Declaration commits members to implementing the BRICS statement on the global governance of AI, and backs cooperation on Industry 4.0 and smart factories," Sen, former additional chief secretary of IT & E in West Bengal, said.

He added that China has become a major force in humanoid robots, while India offers scale, technical talent and a vast laboratory of real-world challenges such as elder care, traffic management, pedestrian safety and sanitation.

Sen, the founder of New Bengal Consulting Pvt Ltd (NBC), which works on AI adoption in the public sector, sees how much these matter for governance.

Chakrabarti said India and China possess capabilities across the entire stack, but they "don't necessarily need to share their most sensitive technologies to cooperate".

Sen also believed the two neighbors can have promising collaboration. "A focused dialogue on civilian AI and robotics among researchers, startups, industry and policymakers would be a sensible beginning. This would allow two neighbors to compete where necessary and cooperate where possible, so technology becomes a bridge rather than another arena of rivalry," he said.

title: MAC accuses Beijing of election interference over Puma Shen family firm sanctions - Focus Taiwan
zh_title: MAC指责北京因对彪马沉氏家族实施严厉制裁而干涉选举 - 聚焦台湾
summary: 中新社台北10月14日电 中国大陆宣布制裁另一家与民进党台北市市长候选人沈伯洋之父有关联的公司后，大陆委员会周三指责北京试图干涉台湾选举。台湾负责中国事务的最高政府机构陆委会在一份声明中表示，北京在竞选期间利用有针对性的媒体叙事来“给某些政治阵营和候选人贴上标签，并施加经济压力”。 “这明显是恶意胁迫台湾社会、干涉台湾社会。”
content:
中新社台北10月14日电 中国大陆宣布制裁另一家与民进党台北市市长候选人沈伯洋之父有关联的公司后，大陆委员会周三指责北京试图干涉台湾选举。

台湾负责中国事务的最高政府机构陆委会在一份声明中表示，北京在竞选期间利用有针对性的媒体叙事来“给某些政治阵营和候选人贴上标签，并施加经济压力”。

马克说：“这显然是恶意胁迫台湾社会并干涉我们的民主选举。”

该委员会还指出，最新的制裁措施与去年对沈父的公司实施的制裁方式相同，在中国台湾事务办公室（TAO）宣布惩罚措施之前，香港媒体就出现了有针对性的报道。

MAC 做出回应之前，TAO 发言人陈斌华周三早些时候宣布，与沉的父亲沉土城有联系的 VWAY 有限公司已被禁止与中国的组织、公司和个人开展业务或合作。

陈在北京举行的例行新闻发布会上表示，尽管沉先生的另一家企业于 2025 年 6 月受到制裁，但沉先生的父亲仍然利用 VWAY 继续与中国公司进行贸易并创造利润。
在 TAO 宣布这一消息之前，亲北京的香港报纸《文汇报》周二发表了一篇报道，指控沉的父亲继续通过 VWAY 与中国公司开展业务。

在吹风会上，陈指责沉反华，阻碍两岸交流，同时与他的亲属一起寻找从中国市场获利的方法。

他补充说：“我们决不允许与顽固的台独分裂分子有联系的企业从大陆获利。”

2024年10月，北京将倾向台独的民进党无席立法委员沉定为“顽固台独分裂分子”，禁止他及其家人进入中国大陆、香港和澳门。

2025年6月5日，北京对其父亲的贸易公司Sicuens International Co., Ltd.实施制裁。

沉在当年6月13日的评论中表示，该公司只是从中国普通供应商订购产品，包括汽车零部件和自行车。

针对民政总署周三晚些时候的声明，沉的竞选办公室表示，台北居民正在选举市长，民政总署应该明白，这样的行为不会赢得台湾公众的信任。

竞选办公室补充说，相信正在寻求连任的国民党台北市市长蒋万安也持有同样的观点。

## TAO 在城市论坛上回绝沉
与此同时，TAO周三还驳回了沉表示如果当选市长，愿意参加一年一度的台北-上海双城论坛的说法。

沉在最近的一次采访中表示，他支持在今年晚些时候举办该论坛，如果当选，他将参加，前提是没有政治先决条件，并且该活动能带来实实在在的好处，包括对企业的好处。

陈在周三的吹风会上表示，过去16年来，该论坛促进了台北和上海在经济事务和城市管理方面的合作，但指责“顽固的台独分裂分子”“煽动两岸对抗”，并称他们“没有资格谈论台湾问题”。

【原文 English Original】
Taipei, Oct. 14 (CNA) The Mainland Affairs Council (MAC) on Wednesday accused Beijing of attempting to interfere in Taiwan's elections after China announced sanctions against another company linked to the father of Democratic Progressive Party (DPP) Taipei mayoral candidate Puma Shen (沈伯洋).

In a statement, MAC, Taiwan's top government agency for China affairs, said Beijing was using targeted media narratives to "label certain political camps and candidates and exert economic pressure" during the election campaign.

"This is clearly a malicious attempt to coerce Taiwanese society and interfere in our democratic elections," MAC said.

The council also noted that the latest sanctions followed the same pattern as those imposed on Shen's father's company last year, with targeted reports appearing in Hong Kong media before China's Taiwan Affairs Office (TAO) announced punitive measures.

MAC's response came after TAO spokesperson Chen Binhua (陳斌華) announced earlier Wednesday that VWAY Co., Ltd., a company linked to Shen's father, Shen Tu-cheng (沈土城), had been barred from conducting business or cooperating with organizations, companies and individuals in China.

At a regular news briefing in Beijing, Chen said that Shen's father had used VWAY to continue trading with Chinese firms and generating profits despite sanctions imposed on another of his businesses in June 2025.

The TAO announcement followed a report published Tuesday by the pro-Beijing Hong Kong newspaper Wen Wei Po alleging that Shen's father had continued doing business with Chinese companies through VWAY.

At the briefing, Chen accused Shen of opposing China and obstructing cross-strait exchanges while working with his relatives to find ways to profit from the Chinese market.

"We will never allow companies associated with diehard Taiwan independence separatists to profit from the mainland," he added.

Beijing designated Shen, a legislator-at-large from the independence-leaning DPP, a "diehard Taiwan independence separatist" in October 2024, barring him and his family members from entering China, Hong Kong and Macao.

On June 5, 2025, Beijing extended sanctions to his father's trading company, Sicuens International Co., Ltd.

In comments on June 13 that year, Shen said the company had merely ordered products, including automotive parts and bicycles from ordinary suppliers in China.

In response to the TAO's announcement later Wednesday, Shen's campaign office said Taipei residents were electing a mayor and that the TAO should understand that such actions would not win the trust of the Taiwanese public.

The campaign office added that it believed incumbent Taipei Mayor Chiang Wan-an (蔣萬安) of the Kuomintang (KMT), who is seeking reelection against Shen, held the same view.

## TAO rebuffs Shen on city forum

Meanwhile, the TAO on Wednesday also dismissed Shen's stated willingness to attend the annual Taipei-Shanghai Twin-City Forum if elected mayor.

Shen had said in a recent interview that he supported holding the forum later this year and would attend if elected, provided there were no political preconditions and the event offered tangible benefits, including for businesses.

At Wednesday's briefing, Chen said the forum had facilitated cooperation between Taipei and Shanghai in economic affairs and city management over the past 16 years, but accused "diehard Taiwan independence separatists" of "stoking cross-strait confrontation," saying they were "in no position to talk about cross-strait exchanges and cooperation."

(By Lu Chia-jung, Liu Chien-pang and Sunny Lai)

title: Hong Kong reports new monkeypox case, closes Mong Kok venue
summary: 香港一名39岁男子在香港旺角一处场所进行高风险性接触后检测出猴痘呈阳性，该场所已被建议关闭。由于病例急剧增加，卫生防护中心自9月14日起敦促游客拨打热线。 [![图片 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编 2026 年 10 月 13 日 22:41 HKT · 2 分钟阅读 香港已录得新猴痘病例，涉及一名39岁男子，目前情况稳定，正在接受治疗
content:
香港
香港一名39岁男子在旺角一处场所发生高风险性接触后，猴痘检测呈阳性，该场所已被建议关闭。由于病例急剧增加，卫生防护中心自9月14日起敦促游客拨打热线。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

香港时间 2026 年 10 月 13 日 22:41 · 阅读时间 2 分钟

卫生防护中心周二表示，香港新增一例猴痘病例，涉及一名39岁男子，目前情况稳定，正在接受隔离治疗。

病人自10月5日起右脚、脸部、背部及臀部出现皮疹，并于10月8日到私家医生就诊。次日转介至仁济医院接受隔离治疗，其临床样本对猴痘病毒呈阳性反应。此后他被转移到玛格丽特公主医院继续接受护理。

该男子在潜伏期内多次到旺角上海街一处名为“胡同”的场所，与陌生人发生高风险性接触。作为预防措施，卫生防护中心已建议该场馆从周二起暂停运营。
卫生防护中心联同警方到胡同进行现场排查，并向工作人员进行健康教育，目前没有人出现任何症状。中心呼吁任何在9月14日或之后到访该处所的人士，尤其是曾与陌生人发生性接触的人士，请致电热线2125 2373进行健康评估。

香港自8月以来已录得22宗猴痘个案，约占今年31宗个案的70%。所有患者均为男性，并报告有高风险性行为，其中大多数未接种疫苗。基因分析显示，一些患者具有相同的序列，这表明男男性行为群体中存在共同的感染源和多个传播链。

针对近期激增的情况，卫生防护中心加强了针对性的控制措施。本月接种的猴痘疫苗剂量比上个月增加了70%以上。该中心敦促高危人群及时接种疫苗，并保留性伴侣的联系方式，以便于追踪接触者。

【原文 English Original】
Hong Kong
A 39-year-old man has tested positive for monkeypox in Hong Kong after high-risk sexual contact at a Mong Kok venue, which has been advised to close. The Centre for Health Protection urges visitors since September 14 to call a hotline, as cases rise sharply.

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

13 Oct 2026 at 22:41 HKT · 2 min read

Hong Kong has recorded a new monkeypox case involving a 39-year-old man, who is in stable condition and receiving isolation treatment, the Centre for Health Protection (CHP) said on Tuesday.

The patient developed rashes on his right foot, face, back and buttocks from October 5, and visited a private doctor on October 8. He was referred to Yan Chai Hospital the next day for isolation treatment, where his clinical samples tested positive for the monkeypox virus. He has since been transferred to Princess Margaret Hospital for continued care.

During his incubation period, the man made multiple visits to a premises called "Hutong" on Shanghai Street in Mong Kok, where he had high-risk sexual contact with strangers. As a precaution, the CHP has advised the venue to suspend operations from Tuesday.

The CHP, together with police, conducted an on-site investigation at Hutong and provided health education to staff, none of whom have shown symptoms so far. The centre is urging anyone who visited the premises on or after September 14, particularly those who had sexual contact with strangers there, to call the hotline 2125 2373 for a health assessment.

Hong Kong has recorded 22 monkeypox cases since August, accounting for about 70 per cent of the 31 cases this year. All patients are male and reported high-risk sexual behaviour, with most unvaccinated. Genetic analysis shows some patients share identical sequences, suggesting a common source of infection and multiple transmission chains within the men who have sex with men community.

In response to the recent surge, the CHP has stepped up targeted control measures. The number of monkeypox vaccine doses administered this month has risen by more than 70 per cent compared with the previous month. The centre is urging high-risk individuals to get vaccinated promptly and to keep contact details of sexual partners to facilitate contact tracing.

title: Expert warns iPhone Duo buyers over risks of pre-order bots
summary: 香港 苹果可折叠 iPhone Duo 的香港买家面临第三方订购机器人的风险，这些机器人可能会窃取信用卡或个人数据。一位 IT 专家警告说，即使成功的订单也可能导致未经授权的收费，远远超过潜在的转售利润。 [![图片 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编 2026 年 10 月 13 日 19:18 HKT · 2 分钟阅读为苹果可折叠 iPhone Duo 本周五开始预购，香港买家被警告第三方
content:
香港
苹果可折叠 iPhone Duo 的香港买家面临第三方订购机器人的风险，这些机器人可能会窃取信用卡或个人数据。一位 IT 专家警告说，即使成功的订单也可能导致未经授权的收费，远远超过潜在的转售利润。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

香港时间 2026 年 10 月 13 日 19:18 · 阅读时间 2 分钟

随着苹果公司的可折叠 iPhone Duo 本周五开始预购，香港买家被警告称，第三方订购机器人可能会损害他们的信用卡和个人数据，预计供应有限将推动需求。

一位自称专业程序员的经销商一直在 Threads 上推广一款机器人，他表示该机器人可以帮助用户保护新 iPhone 的安全。该服务宣传 7 秒内购买两台 iPhone Duo，价格为 399 港元，或 899 港元的套餐，可尝试三次，如果均失败，可退款。自9月10日起，卖家几乎每天都会发布过往订单、聊天记录和机器人界面的截图，吸引了超过2000条感兴趣的用户评论。
《英文虎报》姊妹刊《星岛日报》的一名记者冒充买家联系了卖家。记者被告知先通过快捷支付系统付款，并发送截图，然后才能收到程序和操作说明。当被问及该软件是否可能包含能够窃取信用卡数据的恶意软件时，卖家否认了这种可能性，并表示：“我不需要做任何非法的事情。”他还引用了之前成功的订单，并声称该机器人“100%不会获取客户的数据”。

香港资讯科技商会名誉会长方宝侨告诫消费者不要走捷径。 “即使你成功地保护了手机，后续成本，包括被盗的个人或信用卡数据，也非常高，”他说。 Fong指出，虽然转售一部抢手的手机可能会带来10,000港元至20,000港元的利润，但受害者随后可能会面临80,000港元至100,000港元的未经授权的信用卡收费。

Fong 警告说，由于用户可能需要输入个人和信用卡信息才能让此类机器人进行操作，恶意软件可能会捕获这些详细信息。他还表示，机器人可能包含特洛伊木马，允许犯罪分子在安装后访问用户的个人或付款信息。 Fong表示，即使卖家没有恶意，也不能保证用户的数据得到安全保护。
[![图片3：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

【原文 English Original】
Hong Kong
Hong Kong buyers of Apple's foldable iPhone Duo face risks from third-party ordering bots that may steal credit card or personal data. An IT expert warns that even successful orders could lead to unauthorized charges far exceeding potential resale profits.

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

13 Oct 2026 at 19:18 HKT · 2 min read

As Apple's foldable iPhone Duo goes on pre-order this Friday, Hong Kong buyers are being warned that third-party ordering bots could compromise their credit card and personal data, with limited supplies expected to drive demand.

A reseller claiming to be a professional programmer has been promoting a bot on Threads that he says can help users secure the new iPhones. The service advertises two iPhone Duos within seven seconds for HK$399, or a HK$899 package offering three attempts with refunds if all fail. Since September 10, the seller has posted almost daily screenshots of past orders, chat records and bot interfaces, attracting more than 2,000 comments from interested users.

A reporter from Sing Tao Daily, sister publication of The Standard, posed as a buyer and contacted the seller. The reporter was told to pay via the Faster Payment System and send a screenshot before receiving the program and operating instructions. When asked if the software could contain malware capable of stealing credit card data, the seller denied the possibility, saying: “I don’t need to do anything illegal.” He also cited previous successful orders and claimed the bot would “100 percent not take customers’ data.”

Francis Fong Po-kiu, honorary president of the Hong Kong Information Technology Federation, cautioned consumers against taking shortcuts. “Even if you succeed in securing the phone, the follow-up cost, including stolen personal or credit card data, is extremely high,” he said. Fong noted that while reselling a sought-after phone could potentially generate profits of HK$10,000 to HK$20,000, victims could later face unauthorized credit card charges of HK$80,000 to HK$100,000.

Fong warned that because users may need to enter personal and credit card information for such bots to operate, malicious software could capture those details. He also said a bot could contain a Trojan horse, allowing criminals to access users’ personal or payment information after installation. Even if the seller had no malicious intent, Fong said there was no guarantee that users’ data would be securely protected.

content:
中国国家主席习近平（右一）星期五（10月16日）在中国人工智能（AI）算力重镇内蒙古乌兰察布考察时说，算力网是国家规划建设的“六张网”之一，算力产业正处在加速发展阶段，前景广阔，要搞好算力中心项目建设和运营。 （央视视频截图）

中国国家主席习近平在中国人工智能（AI）算力重镇内蒙古乌兰察布考察时说，算力网是中国规划建设的“六张网”之一，算力产业正处在加速发展阶段，前景广阔。他在当地提出“搞好算力中心项目建设和运营”的希望。

据新华社报道，习近平星期五（10月16日）在内蒙古自治区中共党委书记王伟中和自治区政府主席包钢陪同下，来到内蒙古乌兰察布市考察调研。

报道称，乌兰察布风光资源丰沛，近些年发挥绿电、气候、区位等比较优势，绿色算力产业发展取得积极成效。习近平前往察哈尔高新技术开发区，在展示厅了解内蒙古自治区推进“东数西算”工程枢纽节点建设和绿色算力产业发展等情况。

习近平说，实施“东数西算”工程、构建全国一体化算力网，是中共中央一项重要部署：“要加强科学规划、要素支撑、安全保障，确保已建成项目高效运行，并如期完成后续项目建设。要积极延伸产业链，推动数字经济与实体经济深度融合，不断把算力优势转化为发展优势。”

随后，习近平同在现场的有关算力中心项目负责人、技术人员、察哈尔高新区工作人员等交流。

习近平说，算力网是中国国家规划建设的“六张网”之一，算力产业正处在加速发展阶段，前景广阔。“希望大家认真落实高效、绿色、安全的要求，注重算电协同、算水协同，搞好算力中心项目建设和运营，积极推动绿色算力产业发展，为推进数字中国建设、促进新质生产力发展多作贡献。”

习近平还要求察哈尔高新区加强中共领导，优化各项公共服务和要素保障，为企业和各类人才干事创业营造良好环境。

报道也提到，习近平还到黄旗海自然保护区，听取内蒙古加强生态环境保护和当地推进黄旗海环境综合治理、生态系统修复等情况汇报，并实地察看水岸滩涂生态、栖息鸟类等。

习近平还察看当地特色农牧产品展示，了解主要品种和品质特点，鼓励当地加强产销衔接，促进农牧民增收致富。

他在考察途中说，中国幅员辽阔，东西南北中资源禀赋差异明显。“各地区要按照党中央战略决策和规划部署，树立和践行正确政绩观，完整准确全面贯彻新发展理念，紧跟时代潮流、抢抓发展机遇，立足自身条件、发挥比较优势，因地制宜推动高质量发展。”

据报道，中国副总理何立峰以及中央和国家机关有关部门负责人陪同考察。

据星岛头条此前报道，乌兰察布位于内蒙古中部，风能、太阳能资源丰富，廉价的绿色电力资源成为核心竞争优势。乌兰察布去年底出台《打造“Token之都”三年行动计划（2026-2028年）》，明确继续依托龙头企业，建设服务全国大模型训练及推理的绿色算力底座。

截至今年6月底，华为、阿里巴巴、腾讯、百度、字节跳动、DeepSeek（深度求索）、万润、中金数据、世纪互联、万博数据、中联亚信、苹果数据中心、中银保信数据等89个数据中心项目落户乌兰察布，总投资逾5000亿元人民币（955亿新元）。

content: 最近，我越来越觉得，澳洲留学生回国就业这件事，应该换一种思路了。以前大家讨论海归就业，总喜欢问：澳洲八大的学历，回国能不能打得过985、211？花几十万读一个硕士，回国能拿多少工资？世界排名前50的大学，国内企业到底认不认？ 但我觉得，这些问题可能从一开始就问错了。如果你拿着澳洲大学的毕业证书，回国去和985、211毕业生争同一批岗位，未必有多少优势。尤其是一些对国内实习经历、专业能力和本土行业资源要求很高的岗位，国内名校毕业生可能比你准备得更充分。 但换一条赛道，结果可能完全不同。我最近研究了一些海归就业方向，发现一个值得关注的变化：中国企业越来越需要懂海外市场的人，而这恰恰可能是澳洲留学生值得争取的机会。 今天这篇文章，我不想再空谈留学值不值得。我们来聊点实际的。澳洲留学生回国，到底可以进入哪些行业？应该找什么工作？哪些城市值得去？又该如何把自己的留学经历变成真正的竞争力？ 如果你在澳洲读的是商科、市场营销、传媒、国际商务，甚至是一些就业方向不太明确的文科专业，我建议认真研究一个方向：中国企业出海。 过去很多留学生回国，第一反应是找外企。但今天，中国企业本身也在不断拓展海外市场。跨境电商、消费电子、新能源汽车、智能硬件、互联网服务，都有企业在寻找国际业务人才。 这些企业需要什么样的人？不仅是英语好的人。还需要了解海外消费者、能够与国际客户沟通、理解不同市场商业习惯的人。比如海外市场专员、国际业务拓展、跨境电商运营、海外品牌营销、国际客户经理。这些都是值得搜索的岗位名称。尤其是深圳、杭州、广州等城市，有不少企业从事跨境业务。 举个很简单的例子，一家中国企业想把产品卖到澳洲。它需要了解当地消费者的购买习惯、产品表达方式、客户服务要求，以及如何与澳洲合作伙伴沟通。一个在澳洲生活过几年、英语不错、又懂市场营销的毕业生，确实可能比完全不了解当地市场的人更容易上手。 但请注意，这种优势不是自动产生的。在澳洲生活过，不等于真正懂澳洲市场。如果大学期间从来没有研究过当地商业环境，也没有任何相关项目经验，仅仅因为在澳洲待了三年，就认为自己适合做海外市场，那还是太乐观了。 我建议这类学生在毕业前，就开始研究澳洲本地品牌、消费者行为和跨境商业案例。最好能拿出一两个实际项目。这样回国面试的时候，你讲的就不再是“我英语很好”。而是我了解这个市场，也知道企业进入这个市场可能遇到什么问题。这两种表达的分量，完全不同。 这一条，我觉得特别值得澳洲工程专业的学生关注。很多人一提到工程专业回国就业，就想到设计院、研究院或者传统工程企业。然后开始担心自己能不能竞争过国内985、211的工程毕业生？ 但其实还有另一个方向，中国制造业正在参与全球竞争，而国际业务需要大量既懂技术、又能跨文化沟通的人。比如新能源汽车、储能、智能制造、工业设备、工程机械等行业。这些企业的海外业务，可能涉及技术支持、项目管理、供应链协调、国际采购、海外客户沟通。对于在澳洲读机械、电气、能源、土木、供应链等专业的学生来说，可以重点研究这些岗位。比如海外项目协调、国际供应链管理、海外技术支持、国际采购、海外销售工程师。重点关注上海、深圳、苏州、宁波、常州等制造业和国际业务比较集中的城市。 当然，不是说读过澳洲工程专业，就能直接胜任所有技术岗位。真正的工程技术能力、软件技能、行业知识，仍然是招聘的基础。但如果你既有技术背景，又能用英语处理专业沟通，甚至有澳洲本地项目经验，那么在一些国际业务岗位上，就可能形成自己的竞争优势。 不要只拿自己的海外学历去竞争国内工程师岗位，也可以研究哪些中国企业需要懂国际业务的工程师。这可能是两条完全不同的职业道路。 我发现，很多商科留学生回国以后，求职目标非常集中。金融专业想进券商、基金、银行。会计专业想进四大，这些当然是可以争取的方向。但问题是，这些岗位往往竞争激烈，而且非常看重学校背景、专业能力、实习经历和招聘批次。一张澳洲大学的毕业证书，不一定能让你脱颖而出。所以我反而建议大家，把目光放到一些更具体的国际业务岗位上。比如跨境支付、金融科技、国际合规、反洗钱、海外业务风险管理。这些岗位可能涉及国际资金流转、客户身份核验、交易风险识别、跨境业务流程等工作。 如果你在澳洲学过金融、会计、商业分析或者信息系统，又具备较好的英语能力，可以重点了解这些方向。求职时，可以搜索：国际支付运营、合规助理、反洗钱分析、跨境业务风控、国际客户服务。上海、深圳、杭州等城市，都值得关注。 但我也要提醒一句：国际金融业务不是英语好就能做，相关法律法规、数据能力和专业知识同样重要。如果在澳洲读书期间能够积累相关实习、数据分析项目，或者系统学习金融合规知识，回国以后才更有底气。 这一部分，我自己特别有感触。因为我以前做英语教学，现在也一直从事NAATI口笔译培训。这些年，我越来越觉得：英语好，和能够依靠英语获得高质量的职业发展，是两件事。 有些留学生在澳洲生活了几年，英语交流非常流利。但回国以后，发现自己并不知道应该找什么工作。尤其是教育、语言学、翻译、传媒等专业的毕业生。其实可以研究的方向不少。比如国际学校、国际课程教学、教育项目管理、国际教育合作、专业翻译、本地化服务，以及企业的国际传播岗位。 但我不建议大家简单地认为：我在澳洲留过学，所以回来教英语一定有优势。教学需要教学能力，翻译需要专业训练，国际教育项目需要对课程体系、招生和运营有实际了解。 尤其是现在，人工智能已经能够完成大量基础语言处理工作。单纯依靠英语能力获得高收入，可能越来越难。但如果你能把英语与某个专业领域结合起来，情况就不一样了。比如英语加法律，英语加医疗，英语加工程，英语加国际教育。 真正值得积累的，不是会说英语，而是能够用英语完成别人需要的专业工作。这也是我一直强调的语言能力与职业能力之间的区别。 这一条，我特别想讲给那些已经在澳洲生活多年的人。有些人好不容易拿到PR，后来因为家庭、职业发展或者其他原因，开始考虑回国。但一想到回国找工作，又有点迷茫。自己已经三十多岁了，国内的同龄人可能早就积累了多年工作经验。现在回去，还能竞争得过他们吗？ 我觉得，这时候最不应该做的，就是把自己重新当成一个普通应届毕业生。假设你在澳洲读完硕士，又在当地企业做了三年供应链管理。回国以后，如果只是拿着硕士毕业证书去申请初级岗位，那你可能浪费了自己最有价值的经历。因为你的优势，已经不只是学历，而是你真正参与过海外业务。 你可能熟悉当地供应商的合作方式。能够处理英文合同和业务沟通，了解海外项目如何推进，甚至积累了一定的客户资源。这些经验，对于正在拓展国际业务的中国企业，可能具有实际价值。 所以我建议，已经有澳洲工作经验的人，回国求职时应该重点研究国际项目管理、海外业务运营、区域市场管理等与自身经历匹配的岗位。PR本身不一定能帮你找到工作，但拿PR之前和之后积累的海外工作经验，可能可以。 另外还需要注意，如果打算长期回国，也要提前了解澳洲永久居民的旅行权限和未来返澳条件。不要把回国工作和保留澳洲长期居留选择，当成完全不需要规划的两件事。 真正聪明的留学生，应该在毕业前一年就开始布局。前面讲了这么多行业，我还想给准备回国的学生一些更具体的建议。 第一，别等毕业回国以后，才开始研究招聘市场。 很多国内企业的校园招聘有固定时间窗口。如果你准备回国就业，最好在毕业前半年到一年，就开始关注目标企业的招聘安排。尤其要留意海外毕业生的毕业时间要求、应届生认定规则，以及岗位是否接受海外学历。 第二，找工作的时候，别只搜索“海归优先”。 这个关键词的范围太窄了，你应该根据专业和能力，直接搜索具体岗位。比如海外市场、国际业务、跨境运营、海外项目、国际供应链。有些真正适合留学生的岗位，并不会在招聘信息里特别写明“海归优先”。 第三，简历里最不值钱的四个字，可能就是“国际视野”。 我发现很多留学生写简历，都特别喜欢写：具有国际视野，具备跨文化沟通能力，拥有良好的英语水平，但这些话，几乎每个留学生都可以写。真正能够让招聘方感兴趣的，是具体经历。比如你参与过什么项目？分析过什么市场？使用过哪些专业软件？与哪些团队合作过？最后取得了什么结果？企业招人，不是为了欣赏你的留学经历，而是希望你能解决问题。 第四，提前准备好学历认证和求职材料。 毕业以后，需要根据岗位要求准备教育部留学服务中心的学历学位认证、成绩单、毕业证明，以及相关实习或工作经历材料。 有些企业对海外毕业生的毕业时间和应届生资格有具体要求，一定要提前确认。别因为不了解招聘规则，错过本来有机会申请的岗位。 最后，我想重新谈谈澳洲留学的性价比 前几天，我们讨论过一个问题：澳洲留学到底适合什么样的家庭？我当时说，有些家庭只是希望孩子获得一份有认可度的海外学历，毕业以后有明确的回国发展方向。对于他们来说，澳洲大学的排名优势和多元入学路径，确实可能很有吸引力。 但今天我想把这个观点再往前推进一步。如果一个家庭既希望孩子获得海外名校学历，又希望他回国以后拥有更好的职业竞争力，那么从选专业开始，就应该研究中国企业到底需要什么样的国际化人才。 不是所有专业都适合走出海业务这条路，也不是所有留学生都应该回国。但至少，我们应该意识到：留学的价值，不只有移民这一种兑现方式。对于一些学生来说，澳洲可能不是职业发展的终点，而是进入国际化职业领域的起点。 当然，这并不意味着海归一定比985、211毕业生更有优势。国内优秀大学培养出来的学生，同样可能具备出色的英语能力、国际实习经历和专业技能。真正决定竞争力的，仍然是个人能力与岗位需求是否匹配。 但我觉得，澳洲留学生也没有必要总是拿自己的学历排名，去和国内名校毕业生硬碰硬。你真正应该寻找的，是那些能够发挥自己海外经历的岗位。因为一家企业最终愿意给你多少薪水，看的不是你曾经在哪个国家生活过。而是你能为它创造多少价值。

title: Hong Kong Customs youth visit Macau for exchange, WCO meeting
zh_title: 香港海关青年访澳交流及世界海关组织会议
summary: 香港海关旗下海关YES青年计划到访澳门进行文化教育交流，包括与澳门海关青年举办烘焙工作坊、参观海事指挥部、参加第36届WCO亚太区域会议等。此行旨在扩大参与者的全球视野 [![图1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编 2026年10月15日17:40 HKT·2分钟读香港海关带领一批海关YES青年计划成员
content:
香港
香港海关海关YES青少年计划到访澳门进行文化教育交流，包括与澳门海关青少年举办烘焙工作坊、参观海事指挥部，以及参加第36届世界海关组织亚太区域会议。此行旨在拓宽参与者的全球视野

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

2026 年 10 月 15 日 17:40 香港时间 · 阅读 2 分钟

香港海关周四宣布，香港海关率领一批海关YES青年计划成员前往澳门进行国际交流之旅，旨在加深两地年轻人之间的互动。

代表团首先与澳门海关“诚信守护者”青年计划成员一起参加葡式蛋挞烘焙工作坊，体验澳门独特的饮食文化，建立友谊。随后，他们参观了澳门海关海事司令部，并参观了海关船队，了解海关在维护海上安全、海上巡逻、打击走私等方面的执法工作。
为加深对澳门“一中心、一平台、一基地”的发展定位的了解，考察团参观了中国与葡语国家商贸合作服务平台展厅，了解中国与葡语国家的经贸合作以及澳门在促进交流中的桥梁作用。

在庆祝中华人民共和国成立77周年之际，代表团还参观了叶挺将军故居，学习革命先辈的英雄事迹和中国近代史，弘扬爱国主义精神。他们游览大三巴牌坊、大炮台、官也街等文化地标，体验澳门中西文化的交融。

香港海关以世界海关组织亚太区副主席身份，安排代表团参加在澳门举行的第36届世界海关组织亚太区联络会议。欢迎酒会上，海关YES成员接待了外宾，并首次与澳门青年代表共同举办活动，在区内海关代表面前展现了自信和责任。
特区政府表示，海关YES将继续配合国家“十五五”规划和香港第一个五年发展规划，举办丰富多彩的内地及国际交流活动，帮助年轻人拓宽全球视野，更好地融入国家发展。

[![图片3：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

主编

负责 CLB.org.hk 报道和编辑标准的主编。

【原文 English Original】
Hong Kong
Hong Kong Customs' Customs YES youth programme visited Macau for cultural and educational exchanges, including a baking workshop with Macau customs youth, a tour of the maritime command, and participation in the 36th WCO Asia-Pacific regional meeting. The trip aimed to broaden participants' global视野

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

15 Oct 2026 at 17:40 HKT · 2 min read

Hong Kong Customs led a group of Customs YES youth programme members on an international exchange trip to Macau, aimed at deepening interaction between young people in the two cities, the government announced on Thursday.

The delegation first joined members of Macau Customs' youth scheme, "Keepers of Integrity", in a Portuguese egg tart baking workshop, experiencing Macau's unique food culture and building friendships. They then visited the Macau Customs Marine Command and toured the customs fleet to learn about its law enforcement work in safeguarding maritime security, conducting sea patrols and combating smuggling.

To enhance understanding of Macau's development positioning as "one centre, one platform, one base", the group visited the China and Portuguese-speaking Countries Commercial and Trade Cooperation Service Platform exhibition hall, learning about economic and trade cooperation between China and Portuguese-speaking nations, and Macau's bridging role in promoting such exchanges.

Marking the 77th anniversary of the founding of the People's Republic of China, the delegation also visited the former residence of General Ye Ting, studying the heroic deeds of revolutionary forebears and modern Chinese history to foster patriotism. They toured cultural landmarks including the Ruins of St Paul's, the Mount Fortress and Rua do Cunha to experience Macau's blend of Chinese and Western cultures.

Hong Kong Customs, in its capacity as vice-chair of the Asia-Pacific region of the World Customs Organization, arranged for the delegation to participate in the 36th WCO Asia-Pacific Regional Contact Meeting held in Macau. During the welcome reception, Customs YES members received foreign guests and, for the first time, co-hosted the event with Macau youth representatives, showcasing confidence and responsibility before customs representatives from across the region.

Customs YES will continue to organise diverse mainland and international exchange activities in line with the national 15th Five-Year Plan and Hong Kong's first five-year development plan, helping young people broaden their global horizons and better integrate into national development, the government said.

title: West in nuclear fusion race with China, says UK atomic energy body
zh_title: 英国原子能机构称西方正在与中国进行核聚变竞赛

英国国家核聚变项目首席执行官表示，西方正在与中国竞相开发核聚变能源，他补充说，这项新兴技术的商业化可以说是“有史以来最重要的地缘政治事件之一”。

九月份就任英国原子能管理局（UKAEA）首席执行官的丹尼斯·怀特教授表示，英国拥有世界领先的核聚变项目，但[中国](https://www.ft.com/china)也在快速发展技术和供应链。

他在接受英国《金融时报》采访时表示：“一场新兴的竞赛已经出现，目前看来，这场竞赛本质上是中国与西方或与西方结盟的国家之间的竞赛。”

“我想说，根据我们所看到的情况，这实际上是一场相当不错的比赛。中国在令人惊讶的短时间内建立了一系列令人印象深刻的能力。”

怀特领导了麻省理工学院的核科学与工程系，并与他人共同创立了私营核聚变公司 Commonwealth Fusion Systems，该公司得到了比尔·盖茨的投资基金 Breakthrough Energy Ventures 的支持。
加拿大在核聚变发展的关键时刻承担了英国原子能机构的角色，核聚变涉及核聚变，将质量转化为能量，然后释放大量能量，用于驱动涡轮机发电。

卡勒姆的桅杆升级融合机© Tom Pilston/FT

这项技术已经发展了数十年，但由于产生和维持聚变所需的 1 亿摄氏度温度和高压的挑战（包括能源需求），一直难以走出实验室阶段。

在取得突破性进展后，它现在吸引了创纪录的资金，人们希望反应能够持续，并且核聚变可以在十年或更短时间内用于商业规模的发电。然而，这种乐观情绪因有关进展和有一天发电的价格是否被夸大的问题而受到影响。

怀特表示，例如，美国劳伦斯利弗莫尔国家实验室的国家点火装置在 2022 年达到的[净能量增益里程碑](https://www.ft.com/content/4b6f0fab-66ef-4e33-adec-cfc345589dc7?syn-25a6b1a6=1) 令人兴奋，当时他们的聚变反应产生的能量比发送的能量还要多直接影响核聚变，以及超导磁体的发展，这意味着聚变反应堆运行所需的电力更少。
工作人员正在为桅杆升级融合机接线© Tom Pilston/FT

他说：“我们正在谈论试图满足聚变能源的价格点，这本身就是我们领域的一个新启示。”他强调，在世界各国都在努力应对不断增长的能源需求和对能源安全的担忧之际，这一巨大的回报正在发挥作用。

他说，当核聚变在经济上变得可行时，“很难不说这是有史以来最重要的地缘政治事件之一，因为它以一种与其他能源非常不同的方式释放能源”。

据英国原子能机构称，与燃烧化石燃料相比，聚变每公斤燃料释放的能量大约高出 1000 万倍。

UKAEA 在 8 月份表示，科学

【原文 English Original】
Stay informed with free updates

Simply sign up to the Energy sector myFT Digest -- delivered directly to your inbox.

The west is in a race with China to develop nuclear fusion energy, according to the chief executive of the UK’s state fusion programme, who added that commercialising the nascent technology would arguably be “one of the most important geopolitical events ever”.

Professor Dennis Whyte, who became chief executive of the UK Atomic Energy Authority (UKAEA) in September, said the UK has world-leading fusion programmes but that [China](https://www.ft.com/china) was also rapidly developing both technology and supply chains.

“There is an emerging race which has occurred, and at this point it looks to be essentially the race is between China and the west, or western-aligned nations,” he told the FT in an interview.

“It is actually a pretty good race, I would say, based on what we’ve seen. China has an impressive set of capabilities that they have built up in a surprisingly short period of time.”

Whyte led the nuclear science and engineering department at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology and co-founded the private nuclear fusion company Commonwealth Fusion Systems, which is backed by Bill Gates’s investment fund Breakthrough Energy Ventures.

The Canadian has taken on the UKAEA role at a key moment for the development of nuclear fusion, which involves fusing nuclei to convert mass into energy, enormous amounts of which are then unleashed and can be used to drive a turbine to produce electricity.

The Mast Upgrade fusion machine in Culham© Tom Pilston/FT

The technology has been in development for decades but has struggled to get out of the laboratory stages due to the challenges — including energy demand — of creating and sustaining the required 100mn degrees Celsius temperatures and high pressures for fusion to take place.

It is now attracting record funding following breakthroughs that have raised hopes reactions can be sustained and fusion could be used to produce electricity at commercial scale within a decade or sooner. However, such optimism has been tempered by questions over whether progress and the price at which electricity could one day be produced are being overhyped.

Whyte said there was reason to be excited by, for example, the [net energy gain milestone](https://www.ft.com/content/4b6f0fab-66ef-4e33-adec-cfc345589dc7?syn-25a6b1a6=1) reached by the US’s National Ignition Facility at the Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory in 2022, when their fusion reaction produced more energy than had been sent directly to the nuclei being fused, as well as the development of superconducting magnets, which mean fusion reactors need less electricity to run.

Staff work on the wiring of the Mast Upgrade fusion machine© Tom Pilston/FT

“The mere fact that we’re talking about trying to meet price points for fusion energy is itself a new revelation in our field,” he said, highlighting the huge prize at play at a time when nations around the world are grappling with rising energy demand and concerns over energy security.

When fusion becomes economically viable, “it’s hard not to argue that it’s one of the most important geopolitical events ever because it unlocks energy in a way which is just very different from other kinds of energy sources”, he said.

Fusion can release roughly 10mn times more energy per kilogramme of fuel compared with burning fossil fuels, according to the UKAEA.

The UKAEA said in August that scientists had made breakthroughs in the pressure they could achieve inside its Mast Upgrade fusion machine in Culham, Oxfordshire.

The organisation’s subsidiary UK Fusion Energy, meanwhile, is aiming to develop by 2040 a prototype fusion power plant on the site of a former coal-fired power plant in West Burton, Nottinghamshire.

UKAEA is also working on challenges beyond just creating the fusion reaction, Whyte said, pointing to separate programmes to develop robotics to help maintain fusion reactors, reducing downtime, and to reuse scarce tritium fuel.

Scientists are also using artificial intelligence to help solve the technology’s challenges, he said, such as parsing the billions of permutations of different types of alloys that can help materials survive conditions inside the reactor.“Being able to use these tools is revolutionary,” he added.

消委会表示，今年截至8月的8个月内，共接获2,705宗有关商户客户服务的投诉，接近去年全年的投诉总数。该委员会表示，这些数字反映了商家客户服务质量与消费者期望之间的差距。
进一步分析发现，常见的投诉包括商户跟进不力、客服无法联系、态度粗鲁、反应缓慢等。在该委员会引用的一个案例中，一名投诉人通过一家公司的在线票务平台预订了五天后的一场活动的门票。由于天气预报不稳定，确认机票后无法取消，该客户向该公司在线人工智能客服询问，如果发出8号台风信号，是否可以改期。 AI服务回复称可根据当日情况改期门票，因此顾客以约港币400元购买了三张门票。

活动当天，八号台风信号发布，门票无法使用。当客户联系在线服务重新安排时，人工智能聊天机器人却无能为力。拨打热线电话无人接听，电子邮件和社交媒体消息也连续几天没有得到回复。该顾客最终向消委会求助并成功更改门票日期。

该委员会表示，人工智能的应用是必然趋势。人工智能客服和自助服务工具可以帮助提高处理查询和投诉的效率，但当消费者需要进一步帮助时，人工智能聊天机器人可能无法完全理解他们的需求，可能仍然需要人工支持。
该委员会建议引入人工智能的企业应向客户提供明确的指导，告诉他们如何有效地使用此类服务​​以及如何在必要时转移给人工代理。它还建议消费者注意商家提供的各种支持渠道和说明，保留沟通记录，如果人工智能客服没有帮助，可以考虑请求转接人工客服。

Hong Kong
Hong Kong's Consumer Council received 2,705 complaints about merchant customer service by August this year, nearing last year's total. It urged businesses using artificial intelligence chatbots to provide clear guidance and allow transfers to human agents when needed.

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

15 Oct 2026 at 10:52 HKT · 2 min read

The Consumer Council said it received 2,705 complaints about merchant customer service in the eight months to August this year, a figure close to the total number of complaints received for the whole of last year. The council said the numbers reflected a gap between the quality of merchant customer service and consumer expectations.

Further analysis found that common complaints included merchants failing to follow up, customer service being unreachable, rudeness and slow responses. In one case cited by the council, a complainant booked tickets through a company's online ticketing platform for an event five days later. Noting the weather forecast was unstable and that tickets could not be cancelled once confirmed, the customer asked the company's online artificial intelligence (AI) customer service whether tickets could be rescheduled if a No 8 typhoon signal was issued. The AI service replied that tickets could be rescheduled depending on the day's situation, so the customer bought three tickets for about HK$400.

On the event day, a No 8 typhoon signal was issued and the tickets could not be used. When the customer contacted the online service to reschedule, the AI chatbot could not help. Attempts to call the hotline went unanswered, and emails and social media messages also drew no response for several days. The customer eventually sought help from the Consumer Council and successfully changed the ticket date.

The council said the application of artificial intelligence is an inevitable trend. AI customer service and self-service tools can help improve the efficiency of handling enquiries and complaints, but when consumers need further assistance, AI chatbots may not fully understand their needs and human support may still be required.

The council recommended that businesses introducing AI should provide clear guidance to customers on how to use such services effectively and how to transfer to a human agent when necessary. It also advised consumers to note the various support channels and instructions provided by merchants, keep records of communication, and consider requesting a transfer to a human agent if AI customer service is not helpful.

content:
**第四十篇：从初信者到成熟的神人——为着新耶路撒冷**

**——经历神完整的救恩，在神圣生命里长大、变化、模成并得荣，成为基督的身体、新妇，终极完成新耶路撒冷**

**壹、神拯救我们的最终目的，是完成祂永远的经纶**

以弗所书一章九至十节：「照着祂的喜悦，使我们知道祂意愿的奥秘；这喜悦是祂在自己里面预先定下的，为着时期满足时的经纶，要将万有，无论是在诸天之上的，或是在地上的，都在基督里归一于一个元首之下。」

以弗所书三章九节：「并将那历世历代隐藏在创造万有之神里的奥秘有何等的经纶，向众人照明。」

这两处经文告诉我们，神作事不是没有目的的。在创世以前，神已经有一个永远的心意，就是要把祂自己分赐到祂所拣选、所救赎的人里面，使他们得着祂的生命，成为祂团体的彰显。

因此，我们需要认识：神的救恩不是终点，乃是神永远经纶在我们身上实行的开始。

我们得救以后，不应当只满足于罪得赦免、将来得着永远的福分，更需要认识神今天要在我们里面作什么。祂要把基督作到我们里面，使我们在生命里长大，并与众圣徒同被建造，成为基督的身体。

**生活中的例子**

一个孩子出生以后，父母不会只满足于孩子已经出生，更盼望他健康长大，逐渐成熟。照样，神使我们重生，不是要我们永远停留在属灵婴孩的阶段，乃是要我们在祂的生命里长大成熟。

属灵应用：

我们每天都需要向主祷告：「主啊，不要让我只停留在得救的经历里，求你使我天天在你的生命里长大。」

**贰、神完整的救恩，包括法理的救赎与生机的拯救**

罗马书三章二十四节：「但因神的恩典，借着在基督耶稣里的救赎，就白白地得称义。」

罗马书五章十节：「因为我们作仇敌的时候，且借着神儿子的死得与神和好，既已和好，就更要在祂的生命里得救了。」

这两处经文给我们看见，神完整的救恩包含两个彼此相关的方面。

**一、法理的一面——解决我们在神面前的罪案**

因着人的堕落，我们有罪，亏缺神的荣耀，也落在神公义的审判之下。但主耶稣在十字架上，为我们的罪受死，满足神公义的要求。

借着祂的救赎，我们得蒙赦罪、称义，并与神和好。这是神救恩法理的一面。

**二、生机的一面——使我们在神圣生命里得救**

罗马书五章十节进一步告诉我们：「……就更要在祂的生命里得救了。」这说明，神不仅借着基督的死解决我们的罪，也要借着基督复活的生命，在我们里面继续作拯救的工作。

这生机的拯救，包括重生、圣别、更新、变化、模成与得荣等方面。

法理的救赎，使我们在神面前蒙悦纳；生机的拯救，使我们在神的生命里逐渐变化，成为祂所要得着的人。

**生活中的例子**

一个人原本背负债务，后来有人替他清偿了全部债务。这解决了他的法律责任。但他还需要学习新的生活方式，才能真正过一种不同的生活。这个例子只能帮助我们有限地理解：基督的救赎解决了我们在神面前的罪案，而神生命的工作还要继续改变我们这个人。

属灵应用：

我们不仅要感谢主赦免了我们的罪，也要天天向祂敞开，让祂的生命在我们里面运行。

**叁、重生是神圣生命的开始，使我们成为神的儿女**

约翰福音三章六节：「从肉体生的，就是肉体；从那灵生的，就是灵。」

彼得前书一章三节：「……借耶稣基督从死人中复活，重生了我们，使我们有活的盼望。」

这两处经文告诉我们，我们相信主耶稣以后，不仅罪得赦免，更是从神而生，得着神圣的生命。重生不是改善旧生命，乃是接受一个新的生命，就是神自己的生命。

从前，我们只有受造之人的生命。如今，我们因着相信基督，得着了神圣、永远的生命，成为神的儿女。这就是基督徒生命经历的起点。

**生活中的例子**

一位初信者得救以后，发现自己开始喜欢读圣经，也愿意祷告、亲近主。这不是因为他突然变得完全，乃是因为神圣生命已经在他里面开始运行。

属灵应用：

我们需要认识，自己里面已经有神圣的生命，并学习天天照着这个生命的感觉生活。

**肆、生命长大的秘诀，是天天吃主、喝主、享受主**

约翰福音六章五十七节：「活的父怎样差我来，我又因父活着，照样，那吃我的人，也要因我活着。」

约翰福音七章三十七至三十八节：「……人若渴了，可以到我这里来喝。信入我的人，就如经上所说，从他腹中要流出活水的江河来。」

这两处经文告诉我们，基督不仅是我们的救主，也是我们生命的粮和生命的水。

一个婴孩要长大，必须天天吃喝。照样，我们在神圣生命里长大，也需要天天接受基督作生命的供应。我们怎样吃主、喝主、享受主呢？

主要是借着呼求主名、祷告、读经、祷读主话，并在日常生活中与主交通。我们不应当把读经只当作增加知识，也不应当把祷告只当作向神求东西。读经和祷告最宝贵的意义，是使我们接触这位活的基督，接受祂作生命的供应。

**生活中的例子**

一位弟兄每天早晨用十分钟读经。读到「主是我的牧者」时，他就简单祷告：「主耶稣，你是我的牧者。今天求你牧养我、引导我，使我在工作和家庭生活中经历你。」这样，他不仅明白经文，也借着主的话享受基督。

属灵应用：

每天建立简单、稳定的晨兴生活，借着祷告和主的话接受生命供应。

**伍、生命的长大，带进圣别、更新与变化**

帖撒罗尼迦前书五章二十三节：「且愿和平的神，亲自全然圣别你们，又愿你们的灵、与魂、与身子得蒙保守，在我们主耶稣基督来临的时候，得以完全，无可指摘。」

罗马书十二章二节：「不要模仿这世代，反要借着心思的更新而变化……」

哥林多后书三章十八节：「但我们众人既然以没有帕子遮蔽的脸，好像镜子观看并返照主的荣光，就渐渐变化成为与祂同样的形像，从荣耀到荣耀，乃是从主灵变化成的。」

这三处经文给我们看见，神圣生命在我们里面运行，会带进圣别、更新和变化。

**一、圣别——使我们在性质上归神并被神浸透**

圣别不仅是外面分别出来，更是神圣别的性情在我们里面作工，使我们的生活逐渐符合神的性情。

**二、更新——使我们的心思逐渐被神改变**

从前，我们习惯凭天然的观念、喜好和判断生活。但神要借着祂的话和那灵的工作，更新我们的心思，使我们学习照着祂的心意生活。

**三、变化——使我们里面的所是逐渐改变**

变化不是外面的修饰，也不是单靠意志改善行为。变化乃是神圣生命在我们里面运行，使我们逐渐彰显基督的形像。

**生活中的例子**

一位弟兄过去遇到不顺心的事，很容易发脾气。信主以后，他学习在情绪激动时呼求主名，向主祷告。经过一段时间，他发现自己不再像从前那样急躁，而是逐渐有了忍耐和温柔。这就是神圣生命在他里面变化的实际经历。

属灵应用：

当我们发现自己的天然脾气、观念或习惯显露出来时，不只努力改正，更要转向主，让祂的生命在我们里面运行。

**陆、生命成熟，就是基督成形在我们里面**

加拉太书四章十九节：「我的孩子们，我为你们再受生产之苦，直等到基督成形在你们里面。」

歌罗西书一章二十八节：「我们宣扬祂，是用全般的智慧警戒各人，教导各人，好将各人在基督里成熟地献上。」

这两处经文告诉我们，神所要得着的，不只是已经得救的人，更是在基督里成熟的人。生命成熟，不是指一个人懂得许多圣经知识，也不是指他在召会中服事多年。真正的成熟，乃是基督在我们里面逐渐成形，使我们的思想、感情、意志和生活越来越受基督支配。一个生命成熟的人，不再凡事只顾自己的喜好，乃是学习让基督作生命、作人位。

**生活中的例子**

一位弟兄从前遇到意见不同的人，总想证明自己正确。经过多年的生命经历，他逐渐学习先来到主面前祷告，愿意听取别人的意见，也愿意放下自己的坚持。这不是因为他失去了判断能力，乃是因为他学习让基督在里面掌权。

属灵应用：

我们需要天天向主祷告：「主啊，求你在我里面更多成形，使我不再单凭自己活着，乃是让你在我里面活着。」

**柒、神生机救恩的目标，是使我们模成神长子的形像**

罗马书八章二十九节：「因为神所预知的人，祂也预定他们模成神儿子的形像，使祂儿子在许多弟兄中作长子。」

罗马书八章三十节：「祂所预定的人，又召他们来；所召来的人，又称他们为义；所称为义的人，又叫他们得荣耀。」

这两处经文告诉我们，神拯救我们的目标，是使我们模成祂儿子的形像。基督是神的独生子，也是复活里神的长子。神借着重生，使我们成为祂的众子。

然后，祂继续在我们里面作工，使我们在生命和性情上越来越像基督。最终，在主回来时，神要使我们的身体得赎、改变形状，与基督荣耀的身体同形。这就是得荣。

因此，神完整的救恩，从重生开始，经过生命的长大、圣别、更新、变化和模成，最终达到得荣。神要得着的，不只是蒙赦罪的人，乃是一班在生命和性情上彰显基督的众子。

**生活中的例子**

一个孩子随着生命长大，逐渐显出父亲某些相似的特征。照样，我们既从神而生，神也要借着祂生命的工作，使我们越来越彰显基督。当然，这并不是说我们会成为神格中的神，乃是说我们在神圣生命和性情上有分于神。

属灵应用：

不要只追求外面的成功或属灵表现，更要追求让基督在我们里面长大，使我们逐渐模成祂的形像。

**捌、神圣生命的长大，不是为着个人属灵，乃是为着基督身体的建造**

以弗所书四章十五至十六节：「惟在爱里持守着真实，我们就得以在一切事上长到祂，就是元首基督里面；本于祂，全身借着每一丰富供应的节，并借着每一部分依其度量而有的功用，得以联络在一起，并结合在一起，便叫身体渐渐长大，以致在爱里把自己建造起来。」

这两节经文告诉我们，生命的长大与基督身体的建造有直接关系。我们不是单独追求属灵的人，乃是基督身体上的肢体。一个肢体生命长大，就应当更能够供应其他肢体。

因此，正常的基督徒生活，需要有召会生活。我们需要参加聚会、彼此交通、彼此代祷，并学习传福音、牧养新人、成全圣徒和申言。这就是前面所认识的神命定之路——生、养、教、建。

**生活中的例子**

一位弟兄刚得救时，只愿意接受别人的帮助。后来，他逐渐在生命里长大，开始关心新人，并学习在聚会中分享主的话。这样，他不仅自己得着供应，也开始成为供应别人的肢体。

属灵应用：

衡量生命长大，不应当只看自己明白多少真理，也要看我们是否越来越爱弟兄姊妹，并愿意供应基督、建造身体。

**玖、神完整救恩的终极完成，就是我们成为新耶路撒冷**

启示录二十一章二节：「我又看见圣城新耶路撒冷由神那里从天而降，预备好了，就如新妇妆饰整齐，等候丈夫。」

启示录二十一章九至十节：

天使对约翰说：「你来，我要将新妇，就是羔羊的妻，指给你看。」

随后，天使将约翰带到高大的山上，把圣城耶路撒冷指给他看。这里给我们看见一个极其重要的启示：新耶路撒冷不仅被称为一座城，也被称为羔羊的妻，就是基督的新妇。

因此，新耶路撒冷不能仅仅按照物质建筑来理解。按照这异象的属灵意义，新耶路撒冷是经过过程并终极完成的三一神，与祂所救赎、重生、变化并荣化之人的永远联结与团体彰显。

**一、精金——表征父神神圣的性情**

启示录二十一章十八节说：「城是纯金的，如同明净的玻璃。」精金表征神圣的性情，说明这座城完全与神的性情相符。

**二、珍珠——表征基督借着死与复活所产生的生命结果**

启示录二十一章二十一节告诉我们，十二个门是十二颗珍珠。从属灵预表的角度看，珍珠指向基督借着死与复活，使我们得以进入神圣建造的经历。

**三、宝石——表征那灵变化的工作**

启示录二十一章十九节告诉我们，城墙的根基是用各样宝石装饰的。宝石表征蒙救赎的人经过神圣生命变化的工作，成为适合神建造的材料。

**四、生命水的河与生命树——表征三一神永远作生命供应**

启示录二十二章一至二节：约翰看见一道生命水的河，从神和羔羊的宝座流出来；河的两边有生命树，供应生命。

这给我们看见，新耶路撒冷不是一个缺少生命的外在建筑。整座城充满神圣生命的供应与流通。神自己是这座城的生命、内容、供应和荣耀。

因此，我们需要清楚认识：新耶路撒冷不是仅仅一个将来供我们进入的物质天堂，乃是神永远经纶的终极完成，是三一神与祂所救赎、变化并荣化之人的团体构成。我们今天在基督里重生、长大、变化，并在身体里被建造，就是有分于这个终极完成的过程。最终，我们要成为新耶路撒冷，作神与羔羊永远的团体彰显。

**拾、从初信者到成熟的神人，需要天天过神人的生活**

加拉太书二章二十节：「我已经与基督同钉十字架；现在活着的，不再是我，乃是基督在我里面活着……」

腓立比书一章二十一节：「因为在我，活着就是基督，死了就有益处。」

这两处经文告诉我们，正常基督徒生活的中心，就是基督在我们里面活着。

神人生活不是指我们成为具有神格、可以接受敬拜的神。乃是指我们这些蒙神重生的人，借着神圣生命和那灵的供应，学习否认己、凭基督而活，在日常生活中彰显神的性情。

我们需要在家庭、工作、召会和人际关系中学习活基督。当我们面对困难时，学习祷告。当我们受到冒犯时，学习转向主。当我们遇到软弱的圣徒时，学习用基督的爱顾惜他们。当我们参加聚会时，学习供应基督，建造身体。这就是神人生活的实际实行。

**生活中的例子**

一位弟兄在家庭中遇到意见冲突。从前，他习惯坚持自己的想法。现在，他学习先向主祷告，求主使自己安静下来，并愿意听取家人的意见。这样的经历虽然平常，却是学习凭基督而活的实际操练。

属灵应用：

每天早晨向主祷告：「主耶稣，今天不要让我单凭自己活着，求你在我里面活，使我在一切事上彰显你。」

**拾壹、简短应用祷告**

「哦，主耶稣！感谢你拯救我、重生我，使我得着你的生命。主啊，不要让我停留在属灵婴孩的阶段，求你使我天天享受你，在生命里长大，经历圣别、更新、变化，并模成你的形像。也求你使我与众圣徒一同被建造，成为你的身体和新妇，最终成为新耶路撒冷，作你永远的彰显。阿们！」

title: 北京称台湾向中国渔船动用水炮须“承担后果”，台湾强调“正常执法”

content:
中国政府一位发言人星期三(10月14日)表示，台湾海巡部门必须为在南中国海某环礁附近水域向一艘中国渔船使用高压水炮“承担后果”。台湾则表示，台湾海巡署只是履行“正常执法”任务，台湾国安官员指出，中国在这些区域采取了“侵略性行动”。

与此同时，台湾国防部报告说，中国军方星期三在台湾周边进行了又一次所谓的“联合战备警巡”。

本月早些时候，一艘台湾海巡船对滞留在台湾控制的南中国海东沙群岛，西方称普拉塔斯群岛(Pratas Islands)附近限制水域并拒绝离开的中国大陆渔船使用了高压水炮。这艘渔船随后发动机故障，由另一艘中国渔船将其拖离。

中国国务院台湾事务办公室发言人陈斌华在星期三举行的记者会上被问及此事时声称，中国对东沙及其邻近水域拥有“无可争辩的主权”，而且中国大陆船只在相关海域的活动“完全合法正当”。

陈斌华指责台湾的民进党当局“顽固坚持台独分裂立场”，“以危险方式粗暴对待大陆船舶”，“必须承担由此引发的一切后果。”

但是他并没有透露或说明所谓的“一切后果”到底是什么。

东沙群岛位于台湾南部和香港之间，长期以来一直由台湾控制。岛上没有常住平民，但建有简易跑道和国家公园。负责东沙岛安全守卫的是台湾的海巡署而不是军方。由于东沙群岛距离台湾本岛超过400公里，因此安全专家担心这里很容易遭到中国的攻击。

中国不仅声称拥有几乎整个南中国海及其所有岛礁的主权，而且坚称实行民主治理的台湾也是其“不可分割”的领土，即使诉诸武力也要实现台海两岸的统一。

此次东沙群岛海域发生的摩擦之所以引入注目，另一个重要的原因是中国海警在南中国海的争议海域经常对菲律宾的公务船或渔船使用高压水炮，导致菲方船只受损，甚至人员受伤。

台湾行政院院长卓荣泰10月5日对台湾海巡船对大陆渔船使用水炮一事对外做出以下说明。

“发射水炮是不得不为。如果侵犯我国主权，执法人员要保卫国家安全，”卓荣泰说。

路透社援引一位了解东沙群岛周边局势的台湾官员的话说，台湾海巡部门在事件中执行了“正常执法”任务，并以“非常谨慎且适度”的方式进行了应对。

最近几年，随着北京针对台湾的军事威胁愈演愈烈，中方也逐渐扩大使用“灰色地带”战术，就是在不直接诉诸军事行动的情况下使用准军事的海警船、伪装成渔船的民兵船、甚至科考船向台湾施压。

台湾国家安全会议副秘书长李问星期三在台北出席一场论坛时表示，数十年来，中国的扩张野心在区域内采取侵略性行动。

“这些处于冲突门槛之下的‘灰色地带’活动引发了严重关切，因为它们可能扰乱交通运输或破坏关键基础设施，”李问说。

路透社上周四援引台湾民营航空业者安捷航空(Apex Aviation)的监控报告，指今年8月中旬，该公司自营的侦察机在距离台湾东部花莲海岸约50公里处，发现中国民兵船“闵福鼎渔07902”与一艘中国海警船和一艘中国科研船共同航行。

这是首次在该海域发现中国此类型的船只。

美国国务院一位发言人上周五在回答美国之音(VOA)电邮置评请求时表示，“美国对中国在台湾以东的活动持续感到关切。”

“中国的行动深度破坏稳定。中国对台湾已和平管理70余年的海域宣示权威，这只会加剧紧张局势，并破坏其声称寻求的和平解决问题的努力，”这位发言人指出。

发言人还说，“我们敦促北京停止对台湾的压力，转而与台湾民选当局进行有意义的对话。”

与此同时，台湾国防部星期三指出，中国军方当天在台湾周边进行了又一次“联合战备警巡”，出动了包括歼-16战斗机在内的13架军机以及数量不详的海军舰艇。

中国国防部当天稍早表示，辽宁舰及其编队正在西太平洋进行演练，但未透露具体细节。

title: Hong Kong health experts back low-risk assessment after Russian lab death
zh_title: 香港卫生专家支持俄罗斯实验室死亡后的低风险评估
summary: 香港传染病专家同意政府在一名女工作人员在高度戒备的俄罗斯实验室因不明肺炎死亡后做出的低公共卫生风险评估。已进行超过 5,500 次检测，未发现任何高致病性微生物。 [![图片 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编 2026 年 10 月 17 日 17:44 HKT · 3 分钟阅读香港面孔死亡后直接公共卫生风险较低
content:
香港
香港传染病专家同意政府在一名女工作人员在高度戒备的俄罗斯实验室因不明肺炎死亡后做出的低公共卫生风险评估。已进行超过 5,500 次检测，未发现任何高致病性微生物。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

香港时间 2026 年 10 月 17 日 17:44 · 阅读时间 3 分钟

据当地传染病专家称，俄罗斯一个高度戒备的实验室一名女工作人员死于不明原因肺炎，香港面临的直接公共卫生风险较低。

临床专家对卫生部的低风险评估表示强烈同意，指出俄罗斯当局已经进行了5500多项实验室检测，并对死者的200多名密切接触者进行了筛查。目前尚未发现高致病性微生物或引起鼠疫的细菌，目前也没有出现人际传播或更广泛社区爆发的迹象，这意味着居民无需恐慌或囤积防护口罩。
该事件的主要不确定性源于俄罗斯实验室未能公开识别具体病原体，再加上该高度安全的设施正在积极对引起鼠疫的细菌进行研究。在临床上，鼠疫以三种不同的形式出现。腺鼠疫是最常见的变种，占所有病例的 50% 至 80%，主要通过受感染的啮齿动物跳蚤叮咬传播，导致淋巴结严重肿胀。

肺鼠疫可通过呼吸道飞沫在人与人之间传播，但其传播速度明显慢于 Covid-19 或流感，需要在 6 英尺半径内长时间、密切接触。感染血液的败血性鼠疫仍然是最严重和最致命的形式。与病毒感染不同，如果在症状出现后关键的 48 小时内使用标准的、广泛使用的抗生素，细菌性鼠疫可以成功治疗。

自20世纪初以来，香港没有记录到鼠疫本地病例，政府对当地啮齿动物种群保持严格的例行监测。
另外，香港今年已录得超过30宗MPO病例，自八月暑假开始以来感染人数显着增加。上升趋势与假期期间出行增加以及大湾区内跨境流动频繁密切相关，这增加了高风险人群亲密接触时的传播风险。

卫生专家表示，目前没有科学证据表明MPOX病毒已经突变或改变了其主要传播方式。政府不应强制关闭高风险场所，而应优先开展有针对性的教育活动，并鼓励社会活动前后自愿接种疫苗。 mpox 的接触者追踪仍然非常具有挑战性，因为许多患者通过匿名约会应用程序认识他们的伴侣，并且不拥有他们的永久联系方式。卫生当局正在考虑设立专门的热线电话，允许感染者匿名通知过去的伴侣

【原文 English Original】
Hong Kong
Hong Kong infectious disease specialists agree with the government's low public health risk assessment following a female staff member's death from unidentified pneumonia at a high-security Russian laboratory. Over 5,500 tests have been conducted with no highly pathogenic microorganisms identified.

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

17 Oct 2026 at 17:44 HKT · 3 min read

Hong Kong faces a low direct public health risk following the death of a female staff member from unidentified pneumonia at a high-security laboratory in Russia, according to local infectious disease specialists.

Clinical experts expressed strong agreement with the Department of Health’s low-risk assessment, pointing out that Russian authorities have already conducted over 5,500 laboratory tests and screened more than 200 close contacts of the deceased. No highly pathogenic microorganisms or plague-causing bacteria have been identified so far, and there are currently no signs of human-to-human transmission or a wider community outbreak, meaning residents have no need to panic or stockpile protective masks.

The main uncertainty surrounding the incident stems from the Russian laboratory's failure to publicly identify the specific pathogen, combined with the fact that the high-security facility actively conducts research on plague-causing bacteria. Clinically, the plague presents in three distinct forms. Bubonic plague is the most common variant, accounting for 50 to 80 per cent of all cases, and is transmitted primarily through the bites of infected rodent fleas, causing severely swollen lymph nodes.

Pneumonic plague can be transmitted between humans through respiratory droplets, though its transmission rate is significantly slower than Covid-19 or influenza, requiring prolonged and close contact within a 6-foot radius. Septicemic plague, which infects the bloodstream, remains the most severe and lethal form. Unlike viral infections, bacterial plague can be successfully treated with standard, widely available antibiotics if administered within a critical 48-hour window from the onset of symptoms.

Hong Kong has not recorded a local case of the plague since the early 20th century, and the government maintains strict, routine surveillance of local rodent populations.

Separately, Hong Kong has recorded more than 30 cases of mpox this year, with a significant increase in infections observed since the start of the summer holidays in August. The upward trend is closely linked to increased travel during the holiday season and frequent cross-border movements within the Greater Bay Area, which elevated transmission risks during intimate encounters among high-risk groups.

Health experts stated that there is currently no scientific evidence suggesting that the mpox virus has mutated or altered its primary modes of transmission. Rather than enforcing mandatory closures of high-risk venues, the government should prioritise targeted educational campaigns and encourage voluntary vaccinations before and after social activities. Contact tracing for mpox remains highly challenging because many patients meet their partners through anonymous dating applications and do not possess their permanent contact details. Health authorities are considering dedicated hotlines to allow infected individuals to anonymously notify past partners to undergo testing, helping to break transmission chains while safeguarding privacy.

[![Image 3: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

Editor in Chief

content: 世界，已经进入新科技阶段 科技材料的核心，就是稀土。 稀土对于高科技行业，极为重要。 稀土元素是电动汽车、国防系统等先进技术的关键组成部分 已成为当代地缘政治竞争的核心 几十年来，东大一直主导着稀土元素的生产和加工 过去二十年间，东大持续在关键矿产加工领域投入，几乎垄断全球稀土加工供应链。 在这种背景下，澳大利亚凭借其丰富的矿产资源和发达的采矿业 在向全球市场供应稀土方面发挥着至关重要的作用。 澳洲富含重稀土，相关材料可用于弹道导弹、核动力潜艇与战斗机，项目投产后有望打破中国在关键矿产领域的供应优势。 北方矿业公司2006 年在澳上市，战略价值突出，项目具备潜力打造全球规模最大的稀土产能。 对于西方国家来说，澳洲北方矿业公司在打破东大对关键矿产供应链的主导地位的努力中扮演重要角色。 北方矿业公司g公司的股东，有不少是中资背景！ 而最近发生的一些事情，让中澳关系有开始紧张！ 澳洲政府，强迫中资退出澳洲稀土矿！ 澳大利亚政府已勒令澳洲稀土公司北方矿业公司的数名股东出售其部分或全部股份 等于说是迫使有中资背景的投资者退出这家关键矿物企业。 财政部长查尔默斯下令六名与中国有关联的股东剥离其在北方矿业公司的股份，勒令六名股东剥离在该公司的特定权益 澳洲工党政府已两次下达指令 要求六名中国投资者出售所持价值 4000 万澳元股份，限期为 7 月 2 日前。 但这六名投资者并未遵照执行，包括中资背景投资者 其中一位东大投资者曾试图推翻该公司的领导层，但最终失败。 迫使中资退出澳洲矿产，此举是为了保护澳大利亚的“国家利益”并“确保遵守其外国投资框架” 北方矿业公司是美国和澳洲联手打破中国对关键矿产供应链主导地位的重要一环。 查默斯国库部长进一步介入 说中资无视了澳大利亚《外国收购与兼并法》 此前下达的出售北方矿业公司股份的命令，中资并没有实施，选择无视 因此他现在剥夺这些股东的大部分权利，只保留了出售权。 我们希望在澳大利亚投资的外国公司遵守澳大利亚的法律。” “我们将采取一切必要措施，保护国家利益和我们外国投资框架的完整性。” 10月14日，玛德琳·金演讲时说 东大投资者迟迟不按要求出售股份 政府不排除将这家总部位于珀斯的稀土企业收归国有。 由于与东大有关联的投资者未能撤资，稀土公司或将被国有化。 澳大利亚加强对与 东大 有关联的稀土投资者的审查 北方矿业公司被视为开发镝和铽替代资源的关键力量，而镝和铽是可再生能源和军事技术领域的重要资源。 被视为美国和澳大利亚打破东大对关键矿产供应链控制的关键参与者。 玛德琳 ·金周三在国家新闻俱乐部表示 “这是地球上最重要的重稀土矿藏之一，因此对我们、对我们的国家利益和国家安全意义重大。”
